meta.title: VORTEX — Ciden min bɛ jamana kɔnɔ P2P

hero.sub: Discovery & verification controller ka ɲɛsin Vortex ɲɔgɔndan rezo ma. Ka dayɛlɛ. A sirilen don. A tɛ se ka bali.

network.label: NETWORK Bamako
network.body: A ɲɔgɔnna bɛɛ bɛ ni danyɔrɔ ye min bolonɔ bilalen bɛ a la. Clients bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ sani u ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ, nodes bɛ tigiya jira u tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni waati. Cɛmancɛ-fanga si tɛ se ka fɛn min kɛ, o ye nkalon ye, kriptografi ye min Sɛmɛntiya kaban.
network.dual_body: A tɔgɔ sɛbɛnna controleur AND la min sirilen bɛ cakɛda kan Solana fɛ. Seere yɛrɛmahɔrɔnyalen fila bɛ code hash ni pubkey Sɛmɛntiya. A lakananen don kalansenw kama minnu bɛ kɛ ni hakili ye.
network.ctrl_body: Siginiden b’a Jira ko node (node) ye a ka privé key (kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la) tigi ye, nka code integrity (kode dafalen tɛ ankɔri on-chain) la. Alamaɲi ka ɲɛsin kalan fanba ma; farati = ka da kɔrɔsilikɛla baarakɛla la.
network.unverif_body: A bɛ dɔn ka bɔ config walima gossip fɛ. Dalilu kriptografiki si ma sɔrɔ fɔlɔ. Baara kɛ ni a ye dɔrɔn ka bootstrap peer list — abada i n’a fɔ handoff target for live sessions.

security.label: SECURITY Bamako
security.body: Ed25519 kilisi yɛrɛmahɔrɔnyalen naani, u kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ ni baara fitinin kelen ye. Ni i ye bɛnkan kɛ kilisi kelen o kelen na, o tɛ tɔw tiɲɛ.
security.controller_verified: Clients — ka bɔ SNS walima ka pinɛ jɔ
security.node_verified: Kontrɔla — ka ɲɛsin mɔgɔ tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni ma
security.step1_d: Aw ye vortexx.sol kalan cakɛda kan. Disiki minnu bolonɔ bilala Solana portefeuille fɛ — a tɛ se ka DNS-hijack.
security.step2_d: Client ka weleli /v1/integrity. A bɛ ban jaabi si la fo status: verified ka bɔ bɔli kilisi pinɛlen na.
security.step3_d: API weleli bɛɛ bɛ segin {payload, sig, signed_by} ma. Client bɛ Ed25519 bolonɔbila sɛgɛsɛgɛ ka sɔrɔ ka da a la.
security.step4_d: Nodes sirilenw : kliyan bɛ code_hash kalan ka bɔ Solana sɛbɛnnikɛlan na. Divergence from controller = a bɛ lisi nɛrɛma la kudayi.
security.check_auth: Jaabi tiɲɛni — a tɛ se ka kɛ ka /v1/nodes forge ni controleur ka privé key tɛ.
security.check_integrity: Code integrity — controleur files hashed ani cross-checked daminɛ bɛɛ la. Tampering bɛ segin 503 kan sanni sirako si ka baara kɛ.
security.check_identity: Node identity — node ka kan ka bolonɔ bila sɛbɛnni na n’u yɛrɛ ka kilisi ye. Binkannikɛla tɛ Se k'a tɔgɔ Sɔrɔ node wɛrɛ ka pubkey tɔgɔ la.
security.check_dns: DNS hijack lakanani — .sol ka sɛbɛnw bɛ ɲɛnamaya Solana kan. Kɛlɛɲɔgɔn ka kan ka waribɔsɛbɛn tiɲɛ, a man kan ka DNS sɛbɛnnikɛla dɔrɔn.
security.check_handoff: Handoff security — session transfers bɛ Ed25519 bolonɔbila tokenw ta ni anti-replay ye, minnu bɛ baara kɛ miniti 5 dɔrɔn kɔnɔ. Target bɛ ban sɔrɔyɔrɔ dɔnbaliw la.
security.check_transport: Transport danbe — jɛɲɔgɔnya URL min bɛ ye i ka ISP / Cloudflare fɛ. Baara kɛ ni Tor filɛlikɛlan ye ni metadata nafa ka bon.
security.check_content: Cikan kɔnɔkow — NOT magara a ɲɛminɛbaga fɛ. A laban-ni-dakun min bɛ siri baarakɛlaw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ. Kontrɔla tɛ se ka foyi kalan hali ni a bɛ bɔnɛ a la kosɛbɛ.
security.check_host: Host OS / kernel — ni VPS ye jiri ye, konnɛgɛw bɛ se ka sonya. Baara kɛ ni bolonɔbila ye min bɛ dɛmɛn ni fɛnɲɛnamafagalanw ye walasa ka paranoid deployments (paranoid deployments) kɛ.

access.label: ACCESS Bamako
access.heading_line1: A bɛ se ka sɔrɔ tuma bɛɛ.
access.body: Donda caman kɔrɔ ye ko fɛn kelen si tɛ se k’i ka dondaw bali. Miirili yɔrɔw bɛ baara kɛ ni kunnafoni bolonɔbilalen kelenw ye ka bɔ fɛnsɔrɔsiraw yɛrɛmahɔrɔnyalenw na.
access.tunnel_body: *.trycloudflare.com ladɛrɛsi fu. Jatebɔ si tɛ wajibiya. URL bɛ Changé ni tunnel daminɛna kokura — aw bɛ a minɛ i n’a fɔ waati dɔɔnin dɔrɔn.
access.tor_body: .soja ladɛrɛsi, min bɛ se ka sɔrɔ Tor dɔrɔn fɛ. Censor-proof ani metadata-privé, nka a ka surun. A mago bɛ Tor kliyan dɔ la.
access.ipfs_body: Kɔnɔkow ladɛrɛsi kopi min bɛ ɲɛfɛla jɔlen na. IPFS dakun o dakun bɛ se ka baara kɛ n’a ye — sɛriwusida kelen tɛ yen min bɛ se ka bali.
access.direct_body: Domɛni basigilen + TLS. Sugandili teliyalenba. Blockable at DNS/IP level — ka segin ka bin mɔgɔ wɛrɛw kan ni censure kɛra.
access.mirrors_body: Jatigila wɛrɛw minnu bɛ baara kɛ ni kɔnɔkow bolonɔbilalen kelen ye tigitigi ni nin kunnafonisɛbɛn in ye. Miirili kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛ tuma ni tuma — yɔrɔ jɛman kɔrɔ ye ko i bɛ se ka se miniti 5 labanw kɔnɔ. Tor .onion filɛlikɛlanw tɛ se ka kɛnɛya-sɛgɛsɛgɛ ni sigida Tor proxy tɛ.

start.label: GET STARTED
start.heading_line1: Aw ka don o réseau kɔnɔ
start.step1: I ka Vortex sigi i ka minɛn kɔnɔ — telefɔni selilɛri walima tabali kan.
start.step3: Aw bɛ controleur URL (auto-resolved via SNS) walima entry URL o URL nɔrɔ ka bɔ Entries ɲɛ la.
start.step4: Aw ye a sɛgɛsɛgɛ ko pubkey min bɛ aw ka app kɔnɔ, o bɛ bɛn controleur bolokɔfɛfɛn ma min bɛ duguma. Ni bɛnbaliya kɔrɔ ye ka fɛn dɔ sɛgɛsɛgɛ.
start.step5: Aw ye jεɲɔgɔnya ye. Node list, signatures ani routing bɛ ɲɛnabɔ otomatiki la.
start.fingerprint_note: Aw bɛ nin kilisi in don aw ka kiliyan na sani aw ka da jaabi si la.

treasury.label: TREASURY & REWARDS .
treasury.transparency_body: Protocole sara bɛɛ — node register sara ani 20% tigɛ premium abonnés — bɛ woyo ka taa nafolomarayɔrɔ la Solana kan. Jago bɛɛ bɛ se ka sɛgɛsɛgɛ foroba la mɔgɔ bɛɛ fɛ.
treasury.rewards_body: 70% premium sub kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ taa sara pooli la, o bɛ tila pro-rata ka di active node operators ma. 20% bɛ nafolo di yiriwali jɔnjɔnw ma. 10% bɛ jeni walima ka sigi i n’a fɔ asiransi.

gravitixDocs.title: Gravitix Kanko ɲɛfɔli
gravitixDocs.subtitle: Scripting kan min bɛ baara Kɛ kosɛbɛ botw jɔli kama. 96 ye fɛnw ye. Rust kɔkanna.
gravitixDocs.introDesc: Gravitix ye kan ye min bɛ Weele ko domaine-specific kan (DSL) min Dabɔra ka Bɔ duguma Vortex bots sɛbɛnni kama. Kan wɛrɛw bɛ gafemarayɔrɔw, weleseginw, ani boilerplate wajibiya yɔrɔ minnu na, Gravitix bɛ ko kɛlenw ɲɛnabɔbaga fɔlɔw di i ma, baro taabolo, ani cogoya jɔlen — o bɛɛ bɛ kɛ daɲɛgafe saniyalen na, min bɛ se ka kalan, min lawulila Rust fɛ.
gravitixDocs.goalReadable: Kalan — kode bɛ kalan i n’a fɔ laɲini, a tɛ kalan i n’a fɔ masinw
gravitixDocs.goalSafe: Safe — static types bɛ filiw minɛ ka kɔn boli waati ɲɛ
gravitixDocs.goalExpressive: Expressive — flows, guards, ani pattern matching bɛ don a kɔnɔ
gravitixDocs.goalMinimal: Minimal — kalan tɛ, ciyɛn tɛ, karamɔgɔya tɛ yen ka kalan
gravitixDocs.whoIsThisFor: Nin ye jɔn de ta ye?
gravitixDocs.whoDesc: Gravitix ye mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ ye min b’a fɛ ka Vortex bot jɔ joona — i ma deli ka kode sɛbɛn fɔlɔ, walima i ye baarakɛla ŋana ye min sɛgɛnnen don Python boilerplate la. Nin kunnafoni in bɛ Gravitix kalan ka bɔ sariyakolo fɔlɔw la: ko dɔnniya si tɛ wajibiya ka kɔn o ɲɛ.
gravitixDocs.howToReadDesc: Dakun kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ sinsin tɛmɛnenw kan. N’i ​​ye mɔgɔ kuraw ye porogaramuw dilanni na, i ka kalan kɛ ka bɔ sanfɛ ka taa duguma. N’i ​​bɛ kan wɛrɛ dɔn kaban, baara kɛ ni kɔnɔkow tabali ye walasa ka pan ka ɲɛsin fɛn ma min ka di i ye.
gravitixDocs.quickStartDesc: Sira teliyalen min bɛ Bɔ zeru la ka Taa bot bolilen na.
gravitixDocs.whatHappenedDesc: on /start { ... } — bɛ handler dɔ ɲɛfɔ min bɛ baara kɛ ni baarakɛla ye /start ci. emit "..." — bɛ cikan ci ka segin baarakɛla ma. {ctx.first_name} — a bɛ baarakɛla tɔgɔ fɔlɔ don sɛrɛ kɔnɔ.
gravitixDocs.runningDesc: Gravitix IDE kɔnɔ, i ka Run butɔni digi sanfɛyɔrɔ la. Aw bɛ aw ka Vortex Bot Token don ni ɲininkali kɛra a la. Bot bɛ daminɛ o yɔrɔnin bɛɛ — jɔli sen si mago tɛ.
gravitixDocs.syntaxDesc: Gravitix porogaramu bɛɛ jɔlen bɛ ka bɔ jɔli jɔnjɔn saba la: handlers, emit statements ani logic.
gravitixDocs.whatGoesAfterOn: Min bɛ taa ɲɛ o kɔfɛ
gravitixDocs.whatGoesAfterEmit: Fɛn min bɛ taa emit kɔfɛ
gravitixDocs.multipleHandlers: Handler caman ka ɲɛsin trigger kelen ma
gravitixDocs.declaringDesc: Baara kɛ ni let daɲɛ koloma ye.
gravitixDocs.typesDesc: Gravitix nafa bɛɛ bɛ ni suguya ye. Suguda sitɛmu bɛ yɔrɔ kelen na: suguyaw bɛ lajɛ daɲɛgafe waati la, sanni i ka bot ka baara.
gravitixDocs.optionalTypes: Sugu suguya minnu bɛ se ka sugandi T?
gravitixDocs.operatorsDesc: Baarakɛlaw bɛ nafaw fara ɲɔgɔn kan walasa ka nafa kuraw bɔ.
gravitixDocs.assignmentOps: Baarakɛlaw minnu bɛ baara kɛ ni baara ye
gravitixDocs.logicalOps: Operateurs logique (baarakɛlaw) minnu bɛ hakili la
gravitixDocs.stringsDesc: Gravitix kɔnɔ sɛrɛkiliw ye UTF-8 kode sɛbɛn ye. U bɛ dɛmɛ don interpolation riche (interpolation) ma ani suite (baarakɛminɛnw) minnu bɛ don a kɔnɔ.
gravitixDocs.escapeSequences: Bololabaara kɛcogo minnu bɛ tugu ɲɔgɔn na
gravitixDocs.stringOperations: String baarakɛcogo minnu bɛ Kɛ ni built-ins ye
gravitixDocs.controlFlow: Contrôle Flow (Fɔcogo min bɛ wele ko Contrôle).
gravitixDocs.matchDesc: Pattern-match nafa dɔ ka kɛɲɛ ni patɔrɔn caman ye. Miiri k’a filɛ i n’a fɔ switch (switch) kumasen barikama.
gravitixDocs.functionsDesc: Baarakɛcogo ye kode blokiw ye minnu bɛ se ka baara kɛ kokura. U b’i dɛmɛ i kana segin-ka-bɔnye kɛ ani ka kode faamuyali nɔgɔya.
gravitixDocs.eventHandlersDesc: Handlers ye Gravitix bot dusukun ye. Baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ ko sugu kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen dɔ lamɛn, wa a bɛ boli n’o ko kɛlen kɛra.
gravitixDocs.guardDesc: Garadiw b’a to i ka sarati dɔ fara minɛbaga dɔ kan. Handler bɛ boli dɔrɔn ni garadi ye jateminɛ kɛ ka kɛ tiɲɛ ye.
gravitixDocs.contextDesc: ctx fɛn bɛ sɔrɔ a yɛrɛma minɛbaga bɛɛ kɔnɔ. Kunnafoni bɛ sɔrɔ a kɔnɔ cikan min bɛ sen na sisan ani baarakɛla min y’a ci.
gravitixDocs.stateDesc: Jamana b’a to i ka bot hakili ka to fɛnw na cikanw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ. Ni jamana tɛ, cikan bɛɛ ye yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya ye wa bot hakili tɛ.
gravitixDocs.flowsDesc: Flows b’a To i bɛ se ka barow sɛbɛn minnu bɛ Kɛ ni sen caman ye, cogo la min bɛ Kɛ ‘yɔrɔ la, min bɛ Se ka Kàlan. Flow bɛ se ka jɔ dɔɔnin ka baarakɛla ka cikan nata makɔnɔ.
gravitixDocs.waitKeyword: Daɲɛ koloma min ye makɔnɔni ye
gravitixDocs.multiStepForm: Sɛbɛn min bɛ kɛ ni sen caman ye
gravitixDocs.emitDesc: Cikanw ci ye bot ka bɔko fɔlɔ ye.
gravitixDocs.emitTo: emit_to — ci bila baarakɛla kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen dɔ ma
gravitixDocs.schedulingDesc: Kode boli otomatiki la waatibolodalen dɔ kan — cron baara si tɛ yen, kɛnɛma baara si mago tɛ.
gravitixDocs.everyRepeat: bɛɛ — segin a kan ni cɛmancɛ ye
gravitixDocs.atSpecificTime: at — boli tile waati kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen dɔ la
gravitixDocs.pipeDesc: Pipe baarakɛla |> bɛ nafa dɔ tɛmɛn i n’a fɔ sɔsɔli fɔlɔ ka taa baara nata la. A bɛ cakɛda baarakɛcogo kɛ kalan ye, ka taa numan fɛ ka taa kinin fɛ.
gravitixDocs.errorDesc: Gravitix bɛ filiw ɲɛnabɔcogo sigilen di ni try / catch / finally blocks ye.
gravitixDocs.structsDesc: Structs b’a To i bɛ data minnu bɛ tali Kɛ ɲɔgɔn na olu Fàra ɲɔgɔn kan sugu tɔgɔ dɔ 'kɔnɔ. Enums bɛ fɛnɲɛnɛmaw kulu datugulen dɔ ɲɛfɔ.
gravitixDocs.mathDesc: Gravitix bɛ jatebɔ gafemarayɔrɔ bɛɛ lajɛlen ci ni ~180 baarakɛcogo ye.
gravitixDocs.complexDesc: Gravitix bɛ ni suguya gɛlɛn ye min bɛ bɔ a yɛrɛ la — 64-bit floats fila minnu bɛ yɔrɔ lakikaw ni yɔrɔ miirilenw jira.
gravitixDocs.calculusDesc: Gravitix jatebla jatebla bɛ yen: bɔlenw ni integral minnu jate bɛ Kɛ baarakɛcogo ŋaniyatalenw kan.
gravitixDocs.linearAlgebraDesc: Algebra lineaire ye jatebla ye min bɛ Kɛ vektɔriw ni matiriyaliw kan.
gravitixDocs.numberTheoryDesc: Jateblaw ka miiriya bɛ jateden dafalenw nafaw Sɛgɛsɛgɛ. Bi kriptografiya jusigilan.
gravitixDocs.statisticsDesc: Jateminɛ bɛ baarakɛminɛnw di walasa ka kunnafoniw ɲɛfɔ, k’u sɛgɛsɛgɛ, ani ka dantigɛliw kɛ ka bɔ kunnafoniw na.
gravitixDocs.specialDesc: Baara kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye furaw ye diferential equations nafamaw la.
gravitixDocs.gammaRelated: Gamma & baarakɛcogo minnu bɛ tali kɛ o la
gravitixDocs.orthogonalPolynomials: Polinomi orthogonale (Polinomi orthogonal) minnu bɛ yen
gravitixDocs.fftDesc: Fourier bεε bε taamaʃyɛn dɔ tiɲɛ k’a Kɛ a kɔnɔfɛnw ye.

gravitixDocs.listFunctions: Baarakɛcogo minnu bɛ kɛ, olu tɔgɔ sɛbɛn

gravitixDocs.keepLearningDesc: Gravitix kalancogo ɲuman ye ka a jɔ. A daminɛ ni echo bot nɔgɔman ye, ka sɔrɔ ka state fara a kan, ka sɔrɔ ka flows fara a kan. I bɛ hakilina kura kelen-kelen minnu kalan, olu bɛ seko caman da mɔgɔw ɲɛ na.

math_special.h1: Gamma & baara minnu bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na
math_special.h6: Polinomi orthogonale (Polinomi orthogonal) minnu bɛ yen
math_special.p1: Gamma baarakɛcogo Γ(n) ye fasokanw ka jεnεya sabatili ye: Γ(n) = (n−1)! ka ɲɛsin jateden dafalen ɲumanw ma. A bɛ factorial (faktiyali) lasegin jateden lakikaw ni jateden gɛlɛnw ma.
math_special.p2: Misali baarakɛcogo erf(x) = (2/√π)∫₀ˣ e^(−t2)dt ye Gauss ka integral ye. A bɛ tali Kɛ CDF nɔrɔlen na k’a ɲɛsin funteni hakɛw ma ani dannaya-teori la.
math_special.p3: ζ(w) = Σ 1/nˢ ka ɲɛsin n=1,2,3,... ma (ni Re(w)>1). A bɛ jɛ ni prime distribution ye Euler ka fɛn dilannen fɛ. Riemann ka hakilina (min ma ɲɛnabɔ!) bɛ tali kɛ ζ zeru la plan complexe kɔnɔ.
math_special.p4: Bessel baarakɛcogo Jₙ(x) ani Y3(x) ye Bessel ka diferential equation ɲɛnabɔcogo ye: x2y'' + xy' + (x2−n2)y = 0. U bɛ ye jikuruw jɛnsɛnni na, funteni jiginni na silindaw kɔnɔ, ani quantum mechanics la.
math_special.p5: Ai(x) ni Bi(x) ye y'' = xy ɲɛnabɔcogo ye. U bɛ Ye ‘tunɛli kuantimɛ (WKB gɛrɛgɛrɛ) ni optiki (diffraction) la.
math_special.p6: O denbaya polinomiw bɛ wuli i n’a fɔ baarakɛla nafamaw ka baarakɛcogo yɛrɛ ani u bɛ kɛ spektral fɛɛrɛw la, quadrature ani quantum mechanics la.
math_special.p7: K(k) ni E(k) ye integral elliptique dafalenw ye suguya fɔlɔ ni filanan na. U bɛ pendule non lineaire waati ni ellipse lamini jatebɔ.
math_special.td1: Γ(x) = ∫^∞ tˣ⁻1e⁻dt. Lanczos ka gɛrɛgɛrɛ. Γ(n+1)=n ye!
math_special.td2: ln|Γ(x)|. Avoids ka ca niflow ye x belebelew kama.
math_special.td5: P3(x): orthogonal kan [−1,1]. Hidrɔzɛni jikuruw baarakɛcogo yɔrɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen.
math_special.td6: H3(x): ortogonal w.r.t. e^(−x2) ye. Oscillateur harmonique quantique (Oscillateur harmonique quantique) ye.
math_special.td8: L3(x): orthogonal kan [0,∞) w.r.t. e^(−x) ye. Idɔrɔzi radiyali waleya.

architexDocs.title: Architex Kanko ɲɛfɔli
architexDocs.subtitle: Kan min bɛ fɔ UI Vortex Mini Appw ma. État réactif, layouts composables, zero build step.
architexDocs.introDesc: Architex ye deklaratif fitinin ye DSL min dabɔra ka UI ci Vortex ciden kɔnɔ. I b’a ɲɛfɔ ekran ka kan ka kɛ cogo min na; boli waati bɛ pixelw to ɲɔgɔn fɛ ni cogoya ye a yɛrɛma. DOM virtuel tɛ, bundler tɛ, JSX tɛ — `.arx` file ye app ye.
architexDocs.goalDeclarative: Declarative — i b’a fɛ ka UI min sɛbɛn, i tɛ senna-tɛgɛrɛw sɛbɛn walasa k’a jɔ
architexDocs.goalReactive: Reactive — `~count += 1` ani label bɛɛ min b’a kalan, o bɛ kuraya a nɔ na
architexDocs.goalPortable: Portable — o `.arx` kelen in bɛ baara kɛ ɛntɛrinɛti, iOS ani Android baarakɛwaatiw kan k’a sɔrɔ sɛgɛsɛgɛli ma kɛ
architexDocs.goalTiny: Tiny — parser + renderer kurun bɛ don 30 KB jukɔrɔ, o la Mini Apps bɛ da wuli o yɔrɔnin bɛɛ
architexDocs.goalReadable: Kalan — indentation ye sigicogo ye; fɛn caman sɛmɛntiyalanw bɛ cakɛda ni `::` ye; taamasiyɛnw taji tɛ yen
architexDocs.whoIsThisFor: Nin ye jɔn de ta ye?
architexDocs.whoDesc: Mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ b’a fɛ ka ekran interactive ci Vortex kɔnɔ — kiliyanw ka sɛbɛnw, dashboardw, wote ɲɛw, Telegram-style Mini Apps. Ni i delila ka HTML+CSS+JS sɛbɛn, Architex bɛna a ye ko i bɛ i dɔn nka a bɛna teliya ka sɛbɛnni kɛ. N’i ​​m’o Kɛ, Architex fana ye dakun nɔgɔman ye min bɛ Kɛ ni porogaramuw ye minnu bɛ Kɛ ni ‘reactive (porogaramuw) ye bawo kan bɛ senna-tɛgɛrɛ To a ka dɔgɔ.
architexDocs.howToReadDesc: Dakun kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ jɔ min bɛ ɲɛfɛ. A daminɛ teliya la, o kɔ, Sintasi, Etat, Layout, Modifiers, Actions ani yɔrɔ kɔrɔlen kalan laban na. Aw bɛ pan ka yaala-yaala kɔnɔkow tabali fɛ ni aw bɛ React walima Svelte dɔn kaban — hakilinaw karti ka saniya.
architexDocs.quickStartDesc: Sira surun min bɛ Bɔ dosiye gansan na ka Taa Mini App bolilen na.
architexDocs.firstScreenExample:
@screen Bonjour

  ~tɔgɔ = "diɲɛ".

  kol :: pad(24) gap(12) cɛmancɛ la

    kuncɛ "Bonjour, {~tɔgɔ}!" :: bonya jalen(28)

    donna ~tɔgɔ :: pad(8) radius(6) dankan(#ccc) .

    text "Tɔgɔ dɔ sɛbɛn sanfɛ — nin sɛbɛn in bɛ ladamu i kɛtɔ ka sɛbɛnni kɛ."
      :: hakɛ(12) kulɛri(#888) .
architexDocs.whatHappenedDesc: `@screen Hello` bɛ a jujɔ jira. `~tɔgɔ = "diɲɛ"` bɛ fɛn caman sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ. `col`, `kuntigi`, `donna`, `sɛbɛn` ye fɛnw ye minnu bɛ jɔ. `::` bɛ fɛn caman sɛmɛntiyalanw (padding, colours, size) nɔrɔ ɲɔgɔn na. Ni baarakɛla ye sɛbɛnni Kɛ donna-yɔrɔ la, `{~tɔgɔ}` interpolation bɛɛ bɛ 'kùnnafoni kura Sɔrɔ — wiring tɛ, abonnés tɛ, renders tɛ bolo fɛ.
architexDocs.runningItDesc: Architex tab da wuli Vortex bot studio kɔnɔ, ka kode nɔrɔ, ka Run digi. Boli waati bɛ kɛ ka don ɲɛjirali yɔrɔ la ani ka hot-reloads kɛ save kan. Ni i ye gafe bɔ, i ka baarakɛlaw bɛ appli da wuli ka bɔ baro suguya bɛɛ la — installations si tɛ yen.
architexDocs.syntaxDesc: Architex porogaramu bɛɛ bɛ Kɛ ni fɛn naani ye: fɔlisen minnu bɛ Daminɛ ni `@` ye, fɛn caman sɛgɛsɛgɛli minnu bɛ Kɛ ni `~` ye, yɔrɔ minnu sɛbɛnnen dòn i n'a fɔ dantigɛlan gansanw, ani fɛn caman sɛmɛntiyalanw minnu bɛ nɔrɔ `::` kɔfɛ.
architexDocs.anatomyDeclDesc: `@screen Name`, `@theme`, `@import "./lib.arx"`, ani `@for item in ~list` bɛɛ bɛ daminɛ kulu 0. Fɛn o fɛn bɛ don u jukɔrɔ, o bɛɛ ye o bloki ta ye.
architexDocs.anatomyCompDesc: Yɔrɔw sigilen bɛ u yɛrɛ ka layini kan: `sɛbɛnni`, `butɔni`, `ja`, `kunkolo`, `label`, `badge`, `jatebɔlan`, `col`, `row`. U jɔyɔrɔko sɔsɔli bɛ Nà tɔgɔ in kɔ fɛ yɛrɛ: `text ~message`, `button "Save"`, `image "/logo.png"`.
architexDocs.anatomyModifier: Anatomie de un cakɛda min bɛ fɛn caman sɛmɛntiya
architexDocs.anatomyModifierDesc: `::` kɔfɛ i bɛ se ka cakɛda caman kɛ fɛn caman sɛmɛntiyalan na i b'a fɛ cogo min na. U kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ sɔsɔli zeru walima ka tɛmɛ o kan ta parantezi kɔnɔ: `:: pad(24) gap(16) center bold size(20) color(#4f8ef7)`. Yɛlɛmabaaw ye jɔyɔrɔko ye, daɲɛ koloma tɛ — sigicogo tɛ foyi ɲɛ fo sɛbɛnnikɛla laban-sebaaw i n’a fɔ `kulu`.
architexDocs.anatomyActionDesc: `=>` kan butɔni dɔ kan (walima jɛɲɔgɔnya yɔrɔ o yɔrɔ) bɛ baara walima baarakɛcogo weleli kɛ min bɛ tugu o kɔ. Cakɛda caman `=>` kɛrɛfɛ: `butɔn "Submit" => ~busy = tiɲɛ => ci(wale: "save", data: ~form)`.
architexDocs.reactiveVarsDesc: Tɔgɔ o tɔgɔ bɛ daminɛ ni `~` ye, o ye seli ye min bɛ se ka kɛ. Sɛbɛn `~count = 0` ka fɔ, `~count = 5` ka segin ka baara di, `~count += 1` ka update. UI node bɛɛ min bɛ seli kalan — k’a ɲɛsin a ma walima interpolation fɛ — o bɛ segin ka kɛ ni seli yeli b’a la.
architexDocs.computedVarsDesc: Baara kɛ ni `:=` ye `=` nɔ na walasa ka jatebɔ fɔcogo dɔ fɔ: `~total := ~count * ~step`. Kiɲɛfɛla bɛ segin ka jateminɛ kɛ tuma o tuma ni dannaya fɛn o fɛn Changé. Bololabaarakɛlaw ka abonné tɛ yen ani stale-value bug tɛ yen — n’i ye `~a` kalan yɔrɔ dɔ la kumasen kɔnɔ, i bɛ i jigi da a kan i yɛrɛma.
architexDocs.typeAnnotationsDesc: Annotations ye ŋaniyataama ye nka dɛmɛ bɛ kɛ ni autocomplete ni fili cikanw ye: `~count: number = 0`, `~name: string = ""`, `~ok: boolean = false`, `~items: array = []`, `~user: object = {}`. N'i y'u Tɛmɛ sugu bɛ inferé ka Bɔ initialiser (daminɛ-sɛbɛn) la.
architexDocs.supportedTypesList: `jate`, `sɛrɛ`, `boolean`, `kulu`, `fɛn`, `null`. Donw ni blobw bɛ Tɛmɛ i n’a fɔ juruw ni fɛnw. Boli waati bɛ baara Kɛ ni JavaScript ka jagokɛcogo sariyaw ye hood jukɔrɔ, o la `~count + 1` bɛ baara Kɛ hali ni `~count` ye ɲɛnamaya daminɛ i n'a fɔ juru.
architexDocs.stringInterpolationDesc: Sɛbɛn o sɛrɛkili bɛ se ka kumasenw don ni `{...}` ye: `"Bonjour, {~user.name}!"`, `"Total: {~count * ~price}"`. Interpolation (interpolation) bɛ Kɛ ‘fɛn ye min bɛ Kɛ ‘fɛn ye tuma bɛɛ.
architexDocs.layoutDesc: Architex bɛ ni minɛn fila ye minnu bɛ se ka labɛn ani furabulu yɔrɔ tan ni fila. Aw bɛ u den ni indentation ye — no closing tags.
architexDocs.containersDesc: `col` bɛ denmisɛnw dalajɛ ɲɔgɔn kan, `row` bɛ ɲɔgɔn dalajɛ tilennen na. U fila bɛɛ bɛ sɔn `gap(n)`, `pad(n)`, `center`, `grow`, ani bonya/janya fɛn dɔ ma. Aw bɛ denmisɛnw don nivo kelen kɔnɔ ka taa a fɛ walasa u ka se ka u ka denw kɛ.
architexDocs.containerExample:
row :: gap(8) pad(16) cɛmancɛ la
  ja "/avatar.png" :: w(40) h(40) radiyali(20)
  kol :: bonya gap(2) .
    sɛbɛnni ~tɔgɔ :: sɛbɛnni jɛman
    sɛbɛnni ~bio :: hakɛ(12) kulɛri(#888) .
architexDocs.leafComponentsList: `texte` — farikolo kopi o kopi. `kuntigi` — kɔrɔko siratigɛ la, kuncɛ. `label` — sɛbɛnni fitinin min bɛ sɛbɛnni kɛ. `button` — a bɛ se ka digi a kan. `input` — sɛbɛnni foro sirilen bɛ reactive var. `ja` — ja min bɔra URL dɔ la. `badge` — furakisɛ min bɛ i n’a fɔ furakisɛ. `divider` — danfaralan finman. `toast` — dumunikɛminɛn min bɛ kɛ waati dɔɔnin kɔnɔ. `tabs` / `tab` — tabw sɛgɛsɛgɛlikɛla.
architexDocs.componentTextDesc: `texte "Hello"` bɛ sɛrɛkili jɔlen dɔ jira. `text ~message` bɛ kɛ sababu ye ka jaabi di. Aw bɛ fara ɲɔgɔn kan ni interpolation ye: `texte "Total: {~count}"`.
architexDocs.componentHeaderDesc: Kungolo sɛbɛnni. A bɛ daminɛ ka bonya, ka bonya ka tɛmɛ `text` kan. O jɔyɔrɔko sɔsɔli kelen: `kuntigi "Settings"`. Size balansi ni ekran — override ni `size(n)`.
architexDocs.componentButtonDesc: Eleman min bɛ se ka tap. Jiginni juru ye labeli ye; `=>` wale bɛ boli tap kan. `butɔn "Kɔlɔsili" => ~draft = null`. Tasuma `=>` caman ka kɛɲɛ ni ɲɔgɔn ye.
architexDocs.componentInputDesc: Sɛbɛnni-yɔrɔ min sirilen bɛ sira fila fɛ. Tɔgɔ kɔfɛ fɛn min bɛ se ka kɛ, o bɛ sisan nafa minɛ: `input ~email`. Yɛlɛmafɛnw: `yɔrɔtigi("...")`, `debounce(300)` ka ɲɛsin fɛn kuraw ma minnu bɛ kɛ ni gazi ye.
architexDocs.componentImageDesc: Doniw bɛ bɔ HTTPS URL walima `/uploads/...` sira kan. Yɛlɛmabaaw `w(px)`, `h(px)`, `radius(px)` bɛ kɛsu tigɛ. A bɛ bin ka segin ka kɛ yɔrɔtigi silhouette ye ni URL 404s.
architexDocs.componentDividerDesc: Kunsigi danfaralan, 1px, bɛ bonya da sisan barokun kulɛri kan. Dalilu si tɛ yen.
architexDocs.componentBadgeDesc: Furakisɛ min bɛ a kɔnɔkow minɛ: `badge ~count`, `badge "kura"`. Aw bɛ baara kɛ ni jatebɔlanw ni tag chips ye minnu ma kalan.
architexDocs.componentLabelDesc: Caption/helper text — a ɲɛ bɛ dɔgɔya. Good ka ɲɛsin foroko foro tɔgɔw ma.
architexDocs.componentToastDesc: Ladɔnniyali min tɛ bali. `toast ~yelen "Kisilen!" :: duration(2000)` bɛ jira s 2 kɔnɔ tuma o tuma ni `~visible` ye tiɲɛ ye, o kɔfɛ a bɛ auto-dismisses. Modal stacking tɛ yen, z-index kɛlɛw tɛ yen.
architexDocs.componentTabsDesc: Tab minɛn min sirilen don ni sɛrɛkili ye min bɛ se ka kɛ: `tabs ~activeTab`. A kɔnɔ, `tab "Label" "key"` kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ tab kelen jira; farikolo min donna a jukɔrɔ, o bɛ jira ni kilisi bɛ bɛn.
architexDocs.modifiersDesc: Modifiers (Labɛnbagaw) ye fɛɛrɛ kelenpe ye min bɛ se ka kɛ sababu ye ka yɔrɔ dɔ cogoya. Cakɛda don u la `::` kɔfɛ. U bɛ sɔrɔ denbaya duuru kɔnɔ: u ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ janya, u bonya, u kulɛri, u sɛbɛnnicogo ani u kɛcogo.
architexDocs.modSpacingDesc: `pad(n)` — padding min bɛ kɛ fan bɛɛ fɛ. `pad(x, y)` — tilennen + jɔlen. `pad(sanfɛ, kinin fɛ, duguma, numan fɛ)` — CSS-order. `gap(n)` — yɔrɔ min bɛ denw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ `col` / `row`. `margin(n)` — kɛnɛma yɔrɔjan ni balimakɛw cɛ.
architexDocs.modSizingDesc: `w(px)` — a bonya sabatilen. `h(px)` — janya sigilen. `grow` — ka yɔrɔ tolenw fa ɲɔgɔn kɔ/kolo. `cɛmancɛ` — cɛmancɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni kuruwa ye; `col` kɔnɔ a bɛ cɛmancɛ la jɛgɛn, `row` kɔnɔ a bɛ cɛmancɛ jɔlen.
architexDocs.modColourDesc: `kulɛri(#rrggbb)` — ɲɛfɛla. `bg(#rrggbb)` — kɔkanna. U fila bɛɛ bɛ sɔn barokun taamasiyɛnw ma: `color(~primary)` bɛ kalan ka bɔ sisan `@theme` bloki la. Opacity bɛ tɛmɛ hex 8 fɛ : `#00000080` ye 50 %% nɛrɛma ye .
architexDocs.modTypographyDesc: `size(px)` — sɛbɛnnibolo hakɛ. `bold` / `italic` — girinya ni a cogoya. `align(numan fɛ|cɛmancɛ|niman fɛ)` — sɛbɛnniw labɛncogo.
architexDocs.modVisibilityDesc: `hidden(~flag)` — bɛ node bɔ ni darapo ye tiɲɛ ye. `yelen(~ darapo)` — inverse. Node minnu ma wuli, olu b’u ka DOM bɔn, o la UI saratilen ka dɔgɔ.
architexDocs.modBehaviourDesc: `debounce(ms)` kan `don` gazi kuraw. `placeholder("...")` bɛ hakilinata sɛrɛkili jira. `format(kind, arg)` kan `text` bɛ jateden dɔ labɛn: `format("wari", "USD")`, `format("kɛmɛsarada la")`, `format("compact")`.
architexDocs.modRadiusDesc: `radius(px)` bɛ nkɔni lamini. `border(#rrggbb)` bɛ 1 px sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ. `border(px, #rrggbb)` bɛ janya fana sigi.
architexDocs.actionsDesc: Waleyaw bɛ cogoya caman sɛmɛntiya walima ka kuma ni kɛnɛma diɲɛ ye. U bɛ boli ɲɔgɔn fɛ tap/keypress handler kɔnɔ.
architexDocs.actionAssignDesc: `=> ~jate = 0`, `=> ~busy = tiɲɛ`, `=> ~list = []`. Variable reactive o variable bɛ se ka sɛbɛn.
architexDocs.actionIncDecDesc: `+= n`, `-= n`, `*= n`, `/= n`. `=> ~jate += 1` ye daɲɛ ye min bɛ fɔ jatebɔlaw ma.
architexDocs.actionMultiple: Waleya minnu bɛ kɛ ni cakɛda ye
architexDocs.actionMultipleDesc: `=>` caman bɛ layini kelen kan tasuma bɛ sanfɛ ka taa duguma tick kelen kɔnɔ, o la UI bɛ ladamu siɲɛ kelen laban na: `button "Buy" => ~busy = true => send(action: "buy") => ~busy = false`. Walasa ka async baara kɛ, a ka fisa ni jatebɔlen `@reaction` ye.
architexDocs.actionSendDesc: `ci(wale: "tɔgɔ", ...args)` ye bridge ye ka segin bot kan. Jatigila (Vortex boli waati) b'a Sɔrɔ i n'a fɔ JSON RPC cikan ani a bɛ Se k'i ka bot ka kode Weele. Baara kɛ n’a ye donni kama, API lase, sarali — fɛn o fɛn DSL yɛrɛ tɛ se ka min fɔ.
architexDocs.actionNavigateDesc: `goto("ScreenName", arg: value, ...)` bɛ `@screen` wɛrɛ gɛrɛ stack kan; `kɔfɛ()` bɛ bɔ kɛnɛ kan. Boli waati bɛ ɲɛnamaya kɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye.
architexDocs.actionHostBuiltinsDesc: `copy(~text)`, `share(~text)`, `haptic("light" | "medium" | "heavy")`, `vibrate(ms)`, `alert("...")`, `confirm("...") => ~ok = it` — `it` sɛbɛnni surun ye kumasen tɛmɛnen segin nafa ye.
architexDocs.advanced: Fɛn minnu bɛ kɛ ka ɲɛ
architexDocs.themeDesc: Aw bɛ paleti dɔ fɔ siɲɛ kelen, ka baara kɛ ni a ye kokura yɔrɔ bɛɛ. Tokenw bɛ kɛ fɛn caman ye minnu bɛ se ka kɛ tuma bɛɛ walasa i ka appli ka se ka dibi-mode toggle ci layini saba kɔnɔ.
architexDocs.importsDesc: `@import "./shared/ui.arx"` bɛ `@component` ni `@screen` bɛɛ sama ka bɔ o dosiye kɔnɔ ka don sisan dakun na. Siraw bɛ tali kɛ fɛnw dondonni dosiye la; sɛrɛkili imports bɛ kɔlɔsi ani ka lakali parse waati la.
architexDocs.componentsDesc: A ɲɛfɔ siɲɛ kelen, baara kɛ ni siɲɛ caman ye: `@component Avatar url size\n image url :: w(size) h(size) radius(size / 2)`. Kɔnɔna na, dakun tɔgɔla paramɛtɛrɛw bɛ dakun na i n’a fɔ dantigɛli jɛlenw (ni `~` tɛ).
architexDocs.forLoopsDesc: `@for item in ~list` bɛ jirisun kelen jira fɛn kelen-kelen bɛɛ la. `@for item, idx in ~list` fana bɛ zeru basigilen index siri. Boli waati bɛ danyɔrɔ Ladege element yɛrɛ fɛ, o la, ka fɛnw Fàra ɲɔgɔn kan lisi 10 000 sanfɛ, o bɛ O(1) DOM baara musaka Bɔ.
architexDocs.forExample:
@ka ɲɛsin fɛn ma, idx in ~fɛnw
  jirisun :: gap(8) pad(4) .
    badge ~idx ye
    sɛbɛnni ~fɛn :: bonya
architexDocs.ternaryDesc: `kɔndi ? a : b` bɛ baara kɛ yɔrɔ o yɔrɔ la kumasen dɔ bɛ sɔn. Nest for enums: `~cogo >= 10 ? "kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la" : ~status >= 5 ? "cɛmancɛ" : "dɔgɔya"`.
architexDocs.slotsDesc: Component declaration kɔnɔ, `slot` bɛ welelikɛla farikolo bɛ don yɔrɔ min na, o taamasiyɛn ye, i k’a miiri ko React children / Vue default slot.
architexDocs.reactivity: Reactivité bɛ baara kɛ cogo min na
architexDocs.reactivityDesc: `~var` kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye taamaʃyɛn ye. N’i ​​y’a kalan jatebɔlen, modifier argument, walima interpolation kɔnɔ, runtime bɛ kalan kɔlɔsi sisan dependency graph kɔnɔ. N’i ​​ye sɛbɛnni Kɛ, node o node min b’a kalan, o bɛ Segin ka jateminɛ Kɛ — siɲɛ kelen, sisan microtask laban na.
architexDocs.reactivityBatchingDesc: Sɛbɛn caman minnu bɛ handler kelen kɔnɔ olu bɛ batch (batch) kɛ. `=> ~a = 1 => ~b = 2` bɛ render pass kelen tigitigi daminɛ.
architexDocs.reactivityEqualityDesc: Ka da a kan boli waati bɛ baara kɛ ni bɛnkan gɛlɛn ye (`===`). Nafa kelen sɛbɛnni tɛ foyi boli kokura. Fɛn/array kura tɛmɛn walasa ka fɛn kura dɔ wajibiya; fɛn caman cili tɛ dusu don mɔgɔ kɔnɔ nka a tɛ wajibiya.
architexDocs.examplesDesc: Application canonique naani, kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ u yɛrɛ la ani layini 40 jukɔrɔ. U dɔ la kelen kopi kɛ Architex tab kɔnɔ ka Run digi.
architexDocs.exampleCounter: Jatebɔlan — cogoya min bɛ se ka kɛ, jatebɔ, butɔni minɛbagaw, sɛbɛnni sirili.
architexDocs.exampleTodo: Todo — lisi jiracogo, farali / bɔ, inline sɛgɛsɛgɛli.
architexDocs.exampleProfile: Profil — ja, badges, conditionnel visibilité, navigation.
architexDocs.exampleKiller: Killer features — barokunw, imports, tabs, toasts, formatted numbers, ternaries, typed vars.
architexDocs.errors: Misali minnu bɛ kɛ tuma caman na ani u ka kan ka min kɛ
architexDocs.errUnknownName: `tɔgɔ dɔnbali ~foo` — i ye baara kɛ ni fɛn caman sɛgɛsɛgɛli ye ka sɔrɔ k’a jira. Aw bɛ `~foo = ...` fara a kan `@screen` datugulen sanfɛ.
architexDocs.errIndent: `unexpected indent` — denmisɛnw ka kan ka dun nivo kelen ye ka tɛmɛ u bangebaga kan. Architex bɛ baara Kɛ ni yɔrɔ fla tigitigi ye nivo kelen-kelen bɛɛ la; tabw bɛ ban walasa ka u yɛrɛ tanga invisible-whitespace bugs ma.
architexDocs.errModifier: `unknown modifier` — i ye `:: shadow` sɛbɛn nka boli waati t’a dɛmɛ. Aw ye modifier list lajɛ sanfɛ; Architex ka gɛlɛn tɔgɔ dɔnbaliw ma walasa ka ɲɛfɛla bɛnkan lakana.
architexDocs.errType: `suguya bɛnbaliya` — misali la. i tɛmɛna sɛrɛ dɔ fɛ jateden dɔ bɛ makɔnɔ yɔrɔ min na. Annotate reactive variable (`~count: number`) ani parser bɛna a fɔ i ye nafa jugu bɔra yɔrɔ min na.
architexDocs.errDebug: Walasa ka debug kɛ boli waati la, suspect expression siri `debug(...)` kɔnɔ — boli waati bɛ jateminɛ bɛɛ sɛbɛn konsolɛ kɔnɔ k’a sɔrɔ a ma nɔ bila nafa la.
architexDocs.compatWeb: Web — bɛ kɛ vanili ye DOM ni CSS fɛn caman sɛgɛsɛgɛli ye barokun taamasiyɛnw kama. No React / Vue / Svelte ka bolo kan.
architexDocs.compatIOS: iOS — o `.arx` kelen in bɛ Lajɛ ka Kɛ SwiftUI filɛliw ye Vortex iOS jatigila fɛ. Ladilikɛla bɛɛ bɛ karti kɛ SwiftUI cogoya dɔ la.
architexDocs.compatAndroid: Android — jatigila bɛ baara kɛ ni Jetpack Compose ye. Gesture modifiers (`:: onTap`, `:: onLongPress`) bɛ baara kɛ ni Compose ɲɔgɔndanw ye.
architexDocs.compatVersions: Version policy — Architex bɛ kɔkanna bɛnkan garanti `.arx` filew ma version misɛnninw kɔnɔ. `.arx` file min sɛbɛnna 0.1 kan, o bɛ baara kɛ hali bi 0.9 kan.
architexDocs.nextStepsDesc: Tobilikɛ gafe kalan walasa ka misaliw sɔrɔ (lisi dan tɛ minnu na, sɛbɛnw, sarali), baarakɛminɛnw gafe kalan CLI ani VS Kode plugin kama, ani bolomafara gafe n’i b’a fɛ ka yɔrɔ dɔ fara a kan min bɛ don a kɔnɔ. A sɔrɔyɔrɔ dafalen bɛ github.com/vortex/Architex kan.

meta.title: Vortex Ladilikan
meta.subtitle: Vortex ka subsystem bɛɛ bɛ yɔrɔ kelen na.
meta.intro: Nin kunnafoni in bɛ se ka fɔ ka ban ka kɛɲɛ ni a dilanni ye. A daminɛ yɔrɔ o yɔrɔ — sapitiri kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ a yɛrɛ la. Kuma bɛɛ bɛ segin ka don sɔrɔyɔrɔ siraw la ni a bɛnnen don. Yɛlɛmabali bɛɛ bɛ wele k’a jɛya.
meta.howToUse: Kɔnɔkow jatebɔsɛbɛn min bɛ kinin fɛ, o bɛ sapitiriw jira yan. Sapitiri dɔ digi walasa ka pan ka taa a fɛ; sapitiri kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ ni barokun fitininw ye ani lisi minnu bɛ se ka sɛgɛsɛgɛ segin 30 kɔnɔ sani i ka i yɛrɛ su ji la.
meta.updatedBy: A dabɔra ka bɔ `scripts/build_vortex_docs_v2.py` la. Segin ka jɔ ni `python3 sɛbɛnniw/build_vortex_docs_v2.py` ye.

architecture.title: Architecture (Jɛkulu jɔcogo) lajɛba
architecture.subtitle: Taabolo saba — kliyan, node, controleur — ani protocol kelen min b’u siri.
architecture.intro: Vortex ye ciden ye min bɛ marabolow kɔnɔ. Sani a ka kɛ kɔkanna-yɔrɔ kelen ye min bɛ tɔn kelen bolo, a bɛ **node** yɛrɛmahɔrɔnyalenw ka mesh da wulilen dɔ fara ɲɔgɔn kan, min sɔrɔla ani ka garanti di **contrôleur** compact dɔ fɛ min bɛ a ye kode min seereya, o manifeste bolonɔbilalen dɔ bɔ. **Kiliyanw** bɛ privé keys bɛɛ minɛ ka UI jira. Nin tilayɔrɔba tɔ bɛ taabolo saba taama, u dancɛw, ani kunnafonidilan minnu bɛ woyo u ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ.
architecture.h1p1: Ciden minnu bɛ cɛmancɛ la, olu ye wajibi-yɔrɔ kelen ye. Kiiritigɛso ka yamaruya, sankaba-dilanbagaw ka tiɲɛni, walima juguya sɔrɔli, o bɛɛ bɛ baara kɛ ni "baarakɛlaw bɔnɛna u ka se sɔrɔli la". Vortex bɛ o kɛrɛfɛ k’a to mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ bɛ node dɔ boli ani k’a to kliyanw ka taa node ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ k’a sɔrɔ u ma u tɔgɔ sɛbɛn kokura.
architecture.h1p2: Decentralisation ka kan ka gundo ni danbe mara. Server minnu tɛ dannaya sɔrɔ, olu ka jɛkulu bɛ baara kɛ dɔrɔn ni sèrwɛriw tɛ se ka sɛbɛnni gansanw kalan ani ni u tɛ se ka cikanw forge. Vortex bɛ o fila bɛɛ waleya laban-ni-dakun sirili fɛ ani Ed25519 seereyaw fɛ cross-node cikan bɛɛ kan.
architecture.h1p3: Kontrɔla ye kelen ye centralised-ish piece, nka a ka dɔgɔ. A bɛ `INTEGRITY.sig.json` dɔrɔn de Bɔ ani dondaw dannamɔgɔ lisɛli. Mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ bɛ Se k'a yɛrɛ Jatigila miirili la, o la hali kɔrɔsibaga tɛ dɛsɛko kelen ye — tiɲɛ sɔrɔyɔrɔ kelen dɔrɔn de don "min pubkey bɛ bolonɔ bila bɔli ofisiyaliw la".
architecture.h1l1: Feerekɛlaw ka dasiri tɛ : kiliyanw bɛ se k’u ka danyɔrɔ wuli nodew ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ waati o waati n’u ye X25519 pubkey bolonɔ bila kokura ni JWT kura ye.
architecture.h1l2: No outage correlation : ni node kelen jigira, node wɛrɛw baarakɛlaw t’a kɔlɔsi.
architecture.h1l3: Kiiritigɛyɔrɔ kelen tɛ yen: baarakɛlaw b’u ka so sariyalen ta, ani baarakɛlaw b’u ka baarakɛla ta.
architecture.h1l4: UI kelen tɛ: iOS, Android, web ye ɲɔgɔndan fɔlɔw ye — plateforme si tɛ wrapper finman ye dɔ wɛrɛ kan.
architecture.h2p1: Client bɛ baara kɛ baarakɛla dɔ ka minɛn kan. O yɔrɔ kelenpe de ye cikan gansanw, mɔgɔ kelen-kelen ka kilisi ani file-in-the-clear bɛ ɲɛnamaya yɔrɔ min na. Node tɛ u ye abada.
architecture.h2p2: Plateforme dɛmɛnen bɛɛ bɛ wire protocoles kelenw waleya (HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC). SOLID-split feature modules (`api/` protocols, `impl/` code, `ui/` views) bɛ bɛnkansɛbɛn siri ka ɲɛ ani ka plateforme kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen kode kɛ sigida la.
architecture.h2p3: A marali minɛn kan: Keychain / EncryptedSharedPreferences / HttpOnly cookie tokenw kama; SQLite (GRDB iOS kan, Room kan Android, IndexedDB wrapper web kan) ka ɲɛsin ciphertext cache ma + FTS index.
architecture.h2l1: iOS — Swift Package ni 30+ fɛnw modulu. Min deployment laɲini iOS 17.
architecture.h2l2: Android — Kotlin + Kofɔli + Hilt. minSdk 26, laɲiniSdk 34.
architecture.h2l3: Web — vanille JS PWA, baarakɛla, jɔli sen tɛ ES module bundling kɔfɛ.
architecture.h2l4: Bureau — Tauri wrapper lamini na web kliyan; bundle kelen, Chrome renderer natif.
architecture.h3p1: Node ye Python baarakɛcogo ye (`python -m app.main`, walima `run.py` bundled) min bɛ lamɛnni kɛ 9000 kan ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye. A bɛ ciphertext (ciphertext) to senna, ka WebSocket ko kɛlenw fanw bɔ, ka TURN seereyaw minɛ, ani ka brokers federation ni node wɛrɛw.
architecture.h3p2: Node layɛrɛ bɛ fin ni laɲini ye. A bɛ sira 120 ɲɔgɔn Bɔ kɛnɛ kan `/api/*` jiri kan ka Fàra `/ws` kan waati yɛrɛ la fan-out kama. O kɔrɔta gɛlɛn (kripto, sɔrɔli, waatibolodacogo) bɛ jate `app/security/`, `app/transport/`, `app/peer/` ye.
architecture.h3p3: Node kelen min bɛ SQLite cogo kɔrɔ la, o bɛ ~50 baarakɛlaw minɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ cogo lafiyalen na M1 kan. Ni Postgres ni Redis dabɔra, o kode kelen bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ jɛgɛma — node bɛɛ bɛ kɛ jamana tɛ min na ka tɛmɛ DB ni fan-out kan.
architecture.h3l1: Donda yɔrɔw : `/api/*` HTTPS, `/ws` WebSocket, `/v1/dafalen` ani `/kɛnɛya` ɲɛnamaya kama.
architecture.h3l2: Daɲɛw: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x, uvicorn, kriptografi (OpenSSL), pqcrypto (liboqs), python-multipart, Pillow, Rust farankan `vortex_chat` ka ɲɛsin kripto sira funteni ma.
architecture.h3l3: A bɛ se ka kɛ: Redis (fan-out ka kɛ node caman kɔnɔ), Postgres (production DB), coturn (TURN relay), fluent-bit (log shipping).
architecture.h3l4: Binaire bonya: ~60 MB Python deps + ~10 MB Rust janya. Docker ja 400 MB ɲɔgɔn ka sɔrɔ ka sɔgɔsɔgɔ.
architecture.h4p1: Kɔrɔsilikɛla ye Python baarakɛcogo danfaralen ye (`vortex_controller`) min kun ye ka surunya: ka `INTEGRITY.sig.json` bɔ kɛnɛ kan ani k’a sɛgɛsɛgɛ, ka dondaw URLw bɔ kɛnɛ kan, ani ka jɛkulu jɛkuluw ka kɛnɛya nɔfɛtaama.
architecture.h4p2: Daminɛ na, kɔrɔsibaga bɛ taamaʃyɛn jiri taama, ka dosiye bɛɛ hash, ka sanga ni manifest ye. Ni hash dɔ ma bɛn ɲɔgɔn ma, controleur bɛ ban ka daminɛ. O kɔrɔ ye ko disiki kan filen min sɛgɛsɛgɛra, o tɛ se ka baara kɛ ni `status:"verified"` ye.
architecture.h4p3: Clients bɛ `/v1/integrity` digi sanni u ka da node dɔ la. N'u ye `status != "verified"` ye u bɛ ban ka seereyaw di, period. O de ye dannaya ankɔri ye.
architecture.h4l1: A bolonɔ bilala ni `keys/release.key` ye (Ed25519). Foroba tilancɛ tobilen ka don kliyanw bɔli la.
architecture.h4l2: Manifest entries: `{path, sha256, size}` ka ɲɛsin dosiye bɛɛ ma min ma gitignored.
architecture.h4l3: Segin-ka-bɔnye: `python -m vortex_contrôleur.integrité.taamaʃyɛn_baarakɛminɛn`. A bɛ bɔ `INTEGRITY.sig.json` la repo ju la.
architecture.h4l4: Yɛlɛma: baarakɛlaw foroki Vortex bɛ `release.key` nɔ na. Clients configuré n'u ka pubkey o kɔfɛ u bɛ da o fork la.
architecture.h5p1: Taama min bɛ kɛ ni Alice ye "hi" ci Bob ma:
architecture.h5p2: 1. Client bɛ so jusigilan lajɛ a ka sigida magan na. Ni a tɛ yen, a bɛ anwɛlɛki kura ta ka bɔ `/api/rooms/{id}/keys` la a yɛrɛ ka pubkey kama. DM minnu bɛ siɲɛ fɔlɔ la, olu bɛ Diffie-Hellman boli siɲɛ kelen prekeys kan.
architecture.h5p4: 3. Node bɛ row mara ani ka fanw bɔ `{type:"m", room:..., msg:{id, ct, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at}}` ka taa WebSocket jɛlen bɛɛ la minnu bɛ abonné so kɔnɔ.
architecture.h5p5: 4. Bob ka kiliyan bɛ frame sɔrɔ, ka decrypter ni root key kelen ye, ka cinder pseudo matches expected membership sɛgɛsɛgɛ, ka bubble render.
architecture.h5p6: 5. Bob ka kiliyan bɛ `POST /api/rooms/{id}/read` bila ni kalan cikan laban id ye. O bɛ `{type:"r"}` bɔli daminɛ walasa Alice ka bulon ka tikɛ jira.
architecture.h6p1: CBOR (RFC 8949) ye fɛn ye min ka gɛlɛn, a bɛ kɛ fila ye, wa a bɛ teliya ka kodɔn. Ni i y’a suma ni JSON ye a bɛ nafalan hakɛ tigɛ ni ~30 % ye chat ciphertexte cogoya la ani ka yɔrɔ jɛlenw ka daɲɛ jɛlenw bɔ yen.
architecture.h6p2: Ni i y’a suma ni Protobuf ye a tɛ schema generator de wajibiya wa a tɛ foro nimɔrɔw freeze. O nafa ka bon bawo Vortex bɛ wuli — an ye `thread_id`, `reply_to`, `reactions_count`, `kind` fara bɔli kan k’a sɔrɔ an ma kiliyan kɔrɔw tiɲɛ.
architecture.h6p3: CBOR fana ye min ye Signal, Matrix ani NIP-29 bɛ baara kɛ ni min ye kunw na minnu bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na kosɛbɛ. U ka sugandili bɛnkan kɔrɔ ye ko an ka protocole (sɛbɛnni) sɛgɛsɛgɛli ka nɔgɔn lakana ɲininikɛlaw fɛ minnu bɛ kodɔn dɔn kaban.
architecture.h7p1: Kalansen bɛɛ bɛ `v:<int>` ta. Sisan version ye 1. Frame min bɛ ni version dɔnbali ye, o bɛ fili; kliyanw bɛ lasɔmini sɛbɛn ka taa ɲɛ ni karamɔgɔ nata ye.
architecture.h7p2: Kɔfɛ-baarakɛɲɔgɔnya bɛ garanti (dafalen) karamɔgɔ o karamɔgɔya la min bɛ `v:1` ta hali bi. Forward compatibilité ye cɛsiri ɲuman ye : foro kura bɛ fara dict laban kan, kliyan kɔrɔw bɛ u janto u la.
architecture.h7p3: Kari gɛlɛnw maralen bɛ fɛn caman Changements de sécurité-critique (misali la, HKDF context strings ɲɔgɔn falen-falen). O cogo la, version (fɔcogo) bɛ bump ka se 2 ma ani migration window (yɔrɔko-yɔrɔ) dɔ bɛ Bɔ.
architecture.h1_a: Vortex rezo bɛ tila ka kɛ taabolo saba ye. U kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ boli u yɛrɛ ma, u bɛ kuma tɔw fɛ ni filiw ye minnu ɲɛfɔlen don koɲuman, wa u bɛ se ka wuli u yɛrɛ ma. Monolith tɛ yen — fɛn bɛɛ bɛ don jɔyɔrɔ saba dɔ la kelen na.
architecture.h1_b: Client dɔ bɛ keys minɛ ka UI jira. Node dɔ bɛ ciphertext (ciphertext) to senna, ka ko kɛlenw fanw bɔ WebSocket kan, ani brokers WebRTC signalling. Kontrɔla dɔ bɛ manifeste bolonɔbilalenw ni dondaw URLw bɔ. U bɛ kumaɲɔgɔnya Kɛ HTTPS + WebSocket kan ni CBOR-kodɔn nafamafɛnw ye AES-GCM anwɛlɛkiw kɔnɔ.
architecture.h1_c: O farali in Dònna v0.0.3 la, monolith version fɔlɔ bolilen kɔ gɛlɛya fla la: bɔli seereya sirilen bɛ boli node la (o la, node min bɛ bɔnɛ a la, o bɛ se ka nkalon tigɛ a yɛrɛ ka kode kan), wa federasɔn tun tɛ se ka kɛ bawo node cogoya ni dannaya cogoya tun bɛ balo tabali kelenw kɔnɔ. Ka seereyaw tila ka don a yɛrɛ ka taabolo la, o ye pubkey kelen di baarakɛla bɛɛ ma ka pin ani k’a to an ka federation scale ka N arbitraire.
architecture.h2_a: Node/contrôleur tilali bɛ lakana-ko-ɲɛnabɔ-fɛnba (manifest signé) Bɔ binkanni-yɔrɔba la (API sèrwɛri).
architecture.h2_b: Kontrɔla bɛ SQLite DB fitinin dɔ mara: pubkey dannamɔgɔ, mirror URLw, ani kɛnɛya jatew. A bɛ ban ka daminɛ ni INTEGRITY.sig.json ma bɛn disiki kan jiri ma — dosiye min sɛgɛsɛgɛra, o tɛ se ka baara kɛ abada `status:"verified"`. Node bɛ baara kɛ a yɛrɛ ka Postgres/SQLite kan wa a tɛ bɔli kilisi minɛ abada.
architecture.h2_c: O misali bɛ bɔ Chrome ka root-store tilali la (sɛbɛnw bɛ balo navigatɔrɔ ka bɔli sira kan, a tɛ web bɔyɔrɔ kan) ani Debian ka Release.gpg (manifest signed, packages unsigned). A y’a ta bawo o dilan fila bɛɛ ye san tan caman kɛ kɛlɛɲɔgɔnw ka seginnkanni na.
architecture.h3_a: TLS 1.3 hop bɛɛ kan, laban-ni-dakun nafamafɛnw sirilenw kɔnɔ. TLS bɛ bolifɛnw ɲɛnabɔ; AES-GCM bɛ kɔnɔkow ɲɛnabɔ.
architecture.h3_b: Client ni node cɛ: HTTPS (`/api/*`) ani WSS (`/ws`). Nodew ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ: HTTPS (`/federasiyɔn/*`). Node ni controleur cɛ: HTTPS (`/v1/*`). Bɛɛ bɛ baara kɛ ni TLS 1.3 ye ni Chrome 120 bolokɔnincininw ye walasa ka DPI kɛlɛ.
architecture.h3_c: Vortex fɔlɔw tun bɛ baara kɛ ni TCP raw ye ni ladamu mankan-protocol boloci ye. A jiginna ka kɛ TLS 1.3 ye v0.0.4 kɔnɔ a kɛlen kɔ k’a faamuya ko ladamu protocoles (laada protocoles) bɛ "interesting" jira kɔlɔsilikɛlaw ma minnu tɛ baara kɛ. TLS 1.3 ye sɛgɛn ye, a bɛ yɔrɔ bɛɛ, wa a labɛnnen don ECH — an tun b’a fɛ ka nafolo saba minnu sɔrɔ.
architecture.h3_f:
bolifɛnw taabolow : TLS 1,3 (RFC 8446) + ECH (RFC 9460) min bɛ se ka kɛ .
kɔnɔkow layini: AES-256-GCM datugulen kɔnɔna CBOR .
architecture.h4_a: Cikan bɔlen kelen bɛ tɛmɛ fɛɛrɛ naani fɛ: frame → encrypt → post → fan out.
architecture.h4_b: Client bɛ so kilisi jate (X25519 + HKDF), ka cikan frame i n’a fɔ CBOR, ka sigi ni AES-256-GCM ye ni nonce 96-bit random ye, ka POST kɛ `/api/rooms/{id}/messages` la. Node bɛ ciphertext row mara ani ka fanw bɔ ka taa WebSocket ɲɔgɔndan bɛɛ la min bɛ abonné so kɔnɔ. Jatigila ka kiliyan bɛ decrypt ni o kilisi kelen ye. Taama ni segin latɛmɛni 50 ms jukɔrɔ sigida LAN kan, ~120 ms cogoya la WAN.
architecture.h4_c: Pibiliki min bɛ kɛ ni sen naani ye, o ye o kelen ye Siginiden ye min kɛra san 2014 kɔnɔ; an ye transport (WebSocket) dɔrɔn Changé Signal ka TCP nɔ na) ani encoding (CBOR protobuf nɔ na). Ka dilancogo sɛgɛsɛgɛlen dɔ bɛn ɲɔgɔn ma, o bɛ tɛmɛ kura dabɔli kan.
architecture.h5_a: An ye CBOR ta JSON ni Protobuf kan, an kɛlen kɔ ka payload hakɛ, evolvability, ani debug ergonomics suma ɲɔgɔn na chat baarakɛcogo lakikaw kan.
architecture.h5_b: CBOR bɛ nafalan fitininw Bɔ ~30% ka Tɛmɛ JSON kan cikanw kan minnu ka gɛlɛn unicode ma, a tɛ ni yɔrɔ jɛlenw ye, wa a bɛ foro farali dɛmɛ ni schema generators tɛ. Proto tun bɛna mago don .proto file la bɔko kelen-kelen bɛɛ la ani a tun bɛna foro nimɔrɔw sɛgɛsɛgɛ.
architecture.h5_c: Siginiden jiginna ka bɔ protobuf la ka taa CBOR-like framing la san 2017 o kun kelenw de kosɔn. Matrix bɛ baara Kɛ ni CBOR ye a ka jamana-ɲɛnabɔli-yɔrɔ la. CBOR ye IETF sariya ye (RFC 8949) wa an bɛ kan o kan laɲini, gafemarayɔrɔ kɔgɔlen bɛ o kan.
architecture.h5_f:
CBOR bonya: ~0,7 × JSON utf-8 ɲagaminen kan
          ~1.05 × protobuf kan schema kelen na
Foro dɔ farali = farali a laban na. Client kɔrɔw tɛ u janto u la.
architecture.h6_a: Mun na CBOR — fɛn dilanni sapitiri yɔrɔ dɔ. Nin ye fɛɛrɛ jɔnjɔn dɔ ye min kofɔlen don Vortex ɲɛfɔli bɛɛ kɔnɔ. Sapitiri min bɛ a lamini na, o kalan walasa ka kunnafoni caman sɔrɔ; nin yɔrɔ in bɛ kɛwale kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bonya.
architecture.h6_b: Baarakɛcogo lajɛlen "Mun na CBOR" kan. Fɛɛrɛ in bɛ waleya modulu bɛnnin kɔnɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, walima `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` jukɔrɔ. Module README bɛ file sira tigitigiw wele.
architecture.h6_c: "Mun na CBOR" fɛɛrɛ in jiginna Vortex bɔliw bɛɛ la. O dilancogo bɛ tali kɛ ciden tɛmɛnenw ka ɲininiw ni u dilanni kɛcogo bɔlenw na. Version tariku min bɛ `CHANGELOG.md` kɔnɔ, o bɛ sɛbɛn kɛ waati min na a yɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ jigira ani min y’a bila.
architecture.h7_a: Protocol versioning — a ye architecture sapitiri dɔ ye. Nin ye fɛɛrɛ jɔnjɔn dɔ ye min kofɔlen don Vortex ɲɛfɔli bɛɛ kɔnɔ. Sapitiri min bɛ a lamini na, o kalan walasa ka kunnafoni caman sɔrɔ; nin yɔrɔ in bɛ kɛwale kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bonya.
architecture.h7_b: Baarakɛcogo lajɛlen "Protocol versioning" kan. Fɛɛrɛ in bɛ waleya modulu bɛnnin kɔnɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, walima `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` jukɔrɔ. Module README bɛ file sira tigitigiw wele.
architecture.h7_c: "Protocol versioning" fɛɛrɛ in jiginna Vortex bɔlenw kɔnɔ. O dilancogo bɛ tali kɛ ciden tɛmɛnenw ka ɲininiw ni u dilanni kɛcogo bɔlenw na. Version tariku min bɛ `CHANGELOG.md` kɔnɔ, o bɛ sɛbɛnni kɛ waati min na a yɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ jigira ani min y’a bila.

crypto.title: Kriptografu primitifs (daɲɛ kɔrɔmafɔlenw).
crypto.subtitle: Algoritmɛ bɛɛ min bɛ stack kɔnɔ, a kuntilenna, a paramètres, a RFC.
crypto.intro: Vortex bɛ baara kɛ ni fɛn fɔlɔw dɔrɔn ye minnu lajɛra ɲɔgɔn fɛ. Bloc ciphers customs tɛ yen, KDFw tɛ yen minnu bɛ falen so kɔnɔ, signature schemes kura tɛ yen. Nin tilayɔrɔba in bɛ baara kɛ ni primitive o primitive ye, paramètres tigitigiw, ani rationale minnu bɛ sugandili kelen-kelen bɛɛ kɔfɛ.
crypto.h1p1: Curve25519 (RFC 7748) a ka Montgomery cogo la, a bɛ kɛ Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman ye. 32-bayt dankan kilisi, 32-bayt foroba kilisi, 32-bayt gundo bɔli jɛlen.
crypto.h1p2: A bɛ kɛ ka ninnu kɛ: minɛnw dɔnni statiki, session keys ephemères, puse enveloppes sirilenw, so key wrapping, federation anwɛlɛkiw.
crypto.h1p3: iOS waleyali: `Curve25519.KeyAgreement.PrivateKey` ka bɔ CryptoKit la. Android: `x25519-dalek` ka tɛmɛn JNI fɛ. Node: `kriptografi.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.x25519` OpenSSL kan.
crypto.h1p4: U saba bɛɛ bɛ ɲɔgɔn Dòn dɔɔnin dɔɔnin. Taama ni segin sɛgɛsɛgɛra ni RFC 7748 Alice/Bob sɛgɛsɛgɛli vektɔriw ye jɔli bɛɛ kan.
crypto.h1p5: Baara kɛcogo: ~100 μs Diffie-Hellman kelen na san 2020 iPhone kan, ~30 μs san 2020 Mac kan. So-kɔlɔsili lamininen dɔ ka ɲɛsin kulu 200 ma, o bɛ 10 ms ɲɔgɔn ta kogo-waati la.
crypto.h1p6: Waati basigilen: ɔwɔ, jatebɔ kurulen ni dekodɔn sira raw-byte fila bɛɛ la.
crypto.h1p7: Kɛrɛfɛ-kanali jɔcogo : Montgomery ladɛrɛsi tɛ se ka kɛ waati binkanniw kalasi la minnu bɛ Weierstrass kuruw gosi; OpenSSL ni Swift CryptoKit fila bɛɛ bɛ baara kɛ n’a ye.
crypto.h1p8: Seriyali kunbabaw: 32-bayt fitinin-endian. Foroba kilisiw bɛ siri fɛnw dondonni na walasa donnakow ma labɛnbaliw kana kɛ sababu ye ka low-order-point leaks kɛ.
crypto.h1l1: Mun na X25519 ani P-256 tɛ: teliya, fitinin, haminanko si tɛ NIST-curve.
crypto.h1l2: Mun na 32-bayt bɔli ni 64 tɛ: o bɛ bɛn HKDF-SHA256 donna janya ma tigitigi.
crypto.h1l3: Mun na Montgomery ani Edwards tɛ: an mago bɛ DH dɔrɔn de la, bolonɔbila tɛ, nin kunnafoni jɔnjɔn in kan. Edwards tun mago bɛna kɛ fɛn dɔ la min bɛ mɔgɔw ladɔnniya fɛn caman tigɛli la waati bɛɛ.
crypto.h2p1: EdDSA (RFC 8032) ka tɛmɛn edwards25519 kan. 32-bayt foroba kilisi, 64-bayt bolonɔbila.
crypto.h2p2: A bɛ Kɛ ni ninnu ye: node seereyaw fédération cikanw kan, release-key signatures over the integrity manifest, bot deploy signing, device long-term identity for Double Ratchet.
crypto.h2p3: Determinisme : an bɛ baara Kɛ ni RFC 8032 suguya min ye o bɛ bolonɔbila kelen Bɔ siɲɛ fla cikan + kilisi kelen na. Apple ka CryptoKit min bɛ iOS 17+ kan, o bɛ baara kɛ ni RFC 8032bis randomized variant ye — u fila bɛɛ bɛ se ka kɛ ani u fila bɛɛ bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ ni sɛgɛsɛgɛlikɛla bɛɛ ye min bɛ sariya labato.
crypto.h2p4: Sɛgɛsɛgɛli musaka: ~200 μs bi CPU kan. Batch verify (`batch_verify([msg,sig,pk]*N)`) ye ~10× teliya ye bolonɔbila kelen na.
crypto.h2p5: Siginidenw cogoya: `R || S`, bayt 32 kelen-kelen, dɔɔnin-endian.
crypto.h2l1: Foroba kilisi jiracogo: 32-byte compressed point. A bɛ se ka kɛ tuma bɛɛ — "point at infinity" ko tɛ yen.
crypto.h2l2: Kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, kilisi jiracogo: 32-byte kisɛ. Skalari min bonyalen don, o bɛ sɔrɔ wulu kan SHA-512 fɛ.
crypto.h2l3: Mun na a tɛ ECDSA: ECDSA mago bɛ RNG ɲuman na bolonɔbila bɛɛ la; RNG bias dɔ bɛ privé key (kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la) bɔ. Ed25519 ye deterministic ye, RNG mago tɛ taamasiyɛn waati la.
crypto.h3p1: AES Galois/Jatebɔcogo la (NIST SP 800-38D). 256-bit keys, 96-bit nonces, 128-bit dantigɛli taamasiyɛnw.
crypto.h3p2: A bɛ Kɛ ni ninnu ye: cikan ciphertext enveloppe, file chunk enveloppes, encrypted backup payloads, sealed push payloads.
crypto.h3p3: Nonce jɔli : cikan bɛɛ bɛ 96-bit random nonce kura Bɔ. Node bɛ nonces 10^6 labanw nɔfɛ so kelen kɔnɔ ani ka duplicates fili lafasali la — client man kan ka duplicates lawuli fɔlɔ, nka a miiri-foyi tɛ musaka bɔ.
crypto.h3p4: Mun na 96-bit nonces ani 128-bit tɛ: 96 bits ye GCM-standard "deterministic" nonce janya ye, wa a bɛ 2^32 random nonces di an ma sanni wolodon ɲɔgɔndanw ka kɛ haminanko ye. So kelen konnɛgɛ bɛ wuli kabini waati jan sani o ka kɛ, o la, a tɛ mɔgɔ tɔɔrɔ.
crypto.h3p5: Tag hakɛ: dafalen 128 bitiki. An tɛ tigɛ — marayɔrɔ warimara tɛ jate ani tigɛ bɛ dɔ fara nkalon tigɛcogo kan.
crypto.h3l1: Fɛnɲɛnɛma teliya: AES-NI (x86), ARMv8-A kripto farankanw, kripto bloki kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw Apple Silicon kan. Encryption ka tɛmɛn ~3 GB/s.
crypto.h3l2: ARM minɛn kɔrɔw kan minnu tɛ ni kripto janya ye: ~300 MB/s porogaramuw fɛ. Hali bi a teliya ka tɛmɛ disiki IO kan.
crypto.h3l3: Donanw minnu bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na : karamɔgɔ kuncɛ (`{v, room_id, sender_pseudo}`) bɛ tɛmɛ i n’a fɔ AAD o la kuncɛlan nkalonma tɛna a sɛgɛsɛgɛ.
crypto.h4p1: HKDF (RFC 5869) ni SHA-256 ye. A bɛ 32-byte sub-key caman sɔrɔ ka bɔ 32-byte donna kelen na.
crypto.h4p2: A bɛ Kɛ ni: X25519 bɔli tila-tila ka Kɛ kodɔn-kilisi + MAC kilisi + kuncɛ-kɔlɔsili ye; ka root ratchet key sɔrɔ Diffie-Hellman round dɔ la; ka filen kelen-kelen bɛɛ kilisi jɔ ka bɔ dosiye ju la.
crypto.h4p3: Kunnafoni sɛrɛkiliw ye dantigɛli ye tuma bɛɛ ASCII: `"v1:encryption"`, `"v1:mac"`, `"v1:header"`, `"v1:backup"`. Versioning b’a To an bɛ key hierarchy bɛɛ Lamaga info-string changement fɛ.
crypto.h4p4: Kɔgɔ ye fɛn ye min bɛ se ka kɛ i yɛrɛ sago la. Vortex kɔnɔ an bɛ so id kɛ kɔgɔ ye so-kilisi bɔli kama walasa so danfaralenw kana se ka baara kɛ ni kilisi bɔlenw ye kokura bala la hali ni X25519 bɔli kelen bɔra.
crypto.h4l1: Mun na SHA-256 ani SHA-512 tɛ: plateforme bɛɛ bɛ ni hardware SHA-256 teliya ye; SHA-512 bɛ teliya dɔɔnin CPU 64-bit kan nka a tɛ teliya telefɔniw kan.
crypto.h4l2: Mun na i tɛ KMAC-based KDF: KMAC ye niche ye. HKDF bɛ kripto gafemarayɔrɔ bɛɛ la an bɛ baara kɛ ni min ye.
crypto.h5p1: Argon2id (RFC 9106) ye. Paramɛtiriw : m=64 MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32.
crypto.h5p2: A bɛ Kɛ ni ninnu ye: sèrwɛri fan fɛ tɔgɔlasɛbɛn hash (`users.password_hash`), sigida-dakun-dacogo-kɔlɔsili, kisɛ-kumasenw ladonni bɔcogo.
crypto.h5p3: Mun na nin paramɛtɛrɛ ninnu: OWASP 2023 ladilikanw. 64 MiB + 3 iterations bɛ ~0.5 s ta iPhone X kan — an ka minɛn min bɛ dɛmɛ dɔɔnin dɔɔnin. ASIC binkannikɛla min ka telefɔni hakilijagabɔyɔrɔ ye 100× ye, o mago bɛ ~5 ms hali bi a ɲinini kelen na. Daɲɛ dogolen janw (entropy > 40 bits) bɛ Kɛ jatebɔ-ko ye min tɛ Se ka Kɛ ka kari ni sɛgɛsɛgɛli ye.
crypto.h5p4: Ladoncogo: `argon2:<encoded>` min kodelen don o ye RFC-cogo sɛrɛ ye min kɔnɔ kɔgɔ, hakilijagabɔ, iterations ani hash bɛ yen.
crypto.h5l1: Mun na Argon2id ani Argon2i walima Argon2d tɛ: 2id ye ɲɔgɔndan ye — tɛmɛko fɔlɔ bɛ kɛrɛfɛ-kanaliw kɛlɛ (i-mode), tɛmɛsira nataw bɛ GPU/ASIC kɛlɛ (d-mode). Siginiden bɛ baara kɛ ni o ɲɔgɔn ye.
crypto.h5l2: Dummy-hash comparison: hali ni baarakɛla tɛ yen, an bɛ Argon2 verify nkalonma dɔ boli hali bi ni hash basigilen ye. O bɛ don waati bɛn ɲɔgɔn ma walasa binkannikɛlaw kana se ka baarakɛlaw tɔgɔw jate jaabi waati fɛ.
crypto.h5l3: Rehash on login: ni server admin bumps memory cost, hash kɔrɔw bɛ segin ka hash kɛ don nata ɲɛnabɔlen na. Transparent ka ɲɛsin baarakɛla ma.
crypto.h6p1: FIPS 203 (NIST, 2024 sàn). ML-KEM-768 ye. 1184-bayt foroba kilisi, 1088-bayt ciphertext, 32-bayt gundo jɛlen.
crypto.h6p2: A bɛ Kɛ ni: hybride post-quantum session keys ye. Ni ɲɔgɔn fila bɛɛ ye Kyber dɛmɛni piblisite kɛ session key ye `HKDF(x25519_output || kyber_output)` ye.
crypto.h6p3: Mun na hybride : hali ni Kyber karilen don kɔfɛ (a ni a bɛ tali kɛ a la), X25519 yɔrɔ bɛ an lakana hali bi. Ni u farala ɲɔgɔn kan, o bɛ fɛn bɛɛ la ɲuman di.
crypto.h6p4: Mun na Kyber ani a ma kɛ NIST kandida tɔw ye: o de tun sugandira ka kɛ standardisation ye. Kode sɔrɔli ka bon (liboqs, pqcrypto).
crypto.h6l1: Baara kɛcogo : kilisi bɔnsɔn ~100 μs, encapsulation ~30 μs, decapsulation ~50 μs. A tɛ jate kosɛbɛ ni i y’a suma ni segin-ka-bɔnye latɛmɛni ye.
crypto.h6l2: Bandwidth musaka : bayt 1088 ye session ciphertext kelen na, bayt 1184 foroba key kama. Session bɛ sara ni mɔgɔw ye ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ fɔlɔ; o kɔfɛ a bɛ kɛ zeru ye.
crypto.h6l3: Server fan fɛ: `pqcrypto` Python foroko ni `kem.ml_kem_768`. Client fan fɛ: liboqs via plateforme sirili.
crypto.h7p1: Signal ka Double Ratchet (i n’a fɔ a ɲɛfɔlen bɛ cogo min na san 2016 foroba spec kɔnɔ). A bɛ Diffie-Hellman ratchet ni simetri-key cakɛda fara ɲɔgɔn kan.
crypto.h7p2: A bɛ Kɛ ni: cikan tilennenw ye minɛn fla ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ. Jɛkulu ka so bɛ baara kɛ ni "cibaga ka kilisi" fɛɛrɛ nɔgɔman ye min sirilen bɛ so ju la.
crypto.h7p3: Nafolo : gundo min bɛ taa ɲɛfɛ (ka minɛn dɔ tiɲɛ, o bɛ cikanw dɔrɔn de bɔ kɛnɛ kan a ye minnu sɔrɔ kaban, a tɛ ci nataw bɔ kɛnɛ kan), bɛnkan kɔfɛ lakanani (re-ratcheting heals after a key compromise), fɛnw lasecogo kɔfɛ (fo ka se 1000 cikanw ma minnu bɛ tɛmɛ).
crypto.h7p4: An ka waleyali bɛ `app/security/double_ratchet.py` ani `ios/Modules/Sources/Chat/impl/DoubleRatchet.swift` / `android/app/src/main/.../chat/impl/DoubleRatchet.kt` kɔnɔ.
crypto.h7l1: Cakɛda janya dakun : cikan 1000 cakɛda kelen na ka sɔrɔ ka segin ka wuli ni fanga ye. A bɛ dan sigi tiɲɛni na ka bɔ cakɛda kilisi sonyalen na.
crypto.h7l2: Skipped-key cache : fo ka se 1000 ma minnu tɛ baara la, minnu bɛ mara hakili la cakɛda kelen kɔnɔ. O kɔfɛ, cikan bɛ ban iko a kɔrɔlen.
crypto.h7l3: Kungolo sirili: a bɛ daminɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye. Kungolo bɛ ratchet metadata ta wa a bɛ siri ni kuncɛlan kilisi kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen ye min bɛ bɔ ju la HKDF fɛ.
crypto.h8: BLAKE3 hashing ka ɲɛsin dosiyew ma
crypto.h8p1: Filen minnu tɛ kriptografu ye, olu dɔnni ni u dafalen bɛ baara kɛ ni BLAKE3 ye bawo a teliya ka bon 10× ka tɛmɛ SHA-256 kan blob belebelebaw kan.
crypto.h8p2: A bɛ Kɛ ni: file `sha256` kulu ye DB kɔnɔ (tariku tɔgɔ; tiɲɛ na BLAKE3 hood jukɔrɔ kabini v0.1.2), attachment dedup, file-upload integrity check.
crypto.h8p3: Lakanali jɔyɔrɔ: BLAKE3 barika ka bon kriptografi la (256-bit); an bɛ kulu in wele ko `sha256` ka ɲɛsin jiginni bɛnkan dɔrɔn ma.
crypto.h9: Jatedenw bɔli k’a sɔrɔ u ma kɛ cogo si la
crypto.h9p1: Nonces, prekeys, challenge nafaw bɛɛ bɛ Sɔrɔ OS RNG fɛ: `SecRandom` iOS kan, `java.security.SecureRandom` Android kan, `secrets.token_bytes` kan Python (wrapping `/dev/urandom` walima a ɲɔgɔnna).
crypto.h9p2: `random.random()` abada, `Math.random()` abada, `rand()` abada. Lint sariyaw bɛ u baara bali kripto moduluw kɔnɔ.
crypto.h10: Baara minnu bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ
crypto.h10p1: HMAC sangaɲɔgɔnma, bolonɔbila sɛgɛsɛgɛli, tɔgɔlasɛbɛn hash sɛgɛsɛgɛli — bɛɛ bɛ baara kɛ ni waati basigilen primitives ye walasa ka waati kɛrɛfɛ-kanw bali.
crypto.h10p2: Python: `hmac.ka_daɲɛw suma ɲɔgɔn na`. Swift: `Waati basigilen` dɛmɛbaga. Kotlin: `MessageDigest.ye kelen ye`.
crypto.h1_a: X25519 ye Diffie-Hellman ye min bɛ Kɛ ni kurukurunin ye min bɛ Kuru25519 kan a ka Montgomery cogo la. 32-bayt kilisi, 32-bayt gundo jɛlen. Kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, fɛn kelen-kelen bɛɛ / minɛn jɔlen identité / session key min bɛ Vortex kɔnɔ, o bɛɛ bɛ baara kɛ n’a ye.
crypto.h1_b: Alice ni Bob kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ ni privé keys a, b ani public keys A = a·G, B = b·G ye yɔrɔ min na G ye curve base point ye. U bɛ jatebɔ Kɛ s = a·B = b·A. O gundo 32-bayt jɛlen in bɛ Taa HKDF-SHA256 kɔnɔ walasa ka AES-GCM kilisi simetriw Sɔrɔ. Kuru jatebɔ bɛ Kɛ waati basigilen na ni Montgomery lada ye; bolofara si tɛ gundo kunnafoniw kan.
crypto.h1_c: Curve25519 bɔra Daniel J. Bernstein fɛ san 2005, a sugandira IETF fɛ san RFC 7748 (2016). A bɛ tali kɛ Siginiden, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard fɛ. Vortex bɛ baara kɛ n’a ye bawo a teliya ka tɛmɛ P-256 kan, a ka 32-byte key size ka gɛlɛn, a bɛ a yɛrɛ tanga NIST curve haminankow ma, wa platform bɛɛ bɛ implementation gɛlɛn dɔ ci.
crypto.h1_f:
Kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la: a ∈ [0, 2255) (32 bayt fitinin-endian) .
Foroba kilisi: A = a · G (32-byte compressed point) .
Gundo jɛlen : s = a · B = b · A (bayiti 32, →HKDF donna) .
crypto.h2_a: Ed25519 ye X25519 siginiden balimakɛ ye, a bɛ baara Kɛ ni o kuru kelen in ye a ka twisted-Edwards cogo la. 32-bayt foroba kilisi, 64-bayti bolonɔbila, deterministic by default.
crypto.h2_b: Walasa ka cikan m bolonɔ bila ni privé key d ye : jatebɔ kɛ r = SHA-512(d, m), R = r·G, c = SHA-512(R, A, m), S = r + c·a. Siginiden ye (R, S) ye. Sɛgɛsɛgɛli : a lajɛ R + c·A = S·G. Siginiden latigɛlen bɛ a yɛrɛ tanga baara kɛbaliya farati ma pewu — cikan kelen bolonɔbila fila ni kilisi kelen ye, olu bɛ ɲɔgɔn ta dɔɔnin.
crypto.h2_c: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) bɔra Bernstein ka san 2011 sɛbɛn kɔnɔ ni Duif, Lange, Schwabe ani Yang ye. A kɛra kosɛbɛ san 2013 kɔfɛ.Apple ka CryptoKit, Google ka Tink, libsodium, OpenSSH bɛɛ bɛ baara kɛ n’a ye. Vortex bɛ bolonɔ bila federasiyɔn ka anwɛlɛki bɛɛ la ani node seereya bɛɛ la ni Ed25519 ye.
crypto.h2_f:
Taamaʃyɛn(d, m): r = SHA-512(d∥m);  R = r·G ye
              c = SHA-512(R∥A∥m) ye;  S = r + c·a ye
              kɔsegin (R, S) .

Aw ye sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ: c = SHA-512(R∥A∥m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G ye
crypto.h3_a: AES ka Galois/Jateminɛ kɛcogo la. 256-bit keys, 96-bit random nonces, 128-bit dantigɛli taamasiyɛnw. Blob sirilen bɛɛ min bɛ Vortex kɔnɔ, o bɛ baara kɛ ni GCM ye.
crypto.h3_b: GCM bɛ AES boli CTR cogo la ani ka GHASH jatebɔ ciphertext + AAD kan ni key wɛrɛ ye min bɛ bɔ encryption key la. Tag = GHASH(AAD, sɛbɛnni min bɛ kɛ ni cifɔli ye) ⊕ AES-CTR(0). Decryption bɛ segin ka jatebɔ kɛ GHASH ani ka sanga ɲɔgɔn ma — bit-flip kelen o kelen bɛ dɛsɛ ka sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ. Hardware-telier kan bi CPU bɛɛ kan AES-NI walima ARMv8-A kripto extensions fɛ.
crypto.h3_c: AES ye se sɔrɔ NIST AES ɲɔgɔndan na san 2001. GCM kɛra sariya ye NIST SP 800-38D san 2007 ani a ye AEAD default ye TLS 1.3 la. Vortex bɛ 256-bit keys (256-bit keys) ta hali ni 128-bit bɛna se ka kɛ klasiki juguw kama — panni ka se 256-bit ma, o bɛ 128 bits ɲɔgɔn di an ma post-quantum security (kɔrɔlen lakanani) la Grover ka algorithm kɔnɔ.
crypto.h3_f:
Encryption(k, n, aad, pt): ct = AES-CTR(k, n, pt) Bamako, Mali.
                          tag = GHASH_h(aad∥ct∥lens) ⊕ AES(k, n∥1) .
                          segin ct∥tag kan
Nonce reuse ⇒ gundo + tiɲɛni tiɲɛna.
crypto.h4_a: HKDF (HMAC-based KDF, RFC 5869) bɛ kilisi kelen wuli ka kɛ caman ye. A bɛ donnafɛn dɔ ta min ka bon ni entropi ye ani contexte label; bɛ bayt 32 bɔ labeli kelen na.
crypto.h4_b: Fɛn fila: A bɔ ani ka dɔ fara a kan. A bɔlen = HMAC-SHA256(kɔgɔ, IKM) → PRK. Expand = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, info∥counter) min bɛ ɲɔgɔn kan ka ɲɛsin len bayt ma. An bɛ baara Kɛ n'o ye walasa ka X25519 bɔli dɔ tila ka Kɛ kodɔn-kilisi ye, MAC kilisi, ani kuncɛ-kɔlɔsili min bɛ ni kunnafoni-sɛbɛnw ye "v1:encryption", "v1:mac", "v1:header".
crypto.h4_c: HKDF bɔra Hugo Krawczyk fɛ EUROCRYPT san 2010 ani a kɛra sariya ye iko RFC 5869 san 2010. A bɛ baara kɛ ni TLS 1.3 ye a ka waati bolodacogo la, Signal for Double Ratchet fɛ, WireGuard fɛ session keys kama. Versioning in info strings b'a To an bɛ key hierarchy bɛɛ Lamaga ni "v1" → "v2" bumping ye.
crypto.h4_f:
PRK = HMAC-SHA256(kɔgɔ, IKM) .
T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ kunnafoni ∥ i) .
OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ ... tigɛlen ka kɛ len bayt ye
crypto.h5_a: Argon2id ye hakilijagabɔ-hard hash ye min dabɔra ka GPU ani ASIC binkannikɛlaw kɛlɛ. Paramɛtiriw m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32.
crypto.h5_b: Argon2id bɛ Argon2i (a bɛ kɛrɛfɛ-kanaliw Kùnbɛn k’a sababu Kɛ a ma bolofara Kɛ donanw kan minnu bɛ Bɔ daɲɛ dogolen na) ni Argon2d ye (a bɛ hakilijagabɔ Fa cogo la min tɛ Se ka Fɔ walasa paralɛli fɛnɲɛnamafagalanw kana Se ka nkɔni Tigɛ). Fɔlɔ tilancɛ-tɛmɛ ye data-independant (i-mode) ye; tɔ bɛ tali kɛ kunnafonidilanw na (d-mode). Segin 0,5 jatebɔ iPhone X kan an ka paramɛtɛrɛw la, 5 ms ɲɔgɔn ASIC kan — ~100× teliya ka dɔgɔn n’i y’a suma ni SHA-256-based hashes ye yɔrɔ minnu na ASICw bɛ se sɔrɔ ni 1 000 000× ye.
crypto.h5_c: Argon2 ye sebaaya Sɔrɔ 2015 sàn Password Hashing Competition la min Labɛnna Dmitry Khovratovich ni Alex Biryukov fɛ. A kɛra sariya ye ko RFC 9106 san 2021. A bɛ baara kɛ ni 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass ye. Vortex ka paramɛtɛrɛw bɛ Bɔ OWASP 2023 ladilikanw na, minnu Labɛnna walasa ka don an ka dɛmɛnan minɛn na min ka surun kosɛbɛ (iPhone X) segin 1 jukɔrɔ.
crypto.h5_f:
musaka(m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) ≈ 0,5 s iPhone X kan
binkannikɛla musaka : m × t × (p / binkanni_paralɛli) .
Ni 1010 jateminɛ/s ni 40-bit password entropy ye:
  segin 1012 = san 32 000
crypto.h6_a: Kyber-768 (ML-KEM-768) ye NIST-standardized post-quantum key encapsulation fɛɛrɛ ye. A bɛ session keys di quantum-safe minnu faralen don ɲɔgɔn kan ni X25519 ye.
crypto.h6_b: Alice bɛ generate (pk, sk) kɛ. Bob bɛ wele ko Encapsulate(pk) → (c, ss); a bɛ c ci Alisi ma. Alisi bɛ wele ko Decapsulate(sk, c) → ss. Sisan, fàn fla bɛɛ bɛ ss tila ɲɔgɔn na, o ye gundo ye min bɛ bayt 32 Bɔ. Lakanali bɛ Dɔgɔya ka Se Module-LWE gɛlɛya ma, min dalen b’a la ko quantum-hard. An b’a fara ɲɔgɔn kan ni X25519 ye: session_key = HKDF(x25519_bɔnɛ ∥ kyber_bɔnɛ). Ni tilayɔrɔba kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye ɲɛnamaya sɔrɔ, kalan bɛ kɛ.
crypto.h6_c: Kyber Sugandira NIST fɛ 2022 sàn zuluyekalo la sàn 6 ɲɔgɔndan kɔ fɛ. Standardized as FIPS 203 in August 2024. Vortex bɛ Kyber ci i n’a fɔ a bɛ se ka kɛ cogo min na bawo a bɛ ~2 KB fara a kan session bolodiɲɔgɔnma kelen na; a daminɛna ka kɛɲɛ ni saralenw ye, ka don yɔrɔ wɛrɛ la. O fɛɛrɛ hybride (ɲɔgɔndan) in Laɲini kɛra Signal fɛ 2023 sàn na, Chrome y'a Tà 2024 sàn na.
crypto.h6_f:
KeyGen(): (pk ∈ Zq^k, sk ∈ Zq^k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B. Bamako, Mali
Encaps(pk): (ct ∈ Zq^k, ss ∈ {0,1}256) ct = 1088 B. Bamako, Mali
Decaps(sk,ct): ss ∈ {0,1}256. Bamako, Mali
hybride session = HKDF(x25519_bɔ ∥ kyber_bɔ, kunnafoni="segin-v1")
crypto.h7_a: Signal ka Double Ratchet bɛ gundo ɲɛfɛ ani lakana bɛnkan kɔfɛ 1:1 barow kama.
crypto.h7_b: Cakɛda fila: cakɛda cilen ani cakɛda min bɛ sɔrɔ. Cikan kelen-kelen bɛɛ b’a ka cakɛda ɲɛsin HKDF fɛ. Tuma o tuma, Diffie-Hellman ratchet bɛ jirisun in ɲɛfɛ, ka cakɛda fila bɛɛ siri kokura. Cakɛda kilisi dɔ ka bɛnkan bɛ cikan minnu dɔrɔn de Bɔ kɛnɛ kan a ye minnu siri k’a ɲɛsin a ma. DH ratchet kɔfɛ, cikan nataw bɛ lakana hali ni binkannikɛla dɔ ye cakɛda kilisi sonya.
crypto.h7_c: Trevor Perrin ni Moxie Marlinspike de ye a dabɔ san 2013, a bilala senkan Signal 2014 kɔnɔ, WhatsApp (2016) ye min ta, Facebook Messenger Secret Conversations, Skype Private Conversations. Public spec in 2016. Vortex ka waleyali ye port tilennen ye; interop ni Signal-protocol kliyan tɔw ye v0.4 sirako kan.
crypto.h7_f:
ci: CK = HKDF(CK, "sen");  MK = HKDF(CK, "cikan")
sɔrɔli: CK' = HKDF(CK', "sen"); MK' = HKDF(CK', "cikan")
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(anw_eph, u_eph), RK_prev)
crypto.h8_a: BLAKE3 hashing for files — kripto tilayɔrɔba dɔ. Nin ye fɛɛrɛ jɔnjɔn dɔ ye min kofɔlen don Vortex ɲɛfɔli bɛɛ kɔnɔ. Sapitiri min bɛ a lamini na, o kalan walasa ka kunnafoni caman sɔrɔ; nin yɔrɔ in bɛ kɛwale kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bonya.
crypto.h8_b: Baarakɛcogo lajɛlen "BLAKE3 hashing for files" kan. Fɛɛrɛ in bɛ waleya modulu bɛnnin kɔnɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, walima `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` jukɔrɔ. Module README bɛ file sira tigitigiw wele.
crypto.h8_c: "BLAKE3 hashing for files" fɛɛrɛ in jiginna Vortex bɔlenw kɔnɔ. O dilancogo bɛ tali kɛ ciden tɛmɛnenw ka ɲininiw ni u dilanni kɛcogo bɔlenw na. Version tariku min bɛ `CHANGELOG.md` kɔnɔ, o bɛ sɛbɛn kɛ waati min na a yɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ jigira ani min y’a bila.
crypto.h9_a: Random number generation — kripto sapitiri yɔrɔ dɔ. Nin ye fɛɛrɛ jɔnjɔn dɔ ye min kofɔlen don Vortex ɲɛfɔli bɛɛ kɔnɔ. Sapitiri min bɛ a lamini na, o kalan walasa ka kunnafoni caman sɔrɔ; nin yɔrɔ in bɛ kɛwale kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bonya.
crypto.h9_b: Baarakɛcogo ɲɛfɔli "Random number generation" kan. Fɛɛrɛ in bɛ waleya modulu bɛnnin kɔnɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, walima `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` jukɔrɔ. Module README bɛ file sira tigitigiw wele.
crypto.h9_c: "Random number generation" fɛɛrɛ in jiginna Vortex bɔliw bɛɛ la. O dilancogo bɛ tali kɛ ciden tɛmɛnenw ka ɲininiw ni u dilanni kɛcogo bɔlenw na. Version tariku min bɛ `CHANGELOG.md` kɔnɔ, o bɛ sɛbɛnni kɛ waati min na a yɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ jigira ani min y’a bila.
crypto.h10_a: Baarakɛcogo minnu bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ — kripto sapitiri yɔrɔ dɔ. Nin ye fɛɛrɛ jɔnjɔn dɔ ye min kofɔlen don Vortex ɲɛfɔli bɛɛ kɔnɔ. Sapitiri min bɛ a lamini na, o kalan walasa ka kunnafoni caman sɔrɔ; nin yɔrɔ in bɛ kɛwale kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bonya.
crypto.h10_b: Waleya lajɛba "Waati basigilen baarakɛcogo" kama. Fɛɛrɛ in bɛ waleya modulu bɛnnin kɔnɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, walima `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` jukɔrɔ. Module README bɛ file sira tigitigiw wele.
crypto.h10_c: "Waati basigilen baarakɛcogo" fɛɛrɛ in jiginna Vortex bɔliw kɔnɔ. O dilancogo bɛ tali kɛ ciden tɛmɛnenw ka ɲininiw ni u dilanni kɛcogo bɔlenw na. Version tariku min bɛ `CHANGELOG.md` kɔnɔ, o bɛ sɛbɛnni kɛ waati min na a yɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ jigira ani min y’a bila.

cryptoWire.title: Crypto wire cogoyaw
cryptoWire.subtitle: Bayt labɛncogo tigitigiw blob sirilen bɛɛ la.
cryptoWire.intro: Nin tilayɔrɔba in bɛ bayt (bayt) minnu bɛ fili kan, olu sɛbɛn. Mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ bɛ kiliyan wɛrɛ walima kiritigɛlaw ka baarakɛminɛn dɔ waleya, o tigi bɛ se ka kalan kɛ.
cryptoWire.h1p1: Jateminɛ: `{v:1, nonce:<12-bayt hex>, ciphertext:<variable hex>, ciden_pseudo:<32-hex>, cilen_at:<unix_ms>}`. A bɛ ci HTTPS (POST) ani WebSocket (kalan suguya `m`) kan.
cryptoWire.h1p2: `ciphertext` kɔnɔkow AES-GCM decryption kɔfɛ: CBOR `{v:1, sɛbɛnni?:<string>, attachments?:[<file_id>, ...], jaabi_ka?:<msg_id>, ladilan?:[<sɛbɛn_kɔrɔ>, ...], a bɛ fɔ?:[<user_id>, ...]}`.
cryptoWire.h1p3: Tag bɛ kɔfɛ: `ciphertext` bayt sɛrɛ ye (payload encrypté || 16-bayt tag). Client bɛ tila ka kɛɲɛ ni janya ye.
cryptoWire.h1p4: AAD: hex room id min bɛ ni sɛbɛnni fitininw ye, o bɛ tɛmɛ i n’a fɔ kunnafoniw minnu bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na. So id sirili bɛ so cross-room replay bali.
cryptoWire.h2p1: File root key ye random 32 bayt ye. Kɔrɔɲɔgɔnma kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka kilisi: `HKDF(juru, kunnafoni: "dosiyɛri:yɔrɔ:" + <offset>, len: 32)`.
cryptoWire.h2p2: Chunk ciphertext: AES-GCM ni chunk kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka kilisi ye, 96-bit nonce random, AAD: `<file_id> || <offset>`. Max chunk hakɛ ye 512 KiB ye.
cryptoWire.h2p3: Dosiyɛri bɛɛ lajɛlen dafalen : kiliyan bɛ BLAKE3 jate sɛbɛn gansan kan ka ci i n’a fɔ `plain_blake3` ka ci sɔrɔbaga ma so cikan fɛ. Jatebɔbaga bɛ segin ka jatebɔ kɛ telesarse kɔfɛ ani k’a sɛgɛsɛgɛ.
cryptoWire.h3p1: Client bɛ `p256dh_pub` (32-byte X25519) bila node kɔnɔ.
cryptoWire.h3p2: Ni puse dɔ ka kan ka kɛ, node bɛ X25519 key ephemeral dɔ lawuli, ka DH kɛ ni `p256dh_pub` ye, ka AES-GCM key sɔrɔ HKDF fɛ.
cryptoWire.h3p3: Blob sirilen: `{endpoint, p256dh: kiliyan ka pub, auth: bayt 16, data: ciphertext||tag}`. APNw/FCM ye `donanw` dɔrɔn de lajɛ.
cryptoWire.h3p4: Client bɛ decryptes on receive ni a ka privé key ani `p256dh` (o ye tiɲɛ na node ka ephemeral pub ye enveloppe kɔnɔ).
cryptoWire.h4p1: Password bɛ backup key sɔrɔ Argon2id fɛ (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, salt=<random 16B>, hashLen=32).
cryptoWire.h4p2: Blob: `{kɔgɔ, nonce, ciphertext}`. Ciphertext ye CBOR ye `{v:1, so:[{id,key,ct_refs}...], profile:{...}, contacts:[...]}` la.
cryptoWire.h4p3: A bɛ mara sigida la (iCloud / Google Drive) walima node dɔ kan baarakɛla ka so kɔnɔ.
cryptoWire.h5p1: Cross-node cikan: `{source_node: <pubkey>, target_user: <id>, kɔnɔna: {... o ni so enveloppe ye kelen ye ...}, sig: <64-byte Ed25519>}`.
cryptoWire.h5p2: `sig` bɛ CBOR-serialised `{source_node, target_user, kɔnɔna}` datugu. Laɲini bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ `source_node` pubkey kan ka bɔ `trusted_nodes` la.
cryptoWire.h1_a: So kelen cikan min bɛ nɛgɛ kan o ye CBOR dict ye ni payload sirilen ye, nonce, ciden tɔgɔ wɛrɛ, ani waati taamasiyɛn. Anwɛlɛki bɛ kelen ye hali n’a bɛ boli HTTPS (POST) walima WebSocket (kalan suguya `m`).
cryptoWire.h1_b: Client bɛ cikan farikolo `{v:1, sɛbɛnni, jaabi_ka, cilen_at}` seriyali kɛ i n'a fɔ CBOR → `pt`. A bɛ nonce 12-byte random dɔ lawuli. Jatebɔ kɛ `aad = hex(so_id)`. A bɛ wele ko `ct = AES-GCM-256-Encrypt(so_key, nonce, pt, aad)`. A bɛ siri `{v:1, ciphertext: hex(ct), nonce: hex(nonce), ciden_pseudo: hex(pseudo), ciden_at: unix_ms}` ani ka ci. Jaabi bɛ GCM taamaʃyɛn Sɛgɛsɛgɛ decrypt waati la, o kɔ fɛ CBOR-parse sɛbɛn jɛlenw kan.
cryptoWire.h1_c: Filɛri cogoya ye version-tagged ye kabini v0.0.4 v0.0.3 bɔli kɔfɛ min tun tɛ ni `v` foro ye — an tun ka kan ka format bɛɛ bump n’an ye `thread_id` fara a kan bawo kliyan kɔrɔw binna key dɔnbali kan. Kalan min sɔrɔla : nɛgɛso nata bɛɛ bɛ `v:N` ta a ka foro fɔlɔ la o la ɲɛfɛ bɛnkan bɛ jɛya.
cryptoWire.h2_a: Dosiyɛriw bɛ tila ka kɛ fɛnɲɛnɛmaw ye minnu bonya bɛ sigi sen kan, u kelen-kelen bɛɛ n’u ka kilisi bɛ bɔ dosiye ju ju la ani fɛnɲɛnɛmaw ka bɔyɔrɔ la. Per-chunk encryption bɛ ciden bila ka jɔ/segin chunk dancɛ o dancɛ kan.
cryptoWire.h2_b: File root key ye random 32 bayt ye. Per-chunk key ye `HKDF(root, info="file:chunk:" + str(offset), len=32)` ye. Chunk kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ AES-GCM siri ni a yɛrɛ ka key ye, random 96-bit nonce, ani `aad = file_id ∥ offset`. Chunks default ka kɛ 512 KiB ye; 4 MiB ka bɔgɔdaga. Dosiyɛri dafalen BLAKE3 bɛ ci i n’a fɔ `plain_blake3` so cikan kɔnɔ min bɛ dosiye in jira walasa a sɔrɔbagaw ka se ka sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ decrypt kɔfɛ.
cryptoWire.h2_c: Chunked E2E encryption ni per-chunk keys daminɛna Mega.nz fɛ san 2013 ani a nɔgɔyara Signal ka large-file support fɛ san 2019. Vortex ka 512 KiB default ye hakɛ ye min na TCP flow control bɛ pipe fa fa ni a kun janw tɛ mobili 4G kan. An ye 256/512/1024/4096 KiB sɛgɛsɛgɛ ani 512 de tun ye dumuni duman ye an ka sumanikɛlanw na.
cryptoWire.h3_a: Puse enveloppe min datugulen don, o bɛ kunnafoni nafama dogo Apple / Google / Mozilla la ni a sirili ye ni minɛn kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen X25519 kilisi ye.
cryptoWire.h3_b: Client bɛ `p256dh_pub` ni `auth` sɛbɛn node la. Ni puse dɔ ka kan ka kɛ, node bɛ boli ephemeral-ECDH ni p256dh_pub ye, ka key + nonce sɔrɔ HKDF fɛ ni auth gundo ye i n’a fɔ kɔgɔ. A bɛ `{title, farikolo, so_id, message_id}` siri ni AES-GCM ye. A bɛ sɛbɛn ci i n’a fɔ `data` foro opaque ka taa push dilanbaga ma. Minɛnw janya bɛ segin ka bɔ, ka decrypt, ka renders.
cryptoWire.h3_c: Push min sigilen don, o ye Web Push Message Encryption spec ye (RFC 8291, 2017). Apple y'a Tà iOS 16 ka Ladɔnniyali-sɛnɛfɛnw 'kɔnɔ. Sani sealed push ka kɛ dɛmɛ ye kosɛbɛ, Signal ni WhatsApp ye "fɛn dɔ sera" pings makunlenw ci k'a sɔrɔ kɔnɔkow tɛ ani ka app bila ka cikan in ta kunun waati la — o tun bɛ kɛ dɔɔnin dɔɔnin. Sealed push bɛ danbe di an ma laban-ni-ban ka fara instant render kan.
cryptoWire.h4_a: Encrypted backup blob bɛ baarakɛla bila ka so keys + profile + segin tile 90 kɔnɔ minɛn kura kan ka bɔ password dɔrɔn na.
cryptoWire.h4_b: Backup key bɛ bɔ password la Argon2id fɛ ni kɔgɔ 16-byte random ye. Nafa ye CBOR ye: `{v:1, so: [{id, key, msg_ref_ids}], profil, contacts}`. A sirilen bɛ ni AES-GCM ye min bɛ sɔrɔ kilisi jukɔrɔ. A maralen bɛ sigida la (iCloud / Google Drive) walima i n’a fɔ dosiye min bɛ baarakɛla ka sankaba so kɔnɔ. Segin: tɔgɔlasɛbɛn don → Argon2id → decrypt → keys ni references don kokura.
cryptoWire.h4_c: O cogoya in bɛ tali kɛ 1Password ka OPVault (2013) ani Bitwarden ka sirilen bɔli la (2017). U fila bɛɛ bɛ baara kɛ ni KDF-o kɔfɛ-AEAD ye ni kɔgɔ-dafalenw ye. Vortex ye tile 90 tigɛcogo fara a kan bawo tariku dafalenw kɔkannafɛnw tun ye 100 MB+ ye kɔrɔbɔli la; segin-ka-bɔnye fanba mago bɛ cikan kɔsa in na dɔrɔn, wa kunnafoni kɔrɔw bɛ se ka sɔrɔ hali bi sèrwɛri ciphertext fɛ ni baarakɛla bɛ ni jɛɲɔgɔnya ye.
cryptoWire.h5_a: Cross-node federation message bɛ kɔnɔna enveloppe min sirilen don kaban, o siri kɛnɛma enveloppe bolonɔbilalen dɔ kɔnɔ min bɛ source node lakika.
cryptoWire.h5_b: Node A bɛ `{source_node, target_user, kɔnɔna_ct, kɔnɔna_nonce, sent_at}` kɛ seriyali ye i n'a fɔ CBOR. Taamaʃyɛnw n'a ka Ed25519 kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen bɔli kilisi → `sig`. POSTs `{enveloppe, sig}` ka node B ka `/federation/deliver` ma. B bɛ `sig` sɛgɛsɛgɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni pubkey ye `source_node` kama `federations` kɔnɔ, ka waati taamasiyɛn lajɛ miniti 5 skew window kɔnɔ, o kɔfɛ a bɛ kɔnɔna ciphertext sɛbɛn a yɛrɛ ka `messages` tabali la baarakɛla laɲinibaga ye.
cryptoWire.h5_c: Kɛnɛma anwɛlɛki bolonɔbilalenw bɛ juru ta Matrix ka federation spec (2015) ani ActivityPub ka HTTP Signatures (2018) la. Miniti 5 finɛtiri bɛ bɛn SMTP ka RFC 5321 ladilikan ma, wa a bɛ segin-ka-bɔnyew bali yɔrɔ min na binkannikɛla dɔ bɛ federasɔn kelen minɛ POST k’a segin a kan lɛrɛ caman kɔfɛ. Vortex ye Ed25519 sugandi RSA-PSS kan bawo Ed25519 bolonɔbilaw ye bayt 64 ye vs RSA-PSS-2048 ka bayt 256 — o nafa ka bon ni federasɔn ye baro ye.
cryptoWire.h2_f:
file_root = ran (32) .
chunk_key(o) = HKDF(dosiyɛri_juru, "dosiyɛri:chunk:" + o, 32)
chunk_ct(o) = AES-GCM(chunk_key(o), rand(12), sɛbɛnni jɛlen, aad=dosiyɛri_id ∥ o)
full_hash = BLAKE3(sɛbɛn_kɛnɛ_bayiti_ka_filen_dafalen) // cilen don iko plain_blake3
cryptoWire.h3_f:
waati dɔɔnin = (priv, pub);  ikm = ECDH(waati dɔɔnin.priv, p256dh_pub)
prk = HMAC-SHA256(sɛbɛnni, ikm)
key = HKDF-Expand(prk, "Kɔnɔkow-kodeli: aes128gcm\0", 16)
nonce = HKDF-Expand(prk, "Kɔnɔkow-kodɔn: nonce\0", 12)
ct = AES-GCM(key, nonce, CBOR{titre, farikolo, so_id, cikan_id})
nɛgɛ = kɔgɔ(16) ∥ rs(4) ∥ baarakɛbali(1) ∥ waati dɔɔnin.pub(32) ∥ ct
cryptoWire.h4_f:
kɔgɔ = ran(16) .
key = Argon2id(daɲɛ dogolen, kɔgɔ, m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, len=32)
nonce = ran(12) .
ct = AES-GCM(kili, nonce, CBOR{so, profil, contacts}, aad="vortex-backup-v1")
file = {v:1, kɔgɔ, nonce, ct}.
cryptoWire.h5_f:
kɛnɛma = CBOR{ .
  sɔrɔyɔrɔ_yɔrɔ: hex32, .
  laɲini_baarakɛla: int64, .
  kɔnɔna_ciphertext: bayt, .
  kɔnɔna_nonce: bayt, .
  ci_yɔrɔ: unix_ms
} .
sig = Ed25519-Sign(sɔrɔ_dakun, kɛnɛma) .
POST /federasiyɔn/lase { anwɛlɛki: kɛnɛma, sig: hex64 } .

auth.title: Tiɲɛni
auth.subtitle: Aw ye aw tɔgɔ sɛbɛn, ka don, ka segin a kan, ka a bɔ a la. JWT + X25519 + tɛmɛsira min bɛ se ka kɛ / kisɛ / 2FA.
auth.intro: Vortex bɛ JWT minnu tɛ mɛn (miniti 15 sɔrɔli, tile 30 lakurayali) ni baarakɛla ka X25519 foroba kilisi sirilen don a kɔnɔ.Labanyɔrɔ sensitif bɛɛ bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ JWT + b’a sɛgɛsɛgɛ ko kilisi ma bɔ a la. Nin tilayɔrɔba in bɛ jibɔ bɛɛ lajɛlen ɲɛfɔ ka bɔ a laban na ka taa a laban na.
auth.h1p1: Client bɛ daminɛ ni 32-byte X25519 private key kura bɔli ye ni OS RNG ye. A bɛ foroba-kɔlɔsili Sɔrɔ, a bɛ kodɔn i n’a fɔ 64 hex chars.
auth.h1p2: Client bɛ `POST /api/authentication/register` bila ni `{baarakɛla tɔgɔ, tɔgɔlasɛbɛn, x25519_public_key, display_name, telefɔni, email, avatar_emoji, kyber_public_key?}` ye.
auth.h1p3: Node bɛ tiɲɛ: baarakɛla tɔgɔ bɛ bɛn `^[a-z0-9_]{3,30}$` (daɲɛ fitininw walasa ka i yɛrɛ tanga homograph squats ma); tɔgɔlasɛbɛn bɛ tɛmɛ zxcvbn-cogo fanga fɛ (min jate 2); telefɔni bɛ bɛn E.164 ma ni a dira; email bɛ bɛn RFC 5322 basigilen regex ni a dira.
auth.h1p4: Node bɛ `x25519_public_key` danfara lajɛ — pubkey kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ se ka jatebɔsɛbɛn kelen tigitigi sɛbɛn. O bɛ binkanniw jɔ minnu bɛ baara kɛ kokura ni pubkey kelen ye.
auth.h1p5: Node bɛ Argon2id baara daɲɛ dogolen kan (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) ani ka `argon2:$...$` mara `users.password_hash` kɔnɔ.
auth.h1p6: Node mint JWT fila: sɔrɔli (miniti 15, `jti:<device_id>`) ani lakurayali (d 30). Kɔrɔfɔliw: `{sub: baarakɛla_id, jti: minɛn_id, typ: sɔrɔli|lakurayali, exp: ...}`. Siginiden HS256 kan 64-bayt sèrvèr gundo kan min doni bɛ Bɔ `.env` la.
auth.h1p7: Node bɛ `baarakɛla_minɛnw` jirisun dɔ da: `{baarakɛla_id, minɛn_id, baarakɛla_ciden, dabɔra_yɔrɔ}`. Lakurayali kelen-kelen bɛɛ sirilen bɛ a ka device_id la; minɛn dɔ bɔli a la, o bɛ o jikuru dɔrɔn de faga.
auth.h1p8: Jaabi: `{ok, baarakɛla_id, baarakɛla tɔgɔ, don_taamaʃyɛn, refresh_token, x25519_foroba_kilisi, kyber_foroba_kɔlɔsili, jirali_tɔgɔ, avatar_url, telefɔni, imɛri}`.
auth.h1p9: Client bɛ tokenw mara Keychain (iOS) / EncryptedSharedPreferences (Android) / HttpOnly SameSite=Kukisɛ gɛlɛnw (web) kɔnɔ.
auth.h1l1: Hakɛ dantigɛli: mɔgɔ 5 tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni segin 60 kɔnɔ IP kelen kɔnɔ. TESTING=tiɲɛ bɛ nin bali.
auth.h1l2: Weelecogo: ni `REGISTRATION_MODE=invite`, farikolo ka kan ka `invite_code` bɛnnen dɔ don a kɔnɔ. Kodew bɛ Sɔrɔ admin API fɛ.
auth.h1l3: Dadoncogo: `REGISTRATION_MODE=dafalen`. Kisɛ ɲɛmɔgɔ dɔrɔn de bɛ se k’a tɔgɔ sɛbɛn. Baarakɛlaw minnu bɛ na o kɔfɛ, olu bɛ se weleli-yɔrɔw fɛ ka don so kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw kɔnɔ.
auth.h2p1: Client bɛ `POST /api/authentication/login` bila ni `{baarakɛla tɔgɔ, tɔgɔlasɛbɛn}` ye.
auth.h2p2: Node bɛ ɲininkali kɛ `baarakɛlaw` la ni baarakɛla tɔgɔ fitinin ye. Ni a ma Sɔrɔ, a bɛ hali bi dummy Argon2 verify boli ka kɛɲɛ ni hash basigilen ye walasa ka waati kɛcogo kelen (~0,5 s cogo o cogo).
auth.h2p3: Ni Argon2 verify ye ɲɛtaa sɔrɔ ani ni jatebɔ ma bali, node bɛ enveloppe kelen segin ni register ye. `user_devices` jirisun kura dɔ bɛ dabɔ; jirisun minnu bɛ yen, olu bɛ to u kelen na walasa baarakɛla ka se ka don minɛn caman kan.
auth.h2p4: Ni sɛgɛsɛgɛli ma ɲɛ, node bɛ 401 segin ni `{error:"invalid credentials"}` ye. Danfara tɛ "baarakɛla tɔgɔ jugu" ni "daɲɛ jugu" cɛ jaabi kɔnɔ.
auth.h2l1: Hakɛ dantigɛli: A ɲinini dɛsɛlen 10 segin 60 kɔnɔ IP kelen kɔnɔ. Tɛmɛnen bɛ 429 segin ni `Retry-After` kuncɛlen ye.
auth.h2l2: Konte lockout: 20 dɛsɛra cɛsiri 24 h kɔnɔ, o bɛ jate minɛ ka ɲɛsin admin lajɛ ma. Legit baarakɛlaw bɛ password-reset dɔrɔn u ka sira don.
auth.h2l3: Session tracking: `/api/authentication/devices` bɛ sessions baarakɛtaw bɛɛ jate; baarakɛla bɛ se ka dɔ bɔ a la.
auth.h3p1: Ni dondaw taamasiyɛn bɛ waati surun kɛrɛfɛ (kiliyan bɛ `exp` nɔfɛ sigida la) walima ni ɲinini dɔ seginna 401 ni `token expired` ye, kiliyan bɛ `POST /api/authentication/refresh` bila ni `{refresh_token}` ye.
auth.h3p2: Node bɛ refresh decode, ka `jti` lajɛ hali bi `user_devices` kɔnɔ (a ma revoked), ka `exp` lajɛ, ka mint kɛ don token kura ye.
auth.h3p3: Refresh rotation bɛ dabila ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye. A dabɔ ni `ROTATE_REFRESH=true` ye walasa ka seginkanni kura bɔ fana.
auth.h3p4: Ni refresh waati tɛmɛna, ni a banna, walima ni a kɛra nkalon ye, node bɛ segin 401. Client bɛ bɔ sigida la ka a ɲini a fɛ a ka segin ka don.
auth.h4p1: Web kliyanw bɛ se ka plateforme lakika dɔ tɔgɔ sɛbɛn (Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric). Server bɛ `{seereyaw_id, foroba_kɔlɔsili, jatebɔlan}` mara.
auth.h4p2: Donni: `POST /api/authentication/passkey/begin` → baarakɛla bɛ gɛlɛya segin; kiliyanw ka taamasiyɛnw ni tɛmɛsira privé (min bɛ mara Secure Enclave / TPM kɔnɔ); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → baarakɛla bɛ JWT sɛgɛsɛgɛ ani ka bɔ.
auth.h4p3: Jateden kelen-kelen sɛgɛsɛgɛli : sɛgɛsɛgɛli bɛɛ ka kan ka dɔ fara jatebɔlan kan. N'a ma Kɛ, tɛmɛsira bɛ Jate i n'a fɔ clone (klon) ani a banna.
auth.h5p1: I n’a fɔ balawu-labɔli sira, baarakɛla bɛ se ka daɲɛ 24 BIP-39 kisɛ dɔ bila ka taa jamana wɛrɛ la. A donni minɛn o minɛn kan, o bɛ X25519 danyɔrɔ labɛn kokura (kisɛ → HKDF → kilisi jɔlen) ani ka a sɔrɔli jira gɛlɛya bolonɔbilalen dɔ sababu fɛ.
auth.h5p2: Kisɛ tɛ bɔ minɛn kɔnɔ abada. Node bɛ foroba kilisi sɔrɔlen X25519 dɔrɔn de ye ani bolonɔbila dɔ kan sèrwɛri gɛlɛya dɔ kan.
auth.h5p3: Entropi: 256 bitiki (32 bayt) ye. BIP-39 checksum ye standard ye, o la sɛbɛnni filiw bɛ minɛ ka sɔrɔ ka se server ma.
auth.h6p1: TOTP (RFC 6238) ni sen 30 ni kode 6 ye. A bɛ se ka kɛ baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye.
auth.h6p2: Sɛbɛnni: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` bɛ gundo + otpauth URI + QR segin. Baarakɛla bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ ni Google Authenticator / Authy / 1Password ye. Baarakɛla bɛ kode 6 misali dɔ bila kɔfɛ walasa k’a jira ko appli bɛ baara kɛ.
auth.h6p3: Don ni 2FA ye: tɔgɔlasɛbɛn tɛmɛnen kɔfɛ, node bɛ segin `{needs_2fa: true}`. Client bɛ kode ɲini ani ka poste kɛ `/api/authentication/login/2fa` kan.
auth.h6p4: Hakɛ dantigɛli: 5 TOTP cɛsiri miniti 5 kɔnɔ baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ la. Tɛmɛni bɛ seginkanni 60 kɔnɔna na ani lasɔmini kɛ imɛri la.
