auth.h6p5: Backup codes: 12 × 10-kode minnu bɛ jira siɲɛ kelen i tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni waati. Baara bɛ se ka kɛ ni kode kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye siɲɛ kelen tigitigi.
auth.h7p1: Telefɔni min donna, o bɛ se ka tablɛti kura don a kɔnɔ ni QR kode ye. Minɛn A bɛ `POST /api/authentication/qr/begin` bila → sèrwɛri bɛ nonce ni TTL segin.
auth.h7p2: Minɛn A bɛ QR jira min kɔnɔ `nonce + user_id + server_url` bɛ sɔrɔ. Minɛn B bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ ani ka `POST /api/authentication/qr/verify` bila ni nonce ye.
auth.h7p3: Server b’a sɛgɛsɛgɛ ko nonce bɛ ɲɛnamaya la hali bi (TTL 60 s, one-shot), ka minɛn B ka X25519 pubkey kura siri baarakɛla A ka jatebɔsɛbɛn na (`user_devices` row kura), ka segin JWT kan minɛn B la.
auth.h7p4: Minɛn A bɛ WebSocket kunnafoni sɔrɔ `{type:"n", event:"new_device"}` walasa baarakɛla ka se ka a sɛmɛntiya / ka ban waati yɛrɛ la.
auth.h8p1: An b'a laɲini ka fili kelen in Lasegin "tɔgɔ dɔnbali" ni "daɲɛ dogolen" kan. Sɛbɛnni hakɛ dantigɛliw bɛ baarakɛla tɔgɔ minnu bɛ yen, olu dogo.
auth.h8p2: Profil labanyɔrɔw (`/api/users/{username}`) bɛ auth de wajibiya. Binkannikɛla tɛ Se ka baarakɛlaw tɔgɔw Jate ni token ɲuman tɛ.
auth.h8p3: Rate dan min bɛ `/api/authentication/login` kan, o bɛ brute force mara ka kɛ crawl ye.
auth.h1_a: I tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni bɛ danyɔrɔ kura Dabɔ: X25519 keypair minɛn kan, Argon2id password hash sèrvèr kan, JWT pair min bɛ Bɔ ni ɲɛtaa ye.
auth.h1_b: 1nan : kiliyan bɛ `crypto.randomBytes(32)` boli X25519 kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen kilisi kama, ka foroba kilisi sɔrɔ (~100 μs telefɔni na). 2nan : POST /api/authentication/register ni `{baarakɛla tɔgɔ, tɔgɔlasɛbɛn, x25519_public_key, jirali_tɔgɔ, telefɔni, imɛri, avatar_emoji}`. 3nan : node bɛ tiɲɛni Kɛ Pydantic fɛ (baarakɛla tɔgɔ regex, tɔgɔlasɛbɛn ≥ 8 chars, telefɔni E.164, email RFC-5322-lite). 4nan : node bɛ baara kɛ Argon2id(password) → `argon2:...`, a bɛ mara `users.password_hash` kɔnɔ. 5nan : node bɛ sɔrɔko JWT (miniti 15) + refresh JWT (tile 30), a bɛ to `user_devices` row la.
auth.h1_c: Flow ye bi jiginni ye PHP ka mysql_real_escape_string waati la. Bi auth stack bɛɛ — Auth0, Firebase, Supabase — bɛ o cogoya in kɛ ka caya. Twist kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen min bɛ Vortex kɔnɔ o ye ka X25519 pubkey ci register call kɔnɔ: o kɔrɔ ye ko jatebɔ sirilen bɛ E2E danyɔrɔ kuntaalajan dɔ la ka bɔ frame fɔlɔ la, a tɛ fara a kan kɔfɛ. A lawulilen don Signal ka san 2013 protocol design fɛ.
auth.h1_f:
POST /api/dafalen/sɛbɛnni
  { baarakɛla tɔgɔ, tɔgɔlasɛbɛn, x25519_foroba_kɔlɔsi, jiralan_tɔgɔ, telefɔni?, imɛri?, avatar_emoji }

Jaabi 201 Dabɔra:
  { access_token, refresh_token, baarakɛla_id, baarakɛla tɔgɔ, ... } .
auth.h2_a: Login bɛ tɔgɔlasɛbɛn sɛgɛsɛgɛ ni Argon2 hash maralen ye ani ka JWT fila kura bɔ n’a bɛ bɛn.
auth.h2_b: POST /api/dafalen/don ni `{baarakɛla tɔgɔ, tɔgɔlasɛbɛn}` ye. Node bɛ ɲininkali kɛ `baarakɛlaw` la ni baarakɛla tɔgɔ fitinin ye. Ni a sɔrɔla, a bɛ Argon2id sɛgɛsɛgɛ waati basigilen kɔnɔ ni `users.password_hash` ye. Ni a ma sɔrɔ, hali bi a bɛ boli dummy Argon2 verify kan ka kɛɲɛ ni sɛrɛ basigilen ye walasa ka waati kɛcogo bɛn. Ɲɛtaa → JWT fila kura + `baarakɛla_minɛnw` jirisun kura (kelen don minɛn kelen-kelen bɛɛ kɔnɔ). Dɛsɛ → 401 ni "seereyaw tiɲɛnenw" caman ye — danfara tɛ baarakɛla tɔgɔ jugu ni tɔgɔ jugu cɛ, walasa ka jatebɔ kɛlɛ.
auth.h2_c: Waati-sɛgɛsɛgɛli min bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ ani hashing (hashing) min bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ baarakɛlaw fɛ minnu tɛ yen, o ye misali ye Signal min tara san 2014 ɲininikɛlaw ye waati jatebɔ jira u ka don labanyɔrɔ la. Kabini o waati a bɛ Kɛ kosɛbɛ — django-axes, authelia, Keycloak bɛɛ bɛ baara Kɛ n'a ye. O wale in bɛ ~0,5 s fara donko cɛsiri bɛɛ kan min ma ɲɛ, o ye ko ɲuman ye; an bɛ donni hakɛ dantigɛ 10/min/IP cogo o cogo.
auth.h2_f:
dummy_hash = Argon2id("__waati_ɲɛnabɔli__", kɔgɔ=labɛnna, ...)

donna(u, p): .
  row = baarakɛlaw.find(baarakɛla tɔgɔ=u.lower())
  ni row ye None ye:
      Argon2Verify(dummy_hash, p) // waati kɛcogo kelen
      ka 401 wuli
  ni o tɛ Argon2Verify(row.password_hash, p):
      ka 401 wuli
  segin bɔko_jwt(row) .
auth.h3_a: Sɔrɔdasi taamasiyɛnw bɛ ban miniti 15 kɔfɛ. Refresh bɛ refresh token min bɛ mɛn sen na, o bɛ ɲɔgɔn falen-falen ni don token kura ye k’a sɔrɔ a ma segin ka baarakɛla ɲininka a ka tɔgɔlasɛbɛn na.
auth.h3_b: Client bɛ `exp` nɔfɛtaama sigida la. Ni `now + 30s > exp`, walima ni ɲinini dɔ seginna 401 ni `token_expired` ye, kiliyan bɛ seginkanni taamasiyɛn POST kɛ `/api/authentication/refresh` la. Node bɛ dekodɔn, ka `jti` lajɛ `user_devices` kɔnɔ wa a tɛ `revoked_at` kɔnɔ, ka `exp` lajɛ, ka miniti 15 doncogo taamasiyɛn kura mint. Refresh rotation is opt-in via `ROTATE_REFRESH=true` — off by default because refresh tokens jiginni doncogo kura bɛɛ la, o bɛ boli dabɔ ni kiliyan fila ye lakurayali kɛ waati kelen na.
auth.h3_c: OAuth 2.0 (RFC 6749, 2012) ye sɔrɔli + lakurayali danfara don sen kan. Miniti 15 sɔrɔli ɲɛnamaya ye cɛmancɛ ye izini bɛɛ kɔnɔ — Google bɛ baara kɛ ni sanga 1 ye, Auth0 bɛ baara kɛ ni sanga 24 ye, Okta bɛ baara kɛ ni sanga 1 ye. An ye miniti 15 ta walasa ka finɛtiri dɔgɔya min kɔnɔna na dondaw taamasiyɛn sonyalen nafa ka bon. Tile 30 lakurayali bɛ bɛn mobili porogaramu fanba mago bɛ min na walasa baarakɛlaw ka to ka don a kɔnɔ kalo kelen baarakɛbaliya kɔnɔ.
auth.h4_a: WebAuthn / tɛmɛsira doncogo bɛ baara kɛ ni plateforme authenticator ye (Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric) tɔgɔlasɛbɛn nɔ na.
auth.h4_b: I tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni : sèrwɛri bɛ gɛlɛya dɔ bila sen kan; kiliyan ka dantigɛlikɛla bɛ kilisi kura dɔ lawuli a ka enclave lakananen kɔnɔ ka foroba kilisi + seereya ci ka segin. Server bɛ `{seereyaw_id, foroba_kɔlɔsili, jatebɔlan}` mara. Donni: `POST /api/authentication/passkey/begin` → baarakɛla bɛ gɛlɛya dɔ segin; kiliyanw bɛ bolonɔ bila ni dantigɛlikɛla ka dankan kilisi ye (min maralen bɛ Secure Enclave kɔnɔ, a tɛ bɔ puce la abada); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → baarakɛla bɛ bolonɔbila sɛgɛsɛgɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni foroba kilisi maralen ye. Jatebɔlan kelen-kelen bɛ dantigɛlikɛlanw (clones) dɔn minnu kɛra ni fɛnw ye.
auth.h4_c: FIDO2 / WebAuthn kɛra sariya ye W3C fɛ san 2019 san caman baara kɔfɛ FIDO Jɛkulu fɛ. Apple ye platform-authenticator dɛmɛ fara iOS 16 (2022) kɔnɔ; Google, Microsoft, 1Password tugura o kɔ. Vortex ye WebAuthn ta v0.0.8 kɔnɔ. A bɛ kɛ ni ŋaniya ye nka a bɛ fɔ kosɛbɛ — tɛmɛsira baarakɛlaw t’a ye abada ko jatebɔsɛbɛnw tali min sinsinnen bɛ phishing kan bawo kilisi kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen tɛ minɛn dancɛ tigɛ abada.
auth.h4_f:
sɛbɛnni_daminɛ(): gɛlɛya = rand(32) .
                    sugandiliw = { rp.id, baarakɛla.id, pubKeyCredParams, gɛlɛya }
                    segin sugandiliw

register_finish(sɛbɛnni) : .
  sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ seereya kan TPM / Secure Enclave root CA .
  store { seereyaw_id, foroba_kɔlɔsili, jatebɔlan: 0 } .
auth.h5_a: Kisɛ-kumasen seginni bɛ X25519 danyɔrɔ labɛn kokura minɛn kura kan ka bɔ daɲɛ 24 BIP-39 hakilijagabɔ la. A man kan abada ko sèrvèr ka decryption material si mara.
auth.h5_b: Baarakɛla bɛ hakilijagabɔ sɛbɛn a daminɛ fɔlɔ la (a bɛ se ka kɛ, a bɛ kɛ siɲɛ kelen). Walasa ka kɛnɛya: minɛn kura kan, baarakɛla bɛ don hakilijagabɔ la; kiliyan bɛ boli PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512(hakilila, "hakilila", 2048 lamini) → kisɛ bayt 64. Kisɛ in ka bayt 32 fɔlɔw bɛ Kɛ X25519 dankan kilisi ye; foroba kilisi bɛ bɔ. Server bɛ fɔ foroba key kura dɔrɔn de ye; a bɛ possession sɛgɛsɛgɛ ni Ed25519 challenge-response ye (signed nonce), o kɔfɛ a bɛ JWTw bɔ.
auth.h5_c: BIP-39 (Bitcoin Improvement Proposal 39, 2013) ye kanon ye min bɛ se ka gundo gundo kodɔn i n’a fɔ daɲɛw lisɛli minnu bɛ to mɔgɔ hakili la. 2048-daɲɛ tubabukan daɲɛgafe min bɛ ni 4-bayt sɛgɛsɛgɛli ye a laban na. Vortex bɛ baara kɛ ni daɲɛ 24 ye bawo izini sariya min bɛ kɛ ka ɲɛsin waribɔlanw ma minnu bɛ lakana kosɛbɛ (Trezor, Ledger) o ye 24. Daɲɛ 12 tun bɛna se ka kɛ 128-bit lakanani na nka a tɛ kɛ fɛnba ye baarakɛla fanba fɛ.
auth.h5_f:
daɲɛw = BIP39_Kode(entropy=256_bit + 8_bit_checksum) .
kisɛ = PBKDF2-SHA512(daɲɛw, "hakilila", laminiw=2048, len=64)
sk = kisɛ[0:32] // X25519 mɔgɔ kelen
pk = sk · G // X25519 foroba
auth.h6_a: Fɛn fila-fila-dafalen bɛ waati-dafalen-daɲɛ kelen (TOTP) taamaʃyɛn Fàra o kan daɲɛ-sɛbɛnni-sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɔfɛ.
auth.h6_b: Sɛbɛnni: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` → sèrwɛri bɛ gundo 160-bit random dɔ lawuli, k’a segin i n’a fɔ base32 sɛrɛ + otpauth:// URI QR sɛgɛsɛgɛli kama. Baarakɛla bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ ni Google Authenticator / Authy / 1Password ye; posts back a sample 6-digit code walasa k’a jira ko setup baara kɛra. Donni: tɔgɔlasɛbɛn tɛmɛnen kɔfɛ, baarakɛla bɛ segin `{needs_2fa: true}` ma JWTw nɔ na. Client bɛ ɲininkali kɛ kode 6 ni POSTw `/api/authentication/login/2fa`. Server bɛ HOTP(gundo, T=now_unix / 30) sɛgɛsɛgɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni kode ye.
auth.h6_c: TOTP tun bɛ sariya la iko RFC 6238 san 2011 Mark Pei fɛ. Sani o ka Kɛ, RSA SecurID tun bɛ baara Kɛ ni algorisimu ye min ye a yɛrɛ ta ye; o kɔfɛ, 2FA app bɛɛ sigilen bɛ TOTP kan. Vortex ka seginkanni 30 ni jateden 6 janya ye RFC daminɛw ye. Backup codes (12 × 10-digit, jiralen don siɲɛ kelen) bɛ juru ta GitHub ka dilancogo la kabini san 2012.
auth.h6_f:
gundo = rand(bayt 20) // bitiki 160 RFC 6238 kelen na
TOTP(gundo, t) = HOTP(gundo, ⌊ t / 30⌋)
HOTP(k, c) = tigɛ( HMAC-SHA1(k, c) ) mod 106

finɛtiri : ±1 sen bɛ muɲu waati sɛgɛsɛgɛli la
auth.h7_a: QR don bɛ minɛn kura dɔ fara ɲɔgɔn kan ka don jatebɔsɛbɛn kɔrɔ dɔ kɔnɔ k’a sɔrɔ a ma segin ka tɔgɔlasɛbɛn sɛbɛn. Telefɔni min donna kaban, o bɛ bolonɔ bila nonce la, minɛn kura bɛ baara kɛ ni min ye walasa ka dantigɛli kɛ.
auth.h7_b: Minɛn A bɛ `/api/dafalen/qr/begin` bila. Server bɛ 128-bit nonce labɔ ni TTL 60s ye, k’a siri A ka user_id la, k’a segin. A bɛ nonce kodɔn jira iko QR (`nonce + user_id + server_url` bɛ o la). Minɛn B bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ, ka `/api/authentication/qr/verify` bila ni nonce ye. Server: nonce valide ani kelen-kelen? B ka X25519 pubkey kura ni user_id (`user_devices` row kura), mint JWTs for B. Mint A bɛ WebSocket kunnafoni sɔrɔ walasa baarakɛla ka se ka ye ani ka a yɛrɛ sago kɛ.
auth.h7_c: QR-based pairing (ɲɔgɔndɛmɛ min sinsinnen bɛ QR kan, o kɛra fɛn fɔlɔ ye min diyara WhatsApp Web ye san 2015. Telegram tugura o kɔ; Signal y’a kopi kɛ u ka minɛn caman dɛmɛni kama san 2021. Vortex ka tigɛli : ɲɔgɔndan ko kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ bɔ minɛn fɔlɔ kan ni butɔni "confirm" ye, o la binkannikɛla min bɛ QR minɛ ka bɔ ekran ja la, o tɛ se ka ɲɔgɔndan ban ni baarakɛlaw ka jɛɲɔgɔnya ma kɛ minɛn A kan.
auth.h7_f:
POST /api/dafalen/qr/daminɛ
  → { nonce: 128-bit hex, ttl: 60 } .
QR payload = { nonce, baarakɛla_id, baarakɛla: "https://node.misali" }

POST /api/dafalen/qr/sɛgɛsɛgɛli { nonce } .
  → minɛn kura min tɔgɔ sɛbɛnna; JWTw seginna ka na.
auth.h8_a: Jatebɔ jatebɔ resistance — auth sapitiri yɔrɔ dɔ. Nin ye fɛɛrɛ jɔnjɔn dɔ ye min kofɔlen don Vortex ɲɛfɔli bɛɛ kɔnɔ. Sapitiri min bɛ a lamini na, o kalan walasa ka kunnafoni caman sɔrɔ; nin yɔrɔ in bɛ kɛwale kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bonya.
auth.h8_b: Waleya lajɛba "Jatebɔ jatebɔ resistance" kan. Fɛɛrɛ in bɛ waleya modulu bɛnnin kɔnɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, walima `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` jukɔrɔ. Module README bɛ file sira tigitigiw wele.
auth.h8_c: "Jatebɔ jatebɔ kɛlɛli" fɛɛrɛ in jiginna Vortex bɔlenw kɔnɔ. O dilancogo bɛ tali kɛ ciden tɛmɛnenw ka ɲininiw ni u dilanni kɛcogo bɔlenw na. Version tariku min bɛ `CHANGELOG.md` kɔnɔ, o bɛ sɛbɛnni kɛ waati min na a yɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ jigira ani min y’a bila.

rooms.title: Sow ni cikanw
rooms.subtitle: So suguya naani, tɔndenw, kilisi jiginni, cikanw.
rooms.intro: So suguya naani bɛɛ — DM, kulu kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen, foroba kulu, kanal — bɛ `so` tabali kelen jɛ. Taamacogo bɛ dabɔ ni boolean darapow ye.
rooms.h1p1: **DM**: tɔnden fila tigitigi, `is_dm=tiɲɛ`, `is_kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya=tiɲɛ`. Tɔgɔ auto-set ka kɛ tɔnden tɔ kelen ka bololanɛgɛ ye.
rooms.h1p2: **Jɛkulu kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen**: wele-dɔrɔn, `is_kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen=tiɲɛ`, `is_kanal=nɛgɛjugu`. Max 5000 membres ka kɛɲɛ ni default ye.
rooms.h1p3: **Foroba jɛkulu**: `is_private=false`. Mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ bɛ ni welesɛbɛn ye, o bɛ se ka fara a kan; min sɛbɛnnen bɛ foroba kunnafonisɛbɛn kɔnɔ ni a tigi y’a sugandi ka don.
rooms.h1p4: **Kanal**: kunnafonidi-dɔrɔn, `is_channel=tiɲɛ`. Dutigiw/adminw dɔrɔn de bɛ se ka poste kɛ; jɛkulu kɔnɔmɔgɔw bɛ kalan kɛ tuma bɛɛ.
rooms.h2: Mɔgɔ minnu ye tɔndenw ye ani u jɔyɔrɔw
rooms.h2p1: Jɛkulu jɔyɔrɔw: `tigi`, `admin`, `mɔgɔ`. Dutigi kelen dɔrɔn de bɛ so kelen kɔnɔ (a bɛ se ka di).
rooms.h2p2: Admins bɛ se ka so settings wele, ka kick, ka mute, ani ka so settings ladilan. Mɔgɔw ​​bɛ se ka cikanw ci, ka jaabi di, ka u yɛrɛ ladilan, ka u yɛrɛ bɔ.
rooms.h2p3: Permissions cascade: tigiw bɛ ni admin fanga bɛɛ ye. Admins tɛ se ka demote kɛ a tigi la.
rooms.h2p4: Jɛkulu jɔyɔrɔ caman yeli bɛ sitɛmu cikan dɔ lawuli (`suguya: "role_changed"`) min bɛ ye tɔnden bɛɛ fɛ.
rooms.h3p1: So kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ ni 32-bayt **root key** ye min bɛ dabɔ dabɔli senfɛ `secrets.token_bytes(32)` fɛ dabɔbaa ka minɛn kan.
rooms.h3p2: Mɔgɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ anwɛlɛki dɔ sɔrɔ `{member_id, enveloppe: X25519_encrypt(member_pubkey, root_key)}` min maralen bɛ `room_keys` kɔnɔ.
rooms.h3p3: Ni tɔnden dɔ farala a kan, anwɛlɛki kura bɛ dilan u ye tɔnden kɔrɔ o tɔnden kɔrɔ ka kiliyan fɛ. Enveloppe minting ye O(1) ye join kelen na.
rooms.h3p4: Ni tɔnden dɔ Bɔra, so bɛ Yɛlɛma: dabɔbaa (walima ɲɛmɔgɔ fɔlɔ min bɛ baara Kɛ) bɛ ju kura Sɔrɔ, ka segin ka anwɛlɛki tɔnden tɔw ma, ka `{type:"k", so:..., new_envelopes:[...]}` bila WebSocket fɛ. Ciphertext kɔrɔ bɛ to ka kalan ni key kɔrɔ ye min kliyanw ye min mara hali bi.
rooms.h3l1: Variant-B key publish: foroba so minnu bɛ > mɔgɔ 1000 la, anwɛlɛkiw bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli dabila. O nɔ na, ​​tigi bɛ bolonɔ bila sisan jusigilan na k’a bɔ `room_public_keys` tabali kɔnɔ. Clients bɛ signature sɛgɛsɛgɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni so tigi pubkey ye. O la, jiginni kɛli tɔndenw ka lafiɲɛbɔ la, o ye no-op ye Variant-B so kɔnɔ.
rooms.h3l2: So kelen-kelen bɛɛ pseudo : so kelen-kelen bɛɛ fana bɛ ni `so_pseudo_salt` ye. Mɔgɔ tɔgɔ wɛrɛ minnu bɛ cikanw kɔnɔ olu ye `HMAC-SHA256(kɔgɔ, baarakɛla_id)` tigɛlen ye ka kɛ hex chars 16 ye. Node tɛ se k’a dɔn baarakɛla jumɛn ye cikan min ci ni kiliyan fan fɛ karti tɛ.
rooms.h4p1: Cikanw bɛ ni ID kelen-kelenw ye so kelen kɔnɔ (64-bit auto-increment, `bigserial` Postgres kɔnɔ, `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY` SQLite kɔnɔ).
rooms.h4p2: Komanw kɛli ye sèrwɛri ka baara ye. Clients tɛ kɛlɛ kɛ waati taamasiyɛnw kan; u bɛ jira ID cogo la ani ka ciden ka kogo-waati waati jira i n’a fɔ UI metadata dɔrɔn.
rooms.h4p3: Labɛnw: ciphertext kura bɛ kɔrɔlen in-place, `edited_at` updates nɔ na. Clients bɛ `(edited)` taamasiyɛn jira.
rooms.h4p4: Deletes: set `deleted_at`, null out ciphertext. `{type:"m", deleted:true}` laseli.
rooms.h4p5: Jaabiw: `reply_to` = cikan id min bɛ tali kɛ. Clients bɛ quote header fitinin dɔ jira.
rooms.h5p1: Jaabiw ye jirisunw ye `walew(cikan_id, baarakɛla_id, emoji, dabɔ_yɔrɔ)` kɔnɔ. Client POSTs `/api/cikanw/{id}/walew/{emoji}`. DELETE ka ɲɛsin un-reacts ma.
rooms.h5p2: Node fans out `{type:"m", reactions:[...]}` ka abonné bɛɛ. Clients (kiliyanw) bɛ fara ɲɔgɔn kan.
rooms.h5p3: Dan tɛ emoji kan — Unicode si. Clients de-dupe ani render jatew.
rooms.h6p1: Filɛri ye so nkalonma ye min ju bɔra cikan dɔ la. `POST /api/messages/{id}/thread` bɛ `{id: <so_kura_id>, bangebaga_cikan_id: <msg_id>, bangebaga_so_id: <original>}` da.
rooms.h6p2: Filɛri so bɛ tɔndenw ka ciyɛn ta bangebaga fɛ. Bangebagaw ka so kɔnɔmɔgɔ o mɔgɔ bɛ se ka poste kɛ thread o thread kɔnɔ.
rooms.h6p3: Kilisi bɔyɔrɔ: jirisun ju kilisi = `HKDF(bangebagaw_juru, kunnafoni: "jiri:" + <bangebagaw_cikan_id>, len: 32)`. Compromise de la thread key tɛ leak bangebaga.
rooms.h7p1: Adminw bɛ se ka pinɛ fo ka se cikan 10 ma so kelen kɔnɔ. `POST /api/so/{id}/pin` ni `{cikan_id}` ye.
rooms.h7p2: Pinned set bɛ doni so da wulilen kan; kliyanw bɛ kunkolo pinɛlen dɔ jira sanfɛ.
rooms.h8p1: So kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka sɛbɛnniw bɛ to senna node kan: `PUT /api/rooms/{id}/draft` ni `{text}` ye. `GET` bɛ segin sisan. `DELETE` bɛ jɛya.
rooms.h8p2: Clientw bɛ sɛbɛnniw kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ minɛnw kɔnɔ o la sɛbɛnni kɛli telefɔni na ka ban tabali kan. Draftw tɛ laban-ni-ban siri — u ye sɛbɛn jɛlen ye min bɛ ye sèrwɛri fɛ. O ye jago laɲini ye ka ɲɛsin cross-device UX ma. Baarakɛlaw minnu bɛ sɔsɔli Kɛ olu bɛ Se ka sinsinnan bali so kelen-kelen bɛɛ la.
rooms.h9p1: `POST /api/scheduled` ni `{so_id, ciphertext, ci_at}` ye. Node bɛ mara `scheduled_messages` kɔnɔ; cron baarakɛla dɔ bɛ layidu ta a waati la.
rooms.h9p2: A bɛ se ka ladilan ani a bɛ se ka tiɲɛ fo send_at tick ka tasuma. Cilen kɔfɛ, cikan bɛ kɛ jirisun gansan ye `cikanw` kɔnɔ.
rooms.h1_a: So suguya naani bɛɛ (DM, kulu kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen, foroba kulu, kanal) bɛ `so` tabali kelen jɛ. Danfara bɛ boolean darapo saba la.
rooms.h1_b: Darapow: `ye_dm`, `ye_kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la`, `ye_kanal`. DM: is_dm=tiɲɛ, is_privé=tiɲɛ, mɔgɔ 2 tigitigi. Jɛkulu kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen: is_private=tiɲɛ, is_channel=false, fo ka se mɔgɔ 5000 ma. Foroba kulu: is_private=false, a bɛ sɛbɛn ɲɛbilasɛbɛn kɔnɔ ni tigi y’a sugandi ka don.Kanal: is_channel=tiɲɛ, tigiw/admins dɔrɔn de bɛ sɛbɛn. Bɛɛ bɛ tila-tila key management, fan-out, reactions, threads.
rooms.h1_c: Tabali kelen-kelen camanbɔli ye misali ye min bɔra Martin Fowler ka *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* (2002) kɔnɔ. Telegram bɛ baara kɛ ni so suguya saba danfaralenw ye kɔnɔna na; Slack bɛ baara kɛ ni kanw + DMw + parti caman ka DMw ye i n’a fɔ suguya naani; Discord bɛ baara Kɛ ni "channels" ye fɛn bɛɛ la. An ye tabali kelen sugandi profiling kɔfɛ k’a jira ko musaka kunba ye fan-out ye (o ye kelen ye suguya bɛɛ la) ani o kɔfɛ v0.0.3 refactor ye tabali saba bɔlenw fara ɲɔgɔn kan ka kɛ kelen ye.
rooms.h1_f:
CREATE TABLE sow (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  suguya VARCHAR(16), -- ciyɛn, min tɛ kɛ ni darapow ye
  tɔgɔ VARCHAR(256), .
  ye_kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la BOOLEAN,
  ye_kanal ye BOOLEAN, .
  ye_dm BOOLEAN ye,
  tɔndenw_jate INT, .
  avatar_url VARCHAR(512) Bamako, Mali.
  dabɔra_ka TIMESTAMP,
  dabɔra_ni BIGINT REFERENCES baarakɛlaw(id) fɛ .
);
rooms.h2_a: Jɛkulu jɔyɔrɔw ye saba ye: tigi, ɲɛmɔgɔ, tɔnden. So kelen kɔnɔ, tigi kelen tigitigi, admin kelen dɔrɔn, a yɛrɛ sago la, mɔgɔ caman bɛ yen.
rooms.h2_b: `so_members(so_id, baarakɛla_id, jɔyɔrɔ, joined_at, muted_fo)`. Roles cascade: tigiw bɛ ni admin fanga bɛɛ ye. Admins bɛ se ka wele, ka kick, mute, ani ka so settings ladilan nka u tɛ se ka tigi jigin. Mɔgɔw ​​bɛ se ka cikanw ci, ka jaabi di, ka u yɛrɛ ladilan, ka u yɛrɛ bɔ. Dutigi jiginni `PATCH /api/rooms/{id}` fɛ ni `new_owner_id` ye — tigi kɔrɔ bɛ jigin admin fɛ.
rooms.h2_c: Owner/admin/member ye IRC op/voice/user model saba ye min bɔra san 1988, kɔfɛ Slack, Discord, Telegram ye min ta. Sugandili kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen min bɛ kɛ walasa ka tigi kelen tigitigi sɔrɔ (a tɛ caya) bɛ bɔ sariya jateminɛ na: mara minnu kɔnɔ, kulu-jalaki sariyaw bɛ yen, ka kɛ ni tigi kelen jɛlen ye, o bɛ DMCA ni o ɲɔgɔnna ɲininiw nɔgɔya.
rooms.h2_f:
CREATE TABLE so_mɔgɔw (
  so_dakun BIGINT, .
  baarakɛla_dakun BIGINT,
  jɔyɔrɔ VARCHAR(16) CHECK(jɔyɔrɔ IN (‘tigi’,‘admin’,‘mɔgɔ’)),
  faralen ɲɔgɔn kan_ka TIMESTAMP,
  muted_fo TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (so_dakun, baarakɛla_dakun)
);
rooms.h3_a: So kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ ni 32 bayt simɛtiri root key ye. Mɔgɔ minnu bɛ tɔndenw bolo, olu bɛ kopiw minɛ minnu sirilen bɛ u ka X25519 pubkey jukɔrɔ.
rooms.h3_b: Dabɔli senfɛ, kiliyan bɛ `root_key = secrets.token_bytes(32)` lawuli. Mɔgɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ kama, kiliyan bɛ `root_key` siri `X25519(member_pubkey)` → anwɛlɛki jukɔrɔ. Anwɛlɛkiw bɛ balo `so_kɔlɔsili(so_id, baarakɛla_id, anwɛlɛki)` kɔnɔ. Ni baarakɛla dɔ farala a kan, tɔnden kɔrɔ o tɔnden ka kiliyan bɛ anwɛlɛki kura minɛ u ye. Ni baarakɛla dɔ bɔra, tigi walima ɲɛmɔgɔ fɔlɔ min bɛ baara kɛ, o bɛ wuli — ka root_key kura lawuli, ka segin ka anwɛlɛki kɛ tɔnden tɔw ye, ka `{type:"k", room:..., new_envelopes:[...]}` jira WebSocket kan.
rooms.h3_c: Per-member wrapping ye misali ye Signal ye min daminɛ san 2014 a ka kuluw-v2. Matrix ka Megolm bɛ baara Kɛ ni o ɲɔgɔnna "cibaaw ka kilisi" fɛɛrɛ ye. Vortex taara ni mɔgɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka anwɛlɛki ye bawo a ka nɔgɔn ka hakilinata di nin kan: gundo tɛ ɲɛfɛ cidenw cɛ. Jagokɛcogo ye O(N) anwɛlɛki minɛni ye tɔndenw caman cili kan, o bɛ ɲɛ fo ka se ~5000 tɔndenw ma; public-channel Variant-B bɛ dantigɛli kɛ kɛrɛfɛ.
rooms.h3_f:
kan dabɔ:
  root_key = ran (32) .
  ka ɲɛsin m ma tɔndenw na:
    enveloppe[m] = X25519_Encrypt(m.pubkey, root_key) .

lafiɲɛbɔ la:
  kura_juru = ran(32) .
  rebroadcast(anwɛlɛki kura minnu bɛ kɛ tɔnden tɔw ye)
rooms.h4_a: Variant-B key publish bɛ mɔgɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka anwɛlɛki bila u nɔ na ni kilisi kelen ye min bolonɔ bilalen don, min bɛ bila foroba kalan tabali kan. Scales ka 100k+ membres.
rooms.h4_b: O(N) anwɛlɛki minɛni nɔ na, ​​tigi bɛ bolonɔ bila root_key la ka poste kɛ `room_public_keys(room_id, key, signed_by, signed_at)` la. Clients bɛ na, ka sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni tigi ka Ed25519 pubkey ye, ka baara kɛ ni a ye. Yɛlɛma-yɛlɛma ye no-op ye tɔndenw caman cili kama — mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ tun bɛ ni kilisi ye, o tigi bɛ yen hali bi hali n’u gosira. O bɛ Sɔn foroba laseli-kanw ma yɔrɔ minnu na "tariku jugu" tɛ bagabagali modɛli ye nka seko ni dɔnko ye.
rooms.h4_c: Variant-B bɛ misali di Matrix ka tariku yecogo "diɲɛ kalanni" kan min faralen don ɲɔgɔn kan ni taamasiyɛn ye min bɛ kɛ ni kilisi jiginni ye. A Fàrala Vortex kan v0.0.8 kɔnɔ o kɔfɛ beta tun bɛ ni 50k-member public channel ye min ka waati ni waati re-enveloppe bursts saturated the node. Taamaʃyɛn min bɛ bolonɔbila-ni-sɛbɛn bɔ, o bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ sinsinni na ni fɛn kolomaw jiginni ye (minnu man ca) sanni ka kɛ ni tɔndenw yeli ye (minnu bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ).
rooms.h4_f:
Variant-B: 1. Bamako, Mali.
  tigi taamasiyɛnw: sig = Ed25519Sign(tigi_priv, so_id ∥ root_key ∥ version)
  bɔ kɛnɛ kan: so_foroba_kɔlɔsili += {so_id, root_key, version, sig}
  kiliyan: GET /api/rooms/{id}/public-key → sig sɛgɛsɛgɛ ka ɲɛsin tigi_pubkey ma
rooms.h5_a: Weelekan kode ye hex chars 32 ye. A bɛ se ka kɛ max_uses ye, expires_at, assign_role, revocable.
rooms.h5_b: `POST /api/rooms/{id}/invite` (admin-only) bɛ jirisun dɔ da `invites(code, room_id, created_by, max_uses, used_count, expires_at, assign_role, revoked_at)` kɔnɔ. `POST /api/rooms/join` ni kode bɛ tiɲɛni sɛgɛsɛgɛ (a ma ban, a waati ma ban, used_count < max_uses), ka dɔ fara `used_count` kan, ka `room_members` row da, ka so metadata segin. Revoke via `DELETE /api/invites/{code}` — kɔfɛ jɛɲɔgɔnyaw bɛ dɛsɛ.
rooms.h5_c: Invite codes i n’a fɔ primitif, olu kɔrɔlen don i n’a fɔ IRC ka `+i` mode (1988). Telegram ka foroba weleli jɛɲɔgɔnyaw ni waati dafalen ni baarakɛcogo danw donna sen kan san 2017. Vortex ka fɛn wɛrɛ bɛ `assign_role` fara a kan walasa tigiw ka se ka admin-granting codew tila-tila lafiya la cogo la min bɛ kɛ siɲɛ kelen — nafa bɛ o la ka ɲɛmɔgɔ kura don a kɔnɔ k’a sɔrɔ u mago tɛ k’u ka baarakɛla ka id tigitigi dɔn ka kɔn o ɲɛ.
rooms.h5_f:
bɛ wele bila row:
  kode : VARCHAR(64) -- 32 hex chars
  so_dakun : BIGINT .
  max_uses : INT -- NULL = dan tɛ min na
  baara_jateminɛ : INT .
  bɛ ban_waati la : TIMESTAMP -- NULL = abada
  jɔyɔrɔ_dafalen : VARCHAR(16) -- NULL = tɔnden
  revoked_at : TIMESTAMP -- NULL = ɲɛnamaya
rooms.h6_a: Cikan sɛrɛkili dɔ bɛ ciphertext + metadata mara; ciden tɛ mara abada sɛbɛnni jɛlen kɔnɔ.
rooms.h6_b: `cikanw(id, so_id, ciden_id, ciphertext, nonce, ciden_pseudo, cilen_at, ladilan_at?, deleted_at?, jaabi_ka?, thread_id?, suguya)`. `sender_id` bɛ yen dondaw kɔlɔsili kama ani a bɛ index (daɲɛgafe) la. `sender_pseudo` ye sender_id ka so kelen-kelen bɛɛ latigɛlen hash ye o la fan-out man kan ka maga baarakɛlaw ka tabali la. `suguya` ye ninnu dɔ ye: sɛbɛnni, ja, dosiye, kan, weleli, sistɛm. `ciphertext` ye bɔli ye min tɛ ye AES-GCM; so kɔnɔmɔgɔ minnu bɛ ni kilisi ye, olu dɔrɔn de bɛ se ka decrypt.
rooms.h6_c: Sender_pseudo hakilina bɔra Signal sealed-sender (2018) la. Signal bɛ baara kɛ n’a ye walasa ka sèrwɛri fiyen ka se ciden ka danyɔrɔ ma; an bɛ baara kɛ n’a ye o baara kelen na nka an bɛ `sender_id` sɛbɛn jɛlen mara ACL ni hakɛ dantigɛliw kama. O farali b'a To an bɛ "membrew dɔrɔn de bɛ Se ka poste" Wajibiya k'a sɔrɔ sèrwɛri ma Dɔn jɔn ye mun Fɔ DB dump dafalen kan.
rooms.h7_a: Labɛnw bɛ `ciphertext` sɛbɛn a nɔ na ani ka `edited_at` bugɔ. A bɛ null out ciphertext bɔ ani ka `deleted_at` sigi.
rooms.h7_b: Labɛn: `PATCH /api/messages/{id}` ni `{ciphertext, nonce}` kura ye. Cibaga dɔrɔn de bɛ Se k'u yɛrɛ ka cikan Labɛn. Row ka ciphertext/nonce b'a bila a nɔ na, ​​`edited_at = sisan`, `suguya` ma Changé. Fan-out `{suguya:"m", id, ct, nonce, ladilan_ka}`. A bɔli: `DELETE /api/cikanw/{id}`. Sender walima admin bɛ se ka delete. `deleted_at = sisan`, `ciphertext = NULL`. Row bɛ to o la jaabiw bɛ kɔrɔ sɔrɔ hali bi. Fan-out `{suguya:"m", a bɔra:tiɲɛ, id}`.
rooms.h7_c: Edit-in-place ye Telegram/Slack misali ye; Discord ye sɛgɛsɛgɛli tariku dafalen mara a daminɛ na, o kɔfɛ a y’a bila ka kɛɲɛ ni gundo ye. Vortex bɛ labanw dɔrɔn mara — sɛgɛsɛgɛli tariku ye PR ko kɛlenw sɔrɔyɔrɔ ye ni sɛgɛsɛgɛli-bɔlen dɔ bɛ Se ka Lasegin. Soft-delete ni null ciphertext bɛ bɔ Telegram tulonkɛ gafe kelen na wa a bɛ jaabi cakɛdaw mara k’a sɔrɔ a ma kɔnɔkow mara.
rooms.h7_f:
sɛgɛsɛgɛli: UPDATE cikanw SET ciphertext = $1, nonce = $2, ladilan_at = NOW() WHERE id = $3
delete: UPDATE cikanw SET deleted_at = NOW(), ciphertext = NULL WHERE id = $1
rooms.h8_a: Drafts — sow sapitiri yɔrɔ dɔ. Nin ye fɛɛrɛ jɔnjɔn dɔ ye min kofɔlen don Vortex ɲɛfɔli bɛɛ kɔnɔ. Sapitiri min bɛ a lamini na, o kalan walasa ka kunnafoni caman sɔrɔ; nin yɔrɔ in bɛ kɛwale kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bonya.
rooms.h8_b: Baarakɛcogo lajɛlen "Drafts" kama. Fɛɛrɛ in bɛ waleya modulu bɛnnin kɔnɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, walima `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` jukɔrɔ. Module README bɛ file sira tigitigiw wele.
rooms.h8_c: "Drafts" fɛɛrɛ in jiginna Vortex bɔlenw kɔnɔ. O dilancogo bɛ tali kɛ ciden tɛmɛnenw ka ɲininiw ni u dilanni kɛcogo bɔlenw na. Version tariku min bɛ `CHANGELOG.md` kɔnɔ, o bɛ sɛbɛnni kɛ waati min na a yɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ jigira ani min y’a bila.
rooms.h9_a: Cikan bolodalenw — sow sapitiri yɔrɔ dɔ. Nin ye fɛɛrɛ jɔnjɔn dɔ ye min kofɔlen don Vortex ɲɛfɔli bɛɛ kɔnɔ. Sapitiri min bɛ a lamini na, o kalan walasa ka kunnafoni caman sɔrɔ; nin yɔrɔ in bɛ kɛwale kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bonya.
rooms.h9_b: Baarakɛcogo lajɛlen "Cikan bolodalenw" kama. Fɛɛrɛ in bɛ waleya modulu bɛnnin kɔnɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, walima `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` jukɔrɔ. Module README bɛ file sira tigitigiw wele.
rooms.h9_c: "Cikan bolodalenw" fɛɛrɛ in jiginna Vortex bɔliw kɔnɔ. O dilancogo bɛ tali kɛ ciden tɛmɛnenw ka ɲininiw ni u dilanni kɛcogo bɔlenw na. Version tariku min bɛ `CHANGELOG.md` kɔnɔ, o bɛ sɛbɛnni kɛ waati min na a yɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ jigira ani min y’a bila.

files.title: Dosiyɛriw ni fɛn minnu bɛ fara ɲɔgɔn kan
files.subtitle: Single-shot for small, resumible for large, kliyan fan fɛ encryption fila bɛɛ kama.
files.intro: Filenw bilali bɛɛ bɛ tɛmɛ o kodɔn-pipeline kelen fɛ. Danfara min bɛ siraw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ, o bɛ tali kɛ réseau resilience dɔrɔn de la: resumable bɛ muɲu flaky links.
files.h1p1: Kapi: 5 MB. A bɛ kɛ fotow kama, kumakan sɛbɛnniw, klip surunw kama.
files.h1p2: Client bɛ filen bɛɛ siri ni AES-GCM ye, random 96-bit nonce, key = `file_root = secrets.token_bytes(32)`.
files.h1p3: POST bɛ `multipart/form-data` ka `/api/files` ni forow ye `file` (ciphertext), `plain_blake3` (dafalen ɲinini), `mime_type` (ladilikan; sèrwɛri bɛ segin ka sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ ni `python-magic` ye).
files.h1p4: Node bɛ mara `uploads/<category>/<sha256>.bin` jukɔrɔ ani ka `{file_id, url}` segin.
files.h1p5: O kɔfɛ, kiliyan bɛ so cikan dɔ bila min bɛ file_id jira ani ka file_root ta a ka ciphertext kɔnɔ walasa so kɔnɔmɔgɔw ka se ka decryption kɛ.
files.h2: Upload sira min bɛ se ka segin ka kɛ
files.h2p1: Cap: 5 GB (a bɛ se ka labɛn `RESUMABLE_MAX=5368709120` fɛ).
files.h2p2: Dakun fɔlɔ : `POST /api/files/resumable/init` ni `{dosiyɛri tɔgɔ, a bonya, chunk_size_hint}` ye. Node bɛ upload id di, ka chunk hakɛ dɔ ta (default 512 KiB, capped at 4 MiB), ka `{upload_id, chunk_size}` segin.
files.h2p3: Taabolo 2nan : fɛn kelen-kelen bɛɛ kama, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` ni ciphertext farikolo raw ye. Offsets ka kan ka bɛn `chunk_size` ma.
files.h2p4: Taabolo 3nan : `POST /api/files/resumible/{upload_id}/finalise` ni `{plain_blake3}` ye. Node bɛ ɲɔgɔn lajɛ kokura, ka bonya sɛgɛsɛgɛ, ka mara, ka `{file_id, url}` segin.
files.h2p5: Dɛsɛw ɲɛnabɔli : fɛnw bilali tigɛlenw bɛ se ka daminɛ kokura ni u bilala kokura offset minnu tununna dɔrɔn. Node bɛ tugu offset minnu sera Redis (walima in-memory for SQLite mode) la.
files.h2p6: TTL: fɛn minnu ma ban, olu bɛ saniya 24 h kɔfɛ.
files.h3p1: Jaw bilali (MIME `ja/*`) bɛ Pillow-based thumbnail generator dɔ daminɛ ni 256×256 JPEG q=80 ye. A maralen bɛ `uploads/thumbs/<hash>.jpg` jukɔrɔ.
files.h3p2: Ja fitininw fana ye kiliyan fan fɛ sirilen ye — sɔrɔbaga mago bɛ file_root la walasa ka jira. A bɛ bandwidth mara lisi ɲɛjiraliw kama.
files.h3p3: Wideyow bilali (MIME `video/*`) bɛ ffmpeg basigilen afiriki bɔli daminɛ ni 10 % ye klip kuntaala la, min maralen bɛ o cogo kelen na.
files.h4p1: Client-cibé `mime_type` ye hakilina ye. Server bɛ `python-magic` baara 1 KB fɔlɔw kama ani ka ban ni sniffed suguya bɛ deny list kɔnɔ: `application/x-dosexec`, `application/x-sharedlib`, `application/x-mach-binary`.
files.h4p2: O bɛ baarakɛla nalonmaw bali ka porogaramu juguw tila-tila bala la ciden fɛ. Binkannikɛlaw dusu laminlen bɛ se ka tɛmɛn hali bi ni minɛnw ye minnu tɔgɔ sɛbɛnnen don ka ɲɛ — lafasali ye kiliyan fan fɛ unwrap ban ye, a tɛ server fan fɛ sniff ye.
files.h5p1: Default: sigida ka dosiyew sigicogo. Good ka ɲɛsin node kelen-kelen deployiw ma.
files.h5p2: S3: aw bɛ `STORAGE_BACKEND=s3` + `S3_BUCKET=...` sigi sen kan. Filenw bɛ Lase S3 ma k’a sɔrɔ u ma maga node ka disiki la. URL minnu bolonɔ bilala ka kɔn, olu bɛ kɛ ka telesarse.
files.h5p3: IPFS: kɔrɔbɔli. Uploads bɛ CIDw laseli kɛ DHT fɛ; telesarsew bɛ pinning node suguya bɛɛ lase.
files.h1_a: Single-shot upload ye sira teliya ye fɛn o fɛn na min bɛ 5 MB duguma — fotow, kumakan sɛbɛnniw, klip surunw. HTTPS POST kelen, blob sirilen kelen, jirisun kelen `dosiyɛriw` kɔnɔ.
files.h1_b: Client bɛ filen baytw siri a laban na ka taa a laban na ni AES-GCM ye bayt 32 k’a sɔrɔ a ma kɛ `file_root` ye. POSTs `multipart/form-data` ka `/api/files` ni forow ye `file` (ciphertext), `plain_blake3` (dafalen fɔli), `mime_type` (hint). Node bɛ 5 MB cap waleya receive buffer level la, ka `python-magic` boli suguya dɔnni kama, a bɛ ban ni MIME bɛ deny list kɔnɔ, a bɛ mara `uploads/<category>/<hash>.bin` jukɔrɔ, ka `{file_id, url, mime_type, size}` segin. O kɔfɛ, kiliyan bɛ so cikan dɔ bila min bɛ tali kɛ `file_id` la ani ka `file_root` ta a ka ciphertext kɔnɔ.
files.h1_c: 5 MB cap ye jateden kelen ye Slack ni Telegram bɛ baara Kɛ n'u ka "inline" upload sira ye. Dosiyɛri belebelebaw bɛ taa sira la min bɛ se ka segin a cogo kɔrɔ la. Vortex daminɛ na, a tun bɛ ni 100 MB ye min bɛ kɛ ni fɛn kelen ye; an jigira ka se 5 MB ma profiling kɛlen kɔ k’a jira ko fɛn kelen-kelen bilali minnu bɛ 5 MB sanfɛ, olu jigira 40 % mobili rezow kan. Sira min bɛ Se ka Segin ka Lasegin, o ka fisa kosɛbɛ dosiye belebelebaw ma hali n’a ka ca ni segin-ka-bɔnyew ye nisɔndiya siraw kan.
files.h2_a: Resumable upload ye sira ye file belebelebaw kama. Client uploads fixed-size chunks, a bɛ se ka jɔ, a bɛ se ka daminɛ kokura chunk dancɛ o dancɛ kan, a bɛ se ka segin ka bɔ network blips la.
files.h2_b: Protokol min bɛ kɛ ni taabolo saba ye. Init: `POST /api/files/resumable/init` ni `{filename, size, chunk_size_hint}` → node bɛ `upload_id` tila + a bɛ chunk hakɛ dafa. Chunks: offset kelen-kelen bɛɛ kama, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` ni ciphertext farikolo raw ye. Offsets ka kan ka kɛ chunk_size caman ye. Finalise: `POST /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/finalise` ni `{plain_blake3}` — node bɛ lajɛ kokura, ka hakɛ + tag sɛgɛsɛgɛ, ka a mara, ka `{file_id, url}` segin.
files.h2_c: Protokol saba-saba in cogoya ye kelen ye ni tus.io (Resumable Uploads, 2013), AWS S3 multipart uploads, ani Google Drive resumable uploads ye. Vortex ye tus.io cogoya ta bawo o de tun ye FastAPI + streaming ka bɛnkan nɔgɔman ye. 24 h TTL min bɛ kɛ fɛnw bilali dafabali kan, o bɛ bɛn S3 ka default ma ani balansi bɛ segin ka sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ ni sèrwɛri disiki baarakɛcogo ye.
files.h3_a: Ja fitininw bɛ Dabɔ sèrwɛri fan fɛ u bilali waati la nka u bɛ To sirilen na dosiye ju kelen jukɔrɔ, o la so kɔnɔmɔgɔw dɔrɔn de bɛ Se k’u Jira.
files.h3_b: `ja/*` MIME kama, Pillow bɛ 256×256 JPEG q=80 Sɔrɔ ka Bɔ ɲɛjirali decrypté la. A jira — ayi, sèrvèr tɛ ni sɛbɛnni gansanw ye abada. Flow correct : client bɛ thumb lawuli sigida la, ka encryption ni file_root kelen + nonce kura ye, ka upload kɛ i n’a fɔ balimakɛ blob, ani ka `thumb_id` jira so cikan kɔnɔ. Server bɛ ciphertext (sɛbɛnni cifɔlenw) mara. `video/*` ta la, kiliyan bɛ o ɲɔgɔn kɛ ni ffmpeg-derived keyframe ye.
files.h3_c: Vortex fɔlɔ tun bɛ ni sèrwɛri fan fɛ ja fitininw bɔli ye ka bɔ sɛbɛn gansan na — an y’o seko bɔ v0.0.4 kɔnɔ lakana lajɛ dɔ kɔfɛ k’a jira ko a ye E2E garanti tiɲɛ. Client-side thumbs ye pattern ye Signal ye baara kɛ ni min ye kabini san 2018 ani WhatsApp kabini san 2020. Bandwidth musaka tɛ jate — 256×256 JPEG bɛ 20 KB jukɔrɔ.
files.h4_a: Server bɛ MIME deny list (deny list) wajibiya sniff layer (sniff layer) la walasa ka executables (baarakɛminɛnw) minnu tilalen don bala la, olu jɔ.
files.h4_b: O kɔfɛ, 'sèn dafalen (kelen-ja) walima a laban (segin-ka-bɔ), sèrwɛri bɛ `python-magic` Kɛ ciphertext (ciphertext) ka jatigila-minɛn 1 KB fɔlɔw kan walasa ka suguya lakika Sɔrɔ. Ni sniff ye `application/x-dosexec` (Windows PE), `application/x-sharedlib` (Linux ELF), walima `application/x-mach-binary` (macOS Mach-O) lakali, o jiginni bɛ ban ni 415 Unsupported Media Type ye. Nin ye sèrvèr sariya ye, a tɛ lakana dan ye — kiliyan ka so kɔnɔmɔgɔw tun bɛ se ka wrapper format dɔ sigi hali bi min bɛ sniff tɛmɛ.
files.h4_c: MIME fiyɛli i n’a fɔ sɔsɔli politiki ye IETF draft-mime-sniffing-0X ye ka bɔ san 2012. Discord / Slack / Telegram bɛɛ b’a kɛ. Dantigɛli (zipped/containerised executables bypass sniff) dɔnna kabini san 2016 — an ka lafasali ye layɛrɛ ye: ka fara baarakɛla fan fɛ lasɔminiw kan dosiye o dosiye kan ni executable extension ye.
files.h5_a: Storage backends — filenw sapitiri yɔrɔ dɔ. Nin ye fɛɛrɛ jɔnjɔn dɔ ye min kofɔlen don Vortex ɲɛfɔli bɛɛ kɔnɔ. Sapitiri min bɛ a lamini na, o kalan walasa ka kunnafoni caman sɔrɔ; nin yɔrɔ in bɛ kɛwale kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bonya.
files.h5_b: Baarakɛcogo ɲɛfɔli "Storage backends" kan. Fɛɛrɛ in bɛ waleya modulu bɛnnin kɔnɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, walima `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` jukɔrɔ. Module README bɛ file sira tigitigiw wele.
files.h5_c: "Storage backends" fɛɛrɛ in jiginna Vortex bɔlenw kɔnɔ. O dilancogo bɛ tali kɛ ciden tɛmɛnenw ka ɲininiw ni u dilanni kɛcogo bɔlenw na. Version tariku min bɛ `CHANGELOG.md` kɔnɔ, o bɛ sɛbɛnni kɛ waati min na a yɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ jigira ani min y’a bila.
files.h1_f:
POST /api/dosiyɛriw
  Kɔnɔkow-suguya: yɔrɔ caman/fɔcogo-dantigɛli
  dosiye : <sifiri sɛbɛnni bayt ≤ 5_242_880>
  plain_blake3: <64 hex chars>
  mime_type: "ja/jpeg" (ladilikan; node seginni sɛgɛsɛgɛli)

→ 201 { file_id, url: "/uploads/...", mime_suguya, hakɛ } .

kliyan bɛ thumb_plain = bonya(dafalen, 256, 256, JPEG, q=80) lawuli
thumb_ct = AES-GCM(dosiyɛri_juru, kura_nonce, thumb_plain, aad=bolonɔbila_id)

presence.title: Kɔlɔsili ni jiginni taamasiɲɛw
presence.subtitle: Sɛbɛnni jiralanw, kalan sɔrɔlenw, laban-yelenw — o bɛɛ ye waati dɔɔnin dɔrɔn de ye.
presence.intro: O taamaʃyɛnw bɛ mankan Bɔ. Vortex b’u To u ma Kɛ ‘sèn na k’a da Minɛ: sɛbɛnni bɛ ɲɛnamaya Redis (walima in-memory), kalan sɔrɔlenw ye taamaʃyɛn kelen ye min bɛ kisi daminɛ kura ma.
presence.h1p1: Client bɛ `{type:"t", room:..., state:"start"|"stop"}` ci keystroke kan. Debounced to at most event kelen s 3 kɔnɔ.
presence.h1p2: Node bɛ `{type:"t", room:..., user:..., state:...}` lase WebSockets bɛɛ ma minnu tɔgɔ sɛbɛnna.
presence.h1p3: Auto-expire: `daminɛ` ni tugu `stop` waatiw bɛ ban s 10 kɔfɛ kiliyan fan fɛ.
presence.h2p2: Node bɛ to `read_receipts(so_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` la ani ka `{type:"r", room:..., user:..., message_id:...}` lase.
presence.h2p3: Clients bɛ "seen by N" jira cikan bɔlenw jukɔrɔ.
presence.h2p4: Gundo: baarakɛla bɛ se ka "seen" bali pewu; o tuma na fɛ, node tɛ persist resipiw la u ye. Jagokɛcogo : u fana tɛ mɔgɔ wɛrɛw ka sɔrɔw ye (simɛtiri).
presence.h3p1: Node bɛ `presence.last_seen_at` (unix ms) nɔfɛtaama baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ la. A bɛ ladamu WebSocket karamɔgɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ kan.
presence.h3p2: Granularity tiers (baarakɛla bɛ se ka sugandi): tigitigi, a bɛ lamini fo miniti 5 min ka surun, a bɛ lamini fo ka se lɛrɛ surun ma, "kɔsa in na", walima a bɛ ban.
presence.h3p3: Ɲininkali kɛra `GET /api/users/{id}/presence` fɛ. A tɔgɔ sɛbɛnna `{type:"sub_presence", baarakɛla:...}` fɛ.
presence.h4p1: Baarakɛla dɔ bɛ "ɛntɛrinɛti kan" n'u ka WebSocket baarakɛlen kelen dɔrɔn bɛ u ka minɛn dɔ kan.
presence.h4p2: A bɛ ye mɔgɔ minnu bɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ dɔrɔn — mɔgɔ minnu tɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ, olu bɛ ye labanw ye nka u tɛ yɔrɔ ɲɛnama ye.
presence.h1_a: Sɛbɛnni jiralan bɛ ci WebSocket frame `{type:"t", so, state: "start"|"stop"}` fɛ ani ka lase node fɛ ka taa abonné bɛɛ ma so kɔnɔ.
presence.h1_b: Client debounces at 3 s — keystroke fɔlɔ bɛ `start` ci, o kɔfɛ s 3 kɔnɔ tɛ foyi kɛ. 10 s kɛli kɔfɛ, kiliyan bɛ `stop` ci. Node bɛ frame (kalansen) Lase daɲɛ-daɲɛ na, a bɛ daminɛ ni `user_id` ye. No persistence — sɛbɛnni cogoya bɛ balo in-memory per-room dicts kɔnɔ (walima Redis pub/sub for multi-node). Auto-expire 10 s on the receiver side: ni update si ma se, kliyanw b’a miiri ko a jɔra.
presence.h1_c: Sɛbɛnni jiralanw bɛ segin AIM / ICQ (1997) ma. Bi debounced designs trace to Skype 2006 and iMessage 2011. S 3 s / 10 s jatedenw bɔra iMessage ka kɛwale kɔlɔsilenw na — anw A/B ye 2/5, 3/10, 5/15 ani 3/10 kɔrɔbɔ, an ye "matches human rhythm" hakilina ɲumanw sɔrɔ.
presence.h2_a: Kalan sɔrɔli bɛ to sen na: kiliyan POSTs kalan laban cikan id; node bɛ mara `read_receipts` kɔnɔ ani kunnafonidilanw kɔnɔ.
presence.h2_b: `POST /api/rooms/{id}/read` ni `{kalan_last_cikan_id}` ye. Node bɛ `kalan_sɛbɛnw(so_id, baarakɛla_id, cikan_id, kalan_at)` kura ye ni UPSERT kɔrɔɲɔgɔnmaya ye. Laseliw `{type:"r", so, baarakɛla, cikan_id, kalan_yɔrɔ}`. Clients bɛ "seen by N" jira cikan bɔlenw jukɔrɔ. Gundo: baarakɛla bɛ se ka resipiw bali pewu; o tuma node tɛ to u ye AND u tɛ mɔgɔ wɛrɛw ka sɔrɔw ye (simɛtiri).
presence.h2_c: Kalan sɔrɔlenw kɛra yɔrɔ bɛɛ iMessage 2011 ni WhatsApp 2014 kɔfɛ.Simetri sariya (n’i y’i ta dogo, i tɛ mɔgɔ wɛrɛw ta ye) bɔra Telegram 2014 la, wa o ye sira kelenpe ye min bɛ se ka kɛ sababu ye ka i yɛrɛ tanga kɔlɔsili sira kelen ma. Vortex bɛ simetri waleya sèrwɛri la — a tɛ kɛ kliyan dɔrɔn ye — o la kliyan minnu bɛ nkalon tigɛ darapo kan hali bi, olu tɛ yecogo sɔrɔ.
presence.h3_a: Last-seen ye baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka waati taamasiyɛn ye, min bɛ ladamu WebSocket frame kelen-kelen bɛɛ kan ani ka kɔrɔbaya ni frame si ma se.
presence.h3_b: Node bɛ `presence.last_seen_at` nɔfɛtaama iko unix ms. A bɛ Lakurayali WebSocket frame lakika bɛɛ kan ka Bɔ o baarakɛla la. Kalan kɛ `GET /api/baarakɛlaw/{id}/presence` fɛ. Aw ye aw tɔgɔ sɛbɛn `{type:"sub_presence", user}` fɛ walasa ka puse ɲɛnama sɔrɔ fɛn caman Changement kan. Granularity bɛ se ka labɛn baarakɛla fɛ: waati taamasiyɛn tigitigi, min bɛ lamini ka se miniti 5 ma, ka lamini ka se 1 h ma, "kɔsa in na", walima ka ban.
presence.h3_c: Granularity tiers bɛ tugu WhatsApp ka 2012 sàn danbe-ko kura la, ɲininkaliw kɛlen kɔ ka Kɛ 'sènbɔli laban ye. Telegram san 2013 ye "kɔsa in na / dɔgɔkun kelen kɔnɔ / kalo kelen kɔnɔ" bulonw fara a kan. Vortex ka miniti 5 / lɛrɛ 1 / "kɔsa in na" bɛ Telegram fɔ. "off" sugandi bɛ baarakɛla dogo cogo simetri la walasa a kana mɔgɔ wɛrɛw ka yelen laban ye kun kelen na ni kalan sɔrɔlenw ye.
presence.h4_a: Ɛntɛrinɛti jiralan : baarakɛla dɔ bɛ "ɛntɛrinɛti kan" n'u ka WebSocket ɲɛnama kelen dɔrɔn bɛ u ka minɛn dɔ kan.
presence.h4_b: Node bɛ `active_ws_count(user_id)` mara hakili la. Dɔ farali WS jiginni kan, dɔgɔyali dabɔli kan. `ɛntɛrinɛti = active_ws_count(baarakɛla_id) > 0`. A bɛ ye ɲɔgɔn fɛ dɔrɔn — mɔgɔ minnu tɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ, olu bɛ ye laban ye (ka kɛɲɛ ni granularity ye) nka abada a ɲɛnama tɛ yɔrɔ jɛman ye. Yɛlɛma ko kɛlenw tasuma ni jate tɛmɛna zeru fɛ sira fila bɛɛ fɛ.
presence.h4_c: Kontaktw dɔrɔn yecogo ye misali ye ciden jugu bɛɛ y’a sigi min kan, sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛlen caman kɔfɛ (WhatsApp 2014, Telegram 2015). Vortex daminɛ na, a kɛra ɛntɛrinɛti ye bɛɛ ɲɛ na; an ye default wuli, beta lajɛbaga dɔ y’a jira kɔfɛ ko foroba so bɛna dunan ba caman ka sɔrɔli bɔ dunan ba caman wɛrɛw la.

calls.title: WebRTC weleli
calls.subtitle: Kan + wideyow, 1:1 ani kulu, taamasiyɛn bɛ kɛ WebSocket kan, ka lase coturn fɛ.
calls.intro: Vortex bɛ baara kɛ ni stock WebRTC stack ye. Node ye signalling-dɔrɔn ye. Ni ɲɔgɔndanw y’u ka ICE kandidaw siri ɲɔgɔn na dɔrɔn, kunnafonidilanw bɛ woyo k’u ɲɛsin ɲɔgɔn ma (ɲɔgɔn ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ) walima ka tɛmɛ TURN relay fɛ NAT jugu kan.
calls.h1p1: Weelebaga: `POST /api/weleli/{so_id}/daminɛ` ni `{wideyo: bool, lamɛnt: bool}` ye. Node bɛ wele_id di, ka `{type:"c", kind:"invite", wele_id, wideyow, audio}` lase so kɔnɔ.
calls.h1p3: Ladili/jaabi ɲɔgɔn falen-falen: `{suguya:"lase", sdp:...}` → `{suguya:"jaabi", sdp:...}` → `{suguya:"kandida", ice:...}` × N fo ka se ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ.
calls.h1p4: Weele labanw: `POST /api/weleli/{weleli_id}/ban`. Fɛn fila bɛɛ bɛ se ka telefɔni da. Node bɛ sɛbɛnni kɛ `weleli_sɛbɛnw(weleli_id, duration_s, wideyow, odio, patiw)`.
calls.h2p1: Server Interactive Jɛɲɔgɔnya Sìgiyɔrɔma. Fɛnɲɛnɛmaw bɛ ɲɔgɔn falen-falen kandidaw la (jatigikɛ, srflx, prflx, relay).
calls.h2p2: STUN: a bɛ siri ni coturn ye. Stun-only mode min bɛ kɛ ka simetri-NAT dɔnni kɛ.
calls.h2p3: TURN: coturn ni HMAC-bolonɔbilasɛbɛnw ye minnu bɛ mɛn waati kunkurunnin kɔnɔ. Weele kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ creds kura sɔrɔ minnu bɛ baara kɛ 24 h kɔnɔ.
calls.h2p4: Sɛbɛnw: `{baarakɛla tɔgɔ: <waati taamasiyɛn>:<baarakɛla_id>, tɔgɔlasɛbɛn: base64(HMAC-SHA1(gundo, baarakɛla tɔgɔ))}`. Standard RFC 5389 layidu talen.
calls.h3p1: Lamɛnni: Opus 48 kHz bεε bεε bε bεn (6-128 kbps). DTX kan ka makun damatɛmɛ.
calls.h3p2: Wideyo: VP9 (a ka fisa) / H.264 / AV1 (a ka kan ka don). Simulcast for group calls: welebaga bɛ resolution saba kodɔn waati kelen na.
calls.h3p3: FEC: a bɛ kɛnɛ kan tuma bɛɛ fɔli kama; ka ɲɛsin wideyo ma ni bitrate kunkolo yɔrɔ bɛ sira di.
calls.h4p1: Ka ɲɛsin > 2 ma, Vortex bɛ SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit) bange node kan. Lajɛden kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ upload kɛ siɲɛ kelen, SFU fans out.
calls.h4p2: Sisan, lamɛntaw dɔrɔn bɛ se ka kɛ mɔgɔ 100 ye; wideyow kuluw dancɛ bɛ 8 la v0.1 kɔnɔ (wideyo SFU gɛlɛyali v0.3 sirako la).
calls.h4p3: SFU bɛ baara kɛ ni o coturn relay kelen ye traversal (tɛmɛsira) kama; baara wɛrɛw tɛ kɛ ka fara a kan.
calls.h5p1: `getDisplayMedia` fɛ. Client bɛ track kura fara PeerConnection kan min bɛ yen; bɛ segin ka kumaɲɔgɔnya kɛ offer/response kan.
calls.h5p2: A sɔrɔbagaw bɛ ekran tilalen jira iko videyo sira danfaralen. Mobili kan, ekran tilali bɛ OS-nivo yamaruya de wajibiya — iOS bɛ ɲininkali kɛ, Android bɛ sistɛmu dialogue jira.
calls.h6: Jitter buffer ani a ka kɛnɛya
calls.h6p1: WebRTC ka NetEQ min bɛ a kɔnɔ, o bɛ bɔnɛ ni jiginni ɲɛnabɔ. Ni a tiɲɛna kosɛbɛ, kiliyan bɛ resolution (fɔcogo) jigin walima ka wideyow bali pewu k’a sɔrɔ a bɛ odio to ɲɛnamaya la.
calls.h6p2: 500 ms freeze bɛ segin-ka-bɔnye ɲinini daminɛ (ICE daminɛ kokura). Baarakɛlaw bɛ "Reconnecting..." dakun lajɛ.
calls.h1_a: Weele taamasiyɛn bɛ boli o WebSocket kelen na min bɛ kɛ baro la. Node ye signalling-only ye — a bɛ SDP ni ICE broker kɛ a ɲɔgɔnnaw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ nka a tɛ maga kunnafonidilaw la abada.
calls.h1_b: Weelebaga bɛ POST `/api/calls/{room_id}/start` ni `{video, audio}` ye. Node bɛ `call_id` tila, ka `{type:"c", kind:"invite", call_id, video, audio}` lase so kɔnɔ. Weelebaga bɛ `/api/weleli/{weleli_id}/sɔn` → `{suguya:"c", suguya:"sɔn"}` bila. SDP di/jaabi ɲɔgɔn falen-falen: `{suguya:"sara", sdp}` → `{suguya:"jaabi", sdp}`. ICE kandidaw: `{kind:"candidate", ice}` × N fo PeerConnection ka `connected` fɔ.
calls.h1_c: SDP + ICE taamasiyɛn ye WebRTC misali jɔnjɔn ye min ɲɛfɔlen don RFC 8839 ani 8841. Vortex tɛ foyi dabɔ yan; o ye flow kelen ye Chrome, Firefox, ani WebRTC gafemarayɔrɔ baarakɛminɛn bɛɛ. Node-as-signalling-only sugandili bɛ bɔ a faamuyali la ko SFU-style media forwarding bɛ bandwidth siri ani a bɛ hardware de wajibiya an t’a fɛ ka minnu ci base install kɔnɔ.
calls.h2_a: ICE bɛ sira sɔrɔ NATw fɛ ni host + server-reflexive + relay kandidaw ye. coturn bolow STUN ani TURN Vortex fan fɛ.
calls.h2_b: Peer kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ kandidaw jate: jatigila (IP sigida la), srflx (serveur-reflexive via STUN), relay (TURN-allocated). Fɛnɲɛnɛmaw bɛ ɲɔgɔn falen-falen kandidaw bɛɛ la; fila kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ "pair" Kɛ, jɛɲɔgɔnya sɛgɛsɛgɛli bɛ STUN sirili ɲinini ci UDP kan. Fɔlɔ min ye ɲɛtaa sɔrɔ, o bɛ Kɛ sira sugandilen ye. Simetriki NAT kɔfɛ, relay fila dɔrɔn de bɛ baara kɛ — o waati de la TURN relay bɛ media relay tiɲɛ na.
calls.h2_c: ICE tun bɛ sariya la iko RFC 5245 san 2010 ani ka lakurayali i n’a fɔ RFC 8445 san 2018. Carrier-grade-NAT kɔfɛ, STUN bɛ dɛsɛ 15 % ɲɔgɔn na waati la ani TURN tɛ se ka bali. coturn ye ɲɛfɔli dafalen TURN baarakɛminɛn ye; an b’a ci bawo a nɔfɛta (Twilio/Vonage jagokɛla TURN) bɛ miniti kelen musaka kɛ odio laselen na.
calls.h3_a: TURN seereyaw ye HMAC-bolonɔbilasɛbɛnw ye minnu bɛ bɔ weleli kelen-kelen bɛɛ la, gundo minnu tɛ mɛn.
calls.h3_b: Weele daminɛ na, node bɛ `baarakɛla tɔgɔ = "<expiry_unix>:<baarakɛla_id>"` ani `daɲɛ = base64(HMAC-SHA1(sɛrɛkili_gundo, baarakɛla tɔgɔ))` labɔ. U fila bɛɛ bɛ TTL 24 h. Client bɛ baara kɛ n’u ye a ka RTCPeerConnection config kɔnɔ. coturn bɛ HMAC sɛgɛsɛgɛ session sigicogo la. Creds minnu tɛmɛna, olu tɛ HMAC sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ — u bɛ baara dabila u yɛrɛma ni revocation database tɛ.
calls.h3_c: HMAC creds minnu bɛ mɛn waati kunkurunnin kɔnɔ, olu bɛ bɔ RFC 5389 (STUN) la wa u ye misali ye min bɛ baara kɛ ni fɛn dilanni WebRTC baarakɛcogo bɛɛ ye. Twilio, Google, Xirsys bɛɛ b'a Kɛ. O cogo wɛrɛ — static TURN creds — bɛ bɔ ni kiliyan dɔ ye bɔnɛ sɔrɔ. Creds minnu bɛ mɛn waati kunkurunnin kɔnɔ, olu bɛ dan sigi tiɲɛni finɛtiri la ka se 24 h ma.
calls.h4_a: Odio ye Opus ye 48 kHz la ni DTX ye; wideyow ye VP9 fɔlɔ ye / H.264 fallback / AV1 opt-in.
calls.h4_b: Lamɛnni: Opus 48 kHz, 6-128 kbps VBR. DTX (Discotinuous Transmission) bɛ ci dabila makun waati, a bɛ daminɛ kokura kan kan. FEC kan tuma bɛɛ. Wideyo: VP9 a daminɛ na; H.264 ye piblisite kɛ minɛnw kan minnu tɛ ni fɛnɲɛnamafagalan VP9 decode ye (iOS ka kɔn A10 Bionic ɲɛ); AV1 bɛ dilan i n’a fɔ opt-in for premium bi hardware kan. Simulcast for group calls: caller bɛ kode saba resolutions kɛ waati kelen na, SFU fans out the right one to each viewer.
calls.h4_c: Opus ye IETF ka kodɔn ye min tɛ sara (RFC 6716, 2012). VP9 ye Google ka da wulilen H.265-ɲɔgɔn na. H.264 ye fallback ye bawo Apple ye VP9 dɛmɛni minɛ fo san 2021. AV1 kɛra baarakɛminɛn ye telefɔniw kan iPhone 15 Pro (2023) ni Pixel 8 (2023) ye hardware decode fara a kan kɔfɛ. Vortex ka codec mix ye kelen ye Google Meet bɛ baara kɛ ni min ye.
calls.h5_a: Jɛkulu weleli bɛ baara kɛ ni SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit) ye node kan. Lajɛden kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ fɛnw bila siɲɛ kelen; SFU ka ɲɛsin bɛɛ ma.
calls.h5_b: Ka ɲɛsin > 2 ɲɔgɔn ma welebaga bɛ `/api/calls/{room_id}/group/start` bila. Node bɛ SFU misali dɔ lamini min sirilen bɛ weleli la. Lajɛden kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ PeerConnection dɔ da wuli SFU ma sanni ka kɛ peer tɔw bɛɛ ye. Uplink: kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ 1 ci. Jiginni: SFU ɲɛfɛ N-1 bajiw. Simulcast layers kɔrɔ ye ko SFU bɛ resolution ta min bɛ bɛn filɛlikɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka bandwidth sɔrɔlen ma.
calls.h5_c: SFU jɔli daminɛna Jitsi ka Videobridge (2013) la. Sani SFU ka se, WebRTC kulu weleli tun ye full-mesh ye — ɲɔgɔndan kelen-kelen bɛɛ tun bɛ N-1 jikuruw kodɔn, minnu bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ quadratically. Zoom, Google Meet, Jitsi, Signal kulu weleli bɛɛ bɛ baara kɛ ni SFU ye. Vortex kulu weleli minnu bɛ kɛ ni lamɛntaw dɔrɔn ye, olu bɛ ci v0.0.8 kɔnɔ; wideyow kulu weleli bɛ v0.3 sirako kan.
calls.h6_a: Écran sharing ye kunnafonidilan kura ye PeerConnection kɔrɔlen kan, min bɛ kumaɲɔgɔnya kɛ kokura offer/answer fɛ.
calls.h6_b: Baarakɛla bɛ Share Screen → navigateur / iOS / Android weleli kɛ `getDisplayMedia()`. MediaStream seginnen bɛ faraTrack-ed kan PeerConnection kan. Renegotiation fires: offer/response kura ni track faralen ye. Sɔrɔbagaw bɛ ekran tilalen jira iko videyo yɔrɔ danfaralen. iOS kan, ekran tilali mago bɛ Broadcast Upload Extension la; Android kan, o ye ɲɛfɛ baarakɛyɔrɔ ye + MediaProjection ka yamaruya.
calls.h6_c: getDisplayMedia tun bɛ sariya kɔnɔ san 2017, wa a bɛ navigatɔrɔ bɛɛ kɔnɔ kabini san 2019. iOS ka Broadcast Upload Extension nana iOS 11 (2017) kɔnɔ. Android MediaProjection bɛ sabati kabini Lollipop (2015). Vortex ekran tilali cilen don v0.0.8 kɔnɔ.
