federation.title: Fɛdɛrasiɔn
federation.subtitle: Pubkeys dannayalenw, kumaɲɔgɔnya bolonɔbilalenw, cross-node DMw.
federation.intro: Federation bɛ baarakɛlaw bila node A kan cikan baarakɛlaw ma node B. It’s opt-in per operator. Node pubkeyw bɛ da u kan k’a jɛya; otomatiki "node si bɛ se ka jɛɲɔgɔnya kɛ ni ne ta ye" cogoya tɛ yen.
federation.h1p1: Node kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ `federations(pubkey, endpoint, health_score, added_at, added_by)` mara.
federation.h1p2: Peer dɔ farali bɛ operateur-signed admin action de wajibiya. Admin UI bɛ remote bolokɔfɛfɛn jira walasa baarakɛlaw ka se ka out-of-band sɛgɛsɛgɛ.
federation.h1p3: Fɛnɲɛnɛma minnu Bɔra yen, olu bɛ To DB la minnu taamaʃyɛn ye `revoked_at` ye walasa ka jatebɔ Kɛ. Fɛderasiyɔn kura ɲininiw ka bɔ pubkey kelen na, olu bɛ ban fo admin dɔ ka un-revoke.
federation.h2p1: Ka bɔ A la ka taa user@B la: node A bɛ cikan enveloppe siri blob bolonɔbilalen dɔ kɔnɔ ka `/federation/deliver` POST node B kan.
federation.h2p2: Enveloppe: `{source_node, laɲini_baarakɛla, kɔnɔna_ciphertext, kɔnɔna_nonce, cilen_at, sig}`. Sig bɛ fɛn bɛɛ datugu fo sig yɛrɛ.
federation.h2p3: Node B bɛ bolonɔbila sɛgɛsɛgɛ `source_node` pubkey kan ka bɔ a ka `federations` tabali la. Sig → 401 + jatebɔ ko kɛlen min tɛ tiɲɛ.
federation.h3p1: Ni B tɛ se ka sɔrɔ, A bɛ layidu ta `federation_outbox(target_node, payload, attempts, next_retry_at)` kɔnɔ.
federation.h3p2: Backoff exponentiel : 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, a dabɔra 6h la. Dɛsɛ banbali tile 14 kɔfɛ.
federation.h3p3: Operatɛri lasɔmini tasuma bɛ bɔ ni bɔyɔrɔ juguya > cikan 1000 — o b’a jira ko federasɔn jɛgɛnsira dɔ sirilen don.
federation.h4p1: S 60 o s node kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ `GET /v1/health` ping kɛ ɲɔgɔndan kelen-kelen bɛɛ kan. Jaabi waati + cogoya bɛ tugu ɲɔgɔn kɔ.
federation.h4p2: Kɛnɛya jate : daminɛ na 100. Waati tɛmɛnen kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ 1 bɔ; ɲɛtaa kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ 1 fara a kan (cap 100). Score 0 → federasiyɔn ye lafiɲɛbɔ kɛ o ɲɔgɔndan in kama.
federation.h4p3: A bɔra `GET /v1/peers` fɛ baarakɛlaw ka dashboardw kama.
federation.h1_a: Fɛderasiyɔn min bɛ Vortex kɔnɔ, o ye ɲɔgɔndɛmɛ jɛɲɔgɔnya ye node baarakɛla fila ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ. Node kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ Ed25519 forobaciyɛn 32 bɔ; node tɔ kelen b'a fara `trusted_nodes` tabali kan a labanyɔrɔ kɛrɛfɛ ani kɛnɛya jate.
federation.h1_b: Pubkey dannamɔgɔ dɔ farali bɛ baarakɛla wajibiya a ka bolonɔ bila admin ɲinini na ni node yɛrɛ ka bɔli kilisi ye. UI bɛ yɔrɔjan-minɛn bolokɔfɛfɛn jira 64-hex-char cogo la walasa ɲɛmɔgɔw ka se ka sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ out of band. Ni a farala a kan, federasɔn ka anwɛlɛki min bɛ don, o bɛɛ bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni o pubkey ka Ed25519 bolonɔbila ye — nkalontigɛw bɛ dɔn o yɔrɔnin bɛɛ, ka sɛbɛn. Revocation ye soft ye : row bɛ to taamasiyɛn ye `revoked_at` la audit kama, nka enveloppe bolonɔbila bɛ dɛsɛ sisan.
federation.h1_c: O misali in bɛ Bɔ Matrix ka fédération (yɔrɔ min na sèrwɛri bɛɛ bɛ bolonɔbila-kilisi dɔ Laseli ani ko bɛɛ bɛ bolonɔ Blà n’a ye) ani ka Bɔ imɛri ka DKIM (yɔrɔ min na DNS bɛ bolonɔbila pubkey Bɔ). Matrix y’a jira ko modɛli bɛ baara kɛ ni sɛgɛsɛgɛli ye — u ka rezow bɛ ni 100k ni kɔ ye sèrwɛri jɛkulu fɛ. Vortex ka danfara bɛ danfara la ni ɲɔgɔndɛmɛ jɛlen wajibiyalen ye sanni Matrix ka "sɛrɛkili o baarakɛla bɛ se ka jɛkulu sigi ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye" sariya ye; an ye nɔgɔya jago kɛ walasa ka lafasali barikama sɔrɔ federasɔn namaratɔw kama.
federation.h1_f:
dannaya_nodes row: .
  pubkey : 32 bayt Ed25519 ye
  labanyɔrɔ : https://...
  kɛnɛya_jatebɔ : int [0, 100] .
  faralen_faralen : unix_ms
  faralen_faralen : ɲɛmɔgɔ_baarakɛla_id
  revoked_at : unix_ms | NULL Bamako
federation.h2_a: Kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la cikan bɛ E2E anwɛlɛki kelen ta ni sigida ta ye, a sirilen bɛ kɛnɛma anwɛlɛki taamasiyɛnlen dɔ kɔnɔ min bɛ cikan node tiɲɛ ka taa node minɛbaga ma.
federation.h2_b: Node A b’a fɛ ka lase user@B ma. 1nan : A bɛ `{source_node, target_user, kɔnɔna_ciphertext, kɔnɔna_nonce, sent_at}` kɛ seriyali ye. 2nan : A bɛ bolonɔ bila bayt seriyali la n’a ka Ed25519 privé key → `sig` ye. 3nan : A bɛ tuple POST kɛ `POST /federation/deliver` la node B kan.Taabolo 4nan : B bɛ `source_node` ɲini a ka `trusted_nodes` kɔnɔ, ka `sig` sɛgɛsɛgɛ, ka `sent_at` lajɛ ni replay-window ye, ka kɔnɔna enveloppe to a ka sigida `messages` tabali kɔnɔ. Kunnafoni sɔrɔbaga ka kiliyan b’a ye tigitigi i n’a fɔ sigida cikan — federasɔn layɛrɛ tɛ ye baarakɛla labanw fɛ.
federation.h2_c: Kɛnɛma bolonɔbila sɛbɛn in bɛ juru ta Matrix ka `m.room.message` federasɔn ka ko kɛlenw na. Segin-ka-bɔ-yɔrɔ (miniti 5) ani wajibi min b’a jira ko waati taamasiyɛn minnu bolonɔ bilalen bɛ sɔrɔyɔrɔ fɛ, olu bɛ bɛn kogo waati ma, olu juru donna DKIM la. Vortex fɔlɔ (v0.0.2) y’a ɲini ka federasɔn bolonɔbilabali kɛ ni TLS kliyanw ka seereyaw ye; an jiginna ka taa payload signatures la v0.0.5 kɔnɔ an kɛlen kɔ k’a faamuya ko client certs tɛ kisi load balancers ma ani ka authentication yɛrɛ dogo application layer kɔnɔ.
federation.h2_f:
anwɛlɛki = {
  sɔrɔyɔrɔ_yɔrɔ : hex32, .
  laɲini_baarakɛla : int64, .
  kɔnɔna_ciphertext: bayt, .
  kɔnɔna_nonce : bayt, .
  cilen_kalanso : unix_ms, .
} .
sig = Ed25519Sign(sɔrɔ_dafalen, CBOR(anwɛlɛki))
POST /federasiyɔn/lase { anwɛlɛki, sig } .
federation.h3_a: Ni yɔrɔjan node ma se ka sɔrɔ, ciden node bɛ enveloppe bila layini na a ka `federation_outbox` kɔnɔ, ka segin k’a ɲini ni exponentiel backoff ye.
federation.h3_b: Backoff waati bolodalen : 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, a bɛ kɛ 6h la. A ɲinini dɛsɛlen kelen-kelen bɛɛ kan, jirisunba ka `a ɲini` kulu bɛ dɔ fara a kan ani `next_retry_at` bɛ bila sisan + sisan-taamasenɲɛ na. Baarakɛla dɔ (`app/federation/outbox_worker.py`) bɛ kunun s 5 o s 5 ani ka jirisunw ta yɔrɔ minnu na `next_retry_at <= now()`. Ɲɛtaa bɛ jirisun in bɔ yen; Tile 14 dɛsɛw bɛ taamasiyɛn kɛ a banbali ye ani ka admin alert ci.
federation.h3_c: Exponentiel backoff ni plafond ye o cogo kelen ye Kafka bɛ baara kɛ ni producer retries ye ani SMTP bɛ baara kɛ ni bounced mail ye. Tile 14 ta bɛ bɛn SMTP ka RFC 5321 ladilikan ma. Fɔlɔw tun bɛ baara kɛ ni segin 60 segin-ka-bɔnyew ye minnu tun bɛ kɛ sababu ye ka sanpɛrɛn-kuluba wuli ni a ɲɔgɔnna dɔ seginna ka na ɛntɛrinɛti kan baara tiɲɛni kɔfɛ; exponentiel spread y'o Labɛn v0.0.7 kɔnɔ.
federation.h3_f:
delay(n) = min(6h, 1s · 2−) ka ɲɛsin n = 0, 1, 2, ...

seginkanni waati bolodacogo : 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 32s, 64s, 128s, 256s, ..., 6h
lasɔmini: bɔyɔrɔ_juguya > 1000 fo > miniti 5
federation.h4_a: Seginnkanni 60 o segin 60, node kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ ping kɛ ɲɔgɔndan kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka `/v1/health` labanyɔrɔ la. Score bɛ wuli ka taa sanfɛ ni ɲɛtaa ye, ka jigin ni dɛsɛ ye, a dan bɛ [0, 100] la.
federation.h4_b: Jate bɛ daminɛ 100 na farali kan. Ɲɛtaa kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ +1 fara a kan (a dabɔra 100 na), waati tɛmɛnen kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ -1 bɔ (a bɛ duguma 0 la). Score 0 bɛ federation jɔ o peer fɛ — cikan kuraw bɛ layidu ta outbox kɔnɔ, outbound delivery attempts kura tɛ fo score ka wuli ka segin ka tɛmɛ 20. Score bɛ bɔ kɛnɛ kan `GET /v1/peers` fɛ operator dashboards fɛ ani `/metrics` fɛ Prometheus fɛ. Jatebɔ barikamaw dɔgɔyali ɲɔgɔndan caman cɛ finɛtiri surun dɔ kɔnɔ, o bɛ "rezo tilali sigalen" lasɔmini daminɛ.
federation.h4_c: AIMD-style score in bɛ lawuli TCP ka congestion window ani Akamai ka kɛnɛya-sɛgɛsɛgɛli damper fɛ. ±1 taamaʃyɛn asimɛtiri (sanni TCP tilancɛ ka kɛ) bɛ seginkanni kɛ dɔɔnin dɔɔnin ka tɛmɛ dɛsɛ kan, o min bɛ sistɛmu bila k’a ɲɛsin hakilijagabɔ ma — an b’a fɛ ka federasɔn jɔ ni an dalen tɛ a la ka tɛmɛn ka cikan fila ci ka tɛmɛn flapping link fɛ. A Fàrala v0.0.6 kɔnɔ, a ɲɔgɔnna taamacogo jugu dɔ ye ɲɔgɔndan ɲuman fla Fa ni segin-ka-bɔnyew ye.
federation.h4_f:
ɲɛtaa kan : jate = min(100, jate + 1) .
waati tɛmɛnen kan: jate = max(0, jate - 1) .
ni jate == 0: pause_federation(peer) .
ni jate >= 20: resume_federation(peer) // hysteresis

gossip.title: Gossip ani ɲɔgɔndan sɔrɔli
gossip.subtitle: Nodes bɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ cogo min na ni central registre tɛ.
gossip.intro: Kɔrɔsilikɛla ka lisi seereyalen kɔfɛ, Vortex nodes bɛ kumakanfɔ ɲɔgɔn fɛ u ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ. O bɛ node kura Sɔrɔ ni baarakɛlaw b’u Lamaga, hali n’a y’a Sɔrɔ ko kɔrɔsibaga ma u Seereya fɔlɔ.
gossip.h1p1: S 60 o s 60, node bɛ peer random dɔ ta ka 256-bit Bloom filter ci peer dɔntaw la. Peer bɛ jaabi ni peers NOT ye filɛri kɔnɔ, ka fara a yɛrɛ ka filɛri kan. Bandwidth ye `O(peers kura × 32 bytes)` ye, a ka c’a la, a bɛ 1 KiB jukɔrɔ round kelen na.
gossip.h1p2: Piblisite ɲɔgɔnna kelen-kelen bɛɛ bolonɔ bilalen bɛ piblisite node fɛ. Clients bɛ bolonɔbilasɛbɛnw sɛgɛsɛgɛ u ka ɲɔgɔnye fɔlɔ la — binkannikɛla tɛ se ka a ɲɔgɔnna dɔ forge ka don kumakan na.
gossip.h1p3: Lamini bɛ dan hakɛ ma: fɛn kelen ɲɔgɔn falen-falen ɲɔgɔn na s 30 kɔnɔ (fenɛtiri min bɛ wuli).
gossip.h2p1: Node kura bɛ daminɛ ni 8 hardcoded bootstrap controllers ye. Fɔlɔ kumakan-fɔli-yɔrɔ bɛ a ɲɔgɔnna tan ni caman Sɔrɔ; rezo bɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ ~miniti 1 kɔnɔ.
gossip.h2p2: Bootstrap lisi bɛ se ka ladilan `.env` fɛ `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=pubkey1@endpoint1,pubkey2@endpoint2,...`.
gossip.h3p1: Piblisite ɲɔgɔnna kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka kan ka bolonɔ bila baarakɛla ka Ed25519 bɔli kilisi fɛ. Ka i teriw ka laseli nkalon, o bɛ a ɲini ka konnɛgɛ tiɲɛnen dɔ sonya.
gossip.h3p2: Baara dalilu (min bɛ se ka ladilan, default 2^18 leading zeros) kan peer registrations kura kan, o bɛ Sybil-bot waves caman to u tɛ se ka kɛ.
gossip.h3p3: Tɔgɔladoncogo : u tɔɲɔgɔn minnu bɛ u yɛrɛ minɛ cogo jugu la (bolonɔbila juguw, laseli nkalonmaw, waati tɛmɛnenw segin-segin) olu tɔgɔ bɛ tiɲɛ. Zeru tɔgɔ → lisi nɛrɛma.
gossip.h1_a: S 60 o s 60, node kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ ɲɔgɔndan kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen dɔ ta ka Bloom filɛri 256-bit ci min bɛ ɲɔgɔndan dɔntaw lajɛ. Peer bɛ jaabi ni peer kura ye + a yɛrɛ ka filɛri. Bandwidth ye `O(peers_kura × 32 bayt)` ye.
gossip.h1_b: Bloom filɛri k=5 hashes, m=256 bitikiw. Node A b’a ka peer_ids dɔntaw bɛɛ don a kɔnɔ. A bɛ ci bila ɲɔgɔndan B ma B bɛ filɛri ɲininka n’a tɔɲɔgɔn kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye; fɛn o fɛn ma tɛmɛ, B bɛ ci A ma (ka fara a yɛrɛ ka filɛri kan). A bɛ o sɛgɛsɛgɛli kelen in kɛ kɔfɛ. O ɲɔgɔn falen-falen kɔfɛ, node fila bɛɛ bɛ dɔnniya kelen de Kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ. Fɛnw falen-falen cogoya: 200-800 bayt. Kumakura bɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ ɛntɛrinɛti kan ~5 rounds (miniti 5) kɔnɔ k’a sababu kɛ kumakan nafolo ye.
gossip.h1_c: Bloom-filter kumakanw bɛ daminɛ Cornell ka san 1998 bimodal multicast papier la. Apache Cassandra bɛ baara kɛ n’a ye tɔndenw ye; Bitcoin ka ɲɛsin jagokɛlaw ka relay ma; IPFS ka ɲɛsin DHT ladonni ma. O(log N) ɲɔgɔndan nafolo de b’a kɛ fɛn ye min bɛ bɛn an ka baarakɛcogo ɲuman ma — an mago tɛ diɲɛ jateminɛw la, laban-ko bɛnkan dɔrɔn de la ɲɔgɔn fɛ. Filɛtiri hakɛ (256 bitiki) bɛ labɛn walasa nkalon-pozitif hakɛ ka kɛ < 1 % ye 100 ɲɔgɔnna na.
gossip.h2_a: Node kura bɛ daminɛ ni 8 hardcoded bootstrap controllers ye. Fɔlɔ kumakan round bɛ fɛn caman sɔrɔ; bɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ ~miniti 1 kɔnɔ.
gossip.h2_b: `.env` bɛ ci ni `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=pubkey1@endpoint1,pubkey2@endpoint2,...` ye. Daminɛ na, node bɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ lajɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni ɲɔgɔn ye. Fɔlɔ ka jaabi bɛ ɲɔgɔndan lisi fɔlɔ di (`GET /v1/trusted_nodes` fɛ). Node b’o don a ka sigida ɲɔgɔndan tabali kɔnɔ, k’u taamasiyɛn ko bootstrapped, ka 60 s gossip loop daminɛ. Lamini nataw bɛ ɲɔgɔndɛmɛ-ɲɔgɔnw Sɔrɔ.
gossip.h2_c: Bootstraps hardcoded ye baarakɛcogo kelen ye Bitcoin, Ethereum, IPFS baarakɛcogo. O wɛrɛ — DHT-based sɔrɔli — bɛ don fɔlɔ de wajibiya cogo o cogo. Vortex ka 8 bootstrap jate minɛna bawo ka kɛ > 4 ye, o bɛ se ka muɲu ka ɲɛsin 2-3 ma minnu bɛ kɛ waati kelen na, wa < 16 bɛ `.env` filen to ka kalan. Ladilan per-deployment ni `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS` sɛgɛsɛgɛli ye.
gossip.h3_a: Piblisite ɲɔgɔnna kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka kan ka bolonɔ bila a bɔyɔrɔ baarakɛla ka Ed25519 bɔli kilisi fɛ. Binkannikɛla tɛ se ka a ɲɔgɔnnaw dilan ka don ɛntɛrinɛti kɔnɔ.
gossip.h3_b: Ni node A bɛ peer P laseli kɛ kumakan na ka taa node B la, A bɛ `P.pubkey`, `P.endpoint`, ani waati taamasiyɛn dɔ don a kɔnɔ, olu bɛɛ bolonɔ bilalen bɛ P yɛrɛ ka bɔli kilisi fɛ. B bɛ bolonɔbila sɛgɛsɛgɛ sani a ka da P la.Ni B ye ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ kɔfɛ P ni P ka TLS cert + dusukun tantanni fɔlɔ ma bɛn pubkey piblisite ma, piblisite bɛ taamasiyɛn kɛ baga ye, ka jɛnsɛn ka taa duguma.
gossip.h3_c: Piblisite minnu bɛ bolonɔ bila ɲɔgɔn na, olu ye Sybil kɛlɛli primitive standard ye ka bɔ Chord (2001) ani Kademlia (2002) la. Bitcoin ka adr cikanw bɛ baara kɛ ni modɛli barikama ye (bolonɔbila tɛ, a bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔndan musaka la i n’a fɔ Sybil balilan); Ethereum ka discv5 taamasiyɛnw. Vortex ye piblisite bolonɔbilalenw ta v0.0.6 kɔnɔ testnet binkannikɛla dɔ ye a ɲɔgɔnna nkalontigɛla 1000 laseli kɔfɛ node sariyalen kelen fɛ.
gossip.h1_f:
filɛri : k=5, m=256 bitiki
insert(x) = for i in 0..k: filɛri[hash_i(x) mod m] = 1
ɲininkali(x) = ka i in 0..k: filɛri lajɛ[hash_i(x) mod m].
nkalon-pozitif ka 100 ɲɔgɔnna, 256 bitiki, k=5: ~0,4 % .
gossip.h2_f:
.env: 1 .
  BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=abcd...@https://a.misali,efgh...@https://b.misali

daminɛ na:
  ka ɲɛsin ɲɔgɔndan ma BOOTSTRAP_PEERS kɔnɔ:
    a ɲini: ɲɔgɔndan ← ɲɔgɔndan.get('/v1/daŋaniya_nodes'); kari
    fo ni: ka taa ɲɛ
  daminɛ kumajugu fɔli
gossip.h3_f:
piblisite = {pubkey, labanyɔrɔ, piblisite_la}
sig = Ed25519-Sign(pubkey_priv, CBOR(piblisite)) Bamako, Mali.
kumakan nafama: [..., {piblisite, sig}, ...]

jaabi: sɛgɛsɛgɛli sig kan ad.pubkey → magan iff ok
faralen ɲɔgɔn kan: PoW min ye 2^18 ye zeru ɲɛmɔgɔya la {pubkey, endpoint} kan.

stealth.title: Sonyali rezo
stealth.subtitle: Layɛrɛ duuru, fɛɛrɛ 28. Fɛn bɛɛ, k’a ta TLS padding na ka se Tor soja baarakɛlaw ma.
stealth.intro: Vortex bɛ jamana-jamana-kɛlɛɲɔgɔn ta. Sonyali kulu bɛ layɛrɛ o la hali ni kɛnɛma layɛrɛw tɛmɛna, kɔnɔna ta bɛ baara tiɲɛnen-nka-baarakɛla di hali bi.
stealth.h1p1: Layer 1 — bolokɔfɛfɛnw normalisation. A bɛ danfaralanw (classificateurs passives) jɔ.
stealth.h1p2: Layer 2 — cogoya / bonya morphing. A bɛ sirako-sɛgɛsɛgɛli danfaralanw jɔ.
stealth.h1p3: Layɛrɛ 3 — protocole camouflage (kamouflage) ye. A bɛ baara dabila DPI.
stealth.h1p4: Layer 4 — transports minnu bɛ se ka don a la. A bɛ baara kɛ rezow kɔnɔ minnu bɛ an ka primaire bali.
stealth.h1p5: Layer 5 — laban-ko-ɲɛnabɔli. Soja, BMP, relais multi-hop. A bɛ baara kɛ tuma min na foyi wɛrɛ tɛ o kɛ.
stealth.h2p1: TLS 1.3 ClientHello bɛ bɛn Chrome ma Windows 11 kan bayt-ni-bayt. JA3/JA4 hash bɛ bɛn Chrome 120 ma — bolokɔfɛfɛn kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen tɛ Vortex.
stealth.h2p2: Record-layer padding: TLS disiki bɛɛ padding ka se 16 KB ma. Pakew hakɛw bɛ bɛn navigatɛri caman ka taama ma.
stealth.h2p3: Constant-rate send: queue bɛ frame kelen bɔ N ms o ms kɔnɔ, application baara mana kɛ min o min ye. Waati minnu tɛ baara kɛ, olu bɛ karamɔgɔya mankutuw bɔ minnu taamasiyɛn bɛ anwɛlɛki kɔnɔna na walasa u sɔrɔbagaw k’u fili.
stealth.h2p4: Waati jiginni : 0-50 ms random delay on egress walasa ka se sɔrɔ latency-based DPI kan.
stealth.h3p1: YouTube-720p morfer: pake-hakɛ tilali, burst cadence, ani silence gaps bɛ bɛn YouTube ɲɛnama dɔ ma. Daɲɛgafe minnu bɛ ciden dusukun tantanni ɲini, olu tɛ Se ka Bɛn.
stealth.h3p2: Sira caman : o jibɔ kelen bɛ tila Wi-Fi, selilɛri, ani VPN baarakɛtaw bɛɛ kan waati kelen na. Aw bɛ segin ka ɲɔgɔn lajɛn sɔrɔyɔrɔ la. A bɛ se sɔrɔ sira kelen-kelen cogoya kan.
stealth.h3p3: WebRTC data channel tunnel : ni TLS datugulen don nka WebRTC bɛ baara kɛ, Vortex bɛ tunnel kɛ DTLS-SRTP kanal fɛ ka taa a ɲɔgɔnna dɔnnen dɔ fɛ.
stealth.h3p4: Decoy connections: 3 long-living idle TLS sessions ka taa Google, YouTube, ani Cloudflare. Kɔlɔsilikɛla bɛ navigatɔrɔn kɛcogo nɔgɔman ye.
stealth.h4p1: DoH (RFC 8484): DNS bɛɛ ɲɛnabɔra DoH fɛ ka se Cloudflare / Google / Quad9 ma. ISP bɛ HTTPS dɔrɔn de ye o ɲɛnabɔbagaw fɛ, a tɛ domani lisi yɛrɛ ye.
stealth.h4p2: ECH (Kiliyan sirilen Bonjour): SNI sirilen ni kilisi ye min bɔra DNS HTTPS sɛbɛn kɔnɔ. Kɔlɔsilikɛla pasifw tɛ se ka taa yɔrɔ jatigila tɔgɔ ye.
stealth.h4p3: Probe detection: node bɛ ɲininiw nɔfɛ ni auth session tɛ. Sonda saba dɛsɛlenw ka bɔ IP dɔ la miniti 5 kɔnɔ, olu bɛ "decoy site" cogoya daminɛ — ko IP bɛ sisan HTML landing page gansan ye ni 200 OK ye.
stealth.h4p4: DGA (Domain Generation Algorithm): deterministic domain generator kisɛ donna ni bi don ye. Ni labanyɔrɔ fɔlɔ balilen don, kiliyanw bɛ kandida nata jate k’a ɲini.
stealth.h5: Nivo 4 — Bololabaara minnu bɛ se ka don fiɲɛbɔ la
stealth.h5p1: vmess / vless / trojan / shadowtls: V2Ray-style transports standards ni JSON config ye min bɛ se ka don.
stealth.h5p2: Tiɲɛ: TLS-kɔnɔ-TLS tunnel. Kɛnɛma boloci laɲiniw www.microsoft.com; kɔnɔna bolonɔbila ye Vortex ye. Sonda minnu bɛ kɛnɛma, olu bɛ taa ɲɛfɛ ka taa Microsoft o la sonda active tɛ foyi jira.
stealth.h5p3: Snowflake: navigatɔrɔn minnu bɛ baara kɛ ni u yɛrɛ sago ye, olu bɛ Vortex taamaw lase WebRTC kan. Baarakɛlaw minnu bɛ Snowflake ka farankan sigi sen kan, olu bɛ datugulan di.
stealth.h5p4: NaiveProxy: a bɛ HTTPS sonda caman sɛmɛntiya walasa u ka fara Chromium yɛrɛ ka kɛwale kan fo ka se mikrosekɔndi ma.
stealth.h6p1: Soja baarakɛlaw : node bɛɛ fana b’a yɛrɛ jira ko `.soja`. Tor dɛmɛ bɛ kiliyan minnu na, olu bɛ bin o la ni fɛn tɔw bɛɛ ma ɲɛ.
stealth.h6p2: Blind Mailbox Protocol (BMP): tɔgɔ tɛ min na ka cikanw mara. Aw ye BMP tilayɔrɔba lajɛ.
stealth.h6p3: Multi-hop relay : cikanw bɛ se ka pan ka tɛmɛ cɛmancɛ-yɔrɔ 5 kan, u kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ enveloppe layɛrɛ dɔ fara a kan. I n’a fɔ Tor nka an yɛrɛ ka mesh kɔnɔ.
stealth.h6p4: OHTTP (RFC 9458): ɲinɛni HTTP ka tɛmɛn relay fɛ. Fɛn kelen si tɛ ɲinini ni jaabi fila bɛɛ ye.
stealth.h1_a: Sonyali bɛ labɛn i n’a fɔ layini yɛrɛmahɔrɔnyalen duuru. Layɛrɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ se sɔrɔ jugu kulu wɛrɛ kan. Layɛrɛ kelen dɛsɛ bɛ dɔgɔya ka taa a nɔfɛ — a tɛ cascade.
stealth.h1_b: Layer 1 bɛ an ka TLS bolokɔnincinin normalize o la passive DPI tɛ se ka classifier. Layer 2 bɛ sirako cogoya sɛmɛntiya walasa a ka kɛ i n’a fɔ streaming. Layɛrɛ 3 bɛ protocol camouflage ECH / DoH / probe-response tricks fɛ. Layer 4 bɛ wuli ka taa pluggable transports (vmess, reality, Snowflake) la ni primaire bɛ bali kosɛbɛ. Layɛrɛ 5 ye laban ye: Tor soja, BMP, multi-hop relay.
stealth.h1_c: Layɛrɛ modɛli bɔra Tor ka pluggable-transports architecture (2013) la. Vortex ye layɛrɛ duuru Fàra Tor ka sàba nɔ na bari 2025 sàn na, kὲlɛbolo-yɔrɔ in tùn bɛ DPI la min ye Tor ka bolifɛnw yɛrɛ Dɔn (Great Firewall 2020, Iran 2022). Vortex layɛrɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ donna foroko dɔ kɔfɛ: L1 Kazakhstan balili kɔfɛ (2019-a bɛ bɛn), L2 Iran ka san 2022 kɛlɛli kɔfɛ, L3 Siniwa ka san 2020 DoH sɔrɔli kɔfɛ, L4 Turki ka balili 2023 kɔfɛ, L5 labɛnni na.
stealth.h1_f:
Adversaire ka kalasi | A ye se sɔrɔ ni
------------------- | -----------
pasif DPI | L1 (bololanɛgɛ) .
sirako sɛgɛsɛgɛli | L2 (cogo) .
walekɛla DPI | L3 (kamouflage) .
ka balili kɛ ni IP | L4 (taamakɛlaw) .
fɛn tɔw bɛɛ | L5 (sogo / BMP) .
stealth.h2_a: Layɛrɛ 1 bɛ Vortex taama kɛ fɛn ye min tɛ se ka faranfasi ni Chrome ye Windows 11 kan TLS layɛrɛ la.
stealth.h2_b: ClientHello komandi, jatebɔ lisi, cipher suite lisi, ALPN nafaw — bɛɛ labɛnna walasa ka bɛn Chrome 120 ka bayt tigitigiw ma. JA3/JA4 hash bɛ bɛn Chrome bɔko sisan ma. TLS disiki padding ka se 16 KB ma. Constant-rate cinder bɛ frame kelen bɔ N ms o N ms ni dummy fillers ye idle waati. Waati jitter 0-50 ms ka se sɔrɔ latency sɛgɛsɛgɛli kan. Decoy jεɲɔgɔnya minnu bɛ Google, YouTube, Cloudflare la, olu bɛ boli kɔkan ni s 45 cɛ.
stealth.h2_c: JA3/JA4 bolokɔnincinin bɔra Salesforce injiniyɛriw fɛ san 2017. San 2019 a kɛra sariya ye baarakɛda DPI kɔnɔ. Vortex ka bolokɔnincinin normalisation (bolonɔbila normalisation) bɛ misali di uTLS kan, o ye Go gafemarayɔrɔ ye Snowflake bɛ baara kɛ ni min ye o kun kelen na. Ciden minnu bɛ taa ni wari ye tuma bɛɛ, olu ye WireGuard ka "cover traffic" laɲini ka kurunbonkariyɔrɔ tilennen ye.
stealth.h2_f:
ClientHello bayt = chrome_120_template ni { .
  random = an ka random, .
  server_name = an ka jatigila tɔgɔ (walima ECH-wrapped), .
  session_id = an ka session id, .
} .
JA4 = t13d_xxxx_xxxx_xxxx (a bɛ bɛn sisan Chrome sabatili ma) .
stealth.h3_a: Layer 2 bɛ traffic morphs ka kɛ i n’a fɔ bulk streaming media sanni ka kɛ interactive chat ye.
stealth.h3_b: YouTube-720p morfer: pake-size tilali bɛ bɛn 720p YouTube live stream (tabali empiriki), burst cadence matches, silence gaps bɛ bɛn. Sira caman : jikuru hakilitigi kelen min bɛ tila Wi-Fi, selilɛri, ani VPN baarakɛlen o baarakɛta kan waati kelen na; jaabibaga bɛ ɲɔgɔn lajɛ kokura ka kɛɲɛ ni jatedenw ye minnu bɛ tugu ɲɔgɔn kɔ. WebRTC data channel fallback : ni TLS datugulen don nka WebRTC tɛmɛna, tunnel Vortex ka tɛmɛ DTLS-SRTP data channel fɛ ka taa a teri dɔnnen dɔ fɛ.
stealth.h3_c: Traffic morphing ɲininiw bɛ segin Wright et al. 2009. Obfs4 y'a waleya i n'a fɔ a ka "morph" sub-mode san 2014. Meek+domain-fronting y'an kalan ko cogoya nafa ka bon i n'a fɔ encryption. YouTube-kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, a sugandira bawo a ye yɔrɔ kelen ye min ma bali, dantigɛli-sɛbɛn fanba kɔnɔ — ka dogo YouTube cogoya la, o ye "dogo ye jama cɛma".
stealth.h3_f:
pake_taama[i] ~ P(hakɛ | YT-720p)
ci_latigɛ[i] ~ P(lakɔli | YT-720p)
dummy_frames donna baarakɛbaliya waati la walasa ka anwɛlɛki cogoya mara
stealth.h4_a: Layɛrɛ 3 bɛ protocole identité yɛrɛ camouflage — SNI, DNS, jaabi kode.
stealth.h4_b: DoH (RFC 8484): DNS bɛɛ bɛ tɛmɛ DNS-ka tɛmɛ-HTTPS fɛ ka se Cloudflare/Google/Quad9 ma. ISP bɛ HTTPS dɔrɔn de ye o ɲɛnabɔbagaw fɛ. ECH (RFC 9460): SNI bɛ siri ni kilisi ye min bɔra DNS HTTPS sɛbɛn kɔnɔ. Kɔlɔsilikɛlaw minnu tɛ baara kɛ, olu bɛ ɲɛfɛla IP dɔrɔn de ye. Sonda dɔnni: nodew bɛ IP minnu ma yamaruya, olu nɔfɛ minnu bɛ `/api/*` gosi; dɛsɛ saba min kɛra miniti 5 kɔnɔ, o bɛ IP wuli ka taa "decoy mode" la — ko IP bɛ sisan HTML landing page static ye ni 200 OK ye. DGA: deterministic domain generator seeded ni bi don ye walasa kliyanw ka fallback sɔrɔ ni primaire bɛ bali.
stealth.h4_c: DoH daminɛna Firefox 2018 kɔnɔ ka kɛ Chrome ka default ye san 2019. ECH tɛmɛna draft duuru fɛ ka sɔrɔ ka standardization kɛ san 2024 — Vortex ye dɛmɛ ci draft-13 waati la ani sisan a bɛ spec laban dɛmɛ. Probe-response decoys juru tara meek ka san 2014 dilancogo la, ka nɔgɔya san 2023 Iran ka sonda baarakɛlaw kɛlen kɔ ka meek dɔn a ka jaabi waati fɛ.
stealth.h5_a: Layer 4 bɛ baara kɛ ni pluggable transports ye — mɔgɔ sabananw ka tunnels minnu bɛ i n’a fɔ fɛn wɛrɛ pewu.
stealth.h5_b: vmess/vless/trojan: V2Ray cogoya la, bɔli siratigɛ la; config JSON ye. Tiɲɛ: TLS-kɔnɔ-TLS tunnel yɔrɔ min na kɛnɛma bolonɔbila bɛ laɲini www.microsoft.com; kɔnɔna bolonɔbila ye Vortex ye. Sonde active minnu bɛ taa kɛnɛma, olu bɛ ci Microsoft ma, o la sonda tɛ foyi jira. Snowflake: navigatɔrɔw minnu bɛ u yɛrɛ di, olu bɛ Vortex lase WebRTC kan; infra si tɛ an fan fɛ. NaiveProxy: a bɛ HTTPS sonda caman sɛmɛntiya walasa u ka fara Chromium ka kɛwale tigitigi kan.
stealth.h5_c: V2Ray ka VMess Dabɔra 2015 sàn na Sinuwa jamana ka 'sènfɛ-jɛkulu fɛ. Trojan daminɛna san 2019. Tiɲɛ bɛ bɔ san 2022 la — jaabi ye Great Firewall ka TLS bolokɔfɛfɛnw dɔnni na. Snowflake ye Tor Project ka san 2020 nɔnabila ye obfs4 nɔ na; Vortex ye dɛmɛ Fàra v0.0.9 kan Iran ka 2023 sàn Tor dondaw bloki dafalen kɔfɛ.
stealth.h5_f:
tiɲɛ donta misali:
  baarakɛlaTɔgɔ: www.microsoft.com
  dest: www.microsoft.com: 443. Kalanjɛ ni sɛbɛnni: kalanjɛ ni sɛbɛnni gafew
  Ids surunw: ["<random>"]
kliyan bɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ an ka IP, SNI=www.microsoft.com, an bɛ proxy Microsoft jaabi lakika
ni sira bɛ bɛn shortId+auth ⇒ sira ma ka taa Vortex .
stealth.h6_a: Layɛrɛ 5 ye namara bɔrɔ laban ye : soja baara, BMP magan-ni-ɲɛfɛ, multi-hop relay, OHTTP.
stealth.h6_b: Node bɛɛ bɛ `.soja` ladɛrɛsi bɔ. Client minnu bɛ ni Tor-capable host ye, olu bɛ bin ka tɛmɛ ni TLS + L1-L4 bɛɛ dɛsɛra. BMP (Blind Mailbox Protocol): ciden bɛ blob sirilen dɔ fili node o node la min key bɛ kɛ ni `HKDF(recipient_pubkey, "bmp-v1")` ye; kumakanw bɛ jɛnsɛn; sɔrɔbaga bɛ sama ka bɔ u ka so node la. Multi-hop : cikanw bɛ pan ka tɛmɛ cɛmancɛ-node 5 fɛ, u kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ enveloppe layɛrɛ dɔ fara a kan — i n’a fɔ Tor nka an yɛrɛ ka mesh kɔnɔ. OHTTP (RFC 9458): oblivious HTTP ka tɛmɛn relay fɛ o la mɔgɔ kelen si tɛ ɲinini ni jaabi fila bɛɛ ye.
stealth.h6_c: Soja baara bɛ daminɛ san 2004 la Tor. BMP ye an yɛrɛ ka fɛn dilannen ye, min bɛ tali kɛ Tor ka baara ɲɛfɔli dogolen kumakan na. Multi-hop relay mirrors Signal ka sealed-sender ka fara soja sira kan. OHTTP bɔra san 2024 la, a dabɔra Cloudflare ni Apple fɛ telemetriki ka danbe lakanani kama; an y'a ta v0.0.9 kɔnɔ k'a kɛ fallback laban ye.
stealth.h6_f:
BMP lɛtɛrɛbɔlan_id = HKDF(sɛbɛnnikɛla_pk, "bmp-v1", 32)
Deposit: POST /bmp/deposit { lɛtɛrɛbɔlan_id, blob } .
Pickup: GET /bmp/cikanw (sɛbɛnni)
TTL: 7200 s |  Max blob: 1 MB |  Max per node: 500 MB ye .

bmp.title: Fiyentɔw ka lɛtɛrɛbɔlan Protocol
bmp.subtitle: Tɔgɔko magan-ni-fɔli cikanw kama kumakan-minɛnw fɛ.
bmp.intro: BMP bɛ ciden bila ka cikan bila node o node la k’a sɔrɔ a ma a yɛrɛ jira. Cikan bɛ kuma fo ka se a sɔrɔbaga ka so node ma, a bɛ decrypt kɛ yen i n’a fɔ a bɛ kɛ cogo min na.
bmp.h1p1: Cibaga bɛ `mailbox_id = HKDF(sɔrɔbaga_pubkey, kunnafoni: "bmp-v1", len: 32)` sɔrɔ. Ciden dɔrɔn (min bɛ recipient_pubkey dɔn) bɛ se k’a jatebɔ; sɔrɔbaga fana b' a dɔn.
bmp.h1p2: Ciden bɛ `POST /bmp/deposit` bila ni `{mailbox_id, blob}` ye ka taa kumakanfɔlan o yɔrɔ la.
bmp.h1p3: Node bɛ pari mara fo ka se s 7200 ma. Node fana bɛ mailbox_id don gossip round nata ka Bloom filɛri kɔnɔ.
bmp.h1p4: Node wɛrɛw bɛ blobs sama mailbox_ids kama u bɛ u janto minnu na sigida la (sɔrɔbagaw u ka node kan).
bmp.h1p5: Sɔrɔbaga ka kiliyan bɛ ɲininkali kɛ `GET /bmp/messages` la ani ka blob kura o kura decrypt ni a ka key material sabatilen ye.
bmp.h2p1: Node si tɛ se ka blob ni ciden cɛsiri — ciden ka TLS jɛɲɔgɔnya bɛ sɔrɔyɔrɔ IP jira, nka soja cakɛda dɔ bɛ wuli ciden ni BMP node fɔlɔ cɛ o fana bɛ o fana bɔ.
bmp.h2p2: Jaabi-dogo: blob bɛ siri ni sɔrɔbaga ka pubkey ye. Cɛmancɛ-yɔrɔw bɛ bayt sɛrɛkili opaque dɔrɔn de ye ani mailbox_id random.
bmp.h2p3: Jiginni dafalen tɛ cibaga ma. At-most-once kɔrɔko siratigɛ la.
bmp.h3p1: Blob hakɛ maksimali: 1 MB. Nafa belebelebaw ka kan ka tila ka tɛmɛn dosiyew bolicogo gansan fɛ.
bmp.h3p2: Max marali node kelen na: 500 MB deposits bɛɛ lajɛlen. LRU gɛnni ka bɔ kaso la cap. Operatɛriw bɛ se ka tune (fɔlikan) kɛ.
bmp.h3p3: Spam: per-IP wari bilalen hakɛ dan ye 10 / min. Mailbox ID minnu kɔlɔsira ka tɛmɛ siɲɛ 3 kan / lɛrɛ kɔnɔ node kelen kan, olu hakɛ dan ye i n’a fɔ sanjiba bɛ siga la.
bmp.h4: Baara kɛ ni ko kɛlenw ye
bmp.h4p1: Sensorship high-censorship sɔrɔbagaw : ciden mago t’a la ka sɔrɔbaga ka so node dɔn.
bmp.h4p2: Jɛɲɔgɔnya min bɛ kɛ waati ni waati : blobw bɛ makɔnɔ fo a sɔrɔbaga ka segin ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ ani ka wote kɛ.
bmp.h4p3: Tɔgɔko fɔli : ciden fan fɛ soja + BMP = metadata tɛ mɔgɔ min ye mun bila.
bmp.h1_a: BMP ye magan-ni-ɲɛnabɔ-yɔrɔ ye min tɔgɔ ma fɔ. Ciden bɛ blob dɔ fili node o node la min bɛ se ka kɛ ni kumakan ye; blob bɛ makɔnɔni kɛ lɛtɛrɛbɔlan dɔ kɔnɔ min sirilen bɛ a sɔrɔbaga ka foroba kilisi dɔrɔn de la.
bmp.h1_b: Ciden bɛ jatebɔ kɛ `mailbox_id = HKDF(sɔrɔbaga_pubkey, "bmp-v1", 32)`. Mɔgɔ min bɛ `recipient_pubkey` dɔn, o dɔrɔn de bɛ se k’a jate — a sɔrɔbaga b’a dɔn, ciden b’a dɔn, mɔgɔ sabanan t’a dɔn. Ciden bɛ POST `{mailbox_id, blob}` ci kumakanfɔla node o node ma. Node bɛ o fila in mara fo s 7200 (2 h), ka mailbox_id laseli kɛ kumakan falenfalen nata Bloom filɛri kɔnɔ. Node wɛrɛw minnu bɛ mailbox_id ye sigida la min bɛ bɛn baarakɛla dɔ ka mailbox cache ma, olu bɛ blob sama ka taa o baarakɛla ka kiliyan ma.
bmp.h1_c: BMP dabɔra ka bɔ fɛn fɔlɔ la Vortex jɛkulu fɛ. An y’a jɔ bawo cidenba si tun t’a fɛ ka nafolo musaka minnu ka kan ka kɛ walasa ka metadata dogo laban na ka taa a laban na — fɛn gɛlɛn bɛɛ tun bɛ kɔnɔkow sirili ci nka a tun bɛ lase yɔrɔ da wulilen to, o la, baarakɛla dɔ tun b’a dɔn hali bi jɔn bɛ kuma jɔn fɛ ani waati min na. Ekipu kɔnɔ an tora k'a fɔ ko "ciden lakananen min bɛ sosiyali graphique bɔ kɛnɛ kan, o lakananen tilancɛ dɔrɔn de don." BMP ye an ka jaabi ye : ciden, sɔrɔbaga, ani kɔnɔkow bɛɛ bɛ kɛ opaque ye; node kelen si tɛ mesh kɔnɔ min tɛ fɛn caman minɛ walasa ka baro dɔ labɛn kokura. A bɛ boli Vortex yɛrɛ ka kumakan fini kan sanni ka kɛ fɛnsɔrɔsiraw ye minnu sirilen don ni bololanɛgɛ ye, o de y’a to jago musaka bɛ bɛn ani a dilanni bɛ se ka jateminɛ a kɔnɔ.
bmp.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF(sɔrɔbaga_pubkey, kunnafoni="bmp-v1", len=32)

Deposit: POST /bmp/deposit {mailbox_id: 32B, blob: ≤1 MB}
Laseli: kumakan Bloom filɛri += mailbox_id
Pickup: GET /bmp/messages (auth'd) → blobs ka ɲɛsin baarakɛla ka mailbox_ids ma
TTL: 7200 s |  node kelen-kelen bɛɛ marali dakun: 500 MB |  wari bilalen hakɛ: 10/min/IP
bmp.h2_a: BMP bɛ danbe yɛrɛmahɔrɔnyalen saba di: ciden-dogo, sɔrɔbaga-dogo, kɔnɔkow dogo.
bmp.h2_b: Cibaga-dogo: TLS jɛɲɔgɔnya ni depositing node ye source IP jira; ka Tor hop walima cakɛda min bɛ sira kan ni soja ye, o fara BMP node fɔlɔ kan, o bɛ o bɔ. Jaabi-dogo: mailbox_id ye sira kelen hash ye recipient_pubkey kɔgɔlen ni BMP version string ye — cɛmancɛ node dɔ bɛ 32-byte identifier opaque ye. Kɔnɔkow dogocogo: blob bɛ E2E-encrypté kaban sɔrɔbaga ye ni Vortex room / DM keys gansanw ye, o la cɛmancɛ node bɛ ciphertext dɔrɔn de Ye.
bmp.h2_c: Nafolo saba-fɔcogo ye Pond y’a ka laɲiniw ɲɛfɔ cogo min na san 2014. Vortex y’a nɔgɔya k’a kɛ mailbox_id ye min bɛ se ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ (256-bit hash) walasa baarakɛla fila minnu ni ɲɔgɔn tɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ, olu kana se ka bataki-kɛsu tila bala la. Seginnkanni 7200 TTL bɛ bɔ kɔlɔsili la ko an ka beta kɔnɔ sɔrɔbaga 95 % ye sama 2 h kɔnɔ; a janya TTL fiyɛlen per-node mara la k’a sɔrɔ jiginni tɔnɔ kɔlɔsilen tɛ.
bmp.h2_f:
Kɛlɛɲɔgɔn min bɛ node cogoya ye:
  - b' a dɔn ko mailbox_id bɛ yen waati T
  - yala NOT bɛ ciden dɔn (was a TLS/Tor hop away) .
  - yala NOT bɛ sɔrɔbaga dɔn (mailbox_id ye sira kelen hash ye ) .
  - yala NOT bɛ kɔnɔkow dɔn (blob ye E2E-encrypted ye) .
bmp.h3_a: Dan gɛlɛn minnu bɛ blob hakɛ kan, node kelen-kelen marali, ani deposit rate kan, o b’a to BMP kana kɛ dead-drop ye data arbitralw kama.
bmp.h3_b: Blob hakɛ maksimali: 1 MB. Nafa belebelebaw ka kan ka chunk ka tɛmɛ file system gansan fɛ, min n’a yɛrɛ ka marayɔrɔ sira don. Max per-node marali: 500 MB bɛɛ lajɛlen BMP deposits. Ni cap sera, kɔrɔlen-fɔlɔ gɛnni bɛ blobw fili ka sɔrɔ u ka TTL — baarakɛlaw bɛ se ka ladilan `BMP_MAX_BYTES` env var. Deposit rate per IP: 10 per minute, walasa ka sanjiba kɛlɛ ka bɔ binkannikɛla kelen na. Lɛrɛbɔlan ID minnu kɔlɔsira ka tɛmɛ siɲɛ 3/lɛrɛ kɔnɔ ɛntɛrinɛti kan, olu hakɛ dantigɛlen don i n’a fɔ "sanjiba laɲini min bɛ siga la".
bmp.h3_c: 1 MB blob cap bɛ bɛn IRC DCC-cikan-cikanw ma ani Signal ka sealed-sender cap — a ka bon kosɛbɛ cikan surunw ni ja fitininw kama, a ka dɔgɔ fo binkannikɛla tɛ se ka baara kɛ ni BMP ye filew ladonni kama. 500 MB node kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye OSS-default sensible ye; baarakɛlabaw b'a kɔrɔta ni `BMP_MAX_BYTES` ye. Rate danw Nàna v0.0.8 beta kɔfɛ min na tester dɔ ka test script ye node 50 fa ni deposits ye miniti 20 kɔnɔ.
bmp.h3_f:
danw: 1 .
  BMP_BLOB_MAX_BYTES = 1_000_000 # 1 MB .
  BMP_NODE_MAX_BYTES = 500_000_000 # 500 MB .
  BMP_DEPOSIT_RATE = 10 # miniti kelen kɔnɔ IP kɔnɔ .
  BMP_FLOOD_THRESHOLD = 3 # lɛtɛrɛbɔlan_id kelen lɛrɛ kelen kɔnɔ
bmp.h4_a: BMP bɛ yeelen bɔ ko saba la : jatebɔba sɔrɔbagaw, jɛɲɔgɔnya waati ni waati, tɔgɔko fɔli.
bmp.h4_b: Sansɔrɔ-yɔrɔba : ciden tɛ sɔrɔbaga ka so node dɔn (wa n’a sɔrɔla a tɛ se ka se a ma cogo o cogo). Drop at any peer, a to kumakan sira. Jɛɲɔgɔnya min bɛ kɛ waati ni waati : a sɔrɔbaga tɛ ɛntɛrinɛti kan lɛrɛ caman kɔnɔ; blob bɛ makɔnɔni kɛ, segin-ka-bɔnye si mago tɛ. Tɔgɔko fɔli : ciden fan fɛ soja + BMP = metadata tɛ mɔgɔ min ye mun bila. Ni u farala ɲɔgɔn kan ni so konnɛgɛ ye min bɛ dɔn mɔgɔ dannamɔgɔ dɔrɔn de fɛ, a kɔnɔkow fana tɛ yeli kɛ fɛn minɛbaga si fɛ.
bmp.h4_c: Baarakɛcogo saba ninnu bɛ tariku dusudonw nɔfɛtaama ka ɲɛsin jiginɛ salenw ma farikolo sɛgɛsɛgɛli la (Soviyetiki waati), `alt.anonymous.messages` kan Usenet kan (1990w), ani SecureDrop (2013 ka taa a fɛ). BMP ye an ka cɛsiri ye k’o tariku lase bi ciden dɔ ma k’a sɔrɔ an ma baarakɛminɛn danfaralen dɔ wajibiya.

push.title: Push kunnafoniw
push.subtitle: APNw, FCM, Web Push — bɛɛ ni anwɛlɛkiw datugulen don walasa furakɛlikɛlaw kana se ka kalan kɛ.
push.intro: Push baarakɛminɛnw (APNs, FCM, Web Push) bɛ nafalan bɛɛ ye. Vortex bɛ kunnafoni kelen-kelen bɛɛ siri E2E layɛrɛ danfaralen na walasa dilanbaga ka blob opaque dɔrɔn de ye min kɔnɔ so id, ciden, walima sɛbɛnni tɛ.
push.h1p1: Client bɛ plateforme token sɔrɔ (APNs minɛn token, FCM tɔgɔsɛbɛnni id, walima Web Push abonné JWT).
push.h1p2: Client bɛ X25519 key `p256dh_pub` kura 32 bayt ani `auth` gundo 16 bɔ. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` ni `{dakun, p256dh, auth, plateforme}` ye.
push.h1p3: Node bɛ to ka kɛ `push_subscriptions(baarakɛla_id, labanyɔrɔ, p256dh, auth, plateforme, created_at)`.
push.h2p1: Ni kunnafoni dɔ ka kan ka kɛ (cikan kura min bɛ so dabilalen kɔnɔ min sigilen don ka ladɔnniya, fɔ, wele weleli), node bɛ nafalan siri ni AES-GCM ye ni kilisi ye min bɔra `ECDH(p256dh_pub, ephemeral_priv)` la HKDF fɛ.
push.h2p2: Node pakew `{endpoint, TTL, kɔrɔtɔko, barokun: <collapse_key>, data: <ciphertext>}` ani ka ci APNw ma / FCM / Web Push server.
push.h2p3: Ladilikɛla bɛ `donanw` (ciphertext) + `kunnafoni` dɔrɔn de ye. Sɛbɛn jɛlenw tɛ bɔli kɛ.
push.h3p1: So kelen-kelen bɛɛ barokun kunba: `so:<id>`. Cikan caman minnu bɛ so kelen kɔnɔ, olu bɛ bin ka kɛ kunnafoni kelen ye OS hakɛ la.
push.h3p2: Weele kelen-kelen bɛɛ barokun: `weleli:<id>`. Jaabi walima ban bɛ pankarti sama; wele kura weleli bɛ kɛ so kelen kɔnɔ ka kɔrɔlen bila a nɔ na.
push.h4p1: iOS: Notification Service Extension bɛ decrypt NSE baarakɛcogo la (a danfaralen don ni appli principal ye). A bɛ baara kɛ ni CryptoKit primitives kelenw ye.
push.h4p2: Android: FirebaseMessagingService bɛ decryption kɛ kɔkanna baarakɛyɔrɔ dɔ kɔnɔ. JobScheduler bɛ UI update yɛrɛ boloda ni app bɛ ɲɛfɛ.
push.h4p3: Web: Service Worker bɛ decryption kɛ SW kɔnɔ, ka sigida kunnafoni dɔ bila Web Notifications API fɛ.
push.h5p1: APNw : a bɛ ɲini ka furakɛlikɛla ka token lakurayali miniti 60 o miniti 60. Token kurayali bɛ kɛ otomatiki la Apple ka `auth-team-id` + `auth-key-id` + p8 key file fɛ.
push.h5p2: FCM: ciyɛn HTTP labanyɔrɔ min tɛ baara kɛ; an bɛ baara kɛ ni HTTP v1 labanyɔrɔ ye ni OAuth2 baarakɛyɔrɔ jatebɔsɛbɛn seereyaw ye. Yɛlɛma-yɛlɛma lɛrɛ 1 o lɛrɛ 1.
push.h5p3: Web Push: VAPID kilisi (kilisi fila kelen node kelen na). TTL dantigɛlen don tile 28 kɔnɔ navigatɔrɔ fanba fɛ.
push.h1_a: Client bɛ minɛn token (APNs/FCM/Web Push) sɛbɛn ɲɔgɔn fɛ ni X25519 foroba kilisi kura ye ani 16-byte auth secret.
push.h1_b: Client bɛ `p256dh_priv = rand(32)` ani `auth = rand(16)` labɔ. A bɛ bɔ `p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G` la. POSTw bɛ `/api/push/subscribe` kɛ ni `{endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, user_agent}` ye. Node bɛ to ka kɛ `push_subscriptions(baarakɛla_id, labanyɔrɔ, p256dh, auth, plateforme, dabɔ_yɔrɔ, laban_lasegin_yɔrɔ)`. Yɛlɛma : kiliyan bɛ segin ka abonné kɛ appli daminɛ bɛɛ la, o min bɛ `last_refreshed_at` lakurayali. Abonnés minnu si tɛmɛna tile 30 kan, olu bɛ saniya.
push.h1_c: p256dh + auth forow bɛ Bɔ Web Push RFC 8291 (2017) la. An ye baara kɛ n’u ye kokura APNw ni FCM kama hali n’o baarakɛminɛnw tɛ cogoya sirilen wajibiya — o kɛli bɛ kode sira kelen mara o saba bɛɛ kɔnɔ. Sani v0.0.5 Vortex ka nafamafɛnw ci ka tɛmɛn push services fɛ; Apple ka san 2022 push privacy update kɔfɛ ani ko wɛrɛ min kɛra, n’o ye FCM porozɛ dɔ labɛncogo jugu ye kunnafonidiw bɔ kɛnɛ kan, an ye fɛn bɛɛ bila anwɛlɛki datugulenw na.
push.h1_f:
p256dh_priv = ran (32) ye.
p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G // X25519 Bamako, Mali .
auth = ran(16) .

POST /api/push/abonnen kɛ
  { labanyɔrɔ, p256dh: hex(p256dh_pub), auth: hex(auth), plateforme }
push.h2_a: Ni kunnafoni dɔ ka kan ka kɛ, node bɛ nafalan siri walasa a sɔrɔbaga ka minɛn dɔrɔn de ka se k’a kalan. Puse baarakɛyɔrɔ (Apple / Google / Mozilla) bɛ blob opaque dɔrɔn de Ye.
push.h2_b: Node bɛ X25519 keypair dɔ ta min bɛ kɛ waati dɔɔnin kɔnɔ. A bɛ bɔ `ikm = ECDH(waati_taama_ni, p256dh_pub)`. A bɛ boli HKDF(kɔgɔ=auth, ikm, info="aesgcm", len=32) → kilisi. A bɛ `{title, body, room_id, message_id}` siri i n’a fɔ CBOR → AES-GCM ni key bɔlen + random 96-bit nonce ye. A bɛ `{ban, TTL, kɔrɔtɔko, barokun: collapse_key, data: ciphertext, aes128gcm: {kɔgɔ, pub_ephemeral}}` ci APNw/FCM/Web-Push ma. Minɛn bɛ sɔrɔ, extension / service baarakɛla bɛ o key derivation kelen in boli ka kɔsegin, ka decrypt, ka notification jira.
push.h2_c: Pusi min datugulen don, o ye Web Push Message Encryption spec ye k’a ɲɛsin san 2017 ma (RFC 8291 + RFC 8188). Apple ka san 2022 iOS 16 kurayali ye dɛmɛ fɔlɔ fara kunnafonidi baarakɛyɔrɔw janya kan minnu bɛ decryption kɛ; Android y’a Dɛmɛ FCM data cikanw fɛ kabini sàn caman. Vortex ye ciden damadɔw dɔ ye minnu bɛ flow dafalen waleya ni kode kelen ye plateforme saba bɛɛ kan — iOS bɛ baara kɛ ni `NotificationServiceExtension` ye, Android bɛ baara kɛ ni `FirebaseMessagingService` ye, Web bɛ baara kɛ ni service worker ye.
push.h2_f:
waati_dafalen_priv = rand (32);  waati_dafalen_pub = waati_dafalen_priv · G
ikm = ECDH(kɔrɔlen_koro, p256dh_pub)

push.h3_a: Collapse keys bɛ kunnafoni caman bali ka bɔ baro kelen na ka ɲɔgɔn dalajɛ i n’a fɔ pankarti kelen-kelenw — OS b’u fara ɲɔgɔn kan ka kɛ kelen ye.
push.h3_b: So kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka bin: barokun = `so:<id>`. APNw ka `apns-collapse-id` ani FCM ka `collapse_key` b'a fɔ OS ye ko u ka kunnafoni kɔrɔw bila barokun kelen nɔ na. Baarakɛla bɛ pankarti kelen ye so kelen kɔnɔ hali ni cikan hakɛ mana se. Weele kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka bin: barokun = `weleli:<id>`; weleli kura weleli minnu bɛ kɛ so kelen kɔnɔ, olu bɛ kɔrɔlenw bila u nɔ na. Per-mention: topic = `kofɔli:<baarakɛla>:<so>`; pankarti kelen kofɔ baarakɛla-so fila kelen-kelen bɛɛ la.
push.h3_c: Collapse keys Fàrala APNw kan iOS 10 (2016) kɔnɔ ani FCM la 2014. Sani o ka Kɛ, cikan caman pɛrɛnni ye pankarti caman-da-kuluw Bɔ minnu baarakɛlaw tùn bɛ minnu kɔniya cogo kelen na. Telegram ye so kelen-kelen bɛɛ binni daminɛ UX san 2015; cidenba bɛɛ tugura o kɔ. Vortex ka tilali so / weleli / kofɔli binkanni bɔra baarakɛlaw ka hakilinaw la v0.0.6 beta kɔnɔ ko "weleli weleli bɛ baro pankarti nɔ bila" o y'a ye ko a man ɲi — barokun danfaralenw y'a labɛn.
push.h3_f:
APNw: apns-collapse-id = room:42 → a bɛ pankarti kɔrɔw bila u nɔ na
FCM: collapse_key = call:17 → a bɛ pankarti kɔrɔw bila u nɔ na
Web: barokun = mention:u12:r5 → bɛ pankarti kɔrɔw bila u nɔ na
push.h4_a: Plateforme kelen-kelen bɛɛ n’a ka gotchas don. iOS mago bɛ Notification Service Extension la; Android mago bɛ FCM data cikanw na; Web mago bɛ baarakɛyɔrɔ baarakɛla + VAPID la.
push.h4_b: iOS: app bundle bɛ `NotificationServiceExtension` laɲini dɔ ci. Sistɛmu bɛ nafalan sirilen lase NSE ma; NSE bɛ ni s 30 ye CPU + 25 MB hakili la walasa ka kunnafoni in decrypt ani ka fɛn caman sɛmɛntiya sani a ka jira. FCM: an bɛ `data` cikanw ci (a tɛ `kɔlɔsili` ci) walasa appli ka FirebaseMessagingService ka baara kɛ an selen — o b’a to an bɛ se ka pankarti jira. Web Push: baarakɛla bɛ `push` ko kɛlenw minɛ, ka decrypt, jirali kɛ `self.registration.showNotification` fɛ.
push.h4_c: NSE misali in Dabɔra Apple fɛ iOS 10 (2016) kɔnɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la cikan-sɛbɛnni baarakɛcogo misaliw kama. Sani o ka Kɛ, ciden sirilenw laban-ni-dakun tùn ka kan ka sugandili Kɛ sɛbɛnni gansanw puse-nafabɔlanw (privacy-hostile) ni badge-only pushes (UX-juguya) cɛ. WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram bɛɛ ye pan ka don NSEw la san kelen kɔnɔ. Vortex bɛ tugu o cogo kelen na.
push.h5_a: Furakɛla kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ka quirks — push sapitiri yɔrɔ dɔ. Nin ye fɛɛrɛ jɔnjɔn dɔ ye min kofɔlen don Vortex ɲɛfɔli bɛɛ kɔnɔ. Sapitiri min bɛ a lamini na, o kalan walasa ka kunnafoni caman sɔrɔ; nin yɔrɔ in bɛ kɛwale kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bonya.
push.h5_b: Waleya lajɛba "Provider-specific quirks" kan. Fɛɛrɛ in bɛ waleya modulu bɛnnin kɔnɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, walima `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` jukɔrɔ. Module README bɛ file sira tigitigiw wele.
push.h5_c: "Provider-specific quirks" fɛɛrɛ in jiginna Vortex bɔliw kɔnɔ. O dilancogo bɛ tali kɛ ciden tɛmɛnenw ka ɲininiw ni u dilanni kɛcogo bɔlenw na. Version tariku min bɛ `CHANGELOG.md` kɔnɔ, o bɛ sɛbɛnni kɛ waati min na a yɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ jigira ani min y’a bila.

controller.title: Kontrɔla ka baarakɛyɔrɔ
controller.subtitle: Dafalen seereya, don sɔrɔli, kɛnɛya kɔlɔsili.
controller.intro: Kontrɔla ye Python taabolo danfaralen ye. A ka binkanni-yɔrɔ ka dɔgɔ (sira tan ni fila ɲɔgɔn) wa a ka dannaya bɛ siri Ed25519 foroba-kɔlɔsili kelen na min tobira kiliyanw kɔnɔ.
controller.h1p1: `GET /v1/integrity` — seereya jaabi. Schema: `{status, signed_by, trusted_pubkey, version, built_at, bɛnkan, bɛnbaliya, tununen, faralen, cikan}`.
controller.h1p2: `GET /v1/kɛnɛya` — ɲɛnamaya. Schema: `{status: "ok", version, pubkey, stats:{intɛrinɛti kan, sɔnna, bɛɛ lajɛlen}}`.
controller.h1p6: `GET /v1/dusukun tantanni/{pubkey}` — node ɲɛnamaya sɛgɛsɛgɛli. A bɛ Kɛ ni fédéral nodes ye walasa u tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni ka To kura ye.
controller.h1p7: `POST /v1/register` — node kura bɛ tali kɛ dannaya la. A bɛ admin ka sɔnni de wajibiya fo ni `AUTO_APPROVE=tiɲɛ`.
controller.h2p1: Filen manifeste: `INTEGRITY.sig.json`. Filen kelen-kelen bɛɛ BLAKE3 hash + Ed25519 bolonɔbila bɛ sɔrɔ a kɔnɔ.
controller.h2p2: Jɛnkulu: `python -m vortex_contrôleur.integrité.taamaʃyɛn_baarakɛminɛn`. A bɛ bɔli kilisi kalan ka bɔ `keys/release.key` la, ka taama jiri la, ka manifest sɛbɛn.
controller.h2p3: Sɛgɛsɛgɛli: controleur bɛ manifeste kalan daminɛ na ani ka a suma ni disiki ye. Daminɛ bɛ dɛsɛ kosɛbɛ ni bɛnbaliya ye.
controller.h3p1: Miirili bɛ baara kɛ ni controleur code kelen ye ni release key kelen ye min kopi kɛra a kan. Clients bɛ `signed_by` kelen ye filɛlikɛlanw cɛma — filɛlikɛlan nkalonma dɔncogo dɔ ye ka pubkeys suma ɲɔgɔn na.
controller.h3p2: DNSLink / SNS / IPFS bɛ taamasiyɛnw bɔ ka ɲɛsin filɛlikɛlan caman dɔ ma. Clients b’a ɲini ka kɛɲɛ ni fɔlɔfɔlɔ ye ni waati tɛmɛnenw ye.
controller.h3p3: `vortex.sol-mirror/` ɲɛbilasɛbɛn min bɛ nin repo in kɔnɔ, o ye trycloudflare filɛlikɛlan ye min labɛnnen don ka taa yiriwali kama.
controller.h1_a: Kontrɔla ka foroba API sanfɛla bɛ sira tan ni fila ɲɔgɔn bɔ. U bɛɛ ka dɔgɔ, u bɛɛ sinsinnen bɛ seereya ni don-URL sɔrɔli kan.
controller.h1_b: `/v1/integrity` — bolonɔ bilalen seereya jiralen. `/v1/kɛnɛya` — ɲɛnamaya + pubkey + stats. `/v1/entries` — donna URLw walasa ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ. `/v1/mirrors` — miirili ɲɛnabɔbagaw. `/v1/trusted_nodes` — federasɔn ɲɔgɔndanw. `/v1/heartbeat/{pubkey}` — node ɲɛnamaya sɛgɛsɛgɛli. `/v1/register` — node kura bɛ ɲini dannaya kama (admin ka sɔnni fo ni `AUTO_APPROVE=tiɲɛ`). O de don — ka laɲini ka dɔgɔya walasa ka binkanni yɔrɔ to a ka dɔgɔn.
controller.h1_c: O yɔrɔ fitinin dilanni bɛ kunnafoni sɔrɔ kɔlɔsili fɛ ko seereya taabolo bɛ kɛ laɲini ye min nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ ni kiliyanw y’u pinɛ a la. Kode fitinin = surface fitinin. Aw bɛ a suma ni node ye min sira 120+ bɛ yen; the controller has 12. O cogo kelen na: Debian ka apt-get bɛ da `Release.gpg` baarakɛcogo fitinin dɔ la min ni pakew ladonni tɛ kelen ye.
controller.h2_a: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool` bɛ taama sɔrɔyɔrɔ jiri la, ka dosiye bɛɛ hash, ka taamasiyɛn kɛ ni bɔli kilisi ye, ka `INTEGRITY.sig.json` sɛbɛn.
controller.h2_b: Baarakɛminɛn bɛ kalan `keys/release.key` (32-bayt Ed25519 privé key). Taama `vortex_controller/` + `app/` (filen gitignored tɛ a la). Filen kelen-kelen bɛɛ kama: `blake3(kɔnɔkow) → hash`. Builds manifest `{version, built_at, filenw: [{sira, sha256, bonya}]}`. Jatebɔ kɛ `kan_bayi = CBOR(manifest)`. Taamaʃyɛnw: `sig = Ed25519-Sign(bɔli_kilisi, kanon_bayiti)`. A bɛ sɛbɛnni kɛ `INTEGRITY.sig.json = {manifest, signed_by: pubkey, sig}`.
controller.h2_c: Manifesiti bolonɔbilalenw bɛ segin Debian ka Release.gpg (1997) ani PGP-bolonɔbilalen Linux kernel tarballs kan. Sigstore (2021) ye modɛli nɔgɔya ka ɲɛsin fɛnw dilancogo seereya ma. Vortex ka bɔko ka nɔgɔn kosɛbɛ bawo a bɛ seereya kɛ baarakɛcogo kelen na, a tɛ bɔli cakɛda ye min bɛ kɛ mɔgɔ caman fɛ. An bɛ se ka Sigstore ta v0.4 kɔnɔ foroba bɔli kama.
controller.h3_a: Miirili bɛ baara kɛ ni controleur code kelen ye ni release key kelen ye. DNS / SNS / IPFS donna caman bɛ miirili caman dɔ jira.
controller.h3_b: Baarakɛlaw bɛ N filɛlikɛlanw sigi sen kan (a ka c’a la 3-5). U kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ `vortex_controller` kode kelen baara ni `keys/release.key` kelen ye. Clients bɛ `signed_by` kelen ye filɛlikɛlanw cɛma — hakili sɛgɛsɛgɛli ɲuman. DNS/SNS/IPFS sɛbɛnw bɛ filɛlikɛlanw jira ni fɔlɔfɔlɔ kow ye. Clients b’a ɲini ka kɛɲɛ ni fɔlɔfɔlɔ ye, ni segin 7 waati tɛmɛnen ye a ɲinini kelen-kelen bɛɛ la. `vortex.sol-mirror/` ɲɛbilasɛbɛn min bɛ nin repo in kɔnɔ, o ye trycloudflare miirili misali ye min bɛ kɛ ka kɔn a ɲɛ.
controller.h3_c: Miirili caman ni fɔlɔfɔlɔ ɲinini ye misali kelen ye SMTP bɛ baara kɛ ni min ye MX sɛbɛnniw na ani HTTPS bɛ baara kɛ ni SRV sɛbɛnniw ye. Tor ka kunnafonisɛbɛn ɲɛmɔgɔw ye modeli ye min bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na — 9 hardcoded DAs + votes. Vortex ye "pick a mirror that works" sugandi ka tɛmɛ "quorum vote" kan bawo wote siratigɛ la dilanw bɛ se ka muɲu kosɛbɛ nka u bɛ teliya kosɛbɛ ka bootstrap kɛ.
controller.h1_f:
/v1/dafalen : GET → seereya jaabi
/v1/kɛnɛya : GET → {status, version, pubkey, statis}
/v1/sɛbɛnw : GET → [{protocol, url}, ...]
/v1/miroirs : GET → [kɔlɔsilikɛla_url, ...]
/v1/daŋaniya_yɔrɔw : GET → [{pubkey, labanyɔrɔ, kɛnɛya}, ...]
/v1/dusukun tantanni/{pk} : POST (ka bɔ node sɛbɛnnenw dɔrɔn de la)
/v1/register : POST (ka ɲɛsin node kura ma) .
controller.h2_f:
baarakɛminɛn = taamasiyɛn_baarakɛminɛn
donna = sɔrɔyɔrɔ jiri, kilisi/release.key
manifest = { .
  a bɔcogo: "0.1.0",

storage.title: Layɛrɛ min bɛ mara
storage.subtitle: SQLite ye dev ye, Postgres ye prod ye, Alembic ye migrations ye, GRDB/Room/IndexedDB ye kliyanw kan.
storage.intro: Vortex ka node marayɔrɔ ye SQL ye. SQLite (dev) ni Postgres (prod) cɛ ʃyɛnta ye DATABASE_URL caman cili ye — kode foroko si tɛ yen.

storage.h1p2: `baarakɛla_minɛnw(id, baarakɛla_id, minɛn_id, baarakɛla_ciden, laban_yelen_waati, revoked_at)` — minɛn kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka sigida jirisunw.

storage.h2p1: Alembic min bɛ `alembic/versions/` kɔnɔ. Tariku sinsinni, seginnkanni kelen bɔko kelen-kelen bɛɛ la (tuma dɔw la, dɔw bɛ kɛ bɔko kelen-kelen bɛɛ la).
storage.h2p2: Dev mode: `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` walasa ka segin teliya la.
storage.h2p3: Prod mode: `alembic upgrade head` ka sɔrɔ ka daminɛ. Docker ja b’a boli dondaw la.
storage.h3p1: `messages(room_id, id DESC)` — index fɔlɔ min bɛ kɛ ka ɲɛw ta.
storage.h3p2: `messages(room_id, sent_at DESC)` — ka ɲɛsin waati-dafalen sigicogo ma sɛgɛsɛgɛli kan.
storage.h3p3: `reactions(message_id)` — ka ɲɛsin ɲɔgɔn ma so da wulilen kan.
storage.h3p4: `read_receipts(room_id, message_id)` — ka ɲɛsin `min ye N` ɲininiw fɛ.
storage.h3p5: `user_devices(user_id)` — walasa ka minɛnw lisɛli kɛ minnu bɛ baara la.
storage.h3p6: FTS tabali lakika (FTS5 SQLite / tsvector Postgres) sɛbɛnni dafalen ɲinini kama.
storage.h4p1: `make db-backup` bɛ waati taamasiyɛn sɛbɛnnen dɔ bɔ. Encrypté la lafiɲɛbɔ la ni operateur key ye.
storage.h4p2: A marali : don o don tile 14 kɔnɔ, dɔgɔkun o dɔgɔkun dɔgɔkun 4 kɔnɔ, kalo o kalo kalo 12 kɔnɔ.
storage.h4p3: Segin-ka-bɔnye: `ka db-segin FILE=<sira>` kɛ. Boli bɛ kɛ staging DB kan fɔlɔ; operator bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ o kɔfɛ swaps.
storage.h1_a: Node marali ye SQL ye. SQLite for dev ani misɛnninw yɛrɛ-jatigila; PostgreSQL ka ɲɛsin federasɔn walima node caman dilanni ma. SQLAlchemy 2.x async code kelen bɛ o fila bɛɛ boli.
storage.h1_b: Labɛnni kɛ `DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///vortex.db` walima `postgresql+asyncpg://baarakɛla:pw@host/db` fɛ. Configuration kelen, kode foroko tɛ. SQLite bɛ baara kɛ ni baarakɛcogo ye; Postgres bɛ boli a danma. Baarakɛcogo: SQLite bɛ ~50 baarakɛlaw minɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ cogo lafiyalen na M1 kan; Postgres bɛ balansi kɛ ka se ba caman ma. Migration Postgres → SQLite ye sira kelen ye `pg_dump --data-only` fɛ + SQLite import; sira tɔ kelen in ye kelen ye.
storage.h1_c: "kelen ORM, kɔfɛla fila" misali ye SQLAlchemy wale ye min bɛ kɛ san tan kɔnɔ. Vortex bɛ baara Kɛ ni async 2.x API ye o la ɲininkali bɛɛ bɛ makɔnɔni na. An ye SQLAlchemy Core ta Django ORM / Tortoise ORM / raw `asyncpg` kan ka ɲɛsin jiginni maana nafama ma ani ka bɛn FastAPI ka async idioms ma.
storage.h2_a: 18 tabali jɔnjɔnw : baarakɛlaw, baarakɛla_minɛnw, sow, so_mɔgɔw, cikanw, waleyaw, dosiyew, kalan_sɔrɔliw, sɔrɔli, federasiyɔnw, federasɔn_bɔyɔrɔ, cikan_waati bolodalenw, ɲɔgɔnyew, saved_gifs, foli, bot_installations, sessions, push_subscriptions.
storage.h2_b: Baarakɛlaw ka tabali ye danyɔrɔ ju ye. so_members holds (so, baarakɛla, jɔyɔrɔ, joined_at, muted_until). cikanw bɛ ciphertext + metadata ta; indexed on (room_id, id) ka ɲɛsin ɲɛw tacogo ma. reactions ye tabali ye min bɛ kɛ ka fɛnw fara ɲɔgɔn kan. Fɛn tɔw bɛɛ ye tilennen ye. Ladonni bɛ bonya ka kɛɲɛ ni cikan jate ye — a bɛ se ka kɛ 1 KB ye cikan kelen na disiki kan index overhead kɔfɛ.
storage.h2_c: Skema in tun sabatilen don v0.0.4 kɔfɛ. Fɔlɔ an tun bɛ ni `dm_messages` ni `group_messages` tabali danfaralenw ye; faralen ɲɔgɔn kan v0.0.3 kɔnɔ fanout kode duplicate kɔfɛ u fila bɛɛ kɔnɔ. Tabali 18 ye fɛn fitinin ye min bɛ kɛ ciden dafalen na; baarakɛcogo belebelebaw bɛ jateminɛ tabali fara a kan nka o mago tɛ baarakɛcogo la.
storage.h3_a: Alembic bɛ mɔgɔw ka jiginniw ɲɛnabɔ. Liniyɛri seginnkanni tariku, seginkanni kelen bɔko kelen-kelen bɛɛ la. Seginkanni bɛɛ bɛ ni `upgrade()` ni `downgrade()` baarakɛcogo fila bɛɛ ye.
storage.h3_b: `alembic/versions/` bɛ seginnkanniw minɛ. U kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye Python file ye min bɛ ni sɛgɛsɛgɛli/jiginni ye. CI bɛ boli `alembic upgrade head` + `alembic downgrade -1` + `alembic upgrade head` ka taa-ni-segin sɛgɛsɛgɛ. Fɛn dilanni: `make db-migrate` bɛ baara kɛ Docker dondaw la sanni app ka daminɛ. Dev mode bɛ baara Kɛ ni `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` ye o la iterasiyɔn bɛ teliya k'a sɔrɔ a ma mago ɲɛ 'kɔnɔnafiliw la rebase bɛɛ kan.
storage.h3_c: Alembic (Michael Bayer, 2011) ye SQLAlchemy jiginni baarakɛminɛn kanon ye. Tariku sinsinni (a tɛ bolofara ye) ye sugandili ye — a bɛ a yɛrɛ tanga "dabɔbaa fila bɛ seginnkanni nimɔrɔ kelen dilan" gɛlɛya ma. Django ka jiginniw bɛ baara kɛ ni o fɛɛrɛ kelen ye. Rails bɔra linear la ka taa waati taamasiyɛn na san 2014 nka a seginna ka linear-with-merge ta san 2020.
storage.h4_a: Index key bɛ ta ka ɲɛ walasa kalan dumanw (cikanw, jaabiw, kalan sɔrɔlenw) ka disiki gosi man teli.
storage.h4_b: `cikanw(so_id, id DESC)` — ɲɛcisɛbɛn fɔlɔ. `messages(room_id, sent_at DESC)` — waati-dafalen kɔsegin kɔseginw kama. `reactions(message_id)` — farali kan so da wulilen. `kalan_sɛbɛnw(so_id, cikan_id)` — "a ye N fɛ" jate. `baarakɛla_minɛnw(baarakɛla_id)` — minɛnw lisɛli. FTS tabali virtuelw ɲinini kama (FTS5 SQLite kan, tsvector Postgres kan).
storage.h4_c: Index sugandili bɔra explain-plan-profiling la v0.0.4 doni sɛgɛsɛgɛli waati la. An y’a daminɛ ni index naïfw ye ka fara/bɔ ka da ɲininkali kɛcogo kɔlɔsilenw kan. `messages(room_id, id DESC)` ye index kelen ye min ka di kosɛbɛ — kalansen 80 % ɲɔgɔn b’a gosi. Ni i y’a to a ka surun (no include columns) o b’a to a bɛ don hakili la.

bots.title: Bot karamɔgɔya
bots.subtitle: Gravitix DSL + Python SDK + sugu + antispam.
bots.intro: Botiw ye so fɔlɔ senfɛmɔgɔw ye. Cikanw bɛ bolonɔ bila ni bot dɔ ka Ed25519 kilisi ye walasa nkalontigɛw ka se ka dɔn.
bots.h1p1: Sugandili fila: Python SDK walima Gravitix DSL. Python ye baarakɛcogo gɛlɛnw de kama; Gravitix ka ɲɛsin ko kɛlenw-driven chat bots ma minnu ka kan ka ci joona.
bots.h1p2:
Python misali: `ka bɔ vortex_bot la import Bot
bot = Bot(token=...)
@bot.on_message
async def echo(msg): bot.ci(msg.room_id, msg.text) makɔnɔ
bot.run()`. SDK bɛ WebSocket, ɲɔgɔndan kokura, kodɔn kilisi ɲɔgɔn falen-falen ɲɛnabɔ.
bots.h1p3: Gravitix misali: `on /start { emit "Bonjour, {ctx.tɔgɔ_fɔlɔ}!" }`. A bɛ dalajɛ ka kɛ baytkode ye ani a bɛ boli sandboxed interpreter kɔnɔ.
bots.h1p4: Bot token bɛ Bɔ bot dabɔli waati. Token tununna wa? `POST /api/bots/{id}/rotate-token` bɛ kura bɔ.
bots.h2p1: Baarakɛcogo misali fila: in-process (coroutine inside the node) ani external (bot polls `/api/bots/{id}/updates`).
bots.h2p2: In-process: zero network hop, teliya la, nka baarakɛla ka kan ka da bot code la. Good ye yɛrɛ ka botw ye.
bots.h2p3: Kɛnɛma: webhook walima long-poll. Node-level dannaya si mago tun tɛ. Good ka ɲɛsin mɔgɔ sabananw ka botw ma ani sugu la.
bots.h2p4: Gravitix botw bɛ baara kɛ tuma bɛɛ in-process kɔnɔ sandbox kɔnɔ — u tɛ filesystem walima network sɔrɔ fo API jɛlen.
bots.h3p1: Foroba botw bɛ se ka u yɛrɛ di sugu la. Seginkannikɛlaw b’a sɛgɛsɛgɛ ko kode tɛ phish kɛ, a tɛ spam kɛ, a tɛ baarakɛlaw ka kunnafoniw bɔ kɛnɛ kan.
bots.h3p2: Jateblaw: nafa sɔrɔli, tulonw, kibaruyaw, nafamafɛnw, ai, bamanankan baarakɛcogo.
bots.h3p3: Install: digi kelen. Node bɛ baarakɛla tɔgɔ sɛbɛn bot ka baarakɛla tɔgɔ la walasa DMw ka sira ɲuman don.
bots.h3p4: Wari sɔrɔli : fu, sanni siɲɛ kelen, abonné. Plateforme sara 10 %% ka bɔ brut la.
bots.h4p1: So bɛɛ bɛ kɔlɔsi ni antispam bot yebali ye. Sɛgɛsɛgɛliw : jɛgɛnsira density > 3 miniti kelen kɔnɔ, sɛbɛnni belebelew hakɛ > 70 %% ye 10+ taamasiyɛnw na, cikan segin-seginw, jatebɔsɛbɛn kura-joginbagaw ka barika bɔli barikama.
bots.h4p2: Waleya minnu bɛ kɛ: lasɔmini → waati tɛmɛnen (miniti 5) → kick → ban. Appelw bɛ taa so admin fɛ.
bots.h1_a: Botiw ye so fɔlɔ senfɛmɔgɔw ye. U kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ ni Ed25519 kilisi ni token ye; u bɛ cikan o cikan ci, o bɛ bolonɔ bila, o la, nkalontigɛw bɛ se ka dɔn.
bots.h1_b: Dabɔ: tigi POSTs `/api/bots` ni `{baarakɛla tɔgɔ, jirali_tɔgɔ, kode}`. Node bɛ `users` row da ni `is_bot=true` ye, ka Ed25519 keypair dilan, ka private-key bot token segin a tigi ma (a jiralen don siɲɛ kelen). Run: bot bɛ balo in-process i n'a fɔ coroutine walima kɛnɛma polls `/api/bots/{id}/updates` n'a token. Cikan minnu bɛ bɔ botw fɛ, olu bɛ `from_bot: true` darapo ta ani u bɛ bolonɔ bila ni bot ka dankan kilisi ye.
bots.h1_c: Bot APIw daminɛna Slack fɛ (2014) ani u nɔgɔyara Telegram fɛ (2015). Vortex ka tigɛli : bot bolonɔbila bɛ cikanw siri bot danyɔrɔ la, o la node min bɛ bɔnɛ a la, o ma se ka "@bot ko X" dilan. Matrix ka bot dɛmɛni ye nin nafolo in fara a kan san 2021 federasɔn bolonɔbilaw fɛ; Vortex b'a sɔrɔ kabini v0.0.5.
bots.h2_a: Gravitix ye kan ye min bɛ Kɛ domani kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen na walasa ka botiw sɛbɛnni Kɛ minnu bɛ Kɛ ni ko kɛlenw ye. Misɛnninw, minnu bɛ ɲɛfɔli kɛ, minnu lajɛlen don ka kɛ sandboxed bytecode ye.
bots.h2_b: Daɲɛgafe: `on /start { emit "Bonjour, {ctx.tɔgɔ_fɔlɔ}!" }`. Handlers bɛ siri triggers (cikan, regex, event) la. Farikolo ye `emit`, `let`, `if`, `schedule`, wdfl sinsinni ye Compiler bɛ baytecode bɔ; runtime bɛ kɔrɔfɔ sandbox kɔnɔ min kɔnɔ filesystem tɛ, réseau arbitraire tɛ, Vortex ta API dɔrɔn. A ɲɛfɔli dafalen bɛ Gravitix docs tilayɔrɔba kɔnɔ.
bots.h2_c: Gravitix dabɔra v0.0.6 waati la k’a kɔlɔsi ko bot code fanba tun ye 80 % boilerplate ye walasa ka Vortex SDK wire up, ni kernel of actual logic ye cɛmancɛ la. A DSL bɛ hakilinata bila ka yeelen bɔ ani ka Python diyagoyalen sɔgɔli bali ka don bot-dev sigida la, cɛncɛn bolicogo bɛ se ka kɛ yɔrɔ min na.
bots.h3_a: So bɛɛ kɔnɔ, antispam bot yebali dɔ bɛ yen min bɛ sanjiba, link spam, cikan segin-segin, ani account kura join bursts kɔlɔsi.
bots.h3_b: Sariyaw : jɛgɛnsira density > 3 miniti kelen kɔnɔ ka bɔ baarakɛla kelen fɛ, ALL-CAPS hakɛ > 70 % cikanw kan ≥ 10 chars, cikan seginni > siɲɛ 3 s 30 kɔnɔ, jɛɲɔgɔnyakɛlaw ka pɛrɛn ni jatebɔ si hakɛ < 24 h > 20 ye s 60 kɔnɔ. Waleya bɛ bonya: lasɔmini → miniti 5 waati dafalen → Lɛrɛ 1 kick → ban (admin ka sɔnni ban). Tuneable per-room via `/antispam config`.
bots.h3_c: Antispam heuristics bɛ bɔ IRC-era bot sariyaw (Eggdrop, BitchX) ani bi sistɛmuw i n’a fɔ Discord AutoMod, olu faralen ɲɔgɔn kan. Dakun kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen minnu bɛ Vortex kɔnɔ, olu tun bɛ labɛn ka kɛɲɛ ni kalo 6 beta-kɔripu ye min kɔnɔ cikan 200k bɛ sɔrɔ; nkalon-pozitif hakɛ ye ~0,3 % ye ban-appel hakɛ kɔlɔsilen kelen-kelen bɛɛ la.
bots.h4_a: Foroba botw bɛ u yɛrɛ di sugu la. Seginkannikɛlaw bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ ko phishing tɛ / spam tɛ / data leak si tɛ. Baarakɛlaw bɛ ɲinini Kɛ ka Kɛɲɛ ni kuluw ye k'u Dabɔ ni digi kelen ye.
bots.h4_b: Submission: tigi bɛ bot source + ɲɛfɔli sɛbɛn. Seginkannikɛla bɛ kode in baara sandbox kɔnɔ, k’a kalan anti-patterns dɔntaw kama, ka réseau weleli fɛn o fɛn bɛ tɛmɛ API siralenw fɛ, a bɛ o lajɛ, ka danbe sariyaw sɛgɛsɛgɛ. Lisiti: kulu, sɔngɔ, jatebɔ, install jate. Install: `POST /api/bots/{id}/install` — node bɛ baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka abonnés da. Wari sɔrɔli : fu / siɲɛ kelen / abonné; plateforme bɛ 10 % ta.
bots.h4_c: App suguw bɛ segin ka taa san 2008 App Store la. Slack App Directory (2015), Discord Bot Listings (2017), Telegram Bot Store (2024) Kalanjɛ ni sɛbɛnni: kalanjɛ ni sɛbɛnni gafew. Vortex ka 10 % tigɛlen ka dɔgɔ ni Apple ka 30 % ye, wa a ka dɔgɔ dɔɔnin ka tɛmɛ Shopify ka 20 % kan, o sugandira walasa ka dusu don baarakɛlaw kɔnɔ u ka sɛbɛnw bɔ. Seginkanni sariya in bɛ tali kɛ GitLab ka "seginkanni ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye, ka bɔ lisi kan ɲininkali kan".

kan /daminɛ { .

ops.title: Baarakɛcogo
ops.subtitle: Deploy, monitor, rollback (kɔlɔsili, kɔsegin).
ops.intro: Baarakɛcogo bɛɛ bɛ ni `make` laɲini ye walima CLI cikan. Ops ɲɛw bɛ balo `deploy/` kɔnɔ.
ops.h1p1: `docker compose up` bɛ na ni node, controleur, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy ye.
ops.h1p2: Volumes: `/donanw/vortex.db`, ​​`/donanw/daɲɛw`, `/donanw/logs`. Yɛlɛma ka jatigila sɔrɔ walasa ka timinandiya.
ops.h1p3: Lamini: `.env` in repo root. Aw kana aw yɛrɛ bila abada. `.env.example` ye misali ye.
ops.h1p4: Caddy bɛ auto-fetches Let's Encrypt certs (sɛbɛnw) sɔrɔ. Let's Encrypt hakɛ dantigɛli bɛ kɛ — baara kɛ ni staging ye walasa ka kɔrɔbɔliw kɛ.
ops.h2p1: `make install` — Python deps + dev baarakɛminɛnw sigi.
ops.h2p2: `make dev` — uvicorn ni reload ye port 9000 kan.
ops.h2p4: `ka lint kɛ` — ruff + mypy. CI bɛ blokiw kɛ dɛsɛw kan.
ops.h2p5: `make docker-build` — jɔ ja min tɔgɔ ye ko `vortex:<VERSION>`.
ops.h2p8: `make ci` — ka CI pibiliki dafalen boli sigida la.
ops.h3p1: `Vortex Wizard.app` ye PyInstaller bεε ye ni pywebview GUI ye.
ops.h3p2: Fɔlɔ bolicogo : node tɔgɔ sugandi → bɔli kilisiw lawuli → TLS labɛn (Let's Encrypt / na-i-yɛrɛ-yɛrɛ / yɛrɛ-bolonɔbila) → donna URLw ta → sonyali daminɛ → tasuma-fanga-yɔrɔw da wuli.
ops.h3p3: Setup kɔfɛ, wizard bɛ to i n’a fɔ admin console: start/stop node, logs lajɛ, keys wuli, federated peers fara a kan.
ops.h4p1: Bɔko bɛɛ bɛ taamasiyɛn Kɛ git la. Tag fana bolonɔ bilala ni release key ye walasa tag yɛrɛ ka se ka sɛgɛsɛgɛ.
ops.h4p2: Rollback: `git jatebɔ <tag> && ka docker-build && docker compose up -d` kɛ. Nodes bolilenw bɛ ji bɔ ani ka daminɛ kokura.
ops.h4p3: DB: Alembic `downgrade <rev>` dɛmɛna ka ɲɛsin version fitinin kelen ma kɔfɛ. Ka segin kɔfɛ, o bɛ bololabaara de wajibiya.
ops.h1_a: `docker compose up` bɛ na ni Vortex kulu dafalen ye: node, controleur, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1_b: `docker-compose.yml` ka repo root la. Volumes `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/uploads`, `/data/logs` bɛ wuli ka don jatigila la walasa kunnafoniw ka to sen na daminɛ kura bɛɛ kɔnɔ. Kɛnɛya sɛgɛsɛgɛliw: node kɛnɛya iff `/kɛnɛya/labɛn` bɛ segin 200; controller iff `/v1/integrity` seginniw sɛgɛsɛgɛra. Caddy bɛ auto-fetches Let's Encrypt certs (sɛbɛnw) sɔrɔ. `.env` bɛ gundo di (aw kana kɛ abada). `.env.example` ye misali ye.
ops.h1_c: Docker Compose ye de-facto misali ye min bɛ kɛ ni baarakɛminɛn caman ye minnu bɛ u yɛrɛ ladon. Umami, Ghost, Plausible, Miniflux bɛɛ bɛ baara Kɛ n'a ye. Vortex ka compose file in seginna ka daminɛ v0.0.2 la ka taa a fɛ; sisan cogoya sabatira v0.0.5 kɔnɔ. Fɛn wɛrɛw (k8s, nomad) bɛ To i n’a fɔ degeliw baarakɛlabaw fɛ.
ops.h2_a: Makefile ye cɛmancɛ dondaw ye dev ni ops wale bɛɛ la. `make help` bɛ laɲiniw jate.
ops.h2_b: `make install` → `pip install -r wajibiyalenw.txt`. `make dev` → uvicorn ni reload ye. `make test` → pytest + coverage, bɔli `dafalen.xml`. `ka lint dilan` → ruff + mypy. `ka docker-build kɛ` → `docker jɔli -t vortex:$VERSION`. `make db-migrate` → `alembic sɛgɛsɛgɛli kunkolo`. `db-backup kɛ` / `db-segin kɛ FILE=...`. `make ci` → dafalen CI pibiliki sigida la.
ops.h2_c: Makefile dɔ i n’a fɔ dondaw kanon ye Unix wale ye min bɛ san tan caman bɔ, min bɛ ta Python porozɛba bɛɛ fɛ (pytest, django, flask, fastapi). Baarakɛminɛn wɛrɛw (Poyi, Hatch, uv) ye san-dafa-dafalen ye; Make ye sɛgɛn ye ani min bɛ diɲɛ bɛɛ ta.
ops.h3_a: Setup wizard ye PyInstaller bundle ye (`Vortex Wizard.app`) ni pywebview GUI ye min bɛ taamakɛla siɲɛ fɔlɔ baarakɛla dɔ taama a bilali fɛ.
ops.h3_b: Fɔlɔ bolicogo : node tɔgɔ sugandi → bɔli kilisiw lawuli (Ed25519 kilisi fila maralen bɛ `keys/release.key` kɔnɔ) → TLS labɛn (Let's Encrypt / bring-your-own / self-signed) → donna URLw ta (vortexx.sol / custom domain / .onion) → ka stealth level daminɛ → firewall ports da wuli (iptables/ufw/pf) ye. Boli fɔlɔ kɔfɛ, wizard bɛ to i n’a fɔ admin console: daminɛ/dabila node, logs lajɛ, keys wuli, federated peers fara a kan.
ops.h3_c: Setup wizards ye misali ye min bɛ kɛ baarakɛminɛnw ye minnu bɛ u yɛrɛ ladon minnu bɛ baarakɛlaw laɲini minnu tɛ sysadmin ye: Ghost ka onboarding (2015), Standard Notes ka server setup, Mastodon ka installation questions. PyInstaller b’a to an ka binary kelen ci min bɛ se ka digi siɲɛ fila; pywebview bɛ sigida HTML ɲɛ dɔ jira min bɛ baara kɛ FastAPI ɲɛmɔgɔ API kulu dɔ fɛ 127.0.0.1 — navigatɔrɔ UX k’a sɔrɔ a ma gɛlɛya ka sɔrɔ ka GUI dugutigi jɔ.
ops.h4_a: Bɔko bɛɛ bɛ Taama git la. Rollback ye `git checkout <tag> && kɛ docker-build && docker compose up -d` ye. Migrations bɛ ni `downgrade()` baarakɛcogo ye.
ops.h4_b: Tagw bɛ bolonɔ bila ni bɔli kilisi ye walasa tag yɛrɛ ka se ka sɛgɛsɛgɛ. Rollback taabolo : ka tag kɔrɔ lajɛ, ka ja jɔ kokura, ka minɛnw da kokura — boli jɛɲɔgɔnyaw bɛ ji bɔ SIGTERM kan (default 15 s grace). DB: `alembic downgrade <rev>` bɛ seginkanni kelen kɔsegin. Donanw bɔnɛni kɔlɔsili : an tɛ kuluw fili abada bɔko kelen kɔnɔ; jiginɛw bɛ kɛ N+1 kɔfɛ kode ye u kalanni dabila.
ops.h4_c: "Kode-o kɔfɛ-kode" jiginni cogoya (expand-migrate-contract) ye sariya ye zeru-dabila waati baarakɛcogo la. Stripe ka jiginni gafe (2019) b’a ɲɛfɔ ka ɲɛ. Vortex y’a ta ko dɔ kɔfɛ v0.0.3 kɔnɔ yɔrɔ min na kolon dɔ binna ka miniti 30 ladonni finɛtiri wajibiya.

  → a bɛ kilisiw lawuli, ka .env sɛbɛn, ka jiginni fɔlɔ kɛ

mobile.title: Mobili kliyanw
mobile.subtitle: iOS ani Android — native UI, protocol kelen.
mobile.intro: Mobili kliyan fila bɛɛ ye ɲɔgɔn dafalenw ye, u tɛ web wrappers finmanw ye. Native look, native performance, native integrations (CallKit, ConnectionService, Lock Screen wideyow).
mobile.h1p1: Swift Package min bɛ `ios/Modules/` kɔnɔ. 30+ fɛnɲɛnamafagalanw, kelen-kelen bɛɛ SOLID-tilalen `api/` + `impl/` + `ui/`.
mobile.h1p2: App laɲini ye `ios/VortexApp/` kɔnɔ. XcodeGen spec min bɛ `ios/project.yml` la, o bɛ xcodeproj labɛn kokura.
mobile.h1p3: Kripto: KriptoKit (X25519, Ed25519, AES-GCM, HKDF) + Argon2Swift (Argon2id) ye fɛn ye min bɛ se ka kɛ.
mobile.h1p4: DB: GRDB + FTS5. Yɛlɛma bɛɛ bɛ tɛmɛ `db.write` fɛ.
mobile.h1p6: Push: APNw bɛ tɛmɛ `UNUserNotificationCenter` fɛ + Ladɔnniyali Baarakɛyɔrɔ Janya walasa ka decryption kɛ.
mobile.h2p1: Gradle porozɛ min bɛ `android/` kɔnɔ. 22 feature modules ni Hilt DI, kelen `api / impl / di / ui` tilalen.
mobile.h2p4: DB: So min bɛ ni FTS4 wulilanw ye.
mobile.h2p6: Push: FCM + FirebaseMessagingService ka ɲɛfɔli kɛ.
mobile.h3p1: O yɔrɔ 146-bundle kelen in ni jamana tɔgɔw ye (`Русский ru`, `Angilɛkan en`, `中文 zh`, ...).
mobile.h3p2: O 1500-emoji katalogu kelen ni 9 ye + farikolo-ɲɛnajɛ + MRU + ɲinini.
mobile.h3p3: O kelen multi-account X25519 gɛlɛya-jaabi ka ɲɛsin switching ma.
mobile.h3p4: Baro foli kelenw (Bɛɛ / Archived / custom) ni drag-and-drop sigicogo kura ye.
mobile.h3p5: Saved-GIFs list kelen (Tenor tɛ — mɔgɔ yɛrɛ ka lajɛ dɔrɔn).
mobile.h3p6: O waati bolodalenw-cikan kelenw UI, contacts screen, premium status page.
mobile.h1_a: iOS kliyan ye Swift Package ye min bɛ ni 30+ feature modules ye. HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC protocole kelen i n’a fɔ kiliyan tɔw bɛɛ.
mobile.h1_b: Module minnu labɛnna ka kɛɲɛ ni fɛnw ye: `Bootstrap`, `Auth`, `Chat`, `Files`, `Calls`, `Push`, `Emoji`, `Folders`, `Accounts`, `SavedGifs`, `Contacts`, `Scheduled`, `Premium`, `Reactions`, .... U kelen-kelen bɛɛ tilalen don `api/` (protocols), `impl/` (klasi bɛnkanw), `ui/` (SwiftUI filɛliw). Kripto: KriptoKit ka ɲɛsin X25519 / Ed25519 / AES-GCM ma; Argon2Swift ye Argon2id ye. DB: GRDB ni FTS5 ye. WebRTC: stasel/WebRTC XCFkalan. Push: APN minnu bɛ ni Notification Service Extension ye walasa ka sealed-push decryption kɛ.
mobile.h1_c: Modular pakew ye Swift ka baarakɛcogo jɔnjɔn ye kabini Swift Package Manager 5.0 (2019). An ka tilali api/impl/ui ye SOLID-ish ye: dependency inversion (modules depends on api/ only), haminankow farali, testability (swap impl for tests). Module 30+ jate ye sugandili ye ka ɲɛsin build parallelism ma — module kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ ɲɔgɔn lajɛ a danma.
mobile.h2_a: Android kliyan bɛ iOS filɛ: Kotlin + Composer + Hilt DI. 22 feature modules, kelen `api / impl / di` tilalen.
mobile.h2_b: minSdk 26 (Android 8), laɲiniSdk 34 (Android 14) ye. Kripto: AndroidX lakanani + Tink ka ɲɛsin AES-GCM ma; argon2-jvm ye Argon2id ye. DB: So min bɛ ni FTS4 wulilanw ye. WebRTC: Aw ye WebRTC Android lajɛ. Push: FCM FirebaseMessagingService fɛ + anwɛlɛki datugulen decryption fɛ. Gradle multi-module, Hilt bɛ fɛnɲɛnɛma-modulew Jɛ ɲɔgɔn na k’a sɔrɔ u ma jɔli tilennenw Kɛ.
mobile.h2_c: Compose ye Google ka declarative UI baarakɛminɛnw ye, a sabatilen don kabini san 2021. Hilt (2020) ye Google-endorsed DI framework ye Dagger 2 sanfɛ.U faralen ɲɔgɔn kan u bɛ SwiftUI + property wrappers bɛn iOS kan walasa ka architectural feel kɛ min bɛ se ka kɛ kelen ye. Vortex ye Compose/Hilt ta kabini v0.0.4 ka taa a fɛ; fɔlɔ Android tun bɛ View-based.
mobile.h3_a: iOS ni Android fila bɛɛ bɛ 146-locale JSON set kelen in Blà ɲɔgɔn na ni tɔgɔw ye ani 1500-emoji catalogue — baarakɛla min bɛ 🥹 sɛbɛn iOS 17 kan, o bɛ 🥹 Kɛ Android 9 kan.
mobile.h3_b: `ios/Modules/Sources/I18N/Resources/locales/*.json` bɛ `android/app/src/main/assets/locales/*.json` jira. O porogramu fila bɛɛ bɛ yɔrɔ ɲuman doni daminɛ fɔlɔ la (kan sugandili ekran) ani u bɛ to ka sugandili kɛ. Emoji katalogu ye JSON suguya 9 ye min bɛ ci a kulu fila bɛɛ kɔnɔ; a bɛ OS-nivo emoji-set divergence kɛrɛfɛ min n’o tɛ, o bɛ kɛ sababu ye ka `?` glyphs (sɛbɛnni) minnu ma jira OS kɔrɔw kan.
mobile.h3_c: I yɛrɛ ka emoji katalogu cili ye misali ye Telegram bɛ baara kɛ ni min ye (u ka Twemoji foroko) ani WhatsApp bɛ baara kɛ fo san 2022. Jagokɛcogo: ~300 KB extra per app bundle for emoji + ~1.2 MB for locales. Nafa b’a la ka kɛɲɛ ni cross-platform consistency ye.

webclient.title: Web kliyan
webclient.subtitle: PWA, vanili JS, cogo min tɛ ɛntɛrinɛti kan, baarakɛla.
webclient.intro: Web kliyan ye vanili-JS PWA ye. No React, no bundler ka tɛmɛ ESM kan. ~400 KB gzipped bɛɛ lajɛlen, sigida 146 bɛ o la.
webclient.h1p1: `static/js/main.js` ye sɛbɛnni ye. Feature modules lazy-load kan baara fɔlɔ la.
webclient.h1p2: Jamana: so kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka ring buffers IndexedDB kɔnɔ, in-memory decrypted cache. Baarakɛla baarakɛla bɛ cɛsiri kɛ fetch la.
webclient.h1p3: UI: Glass jilama nɔw bɛ sɔrɔ CSS kɔkanna-filɛri fɛ. Kalanbolo si tɛ yen; ko kɛlen delegasiyɔn + idempotent render dɛmɛbagaw.
webclient.h2p1: Sɛbɛn o sɛbɛnni kɛra k’a sɔrɔ a tɛ ɛntɛrinɛti kan, o bɛ layidu ta IndexedDB la. SW bɛ wuli ni jɛɲɔgɔnya seginna.
webclient.h2p2: Idempotency key kan POST kelen-kelen bɛɛ kan, o bɛ a to duplicate retries ka ɲɛ sɔrɔ lafiya la.
webclient.h2p3: Kalan bɛ baara kɛ pewu ɛntɛrinɛti kɔkan — ciphertext sync bɛɛ bɛ balo IndexedDB kɔnɔ.
webclient.h3p1: 146 sigidaw bɛ `static/locales/*.json` kɔnɔ. Welcome screen (`lang-picker.js`) bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ ka tɛmɛn native-name hakilinaw fɛ.
webclient.h3p2: Boli waati yɔrɔ sɛgɛsɛgɛli : `document.documentElement.lang = kode` + ka labeliw jira kokura `data-i18n` fɛnw fɛ.
webclient.h1_a: Web kliyan ye vanili-JS PWA ye. No React, no build step ka tɛmɛ ESM bundling kan. JS cilenw bɛɛ lajɛlen: ~400 KB gzipped.
webclient.h1_b: `templates/base.html` ye Jinja2-kalansen ye . `static/js/main.js` ye ES-module doncogo ye. Fɛnɲɛnɛma moduluw bɛ `static/js/<feature>/` lazy-load kɔnɔ baara fɔlɔ la. CSS `static/css/` kɔnɔ ni 1-file-per-component bɛnkan ye. Baarakɛla bɛ cache (cache) ɲɛnabɔ; doni fɔlɔ bɛ bɔ rezo la, o kɔfɛ ka bɔ cache la; update sɛgɛsɛgɛliw kɛ navigatiɔn kan.
webclient.h1_c: Ka to karamɔgɔya la, o kɛra v0.0.1 latigɛ ye min kɛra ni laɲini ye, React ni Vue PWAw jateminɛni kɔfɛ ~1.5 MB gzipped ni o ɲɔgɔnna fɛnw ye. Vanili JS + ES moduluw bɛ ~400 KB di an ma. Jago-yɔrɔ ka ca ni DOM-manipulation boilerplate ye, an bɛ min nɔgɔya ni dɛmɛbaga misɛnninw ye `static/js/lib/dom.js` kɔnɔ.
webclient.h2_a: Offline mode: bɔli bɛ sɛbɛnniw layidu ta IndexedDB la; Baarakɛla bɛ ji bɔ ni ɲɔgɔndan seginna.
webclient.h2_b: POST / PATCH o POST / PATCH baarakɛla bɛ min Kɛ offline, o bɛ idempotency key sɔrɔ ka Jigin `outbox` (IndexedDB) kɔnɔ. Baarakɛla bɛ `ɛntɛrinɛti` ko lamɛn ani ka segin-ka-bɔnye kɛ ni idempotency kilisi ye i n’a fɔ kuncɛ. Server bɛ duplicates dɔn idempotency key fɛ ani ka jaabi fɔlɔ segin. Kalan bɛ baara kɛ pewu ɛntɛrinɛti kɔkan — ciphertexte syncs bɛɛ bɛ balo IndexedDB kɔnɔ ani a bɛ decrypt sigida la ni in-memory keys ye.
webclient.h2_c: Idempotency keys for retryable POSTs ye Stripe ka san 2017 bɛnkan ye, min minɛna bi API fanba fɛ. IndexedDB i n’a fɔ bɔyɔrɔ ye misali ye Google Drive web bɛ baara kɛ ni min ye walasa ka fɛnw sɛgɛsɛgɛ minnu tɛ ɛntɛrinɛti kan. Vortex ka waleyali ye ~200 zana ye `static/js/lib/outbox.js` kɔnɔ.
webclient.h3_a: 146-kanw bunteni bɛ `static/locales/*.json` la. Welcome screen cycles through native-name hints (`Выберите язык` / `I ka kan sugandi` / `选择语言` / ...).
webclient.h3_b: Fɔlɔ daminɛ: `lang-picker.js` bɛ sɛbɛnnikɛlan-animated hint jira min bɛ wuli ka tɛmɛ locales 97 fɛ 45 ms/char, ka 1,8 s jɔ, ka delete ni 30 ms/char, ka taa ɲɛ. Baarakɛla bɛ kan dɔ sugandi; a tora `localStorage.vortex_lang` kɔnɔ. Boli kɔfɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ sugandili maralen kalan. Boli waati sɛgɛsɛgɛli: `setLang(code)` bɛ JSON doni, ka `data-i18n` fɛnw jira kokura.
webclient.h3_c: Sɛbɛnni-minɛn-hint misali ye bonya ye terminal splash screens kɔrɔw ma wa a kɛra UX funteni kama v0.0.6 beta y’a jira kɔfɛ ko baarakɛlaw ma u janto fɛn dɔ la min bɛ se ka wuli ka bɔ a nɔ na. Sikilila-fɔli-minɛnw bɛ seginkanni 1 di baarakɛla bɛɛ ma walasa a k’a ka kan tɔgɔ ye k’a dɔn o yɔrɔnin bɛɛ.
webclient.h1_f:
shell : templates/base.html ( baarakɛminɛnw labɛncogo Jinja2 ) .
donna: static/js/main.js (ES modulu) .
fɛnw: static/js/{chat,so,auth,weleli,dosiyɛri,bots}/...
SW: jɔlen/baarakɛla.js
bonya: ~400 KB gzipped bɛɛ lajɛlen
webclient.h2_f:
sɛbɛnni taabolo min tɛ ɛntɛrinɛti kan:
  1. jatebɔ idempotency_key = rand(16).hex
  2. db.outbox.put({url, fɛɛrɛ, farikolo, idempotency_key, ts})
  3. ‘ɛntɛrinɛti kan’: flush outbox
     ka ɲɛsin jirisun kelen-kelen bɛɛ ma: fetch(url, {fɛɛrɛ, farikolo, kunkolow: {"Idempotency-Key": ikey}})
       → 2xx: ka jiri bɔ
       → 4xx: jiginɛ (dɛsɛ banbali) .
       → 5xx/offline: aw bɛ segin ka a lajɛ kɔfɛ

lang-picker.js ye:
  hints = ["Выберите язык", "I ka kan sugandi", "Elige tu idioma", ...]
  type hint ni 45 ms/char → lafiɲɛbɔ 1,8 s → bɔ ni 30 ms/char → lafiɲɛbɔ 0,2 s → o kɔfɛ

boli waati sɛgɛsɛgɛli: .
  sigida Ladonni.vortex_lang = kode

security.title: Lakanali jɔyɔrɔ
security.subtitle: Bagabagali modɛli, lafasali-kɔnɔna, WAF, jatebɔ sira, kanari.
security.intro: Vortex bɛ baara Kɛ ni lafasali-kɔnɔ-kɔnɔna ye : layɛrɛ kelen kari tɛ Bɔ, binkannikɛla lakika mago bɛ se sɔrɔli yɛrɛmahɔrɔnyalen caman na.
security.h1p1: **Rezo kɔlɔsibaga pasif**: a bɛ TLS pakew ye; bɛ bonya/waati sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ. A ye se sɔrɔ ni Nivo 1 sonyali ye.
security.h1p2: **Active network attacker**: bɛ se ka jigin/ka bila/pikiri kɛ. A ye se sɔrɔ ni Nivo 2-4 sonyali ye.
security.h1p3: **Node operateur compromise**: a bɛ ciphertext + metadata ye. Cikan kɔnɔkow bɛ to gundo la.
security.h1p4: **Kiliyan minɛn sonyalen**: cikan tɛmɛnenw sɛbɛncogo jɛlen minnu bɔra kɛnɛ kan. Double Ratchet dan ye sisan session ye; wipe-on-next-unlock bɛ sɔrɔ.
security.h1p5: **Quantum adversary with stored past traffic**: a ye se sɔrɔ ni Kyber-768 session keys hybride ye tuma min na a fila bɛɛ ye PQ piblisite kɛ.
security.h2p1: Sɛgɛsɛgɛlikɛla ɲininikɛla: SQLi misaliw, sira tigɛcogo, jatebɔlan pikiri, LFI, NoSQLi. Drops ka kɔn app code ɲɛ.
security.h2p2: Rate dans: diɲɛ 1000 req/s soft cap ni burst; sira kelen-kelen bɛɛ la (don 10/min, i tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni 5/min); baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ 100 req/s auth kɔfɛ.
security.h3p1: Lakanali-ko minnu bɛ tali kɛ (admin wale, federasɔn caman cili, bɔli sɛgɛsɛgɛli, panic wipe) hash-chained via `app/security/canary.py`.
security.h3p2: Cakɛda karilen ⇒ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛra. Lasɔmini tasumaw.
security.h3p3: `/api/admin/audit` bɛ jatebɔsɛbɛn jira (admin auth dɔrɔn). Append-dɔrɔn.
security.h4p1: Kanari dosiye bolonɔ bilalen don don o don ni bɔli kilisi ye. Absence ⇒ bɛnkan min bɛ siga la.
security.h4p2: Kɔrɔtɔko bɔli: ɲɛmɔgɔ bɛ `{type:"n", event:"compromise", ...}` lase WebSocket bɛɛ ma. Kliyanw bɛ kilisi minnu maralen don, olu ko.
security.h4p3: Yɛlɛma-yɛlɛma: bɔli kura kilisi, segin-ka-bɔnye manifest, segin-ka-bɔnye. Clients (Kiliyanw) bɛ segin ka bootstrap (bootstrap) kɛ.
security.h1_a: Kɛlɛɲɔgɔnw ka kalasi naani bɛ dilancogo ɲɛminɛ: kɔlɔsilikɛla pasif, binkannikɛla min bɛ baara kɛ, baarakɛla min bɛ bɔnɛ a la, minɛn min bɛ tiɲɛni kɛ. U kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye se sɔrɔ ni layɛrɛ wɛrɛ ye.
security.h1_b: Kɔlɔsilikɛla pasif : a bɛ TLS-encrypté pakew ye, a bɛ sirako sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ. A ye se sɔrɔ ni Nivo 1-2 sonyali ye. Binkannikɛla min bɛ baara kɛ: a bɛ se ka pakew fili/ka kɔfɛ/pikiri kɛ. A ye se sɔrɔ ni Nivo 3-4 sonyali ye. Baarakɛla min bɛ tiɲɛni kɛ: a bɛ ciphertext + metadata ye. A ye se sɔrɔ ni E2E kripto + metadata dɔgɔyali ye. Minɛn min tiɲɛna: a bɛ cikan tɛmɛnenw sɛbɛnni jɛlenw ye. Tiɲɛni dantigɛlen don ni ɲɛfɛ gundo ye (Double Ratchet) ani siranɲɛ ko.
security.h1_c: O misali naani bɔra Schneier ka san 1999 "Applied Cryptography" bagabagali misali taxonomi la, min janyalen don ni Snowden kɔfɛ kɔlɔsiliw ye jamana kɔnɔ kɔlɔsilikɛlaw kan. Bi secure-messenger dilancogo bɛɛ bɛ o ɲɔgɔnna fɛn dɔ fɔ. Vortex ka tigɛli ye ka kalasi duurunan fara v0.4 sirako kan: jugu min bɛ se ka kɛ ni quantum ye ni sira tɛmɛnen maralenw ye, Kyber bɛ min ɲɛnabɔ.
security.h2_a: WAF bɛ ɲinini bɛɛ Sɛgɛsɛgɛ sani a ka Se app code ma, ka ban SQL-i, sira taama, template pikiri, NoSQLi.
security.h2_b: `app/security/middleware.py::WAFMiddleware` bɛ ~50 regex sɛgɛsɛgɛliw kɛ URL, ɲininkali, ani farikolo kan. Dɔnniya-juguya misaliw (`UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$where`) → 403. Taari danw: diɲɛ 1000 req/s soft cap ni burst tolerance; sira kelen-kelen bɛɛ la `/don` 10/min, `/sɛbɛnni` 5/min; baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ 100 req/s auth kɔfɛ. Geo-blocking optionnel via `GEO_BLOCK=RU,CN,IR` walasa ka sankɔrɔta wajibiyalenw dafa baarakɛlaw ye minnu bɛ sariya labato.
security.h2_c: WAFw i n’a fɔ cɛmancɛ-minɛnw ye misali sigilen ye — mod_security (2002), Cloudflare ka WAF, AWS WAF. Vortex ta ye laɲini ye ka dɔgɔya bawo WAF girinman bɛ nkalon pozitifw lawuli minnu bɛ bagabagali lakikaw jigin. Regex lisi in Lajɛra ka Bɔ OWASP Top 10 bolonɔbilalenw na k'a Labɛn v0.0.5 kɔnɔ o kɔfɛ beta WAF sariya dɔ ye "DROP TABLE" sɛrɛkili dafalen bali kumaɲɔgɔnya cikan kɔnɔ min bɛ SQL kan.
security.h3_a: Lakanali siratigɛ la, ko minnu bɛ kɛ, olu bɛ jigin jatebɔ sɛbɛn dɔ kɔnɔ min bɛ ni hash-chained ye. Ni cakɛda karilen don, o b’a jira ko fɛn dɔ bɛ a la.
security.h3_b: Admin wale bɛɛ, federasiyɔn caman cili, bɔli sɛgɛsɛgɛli, walima siranɲɛko bɛɛ bɛ don `audit_log(ts, event, actor_id, target_id, detail_cbor)` kɔnɔ. Layini kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ `prev_hash = hash(prev_row)` ta. Sisan row ka hash jate bɛ kɛ `ts ∥ event ∥ prev_hash` kan. Ni jirisun dɔ bɔra walima ni fɛn dɔ b’a sɛmɛntiya, jirisun nataw ka `prev_hash` cakɛda bɛ tiɲɛ — a bɛ se ka dɔn ni cakɛda seginni ye.
security.h3_c: Hash-chained audit logs ye primitive kɔrɔ ye (hash-linked timestamping, 1991). Linux auditd bɛ baara Kɛ n'u ye. Git ka commit DAG ye 'sèn kelen ye a jɔyɔrɔba la. Vortex y’u Fàra o kan v0.0.6 kɔnɔ ladilikɛla dɔ y’a Jira kɔfɛ ko node min bɛ 'kɔnɔnafili, o bɛ Se ka log rows (log rows) Bɔ a makun na.
security.h4_a: Ko kɛlenw jaabi bɛ labɛn ka kɔn : kanari b’a jira ko bɔli kilisi tɛ bɛnkan sɔrɔ ; kɔrɔtɔko bɔli bɛ kilisi cakɛlenw ko kliyanw bɛɛ kɔnɔ.
security.h4_b: Don o don `canary.txt` bolonɔ bilalen bɛ bɔko kilisi fɛ, min bɛ bɔ kunnafonisɛbɛn kɛrɛfɛ. Clients b’a fɛ ka sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ daminɛ na — absence ⇒ compromise suspected. Ni bɛnkan dɔ Dabɔra: ɲɛmɔgɔ bɛ `{type:"n", event:"compromise", dalilu}` Lase WebSocket bɛɛ kan. Clients bɛ cached keys ko, ka force re-login. Kura bɔli key minted, manifest re-signed, clients re-bootstrap ka bɔ mirrored integrity endpoint. Ciphertext kɔrɔ min kɛra fɛn ye min tɛ se ka kalan a dilanni fɛ.
security.h4_c: Kanari dosiyew bɛ tugu Apple ka san 2013 yamaruya kanari ni `canarywatch.org` porozɛ la. Siginiden bɛ baara kɛ n’u ye. Vortex's ye otomatiki ye : cron dɔ bɛ `canary.txt` taamaʃyɛn Kɛ ni bɔli kilisi ye lɛrɛ 24 o lɛrɛ 24. Kɔrɔtɔko bɔli laseliw ye misali kelen ye Let's Encrypt bɛ baara kɛ ni min ye seereyaw jama-bɔli la.
security.h2_f:
bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ ɲinini bɛɛ kan:
  SQL pikiri : a dɔn UNION SELECT, DROP TABLE, ; -- wdfl.
  sira tɛmɛni : ../, ..%2f, URL-kodelenw danfaralenw dɔn
  template pikiri : ka {{, {% dɔn .
  XSS : detect <sɛbɛnni, javascript:
  NoSQLi : ka $ne, $yɔrɔ, $regex dɔn
hakɛ dancɛw : 1000/s diɲɛ kɔnɔ, 10/min doncogo, 5/min sɛbɛnni

row: {ts, ko kɛlen, acteur_id, laɲini_id, detail_cbor, prev_hash, row_hash}
