privacy.title: Gundolakow ani sariya labatoli
privacy.subtitle: GDPR, josariyaw-ka-bɔli, metadata dɔgɔyali, data portability.
privacy.intro: Vortex kurunw GDPR ani CCPA baarakɛminɛnw bɔra kɛsu kɔnɔ. Baarakɛlaw minnu bɛ marabolow kɔnɔ minnu bɛ sariya kɔnɔ, olu bɛ ni admin labanyɔrɔ kelen ye sariya ɲinini bɛɛ la.
privacy.h1p1: No IP logs ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye. Proxy reverse strips `X-Real-IP` fo ni baarakɛla y'a sugandi.
privacy.h1p2: `sender_pseudo` min bɛ cikanw sɛrɛkiliw kɔnɔ, o bɛ ciden ID lakikaw hash — DB dump bɛ so kelen-kelen bɛɛ tɔgɔla tɔgɔw dɔrɔn de jira.
privacy.h1p3: Ɲini bɛ baara kɛ ni encrypted-tokens ye. Client bɛ daɲɛ kolomaw siri ni so key ye; node bɛ token opaque mara; lookup ye exact-match ye ciphertext tokenw kan.
privacy.h1p4: Last-seen truncated ka Kɛ baarakɛla ka granularity sugandilen ye.
privacy.h2p1: `POST /api/privacy/erase` bɛ baarakɛla kulu tɔgɔ fɔ, k’u ka cikan cilenw ko (metadata minnu maralen bɛ quorum kama), ka dosiyew bɔ disiki kɔnɔ.
privacy.h2p2: Fɛderasiyɔn : kumajugu bolonɔbilalen bɛ a teriw kunnafoni; u bɛ foni u kɛrɛ fɛ 72 h kɔnɔ.
privacy.h2p3: Audit: erasure bɛ sɛbɛn ni waati taamasiyɛn ye ani (hashed) user id walasa baarakɛla ka se ka sariya labatoli jira.
privacy.h3p1: `GET /api/privacy/export` bɛ zipu dɔ bɔ: profil JSON, ciphertext cilen/sɔrɔlen, dosiyew ɲɛfɔli ni dosiye kelen-kelen bɛɛ jusigilanw ye, mɔgɔw ka lisi.
privacy.h3p2: Jɛnɛ waati: ~5 min ye cikan 10 k ye, a dan ye IO ye.
privacy.h3p3: Sɔrɔbaga ka kan ka ciphertext decrypt sigida la; export tooling bɛ ci a kɛrɛfɛ.
privacy.h4p1: Logo digilen jan 5 s → sigida ko teliya la: kilisi, cikan minnu maralen bɛ, fɛnw faralen ɲɔgɔn kan.
privacy.h4p2: Coupled wipe: `/api/privacy/panic` fana bɛ kaburu kabakurunw kɛ server-side jatebɔ la.
privacy.h1_a: No IP logs ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye. Baarakɛlaw dɔnni-mɛtadata si tɛ cikanw sɛrɛkiliw kan. Sɛbɛnni dafalen ɲinini token sirilenw kan.
privacy.h1_b: Reverse proxy bɛ `X-Real-IP` bɔ sanni node k’a ye fo ni baarakɛla y’a sugandi ka rate-limiting kɛ. Cikanw sɛrɛkiliw bɛ `sender_id` (ka ɲɛsin ACL) ani `sender_pseudo` (fan-out kama); sender_pseudo ye HMAC(so_kɔgɔ, ciden_id) ye o la DB dump tɛ a jira jɔn ye mun fɔ sow cɛma. Ɲini: kiliyan bɛ daɲɛ kolomaw siri ni so kilisi ye; node bɛ token opaque mara; lookup ye exact-match ye ciphertext tokens kan, index plaintext tɛ yen.
privacy.h1_c: Metadata dɔgɔyali ye Snowden kɔfɛ bɛnkan ye — Signal y’a kɛ fɛn ye min bɛ fɔ kosɛbɛ san 2014, WhatsApp tugura o kɔ ni sender-pseudo ye san 2019. Ɲini sirilen ciphertext tokens kan o ye CryptDB (2011) ani ShadowCrypt (2014) misali ye. Vortex ka waleyali ye 'sènbɔli ye min bɛ ɲininkali dɔw Labɛn ka Kɛ nɔgɔya ye.
privacy.h2_a: `POST /api/privacy/erase` bɛ baarakɛla kulu tɔgɔ fɔ, k’u ka ciyɛri cilenw ko, ka dosiyew bɔ yen, ka jɛkulu jɛɲɔgɔnw ladɔnniya.
privacy.h2_b: Server-side: `baarakɛlaw` row ka foro sɛgɛsɛgɛlenw zeru (`baarakɛla tɔgɔ = "deleted-<id>"`, `telefɔni = null`, `email = null`, `display_name = "[deleted]"`); `messages.ciphertext` ye NULL sigi jirisunw bɛɛ la yɔrɔ min na `cibaga_id = u.id`; dosiye minnu bɛ tali kɛ o cikanw na minnu bɔra disiki la. Fɛderasiyɔn ɲɔgɔndanw bɛ bolonɔ bila `{ko: "erasure", user_id, signed_by}` kumakan dɔ sɔrɔ; u bɛ boli o saniya kelen in na u kɛrɛ fɛ lɛrɛ 72 kɔnɔ (SLA).
privacy.h2_c: Hakilila-bɔli ye GDPR sariyasen 17nan wajibiyalen ye kabini san 2018. CCPA tugura o kɔ san 2020; LGPD (Brezil) san 2021. Vortex bɛ primitive out-of-the-box bila kurun kɔnɔ walasa baarakɛlaw minnu bɛ marabolow kɔnɔ minnu bɛ sariya kɔnɔ, olu kana a jɔ. 72 h federasɔn SLA bɛ bɛn GDPR ka tile 30 jaabi finɛtiri ma ni kunkolo yɔrɔ ye walasa ka jɛnsɛn.
privacy.h3_a: `GET /api/privacy/export` bɛ zipu dɔ bɔ: profil JSON, ciphertext cilen/sɔrɔlen, dosiyew ɲɛfɔli ni dosiye kelen-kelen bɛɛ jusigilanw ye, mɔgɔw ka lisi.
privacy.h3_b: Generation ye async ye bawo account belebelebaw bɛ miniti caman ta. Client POSTs ɲinini → node enqueues baara → baara bɛ boli kɔkan → client polls `/api/privacy/export/{job_id}` → 200 ni signed URL ni labɛnnen don. Zip kɔnɔkow: `profile.json`, `rooms.jsonl` (kelen so kelen kɔnɔ), `messages.jsonl.enc` (ciphertext + filen kelen-kelen bɛɛ jusigilanw), `files/` (blobs telesarse-i n’a fɔ a bɛ cogo min na).
privacy.h3_c: Donanw tacogo ye filanin wajibiyalen ye ni erasure ye GDPR kɔnɔ. Apple, Google, Telegram, Siginiden bɛɛ bɛ ni fɛnw ta minɛnw ye. Vortex's bɛ fɛn kolomaw fara a kan (file_root per file) walasa baarakɛlaw ka se ka bɔli kɛ sigida la — n’o tɛ, bɔli nafa tɛ. Ni nin kunnafoni in tɛ Apple / Google ta-taama-minɛnw bɛ Kɛ cogo ɲuman na sɛbɛnni jɛlenw dɔrɔn de la bawo u ye decryption (dafalen) Kɛ kaban.
privacy.h4_a: Panic wipe: aw bɛ Vortex taamasiyɛn digi ka mɛn fo segin 5 walasa ka teliya la ka kilisi bɛɛ tiɲɛ ani ka kunnafoniw maralenw tiɲɛ minɛn kan. A tɛ se ka segin kɔ.
privacy.h4_b: Client-side : ni segin 5 janya-press, jira confirmation; on confirm, call `wipeKeychainItems()` / `clearKeystore()` / `sigida-Storage.clear() + indexedDB.databases().forEach(deleteDatabase)`. Ciphertext caché tɛ yen, keys tɛ yen, JWTw tɛ yen tugun. Optional coupled wipe: `POST /api/privacy/panic` fana bɛ kaburu kabakurunw kɛ konte server-side ani ka federate an erasure gossip.
privacy.h4_c: Panic buttons / dead-man switches tariku ka jan cikan lakananenw na: Wickr ka 2014 "Shred", Cryptocat ka 2013 "Forget", Signal ka "Secure Deletion" laɲini (2016, a ma ci abada). Vortex ka segin 5 janya-presse ka gɛlɛn ni laɲini ye ka daminɛ bala la — an ye haptic feedback kalan iPhone 15 ani Pixel 8 kan ani ka s 5 ta i n’a fɔ yɔrɔ duman min bɛ "teliya ka se kɔrɔtɔko la" ni "can't fire by pocket-button" cɛ.
privacy.h1_f:
ciden_pseudo = HMAC-SHA256(so_kɔgɔ, ciden_id)[:16]
  ⇒ DB dump: {so, ciden_ka_kofɔlen, ciphertext}
  ⇒ binkannikɛla tɛ se ka sender_pseudo siri so kɔnɔ (kɔgɔ danfaralenw) .

ɲinini taamasiyɛn = HMAC-SHA256(so_kɔlɔsili, daɲɛ koloma) .
  ⇒ ɲininkali "bonjour" ⇒ jatebɔ token ⇒ index-match tigitigi ɲinini
  ⇒ node tɛ daɲɛ jɛlen ye abada
privacy.h2_f:
POST /api/danbe/furu (yɛrɛlabaara) .
  UPDATE baarakɛlaw SET baarakɛla tɔgɔ='bɔra-'||id, telefɔni=NULL, email=NULL, ... WHERE id=$u
  UPDATE cikanw SET ciphertext=NULL WHERE ciden_id=$u
  DELETE FROM filew WHERE bilalen_ka_ka=$u
  kumakan {ko:"erasure", baarakɛla_id, sig:Ed25519(bɔli_priv, ko kɛlen)}
privacy.h3_f:
export.zip ye
├── profile.json (baarakɛlaw ka forow) .
├── so.jsonl (so kelen layini kelen na)
├── messages.jsonl.enc (ciphertext + cikan kelen-kelen bɛɛ file_root)
├── decrypt.py (dɛmɛnan sɛbɛnni) .
└── dosiyew/
    ├── <file_id>.bin (blob sirilen, root key in messages.jsonl)
    └── ...
privacy.h4_f:
digi jan ≥ s 5 kan VORTEX logo kan:
  dialogue (daɲɛgafe) dafalen
  kan confirmer:
    Keychain.deleteAll(dakun fɔlɔ="vortex.")
    Baarakɛla ka baarakɛcogo.removeObject(forKey: "vortex.*")
    SQLite vortex.db DROP tabali bɛɛ
    couplé: POST /api/privacy/panic (kaburu kabakurun serwɛri fan fɛ)

debugging.title: Debugging (ɲɛnabɔli) ni diagnostic (sɛgɛsɛgɛli) kɛli
debugging.subtitle: Baarakɛminɛn minnu bɛ kɛ ka koɲɛw nɔfɛtaama dev, staging ani prod kɔnɔ.
debugging.intro: Sisitɛmu fitinin bɛɛ bɛ ni logging structured ani /metrics surface ye. Nin ye bana sɛgɛsɛgɛli tulonkɛ gafe ye min bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ.
debugging.h1p1: JSON-labɛnna ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye. `logger.info("wale", extra={"baarakɛla_id": ...})` bɛ `{"ts":..., "lvl":"INFO", "msg":"wale", "baarakɛla_id": ...}` bɔ.
debugging.h1p2: Aw bɛ a wuli ni 100 MB ye; ka 14 gens gzipped mara.
debugging.h1p4: Correlation id: ɲinini bɛɛ bɛ `X-Request-Id` sɔrɔ; duguma RPCw bɛ baara kɛ n’a ye kokura.
debugging.h2p2: RED: hakɛ / filiw / kuntaala sira kelen kan.
debugging.h2p3: USE: baarakɛcogo / saturasiyɔn / filiw DB pool kelen kɔnɔ, WebSocket fan-out, TURN relay.
debugging.h2p4: Laada: so baarakɛtaw, cikanw/w, histogramme sonyali-nivo.
debugging.h3p1: `py-spy` ka ɲɛsin boli waati misali ta ma. Aw bɛ a siri boli node la PID.
debugging.h3p2: `memray` ka ɲɛsin heap profiling ma. Miniti 1 ja bɛ bɔgɔbɔgɔw jira joona.
debugging.h3p3: Rust farankan `vortex_chat` bɛ `--profile` darapo bɔ kɛnɛ kan min bɛ taamasiyɛn sɛbɛn min bɛ bɛn flamegraph ma.
debugging.h4p1: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` bɛ baara kɛ ni sɛbɛnni/don/ci/sɔrɔ/bɔ ye sigida node dɔ kan. A bɛ Bɔ non zero (zero tɛ) dɛsɛ o dɛsɛ kan.
debugging.h4p2: CI bɛ boli sisi kan PR bɛɛ kan ka fara merges kan ka kɛ main ye.
debugging.h4p3: Sɛnɛfɛnw dilanni sisi : kɛnɛma sonda bɛ kanari jatebɔsɛbɛn dɔ gosi siɲɛ kelen miniti kɔnɔ.
debugging.h1_a: Logs (jatebɔsɛbɛnw) bɛ JSON-labɛn ka kɛɲɛ ni u ye. Log line bɛɛ kɔnɔ, ts, level, module, message, ani correlation id bɛ sɔrɔ.
debugging.h1_b: `logger.info("baarakɛla_dabɔra", extra={"baarakɛla_id": u.id})` bɛ `{"ts":"2026-04-21T10:23:14.127Z", "lvl":"INFO", "mod":"auth", "msg":"baarakɛla_dabɔ", "baarakɛla_id": 42, "req_id": "..."}` ye. Korelasiyɔn id bɛ bɔ `X-Request-Id` kuncɛ la; jiginɛ RPC bɛɛ bɛ baara kɛ n’a ye kokura. Yɛlɛma-yɛlɛma ni 100 MB ye; ka mɔgɔw bɔnsɔn 14 mara gzipped. Nivo per-module via `LOG_LEVEL_<MODULE>=DEBUG`.
debugging.h1_c: Structured JSON logging ye bɛnkan ye min bɛ sen na sisan — Stripe, Datadog, bi kɔlɔsili feerela bɛɛ ye min ta. Korelasiyɔn IDw bɛ tugu X-Request-Id (RFC 4557) la, wa u kɛra kanon ye mikrosɛrɛwisiw kɔnɔ Jaeger / Zipkin (2015) sababu fɛ. Vortex bɛ baara kɛ ni id nɔgɔman ye min bɛ jɛnsɛn ni kunkolo-yɔrɔ ye sanni ka taamasiyɛnw tila-tila bawo taamasiyɛn-taama-minɛnw bɛ gɛlɛya dɔ fara an mago tɛ min na fɔlɔ.
debugging.h2_a: Prometheus metrics at `/metrics` (admin-dafalen bɛ baarakɛcogo la). Grafana dakunw bɛ ci `deploy/grafana/` kɔnɔ.
debugging.h2_b: RED jateminɛw sira kelen-kelen bɛɛ la: ɲinini hakɛ, fili hakɛ, waati janya histogramme. USE jateminɛw nafolo kelen-kelen bɛɛ la : DB pooli baarakɛcogo, WebSocket fan-out saturation, TURN relay bandwidth. Laada: so baarakɛtaw, cikanw segin kɔnɔ, histogramme sonyali-nivo. Admin dashboard min bɛ `/admin/metrics` la, o bɛ sanfɛla jatew jira; Prometheus scraping ka tariku dafalen sɔrɔ.
debugging.h2_c: RED (hakɛ / filiw / kuntaala) ye Weaveworks ka san 2016 daɲɛ surun ye. USE (baarakɛcogo / saturasiyɔn / filiw) ye Brendan Gregg ka san 2013 fɛɛrɛ ye. U faralen ɲɔgɔn kan, u bɛ baarakɛyɔrɔ ni nafolomafɛnw taamasiyɛnw ɲɛfɔ. Prometheus + Grafana ye dakun dafalen ye kabini san 2016.
debugging.h3_a: `py-spy` ka ɲɛsin boli waati misali ta ma; `memray` ka ɲɛsin heap snapshots ma; `vortex_chat` Rust farankan bɛ ni `--profile` ye flamegraph taamasiyɛnw kama.
debugging.h3_b: `py-spy record -o profile.svg --pid <node>` fo s 60 bɛ tasuma-fanga SVG bɔ min bɛ Python kulu funtenimaw jira. `memray run -o mem.bin <cmd>` bɛ jatebɔw nɔfɛtaama; `memray flamegraph mem.bin` bɛ a jira. Rust farankan bɛ kɔnɔna-porofilɛriw bɔ kɛnɛ kan i n’a fɔ Chrome-tracing JSON n’a welera ni `--profile` ye. Olu dɔ la kelen fara ɲɔgɔn kan ni doni-sɛgɛsɛgɛli ye min bɛ boli `scripts/smoke/all.sh` fɛ walasa ka cogoyaw sɔrɔ minnu bɛ bɛn ɲɔgɔn ma.
debugging.h3_c: py-spy (2018) ye jatebɔlan ye min tɛ don a kɔnɔ, min bɛ nɔrɔ Python baarakɛcogo bolilen na k’a sɔrɔ kode caman ma Changé — Python profilerw ka Go. memray (Bloomberg, 2022) ye Python heap profiler ɲuman ye bi. Rust yɛrɛ ka profiling ekosisɛti kɔgɔlen don nka a ma don ɲɔgɔn na kosɛbɛ; an ka farankan bɛ Chrome-tracing bɔ kɛnɛ kan kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la bawo navigatɔrɔ bɛɛ kɔnɔ, filɛlikɛlan dɔ bɛ a kɔnɔ.
debugging.h4_a: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` degeliw sɛbɛnni/don/ci/sɔrɔ/bɔ ka ɲɛsin sigida node dɔ ma. CI b'a boli PR bɛɛ kan.
debugging.h4_b: Sisi bɛ boli ~sekɔndi 5 kɔnɔ. A bɛ jatebɔsɛbɛn kura fila da, ka DM da wuli, ka cikan ci, ka jiginni sɛgɛsɛgɛ, ka u fila bɛɛ bɔ. A bɛ Bɔ non zero (zero tɛ) dɛsɛ o dɛsɛ kan. CI b'a wele post-build. Prod-smoke kanari danfaralen bɛ boli miniti kelen-kelen bɛɛ la ka bɔ kɛnɛma sonda la ka ɲɛsin sɛgɛsɛgɛli jatebɔsɛbɛn kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen dɔ ma min bɛ bɔli node kan.
debugging.h4_c: Sisi sɛgɛsɛgɛliw ye Toyota izini ntalen ye (1950 waatiw) — boli teliya la walasa ka a jira ko a jɛlen don ko sistɛmu ma tiɲɛ. Porozɛw la u kɛra sariya ye Michael Feathers ka "Working Effectively with Legacy Code" (2004) kɔfɛ. Vortex ka sisi sɛbɛnni ye ~200 layini ye bash + curl.
debugging.h1_f:
{
  "ts": "2026-04-21T10:23:14.127Z", Bamako, Mali.
  "lvl": "INFO",
  "mod": "auth",
  "msg": "baarakɛla_dabɔlen",
  "baarakɛla_dakun": 42,
  "req_id": "7f3a1e9c-..." Bamako, Mali.
} .

jiginni: 100 MB × 14 jɛnɛya gzipped
modulu kelen-kelen bɛɛ la: LOG_LEVEL_TRANSPORT=DEBUG .

py-spy sɛbɛnni -o profile.svg --pid $(pgrep -f uvicorn) --waati 60

memray boli -o mem.bin python -m app.main

sɛbɛnniw/sisi/bɛɛ.sh:

testing.title: Kɔrɔbɔli fɛɛrɛ
testing.subtitle: 29 k layiniw sɛgɛsɛgɛli Python, Swift, Kotlin, JS cɛ.
testing.intro: Layɛrɛ bɛɛ n’a ka sɛgɛsɛgɛli suite don. CI bɛ boli u bɛɛ la miniti 10 jukɔrɔ.
testing.h1p1: `pytest app/tests` bɛ routeurs, lakana, bolifɛnw, botw de kan.
testing.h1p2: Hypothèse nafolo-sɛgɛsɛgɛliw kripto kan: `assert decrypt(encrypt(m, k), k) == m` for 1000 random m.
testing.h1p3: AFL-style fuzz on WAF: miliyɔn caman donnakow ma labɛnbaliya — a b’a jira ko 5xx bɔli si tɛ yen.
testing.h2p1: `swift test` min bɛ `ios/Modules/` kɔnɔ, o bɛ unit testw kɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni RFC 7748 / 8032 / 5869 / 8446 sɛgɛsɛgɛli vektɔriw ye.
testing.h2p2: XCUI sɛgɛsɛgɛliw bɛ SwiftUI filɛliw bila simulator kunkolo tɛ min na; snapshot-ka kɛɲɛ ni ɲɔgɔn ye.
testing.h3p2: `./gradlew connectedCheck` bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛliw kɛ ni minɛnw ye emulatɛri bolilen kan.
testing.h4p1: Playwright bɛ ɛntɛrinɛti kliyan boli, Chrome kunkolo tɛ min na + Firefox kunkolo tɛ min na. Weelekanw bɛ Kɛ ni `--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream` ye.
testing.h4p2: Ɲɛjiraliw: jatebɔsɛbɛn fila sɛbɛn → DM → filen ci → ka bɔ → ka sinsinnan sɛgɛsɛgɛ → ka ban.
testing.h1_a: Python sɛgɛsɛgɛliw bɛ kɛ ni pytest + coverage ye. Routeur bɛɛ, security primitive bɛɛ, transport module bɛɛ bɛ ni tests ye. ~80 % ka bεnkansεbεn.
testing.h1_b: `pytest app/tests` bɛ suite dafalen baara miniti 2 jukɔrɔ core kelen kan. Hypothèse nafolo-sɛgɛsɛgɛliw kripto primitives kan: `assert decrypt(encrypt(m, k), k) == m` cikan 1000 kan k’a sɔrɔ u ma kɛ cogo si la. AFL-style fuzz tests on the WAF: donnafɛn miliyɔn caman minnu ma labɛn ka ɲɛ, olu y’a jira ko u bɛ jaabi 4xx (a tɛ 5xx) lase. `pytest --cov=app` ka ɲɛsin fɛnw ma.
testing.h1_c: pytest (Holger Krekel, 2009) ye sɛgɛsɛgɛli bolila ye min bɛ kɛ tiɲɛ na Python. Hypothesis (2015) min bɛ kɛ ka sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ nafolo kan, o ye QuickCheck hakilina ta ka bɔ Haskell fɛ. AFL (Michał Zalewski, 2013) for fuzz ye kanon ka coverage-guided fuzzer ye. Vortex ka stack ye mainstream ye; o daji kelenpe ye an ka fɛɛrɛ ye pytest parametrisation ye ka tɛmɛ test-class ciyɛn kan.
testing.h2_a: Swift sɛgɛsɛgɛli minnu bɛ `ios/Modules/` kɔnɔ, olu bɛ kripto primitifw datugu ka ɲɛsin RFC sɛgɛsɛgɛli vektɔriw ma ka fara SwiftUI snapshot sɛgɛsɛgɛliw kan.
testing.h2_b: `swift test` min bɛ bɔ `ios/Modules/` la, o bɛ unit tests kɛ s 1 jukɔrɔ. RFC 7748 (X25519) fɛnɲɛnamafagalanw. RFC 8032 (Ed25519) fɛnɲɛnamafagalanw. RFC 5869 (HKDF) fɛnɲɛnamafagalanw. RFC 8446 (TLS 1,3) bεε lajɛlen. SwiftUI ka ɲɛjirali fɔlɔ ja minnu bɛ tali kɛ ja diff fɛ ni git-tracked baseline ye; kɔsegin pixel o pixel kan o bɛ dɛsɛ ka jɔ.
testing.h2_c: Kripto kɔrɔbɔli ni sɛgɛsɛgɛli vektɔri ofisiyaliw ye, o ye wale ye min tɛ marifa ci kosɛbɛ — n’i ka kode bɛ bɛn RFC vektɔriw ma, o bɛ bɛn a ɲɛfɔli ma. SwiftUI ka ja sɛgɛsɛgɛli ye ~2022 cogoya ye, min diyara kosɛbɛ pointfreeco/swift-snapshot-testing fɛ. Vortex bɛ baara kɛ ni minimal in-house version ye walasa ka a yɛrɛ tanga o ma.
testing.h3_a: Kotlin ka sɛgɛsɛgɛliw: JVM-dɔrɔn `./gradlew sɛgɛsɛgɛli` fɛ; instrumented via `./gradlew connectedCheck` kan emulatɛri bolilen dɔ kan.
testing.h3_b: `./gradlew test` bɛ boli segin damadɔ kɔnɔ — Android framework si mago tɛ, JUnit + Hilt-android-testing dɔrɔn. Unit-test laɲiniw : kripto, jirabagaw, coroutine-based flows. `./gradlew connectedCheck` bɛ emulator dɔ lamini, ka appli in sigi sen kan, ka UI sɛgɛsɛgɛliw kɛ Espresso fɛ. E2E flows: don → cikan ci → a lajɛ baro la.
testing.h3_c: JVM-dɔrɔn sɛgɛsɛgɛliw ni minɛn sɛgɛsɛgɛliw farali ɲɔgɔn kan, o ye Android 2019+ lajɛba ye. JVM sɛgɛsɛgɛliw bɛ teliya (seginkanni); sɛgɛsɛgɛli minnu bɛ kɛ ni minɛnw ye, olu bɛ kɛ dɔɔnin dɔɔnin (minitiw). Robolectric (2014) tùn bɛ o danfara in Dabɔ nka a fanba Dònna o farali in nɔ na bi Android yiriwali la.
testing.h4_a: Playwright bɛ ɛntɛrinɛti kliyan boli Chrome ni Firefox kunkolo tɛ minnu na, ka sɛbɛnni lakika → DM → weleli bolicogo dege.
testing.h4_b: `playwright-tests/` bɛ ɲɛjiraliw minɛ TypeScript kɔnɔ. Node fililen + Postgres bɛ spun up test session kelen-kelen bɛɛ la docker compose fɛ. Kɔrɔbɔliw bɛ ɛntɛrinɛti UI ɲɛminɛ : ka jatebɔsɛbɛn fila sɛbɛn, ka DM da wuli, ka cikan ci, ka cikan sɛgɛsɛgɛ, ka wideyow wele ni `--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream` + `--use-fake-device-for-media-stream` darapow ye walasa Chrome ka odio/video sintetiki dilan. Sɛnɛfɛnw bɛ boli ɲɔgɔn fɛ Playwright baarakɛlaw sababu fɛ.
testing.h4_c: Tulonkɛla (Microsoft, 2020) ye Selenium nɔ bila ɛntɛrinɛti E2E kɔrɔbɔli fanba la bawo a teliyalen don, a bɛ se ka da a kan, wa a bɛ se ka tiɲɛni kɛ ka ɲɛ. WebRTC sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛli navigatɛriw la minnu tɛ kunkolo ye, o kɛra dimi ye fo Chrome 69 ye minɛn nkalonma darapow fara a kan; kabini o waati a kɛra wale jɔnjɔn ye.

apiSurface.title: API sanfɛla
apiSurface.subtitle: HTTP labanyɔrɔ o HTTP node bɛ jira, ka kuluw kɛ yɔrɔ la.
apiSurface.intro: Nin ye foroba siraw lisɛli ye min bɛ fanga sɔrɔ. Karti labanyɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ bonya walasa ka kuntilenna, auth tier, ɲinini / jaabi schemas, fili tabali, ani curl misali jira. So kɔnɔna ladonni sira minnu bɛ `/kɔnɔna/*` jukɔrɔ, olu bɔra politiki siratigɛ la.

auth.title: Tiɲɛni
auth.subtitle: I tɔgɔ sɛbɛn, don, ka lakurayali, ka ban — ani segin siraw.
auth.intro: Sira bɛɛ bɛ `/api/authentication/*` jukɔrɔ. JWT min bɛ bɔ donko ɲɛnabɔlen na, o bɛ `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, typ: access|refresh}` taamasiyɛn HS256 ta node gundo kan. Sɔrɔli bɛ kɛ miniti 15 kɔnɔ, ka segin ka kɛ tile 30 ye.

register.title: POST /api/dafalen/sɛbɛnni
register.subtitle: Baarakɛla kura dabɔ ni X25519 danyɔrɔ + Argon2id tɔgɔlasɛbɛn ye.
register.h1_a: A bɛ baarakɛla ka jatebɔsɛbɛn kura Dabɔ ani ka JWT fila fɔlɔ Bɔ. A bɛ baarakɛla ka forobaciyɛn X25519 min bɛ mɛn sen na, o siri jatebɔsɛbɛn na kabini weleli fɔlɔ yɛrɛ.
register.h1_b: Node bɛ foro bɛɛ tiɲɛ Pydantic fɛ, ka baarakɛla tɔgɔ ni x25519_public_key danfara lajɛ, ka Argon2id (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) boli tɔgɔlasɛbɛn kan, ka don `baarakɛlaw`, `baarakɛla_minɛnw`, `push_abonnenw` kɔnɔ, mints doncogo + JWTw lakurayali.
register.h1_c: A cilen don v0.0.1 kɔnɔ i n’a fɔ labanyɔrɔ fɔlɔ. X25519 pubkey paramɛtiri Fàrala v0.0.2 kɔnɔ a kɛlen kɔ k’a Dɔn ko danyɔrɔ ni jatebɔ ka kan ka Dabɔ atomi la — n’o tɛ, sèrwɛri bɛ Se ka MITM baarakɛla dɔ Sɔrɔ register ni key upload fɔlɔ cɛ.
register.h2_a: A bɛ wajibiya: **none**. Cɛmancɛ-minɛn `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` bɛ nin sira in da ani ka ban ni `401 unauthenticated` ye ni seereya wajibiyalen tɛ yen walima ni a tɛ tiɲɛ.
register.h2_b:
- `none` — min ma sɛgɛsɛgɛ (ka kɔn don ɲɛ).
- `jwt` — Bearer JWT don taamasiyɛn min bɛ `Authorization` kuncɛ la.
- `refresh` — Bearer JWT lakurayali taamasiyɛn.
- `admin` — JWT min ka fɔtaw bɛ `is_admin: tiɲɛ`.
- `peer-signed` — ɲinini farikolo bolonɔ bilalen bɛ peer dannamɔgɔ dɔ ka Ed25519 kilisi fɛ.
register.h2_c: Auth tier bɛ privilege dɔgɔman sariya jira: sanni ka don labanyɔrɔw dantigɛlen don kosɛbɛ jatebɔ dabɔli n’a seginni ma; fɛn o fɛn bɛ JWT kɔfɛ, o bɛ baarakɛla lakika ye; admin labanyɔrɔw bɛ badge jira UI kɔnɔ o la baara jugu bɛ kɔlɔsi.
register.h3_a: JSON farikolo ni baarakɛla tɔgɔ + tɔgɔlasɛbɛn + x25519_foroba_kunnafoni wajibiyalen; telefɔni sugandilen (E.164), imɛri (RFC 5322 lite), jiracogo_tɔgɔ, avatar_emoji, wele_kode, kyber_public_key.
register.h3_f:
{
  "baarakɛla tɔgɔ": "alisi", // [a-z0-9_]{3,30}
  "daɲɛ": "...", // ≥ 8 jate
  "x25519_public_key": "<64-hex>", // 32 bayt hex
  "display_name": "Alice", // a bɛ se ka kɛ
  "telefɔni": "+15551234567", // a bɛ se ka kɛ, E.164
  "email": "a@misali.com", // a bɛ se ka kɛ
  "avatar_emoji": "🦊", // a bɛ se ka kɛ, emoji 1
  "invite_code": "...", // ŋaniyata ni INVITE cogoya
  "kyber_public_key": "<1184 hex>" // a bɛ se ka kɛ, ka ɲɛsin PQ ma .
} .
register.h4_a: 201 Dabɔra ni JWT fila ye ani baarakɛla kura ka kanon ɲɛfɔli.
register.h4_f:
{
  "ok": tiɲɛ don,
  "don_taamasen": "eyJ...", // miniti 15 TTL
  "refresh_token": "eyJ...", // tile 30 TTL
  "baarakɛla_dakun": 42,
  "baarakɛla tɔgɔ": "alice",
  "tɔgɔ_jiracogo": "Alisi",
  "avatar_url": fɛn fu, .
  "x25519_foroba_kunnafoni": "<64 hex>",
  "kyber_public_key": "<hex>" .
} .
register.h5_a: Standard validation + domani kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ka ban fila. `409 username_taken` ni tɔgɔ bɛ yen; `409 pubkey_reused` ni X25519 foroba kilisi sɛbɛnna kaban jatebɔsɛbɛn wɛrɛ kɔnɔ.

409 baarakɛla tɔgɔ_talen baarakɛla tɔgɔ ɲɔgɔndan
409 pubkey_reused X25519 pubkey baara kɛra kaban
422 validation_error foro dantigɛli tiɲɛna
429 hakɛ_dantigɛlen >5 sɛbɛnni/min/IP .
403 registration_closed node bɛ INVITE cogo la ani kode tɛ yen

login.title: POST /api/dafalen/donni
login.subtitle: Baarakɛla tɔgɔ + tɔgɔlasɛbɛn sɛgɛsɛgɛ, ka segin JWT fila kan.
login.h1_a: A bɛ seereyaw ɲɔgɔn falen-falen JWT fila-fila dɔ kama. Daɲɛ dogolen bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛ ni Argon2id hash ye `users.password_hash` kɔnɔ. Waati ye waati basigilen ye hali baarakɛla tɔgɔ dɔnbaliw fɛ walasa ka jatebɔ kɛlɛ.
login.h1_b: A bɛ baarakɛla ɲini ni baarakɛla tɔgɔ fitinin ye, a bɛ baara kɛ ni `argon2.PasswordHasher.verify(stored, submitted)` ye. Ni baarakɛla tɛ yen, a bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli Kɛ ni dummy hash (hash dummy) ye min jatebɔra ka Kɔn walasa ka waati kɛcogo Blà ɲɔgɔn na. Ɲɛtaa → bɔli JWT + `baarakɛla_minɛnw` row.
login.h1_c: A bɛ ci ni register ye v0.0.1 kɔnɔ. Constant-time dummy hashing farala v0.0.2 kan ɲininikɛlaw ye waati jatebɔ jiralen kɔfɛ dilan fɔlɔ kan.
login.h2_a: A bɛ wajibiya: **none**. Cɛmancɛ-minɛn `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` bɛ nin sira in da ani ka ban ni `401 unauthenticated` ye ni seereya wajibiyalen tɛ yen walima ni a tɛ tiɲɛ.

- `none` — min ma sɛgɛsɛgɛ (ka kɔn don ɲɛ).
- `jwt` — Bearer JWT don taamasiyɛn min bɛ `Authorization` kuncɛ la.
- `refresh` — Bearer JWT lakurayali taamasiyɛn.
- `admin` — JWT min ka fɔtaw bɛ `is_admin: tiɲɛ`.
- `peer-signed` — ɲinini farikolo bolonɔ bilalen bɛ peer dannamɔgɔ dɔ ka Ed25519 kilisi fɛ.
login.h2_c: Auth tier bɛ privilege dɔgɔman sariya jira: sanni ka don labanyɔrɔw dantigɛlen don kosɛbɛ jatebɔ dabɔli n’a seginni ma; fɛn o fɛn bɛ JWT kɔfɛ, o bɛ baarakɛla lakika ye; admin labanyɔrɔw bɛ badge jira UI kɔnɔ o la baara jugu bɛ kɔlɔsi.
login.h4_f:
ɲɛtaa kan : 201 + JWT anwɛlɛki (a ni sɛbɛnnikɛlan cogoya ye kelen ye) .
kan 2FA mago bɛ: 200 { "mago_2fa": tiɲɛ } (JWT tɛ fɔlɔ)
on failure: 401 { "fili":"seereya_dafabaliw" } .
login.h5_a: Standard Vortex fili enveloppe `{fili, cogoya, sira}`. `401` kan seereyaw juguw kan; `403` kan, nɛɛma dafalen tɛ; `422` ka ɲɛsin tiɲɛni ma; `429` kan hakɛ dancɛ kan; `5xx` kan kɔnɔna fili kan.

401 account_suspended jatebɔ bɛ jɔ
401 totp_required supply totp ani ka segin a kan
429 hakɛ_dan >10 cɛsiri/min/IP .

refresh.title: POST /api/dafalen/lakurayali
refresh.subtitle: Jago kɛ ni refresh JWT ye walasa ka sɔrɔ kura sɔrɔ JWT.
refresh.h1_a: Mints a fresh 15-minute access token k'a sɔrɔ a ma a ɲini baarakɛla fɛ a ka password ɲini tugun. A bɛ kɛ ni sisan dondaw taamasiyɛn bɛ ka surunya a waati la walima ni a ye 401 segin sisan.
refresh.h1_b: A bɛ dekodɔn ani ka tiɲɛni token (signature, exp, not-revoked) decode, ka don kura JWT mint ni `jti` kelen ye. Ni `ROTATE_REFRESH=tiɲɛ`, fana bɛ lakurayali kura bɔ.
refresh.h1_c: A bɛ tugu RFC 6749 OAuth 2.0 kɔ. Refresh rotation bɛ dabila ka daminɛ walasa ka boliw bali ni client caman bɛ refresh kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ.

roadmap.title: Sira-yɔrɔ-ko-sɛbɛn
roadmap.subtitle: Mun bolodara ani waati min na.
roadmap.intro: Yɔrɔ sanfɛla lajɛ. Donw ye laɲiniw ye; lakana koɲɛw bɛ kɔn ka fɛnɲɛnɛma baara ɲɛ.
roadmap.h1p1: Kyber-768 PQ bɛ se ka baara kɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye installation kura kan.
roadmap.h1p2: Jɛkulu minnu bɛ se mɔgɔ 50 000 ma ni Variant-B key bɛ bɔ.
roadmap.h1p3: Burukina Faso (Tauri) pakew macOS / Windows / Linux kama.
roadmap.h1p4: Bot sugu bɛ da mɔgɔw ɲɛ na.
roadmap.h2p1: Jɛkulu min bɛ fɔ ni mankan dɔrɔn ye, o bɛ se ka mɔgɔ 100 wele SFU fɛ.
roadmap.h2p3: Mɔgɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka mute / kick in the call UI.
roadmap.h3p1: Miro-style jɛ-ka-baara kanpaɲi CRDT (Yjs-flavoured) kan cikan-ci-yɔrɔ fɛ.
roadmap.h3p3: A bɛ taa ni a ye PNG / SVG / PDF.
roadmap.h4p1: Escrow min bɛ cakɛda kan bot sanni kama (Solana + EVM).
roadmap.h4p2: Baarakɛlaw ka sɔrɔ tilayɔrɔ, 10 %% plateforme sara.
roadmap.h4p3: Fiat on/off ramp ka tɛmɛ Stripe connect fɛ.
roadmap.h5p1: Sanfɛ sabatilen, lakana jateminɛ foroba, jɔli minnu bɛ se ka segin, SemVer frozen.
roadmap.h5p3: Lakanali yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya seginnkanni kelen ni kɔ ni foroba sɛbɛnni ye.
roadmap.h1_a: v0.2 — foroba bɔli filanan. Kyber PQ on by default, foroba so belebelebaw Variant-B fɛ, Tauri tabali pakew, bot sugu da wulilen.
roadmap.h1_b: Kyber-768 bɛ daminɛ ka kɛ enabled ye installation kura kama; kliyan minnu tɛ dɛmɛ sɔrɔ gracefully downgrade. So minnu bɛ se mɔgɔ 50 000 ma Variant-B key fɛ publish — no per-member envelope fanout on rotation. Desktop (Tauri 2 wrapper around the web client) min bɔra macOS, Windows, Linux kama ni o bundle kelen ye. Bot sugu bɛ da wuli forobaciyɛnko la ni tile 3 baarakɛdon seginnkanni ye SLA.
roadmap.h1_c: v0.2 bɛ tali kɛ primitif kɔrɔw sɛgɛsɛgɛli la sanni ka kuraw dabɔ. Kyber tun bɛ sirako kan tuma bɛɛ; jiginni ka taa default la, o bɛ bɔ sabatili la doni kɔrɔ. Tauri sugandira Electron kan bawo bundle ye ~5 MB vs ~150 MB ye. Bot sugu forobaciyɛn cikanw balila seginnkanni infrastructure kan min jigira v0.1 kɔnɔ.
roadmap.h2_a: v0.3 — kulu weleli. SFU-based audio kuluw fo ka se 100 ma; videyo kuluw fo ka se mɔgɔ 32 ma; simulcast min bɛ se ka ladamu.
roadmap.h2_b: SFU waleyali Rust kɔnɔ baarakɛcogo kama. Opus DTX + FEC + laseli kɛ waati kelen na ka ɲɛsin lamɛntaw ma. VP9 L1/L2/L3 simulcast for video ni SFU picking per-viewer layer ka da downlink fɔlen kan. Per-participant mute ani kick ka bɔ UI la. Weele sɛbɛnni (consent-gated, off by default) maralen sirilen ye weleli kelen-kelen bɛɛ jusigilan jukɔrɔ min bɛ tila lajɛdenw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ.
roadmap.h2_c: Jɛkulu weleli ye fɛn kelen ye min ɲininen don kosɛbɛ ka bɔ v0.1 beta la. SFU dilancogo bɛ tugu Jitsi Videobridge + Janus misaliw kɔ. Rust waleyali sanni ka baara kɛ ni mediasoup ye kokura bawo mediasoup ka Node.js baarakɛcogo bɛ latency fara an t'a fɛ sira funteni kan.
roadmap.h3_a: v0.4 — jɛ-ka-baara kanpaɲi. Miro-style shared board over CRDT (Yjs-flavoured) ka tɛmɛn cikan layɛrɛ kɔrɔ fɛ.
roadmap.h3_b: CRDT sɛbɛnw sinsin donsokɛw kan so cikanw kan minnu bɛ yen. Board edit kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye CRDT baarakɛcogo ye min bɛ seriyali kɛ i n’a fɔ CBOR, min sirilen don ni so key ye, min bilalen bɛ i n’a fɔ cikan min ye `kind:"board_op"` ye. Clients deserialise, ka baara kɛ, ka render kɛ. Kurukuruni sɔrɔli waati yɛrɛ la `kind:"board_cursor"` cikan suguya danfaralen fɛ. Aw bɛ a bila PNG / SVG / PDF la kliyan fan fɛ kanpaɲi jirali fɛ.
roadmap.h3_c: CRDTw (Shapiro ni a ɲɔgɔnnaw 2011) kɛra sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli ye ni Yjs ye (Kevin Jahns, 2017). Figma tɔgɔ bɔra k’u ka jɛ-ka-baara jɔ laadala CRDT ɲɔgɔnna jɔli kan. Hakilina min b’a la ka baara kɛ kokura n’an ka cikan-yɔrɔ sirilen ye sanni ka WebSocket sira danfaralenw jɔ, o bɛ bɔ sariyakolo dɔ la: bolifɛnw siraw ka dɔgɔ, buguw ka dɔgɔ.
roadmap.h4_a: v0.5 — wari sarataw. Escrow min bɛ cakɛda kan (Solana + EVM) + fiat on/off ramp Stripe Connect fɛ.
roadmap.h4_b: Bot sanni sira bɛ tɛmɛ on-chain escrow contract fɛ. Sannikɛla bɛ sɔn a ma; 24 h minɛcogo; o kɔfɛ nafolo bɛ bɔ feerekɛla la ka bɔ 10 % plateforme sara la. Kɛlɛw bɛ taa sigida kiritigɛlaw fɛ minnu sugandira staking fɛ. Fiat on-ramp: Stripe Connect ka jatew baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ walima bot feerela kelen-kelen bɛɛ; off-ramp: banki ka wari bilali tilennen walima USDC sigili. Kripto dɛmɛni: SOL, USDC, USDT Solana ni Ethereum fila bɛɛ kan.
roadmap.h4_c: Escrow smart contracts kɔrɔlen don (OpenBazaar 2016) nka hali bi u ka gɛlɛn ka da lamini na UX siratigɛ la. Vortex bɛ gɛlɛya ciyɛn ta nka a bɛ a fanba dogo — sannikɛlaw bɛ "san" butɔni dɔnta dɔ ye. Plateforme sara 10 % bɛ bɛn App Store ka bɛnkanw ma (hali n’a y’a sɔrɔ Apple bɛ 30 % ta); duguma tigɛ bɛ kɛ ni laɲini ye walasa ka feerekɛlaw sama.
roadmap.h5_a: v1.0 — sabatili. Lakanali jatebɔ, jɔli minnu bɛ se ka segin ka kɛ plateforme bɛɛ kan, SemVer frozen.
roadmap.h5_b: Mɔgɔ sabanan ka jatebɔ bolodara ka kɔn 1.0 freeze ɲɛ — a ka c’a la Trail of Bits walima NCC Group ka da jagokɛlaw ka quotations kan. Jiri minnu bɛ Se ka Lasegin, o kɔrɔ ye ko jirisun kelen bɛ binary (biti-identique) Bɔ jɔli masin fla o fla kan; o bɛ fɛnw dilancogo caman sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɔlɔsi. SemVer frozen kɔrɔ ye ko wire protocoles, storage schema, ani foroba SDK surface bɛ kɔfɛ-ɲɔgɔndan garantiw sɔrɔ 1.x kɔnɔ. Bug bounty porogaramu bɛ daminɛ ni $25k sanfɛ tier ye yɔrɔjan kode waleyali kama node kan.
roadmap.h5_c: Stabilise-audit-freeze sinsinni ye misali ye Signal, Tor, I2P, ani WireGuard bɛɛ tugura ɲɔgɔn kɔ. So jɔli minnu bɛ se ka segin ka bɔ u nɔ na, ​​olu kɛra fɛnba ye Reproducible Builds porozɛ (2014) kɔfɛ. Vortex bɛ baara kɛ ni Reproducible Builds baarakɛminɛnw ye. Bug bounties ye sariya ye poroze o poroze la min bɛ baarakɛlaw ka kunnafoniw ɲɛnabɔ; $25k ye cɛmancɛ-yɔrɔ ye san 2025 sariyaw fɛ.

  sobaw : Variant-B published key, fo ka se 50k ma

v0.4 jiginni (labɛnna):
  kanpaɲi : Yjs-dafalen CRDT, donsokɛ ka so cikanw kan
  baarakɛcogo : CBOR{v:1, op_type, laɲini, nafalan} .
  kurufe sɔrɔli : kind="board_cursor", a bɛ gazi la ka se 10 Hz ma

v0.5 jiginni (labɛnna):
  escrow : Solana porogaramu + EVM kontra, 24 h minɛ
  plateforme sara : 10 % ye fɛn bɛɛ lajɛlen na
  fiat : Stripe Connect feerekɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ
  kripto : SOL, USDC, USDT kan Solana + Ethereum kan
  sɔsɔli : sigida kiritigɛlaw, wote min bɛ kɛ ni wari ye

v1.0 lase (labɛnna):
  lakana jatebɔ : Trail de Bits walima NCC (Q3) .
  jɔli minnu bɛ Se ka Lasegin: sɔrɔyɔrɔ SHA256 → binary deterministe SHA256 .

glossary.subtitle: Daɲɛ o daɲɛ bɛ fɔ Vortex docs kɔnɔ, o sɛbɛnnen don.
glossary.intro: Alfabɛti ɲɛfɔli. Daɲɛ karti kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ bonya ka kɛ ɲɛfɔli dafalen ye, a bɛ baara kɛ yɔrɔ min na, a tariku, ani formula walima misali dɔ ni a bɛ se ka kɛ.

aead.title: AEAD Bamako
aead.subtitle: Encryption authentiquée ni Donanw ye minnu bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na.
aead.intro: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) ye cryptographie primitive ye min bɛ gundo ni dafalenya fara ɲɔgɔn kan weleli kelen kɔnɔ. Ni key, nonce, plaintext, ani optional associated data (AAD) dira a ma, a bɛ ciphertext + authentication tag dilan walasa fɛn o fɛn bɛ kɛ ni sɛbɛnni gansan, ciphertext, walima AAD ye, o tɛ se ka sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ.
aead.h1_a: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) ye cryptographie primitive ye min bɛ gundo ni dafalenya fara ɲɔgɔn kan weleli kelen kɔnɔ. Ni key, nonce, plaintext, ani optional associated data (AAD) dira a ma, a bɛ ciphertext + authentication tag dilan walasa fɛn o fɛn bɛ kɛ ni sɛbɛnni gansan, ciphertext, walima AAD ye, o tɛ se ka sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ.
aead.h1_b: Vortex ka AEAD ye AES-256-GCM ye tuma bɛɛ. AAD slot bɛ contexte ta a sɔrɔbaga ka kan ka min dɔn walasa ka decrypt ka ɲɛ (so id, file id, offset). Binding AAD bɛ cross-context replay bali — ciphertext min bɛ bɔ so A la, o tɛ se ka decrypté i n’a fɔ so B.
aead.h1_c: AEAD iko tɔgɔla fɔlɔ min bɛ tugu Rogaway 2002. GCM (Galois/Counter Mode) tun bɛ sariyasun NIST fɛ SP 800-38D (2007) kɔnɔ. A kɛra AEAD default ye TLS 1.3 kɔnɔ (RFC 8446, 2018). Bi protocol lakananen bɛɛ bɛ baara kɛ ni AEAD ye.
aead.h1_f:
AEAD.Enc(k, n, pt, aad) = (ct, tag) // ct = len(pt) bayt, tag = 16 bayt
AEAD.Dec(k, n, ct, tag, aad) = pt walima ⊥
aead.h2: Yɔrɔ min na a bɛ Kɛ Vortex .
aead.h3: Daɲɛ minnu bɛ tali Kɛ ɲɔgɔn na
aead.h3_a: AES-GCM, HKDF, min tɛ kɛ, tag

alembic.title: Alembic ye
alembic.subtitle: Donanw jiginni baarakɛminɛn ye SQLAlchemy ye.
alembic.intro: Alembic ye SQLAlchemy ka 'kɔnɔnafili-kalanbolo ye. Kɔnɔnafili kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye Python filen ye ni `upgrade()` ani `downgrade()` baarakɛcogo ye minnu bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛcogo caman ɲɛfɔ iko SQL walima ORM baarakɛcogo.
alembic.h1_a: Alembic ye SQLAlchemy ka 'kɔnɔnafili-kalanbolo ye. Kɔnɔnafili kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye Python filen ye ni `upgrade()` ani `downgrade()` baarakɛcogo ye minnu bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛcogo caman ɲɛfɔ iko SQL walima ORM baarakɛcogo.
alembic.h1_b: Vortex bɛ baara kɛ ni Alembic ye ni seginkanni tariku sinsinni ye (bolofara tɛ). `alembic upgrade head` bɛ boli Docker minɛn daminɛ bɛɛ kan. `alembic downgrade -1` bɛ segin sen kelen kan ka ɲɛsin rollback ma. Dev mode bɛ baara kɛ ni `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` ye o la sigida iterasiyɔn mago tɛ jiginniw na rebase bɛɛ kan.
alembic.h1_c: Alembic sɛbɛnna Mike Bayer fɛ (SQLAlchemy sɛbɛnbaga) san 2011 ka kɛ `sqlalchemy-migrate` nɔnabila ye. Django ka 'kɔnɔnafiliw (2014) ye juru ta modeli jɔnjɔn na. Alembic tora ɲɛfɛ fɛnw kan — rollback, autogenerate, branching — hali ni Vortex tɛ baara kɛ ni bolofara ye.

apns.title: APNw (APN) minnu bɛ yen
apns.subtitle: Apple Push Ladɔnniyali baarakɛyɔrɔ.
apns.intro: APNw ye Apple ka push-notification baarakɛminɛn ye iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS kan. Apps (porogaramuw) bɛ minɛnw token (taamaʃyɛn) sɛbɛn ani dilanbagaw bɛ kunnafoni-falen-falen-fɛnw ci APNw ma minnu b’u fanw Bɔ minɛnw na.
apns.h1_a: APNw ye Apple ka push-notification baarakɛminɛn ye iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS kan. Apps (porogaramuw) bɛ minɛnw token (taamaʃyɛn) sɛbɛn ani dilanbagaw bɛ kunnafoni-falen-falen-fɛnw ci APNw ma minnu b’u fanw Bɔ minɛnw na.
apns.h1_b: Vortex bɛ baara kɛ ni APNw ye minnu bɛ ni enveloppes sealed-push ye : node bɛ kunnafoni nafama kelen-kelen bɛɛ siri a sɔrɔbaga ka X25519 pubkey kama ; APNw bɛ blob opaque dɔrɔn de ye. iOS kliyan ka Notification Service Extension bɛ decrypt kɛ cogo wɛrɛ la sanni pankarti ka kɛ.
apns.h1_c: APNw daminɛna ni iOS 3.0 ye (2009). Sealed push / mutable content support nana ni iOS 10 (2016) ye. Token-based auth (.p8) ye certificate-based auth bila a nɔ na i n’a fɔ a daminɛcogo san 2016. Vortex bɛ baara kɛ ni token auth ye ni miniti 60 dilanbaga tokenw ye.

argon2id.title: Argon2id (Argon2id) ye
argon2id.subtitle: Hakilila-hard password hash (RFC 9106).
argon2id.intro: Argon2id ye hakilijagabɔ gɛlɛn ye, min bɛ se ka kɛ kɛrɛfɛ-kanal-kɔrɔ-kumasen-hashing baarakɛcogo ye. Paramɛtiriw : hakilijagabɔ hakɛ (m), waati musaka (iterations, t), parallelism (lanes, p), ani hash janya. ‘id’ ɲɔgɔnna bɛ tɛmɛsira minnu tɛ kunnafonidilanw na (Argon2i) ani minnu bɛ tali kɛ kunnafonidilanw na (Argon2d) olu ɲagami ɲɔgɔn na.
argon2id.h1_a: Argon2id ye hakilijagabɔ gɛlɛn ye, min bɛ se ka kɛ kɛrɛfɛ-kanal-kɔrɔ-kumasen-hashing baarakɛcogo ye. Paramɛtiriw : hakilijagabɔ hakɛ (m), waati musaka (iterations, t), parallelism (lanes, p), ani hash janya. ‘id’ ɲɔgɔnna bɛ tɛmɛsira minnu tɛ kunnafonidilanw na (Argon2i) ani minnu bɛ tali kɛ kunnafonidilanw na (Argon2d) olu ɲagami ɲɔgɔn na.
argon2id.h1_b: Vortex bɛ baara kɛ ni Argon2id ye ni m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32 ye. O bɛ ~0,5 s Kɛ iPhone X (an ka dɛmɛ-minɛn min bɛ Dɛmɛ dɔɔnin dɔɔnin) ani 5 ms ɲɔgɔn na ASIC sanfɛla la — 100× teliya tɛ foyi ye n’i y’a Jira ko SHA-256-based hashes (hashes) minnu sinsinnen bɛ SHA-256 kan, ASICw bɛ se sɔrɔ yɔrɔ minnu na ni miliyɔn caman ye.
argon2id.h1_c: Argon2 ye sebaaya Sɔrɔ 2015 sàn Password Hashing Competition la min Labɛnna Dmitry Khovratovich ni Alex Biryukov fɛ. A kɛra sariya ye iko RFC 9106 san 2021. A bɛ baara kɛ ni 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass ye. Vortex ka paramɛtɛrɛw bɛ bɔ OWASP san 2023 ladilikanw na.

a daminɛ na : m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32
musaka ye ≈ 0,5s ye iPhone X kan; ~5ms kan ASIC (100× binkannikɛla teliya)

blake3.title: BLAKE3 Bamako
blake3.subtitle: Hash cryptographique teliya la.
blake3.intro: BLAKE3 ye kriptografu hash baarakɛcogo ye min bɔra BLAKE2 ani BLAKE la. A bɛ bɔli kɛ min janya ye a yɛrɛ sago ye ka bɔ donnakow la; 10× teliya ka tɛmɛ SHA-256 kan blob belebelebaw kan k’a sababu kɛ jiri kɔnɔna hashing ye.
blake3.h1_a: BLAKE3 ye kriptografu hash baarakɛcogo ye min bɔra BLAKE2 ani BLAKE la. A bɛ bɔli kɛ min janya ye a yɛrɛ sago ye ka bɔ donnakow la; 10× teliya ka tɛmɛ SHA-256 kan blob belebelebaw kan k’a sababu kɛ jiri kɔnɔna hashing ye.
blake3.h1_b: Vortex bɛ baara Kɛ ni BLAKE3 ye dosiye dafalen kama: dosiye kelen-kelen bɛɛ min bɛ Blà, o bɛ `plain_blake3` hash ta a kɔnɔkow decrypted (daɲɛ kɔrɔfɔlenw) la walasa a sɔrɔbagaw ka Se k’a Sɛgɛsɛgɛ telesarse + decrypt kɔfɛ. DB kulu in tɔgɔ Dara tariku la ko `sha256` ka ɲɛsin jiginni bɛnkan ma nka BLAKE3 bɔli bɛ a kɔnɔ.
blake3.h1_c: BLAKE3 bɔra Jack O’Connor ni a ɲɔgɔnnaw fɛ. san 2020. A bɔra BLAKE la, o min tun ye SHA-3 laban ye san 2012. Jiri-hashing dilancogo b’a to BLAKE3 ka sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ ni cores ye walasa ka donfɛnbaw sɔrɔ. SHA-256 bɛ teliya hali bi donnafɛn misɛnninw na; BLAKE3 bɛ fanga sɔrɔ fɛn o fɛn kan > 4 KiB.
blake3.h1_f:
BLAKE3(bayiti) = 32 bayt // bɔli daminɛ
BLAKE3(bayiti, len) = len bayt (XOF) .
tɛmɛsira: ~3 GB/s kan Apple Silisiyɔmu vs SHA-256 ~500 MB/s
blake3.h2: Yɔrɔ min na a bɛ Kɛ Vortex .
blake3.h3: Daɲɛ minnu bɛ tali Kɛ ɲɔgɔn na

bmp.title: BMP Bamako
bmp.subtitle: Fiyentɔw ka lɛtɛrɛbɔlan Protocol.
bmp.intro: BMP ye Vortex ka magan-ni-ɲɛnabɔ-yɔrɔ ye min tɔgɔ ma fɔ. Cidenw bɛ blob sirilenw bila node o node la min bɛ se ka kɛ ni kumakan ye, keyed ni hash kelen ye min bɛ sɔrɔ a sɔrɔbaga ka pubkey fɛ. Blobs ride gossip fo ka se a sɔrɔbaga ka node sama.
bmp.h1_a: BMP ye Vortex ka magan-ni-ɲɛnabɔ-yɔrɔ ye min tɔgɔ ma fɔ. Cidenw bɛ blob sirilenw bila node o node la min bɛ se ka kɛ ni kumakan ye, keyed ni hash kelen ye min bɛ sɔrɔ a sɔrɔbaga ka pubkey fɛ. Blobs ride gossip fo ka se a sɔrɔbaga ka node sama.
bmp.h1_b: BMP bɛ danbe yɛrɛmahɔrɔnyalen saba di: ciden-dogo (TLS + soja sugandilen), sɔrɔbaga-dogo (mailbox_id ye opaque ye cɛmancɛ nodes fɛ), kɔnɔkow dogo (blob is already E2E-encrypted). Max blob 1 MB, node kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka fini 500 MB, wari bilali hakɛ 10/min/IP, TTL 7200 s.
bmp.h1_c: BMP dabɔra ka bɔ fɛn fɔlɔ la Vortex jɛkulu fɛ. An y’a jɔ bawo cidenba si tun tɛ sɔn ka ɛntɛrinɛti musaka sara, n’o ye ka metadata dogo laban na ka taa a laban na — u bɛ kɔnɔkow siri nka u bɛ sosiyete ka jatebɔsɛbɛn bɔ kɛnɛ kan. An jɔyɔrɔ kabini tile fɔlɔ, o tun ye ko ciden lakananen min bɛ mɔgɔ min bɛ kuma-min-ka-bɔ-mɔgɔ bɔ, o ye lakana tilancɛ dɔrɔn de ye. BMP bɛ o tilancɛ datugu ni ciden, sɔrɔbaga ani kɔnɔkow kɛli ye u yɛrɛma, u tɛ ye, Vortex yɛrɛ ka kumakan-minɛn sanfɛ sanni ka kɛ fɛnsɔrɔsiraw ye minnu bɛ bolonɔ bila.
bmp.h2: Yɔrɔ min na a bɛ Kɛ Vortex .
bmp.h3: Daɲɛ minnu bɛ tali Kɛ ɲɔgɔn na
bmp.h3_a: kumakan, soja baara, ciden sigilen, Kɔlɔn

cbor.title: CBOR Bamako
cbor.subtitle: Fɛn fila jiracogo surun.
cbor.intro: CBOR (RFC 8949) ye kunnafonidilan fila-fila ye min dabɔra kode hakɛ fitininw ni kode teliya kama. JSON ka kunnafonidilan modɛli superset, binary-encoded, strictly deterministic.
cbor.h1_a: CBOR (RFC 8949) ye kunnafonidilan fila-fila ye min dabɔra kode hakɛ fitininw ni kode teliya kama. JSON ka kunnafonidilan modɛli superset, binary-encoded, strictly deterministic.
cbor.h1_b: Vortex bɛ baara kɛ ni CBOR ye i n’a fɔ nafamafɛnw cogoya AES-GCM anwɛlɛkiw kɔnɔ. ~30 % ka dɔgɔ ni JSON ye unicode-heavy chat kan; parsing strict (yɔrɔ jɛlen tɛ) bɛ parser-differential binkanniw kɛlɛ; schema-free o la foro dɔ farali tɛ .proto recompilation wajibiya.
cbor.h1_c: CBOR tun bɛ sariyasun na iko RFC 7049 san 2013, a sɛmɛntiyalen don ka kɛ RFC 8949 ye san 2020. A bɛ baara kɛ ni Signal ye (kɔnɔna karamɔgɔya kabini san 2017), Matrix ka jamana-ɲɛnabɔli-yɔrɔ, WebAuthn (seereya fɛnw). A bɛ ta Vortex fɛ v0.0.2 kɔnɔ a kɛlen kɔ ka a suma ni JSON ni protobuf ye.
cbor.h1_f:
CBOR kodɔn : {suguya_ba (biti 3), sɔsɔli (biti 5), [data]}
karti: suguya=5 fila-fila
array: suguya=4 fɛnw
sɛbɛnni: suguya=3 bayt
bayt: suguya=2 raw
cbor.h2: Yɔrɔ min na a bɛ Kɛ Vortex .
cbor.h2_a: Cikanw ka anwɛlɛki bɛɛ, sealed-push payload bɛɛ, federasiyɔn ka anwɛlɛki bɛɛ.

controller.h1_a: Kontrɔla ye Python baarakɛcogo danfaralen ye (`vortex_controller`) min ka baara kelenpe ye ka manifesiti bolonɔbilalen (`INTEGRITY.sig.json`) ni donna URLw bɔli ye. Clients pin controller ka Ed25519 pubkey bɔli waati la.
controller.h1_b: A bɛ API yɔrɔ fitinin dɔ jira (~sira 12). O yɔrɔ fitinin ye laɲini ye — o ye binkanni laɲini ye min nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ ni kliyanw ye pinɛ kɛ siɲɛ kelen. Miirili bɛ kode kelen de baara ni bɔli kilisi kelen ye; DNS/SNS/IPFS ka filɛlikɛlanw lisɛli bɔ.

doubleRatchet.title: Ratchet fila ye
doubleRatchet.subtitle: Siginiden ka per-DM ɲɛfɛ-gundo protocol.
doubleRatchet.intro: Double Ratchet bɛ Diffie-Hellman ratchet ni simetri-key cakɛda fara ɲɔgɔn kan. Cikan kelen-kelen bɛɛ b’a ka cakɛda ɲɛtaa; waati ni waati DH sɔgɔsɔgɔninjɛw bɛ segin ka jiribolo digi. A bɛ gundo lase ɲɛfɛ (cikan tɛmɛnenw lakananen don bɛnkan kɔfɛ) ani bɛnkan kɔfɛ lakana (cikan nataw lakananen don re-ratchet kɔfɛ).
doubleRatchet.h1_a: Double Ratchet bɛ Diffie-Hellman ratchet ni simetri-key cakɛda fara ɲɔgɔn kan. Cikan kelen-kelen bɛɛ b’a ka cakɛda ɲɛtaa; waati ni waati DH sɔgɔsɔgɔninjɛw bɛ segin ka jiribolo digi. A bɛ gundo lase ɲɛfɛ (cikan tɛmɛnenw lakananen don bɛnkan kɔfɛ) ani bɛnkan kɔfɛ lakana (cikan nataw lakananen don re-ratchet kɔfɛ).
doubleRatchet.h1_b: Vortex bɛ baara kɛ ni Double Ratchet ye cikan tilennen cakɛdaw kama. Jɛkulu ka so bɛ baara kɛ ni ciden-kɔlɔsili fɛɛrɛ nɔgɔman ye min sirilen bɛ so ju la. Cakɛda janya dantigɛlen don cikan 1000 na ka sɔrɔ ka segin-ka-bɔ fanga la; skipped-key cache fo ka se cikan 1000 ma minnu tɛ sigi sen kan; kunkolo sirili kan ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye.
doubleRatchet.h1_c: Trevor Perrin ni Moxie Marlinspike ye a dilan san 2013; a bilala sen kan Siginiden 2014 kɔnɔ ; min minɛna WhatsApp fɛ (2016), Facebook gundo barow, Skype barow kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw. Public spec 2016. Vortex ka waleyali ye port tilennen ye.
doubleRatchet.h1_f:
ci cakɛda: CK_ci → HKDF(CK_ci, "sen") → CK_ci'.
                    MK → HKDF(CK_cikan, "cikan")
cakɛda min bɛ sɔrɔ: CK_recv → HKDF(CK_recv, "sen") → CK_recv'.
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(anw_eph, u_eph), RK_prev)
doubleRatchet.h2: Yɔrɔ min na a bɛ Kɛ Vortex .
doubleRatchet.h3: Daɲɛ minnu bɛ tali Kɛ ɲɔgɔn na
doubleRatchet.h3_a: ɲɛfɛ gundo, bɛnkan kɔfɛ lakana, X25519 .

ech.title: ECH Bamako
ech.subtitle: Client encrypté Bonjour (RFC 9460) ye.
ech.intro: ECH bɛ SNI (Serveur tɔgɔ jiracogo) dogo TLS 1.3 kan ni ClientHello kɔnɔna sirili ye kɛnɛma ClientHello kɔnɔ min sirilen bɛ foroba kilisi dɔ jukɔrɔ min bɔra DNS HTTPS sɛbɛn kɔnɔ.
ech.h1_a: ECH bɛ SNI (Serveur tɔgɔ jiracogo) dogo TLS 1.3 kan ni ClientHello kɔnɔna sirili ye kɛnɛma ClientHello kɔnɔ min sirilen bɛ foroba kilisi dɔ jukɔrɔ min bɔra DNS HTTPS sɛbɛn kɔnɔ.
ech.h1_b: Vortex nodew bɛ ECHConfigs bɔ u ka DNS HTTPS sɛbɛnw kɔnɔ. Client minnu bɛ ni ECH dɛmɛ ye, olu bɛ baara kɛ ni kɛnɛma jatigila tɔgɔ ye (misali la `vortex-public.cloudflare.com`) i n’a fɔ SNI yelen; kɔlɔsilikɛlaw minnu tɛ baara kɛ, olu bɛ o kɛnɛma tɔgɔ caman dɔrɔn de ye. DPI tɛ se ka Vortex kiliyan dɔ fɔ Cloudflare kiliyan wɛrɛ fɛ.
ech.h1_c: ECH tɛmɛna IETF sɛbɛn 5 fɛ ka sɔrɔ ka sariyasun sigi senkan i n’a fɔ RFC 9460 san 2024. A ɲɔgɔnna fɔlɔw: ESNI (2018-2019, bilalen), ECH sɛbɛn-00 ka se sɛbɛn-13 ma (2020-2024). Chrome ye ECH daminɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye san 2023; Firefox san 2024. Vortex b’a dɛmɛ kabini v0.0.9.
ech.h1_f:
kɛnɛma SNI: "public.cloudflare.com" ← min bɛ ye kɔlɔsilikɛlaw fɛ
kɔnɔna SNI: "node.vortex.misali" ← sirilen
ECHConfig: a bɔra DNS HTTPS sɛbɛn kɔnɔ min bɛ kɛnɛma yɔrɔ la

ed25519.title: Ed25519 ye
ed25519.subtitle: EdDSA bolonɔbila edwards25519 kan (RFC 8032).
ed25519.intro: Ed25519 ye siginiden-sɛbɛn ye min bɛ wele ko elliptic-curve signature scheme. 32-bayt foroba kilisi, 64-bayt bolonɔbila, deterministic bolonɔbila ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye. Sɛgɛsɛgɛli teliya (~200 μs bi CPU kan), a bɛ se ka sɛgɛsɛgɛ ni batch ye.
ed25519.h1_a: Ed25519 ye siginiden-sɛbɛn ye min bɛ wele ko elliptic-curve signature scheme. 32-bayt foroba kilisi, 64-bayt bolonɔbila, deterministic bolonɔbila ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye. Sɛgɛsɛgɛli teliya (~200 μs bi CPU kan), a bɛ se ka sɛgɛsɛgɛ ni batch ye.
ed25519.h1_b: Vortex bɛ bolonɔ bila federasiyɔn ka anwɛlɛki bɛɛ la, integrité manifeste bɛɛ la, node attestation bɛɛ la, ani bot cikan bɛɛ la ni Ed25519 ye. Apple ka CryptoKit min bɛ iOS 17+ kan, o bɛ baara kɛ ni RFC 8032bis suguya ye min kɛra k’a sɔrɔ a ma kɛ cogo si la; Vortex bɛ sɔn o fila la kelen ma — sɛgɛsɛgɛlikɛla o sariya labatoli bɛ o fila bɛɛ ɲɛnabɔ.
ed25519.h1_c: Ed25519 bɔra Bernstein, Duif, Lange, Schwabe, Yang fɛ san 2011. A kɛra sariya ye ko RFC 8032 san 2017. A sɔnna OpenSSH 6.5 fɛ (2014), TLS 1.3, Apple Keychain, signal-protocol. Siginiden latigɛlen sugandira k’a jɛya ECDSA kan walasa ka an yɛrɛ tanga ECDSA RNG-segin-ka-baara kɛcogo juguya kalasi ma.
ed25519.h1_f:
Taamaʃyɛn(d, m): r = SHA-512(d ∥ m) .
              R = r · G ye
              c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m) .
              S = r + c · a
              kɔsegin (R, S) .
Aw ye sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ: c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G ye

fanout.title: Fan-ka-bɔ
fanout.subtitle: Ko dɔ laseli ka bɔ yɔrɔ kelen na ka taa abonɛn caman ma.
fanout.intro: Fan-out ye fɛn dilanni cogoya ye min kɔnɔ, fɛn dilannikɛla kelen bɛ ko dɔ bɔ kɛnɛ kan, ka sɔrɔ N feerekɛlaw fɛ. Vortex ka WebSocket layɛrɛ kɔnɔ, cikan kelen POST bɛ N sosɛti ci daminɛ — kelen abonné kelen-kelen bɛɛ la so kɔnɔ.
fanout.h1_a: Fan-out ye fɛn dilanni cogoya ye min kɔnɔ, fɛn dilannikɛla kelen bɛ ko dɔ bɔ kɛnɛ kan, ka sɔrɔ N feerekɛlaw fɛ. Vortex ka WebSocket layɛrɛ kɔnɔ, cikan kelen POST bɛ N sosɛti ci daminɛ — kelen abonné kelen-kelen bɛɛ la so kɔnɔ.
fanout.h1_b: A bɛ waleya i n’a fɔ so kelen-kelen bɛɛ lajɛlen WebSocket bololanɛgɛ minnu bɛ kɔlɔsi asynci.Lock fɛ. Sɛbɛnni bɛ sɔrɔ, ka seti kopi kɛ, ka bɔ, o kɔfɛ a bɛ segin ka kopi kɛ min bɛ `ws.send_bytes(payload)` makɔnɔ ni per-socket 1 s timeout ye. Slow consumers bɛ 256-frame layidu ta sani framew ka jigin.
fanout.h1_c: Fan-out bɛ segin ka taa bɔ/abonnement sitɛmuw la san 1980 waatiw la (POP, TIBCO). Bi dilancogo (Kafka, Redis pub/sub, NATS) bɛ misali in sɛgɛsɛgɛ ka se abonɛn miliyɔn caman ma. Vortex ka so kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka hakilijagabɔ fan-out ka dɔgɔ bawo a mago tɛ cross-node replication la node kelen cogo la; Redis pub/sub bɛ baara kɛ node caman kuluw kɔnɔ.
fanout.h1_f:
broadcast(so_id, nafamafɛnw):
  subs = fanout[so_id] # O(1) dict ɲinini
  for ws in snapshot(subs): # kopi kɛ ka segin-ka-bɔnye kɛ lafiya la
      await ws.send_bytes(nafa, waati dafalen=1s)

federation.title: Fɛdɛrasiɔn
federation.subtitle: Cikan dicogo min bɛ ɲɔgɔn da ɲɔgɔn kan Vortex node yɛrɛmahɔrɔnyalenw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ.
federation.intro: Fɛderasiyɔn ye ɲɔgɔndɛmɛ ye node baarakɛla fila ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ. U kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ tɔ kelen ka Ed25519 pubkey fara a ka `federations` tabali kan. Baarakɛlaw minnu bɛ node A kan, olu bɛ se ka ci bila baarakɛlaw ma node B kan ni anwɛlɛkiw bilali ye `POST /federation/deliver` bolonɔbilalen fɛ.
federation.h1_a: Fɛderasiyɔn ye ɲɔgɔndɛmɛ ye node baarakɛla fila ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ. U kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ tɔ kelen ka Ed25519 pubkey fara a ka `federations` tabali kan. Baarakɛlaw minnu bɛ node A kan, olu bɛ se ka ci bila baarakɛlaw ma node B kan ni anwɛlɛkiw bilali ye `POST /federation/deliver` bolonɔbilalen fɛ.
federation.h1_b: Opt-in per operateur: "node si bɛ se ka federate" default tɛ yen. Peer dɔ farali bɛ operator-signed admin action de wajibiya. Kɛnɛya hakɛw (AIMD ±1) bɛ federasɔn jɔ ka ɲɛsin a filankuruw ma minnu tɛ taamacogo jugu kɛ. Outbox retries dɛsɛra deliveries ni exponential backoff fo tile 14.
federation.h1_c: Fɛderasiyɔn tun ye Matrix ka mɔgɔfagala ye (2014) ani ka kɔn o ɲɛ XMPP/Jabber (1999). Vortex ka dilancogo bɛ bɔ u fila bɛɛ la: anwɛlɛki bolonɔbilalenw (Matrix), dannaya ankɔri jɛlenw (u fila si tɛ — an ka gɛlɛn ka tɛmɛ), kɛnɛyako jatew (AIMD ka bɔ TCP la). A farala a kan v0.0.5 kɔnɔ.
federation.h2: Yɔrɔ min na a bɛ Kɛ Vortex .

fts5.h1_a: FTS5 ye SQLite ka sɛbɛn dafalen ɲinini dakun duurunan ye. A bɛ tabali virtuel dɔ Dabɔ min bɛ index tokenised mara ɲininkali teliyalenw kama LIKE / MATCH.
fts5.h1_b: Vortex bɛ sɛbɛnni gansanw taamasiyɛnw jira (client-encrypted as opaque tags) ka don FTS5 tabali virtuel kɔnɔ walasa ɲinini ka `O(log n)` gosi sanni ka `O(n)` scans kɛ. fts5.h1_c: FTS bɛ segin SQLite 3.7 (2010) kan. FTS5 cilen bɛ SQLite 3.9 kɔnɔ (2015). A bɛ tali kɛ a la kosɛbɛ; sigida-fɔlɔ cikan-porogaramu bɛɛ min bɛ iOS / Android kan, o bɛ baara kɛ n’a ye. Postgres ye `tsvector` sɔrɔ kabini san 8,3 (2008).

gossip.title: Gossip (sɔgɔsɔgɔninjɛ).
gossip.subtitle: Peer-list exchange waati ni waati Vortex nodes ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ.
gossip.intro: Gossip ye protocole ye min bɛ se ka kɛ ni bandwidth ye, n’o ye node kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ dɔnniya kuncɛlenw ɲɔgɔn falen-falen waati ni waati ni ɲɔgɔndan gansan ye. Waati tɛmɛnen kɔfɛ, node bɛɛ bɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ ka taa filɛli kelen na k’a sɔrɔ cɛmancɛ-sɛbɛn tɛ.
gossip.h1_a: Gossip ye protocole ye min bɛ se ka kɛ ni bandwidth ye, n’o ye node kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ dɔnniya kuncɛlenw ɲɔgɔn falen-falen waati ni waati ni ɲɔgɔndan gansan ye. Waati tɛmɛnen kɔfɛ, node bɛɛ bɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ ka taa filɛli kelen na k’a sɔrɔ cɛmancɛ-sɛbɛn tɛ.
gossip.h1_b: Vortex nodes bɛ kumajugu fɔ segin 60 o segin 60. Fɛnɲɛnɛma kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye Bloom filɛri ye min bɛ 256-bit, min bɛ ɲɔgɔndan dɔntaw lajɛ; fan dɔ bɛ jaabi ni ɲɔgɔndanw ye minnu tununna filɛri la ka fara a yɛrɛ ka filɛri kan. Bandwidth ye O(peers kura × 32 B), a ka c’a la, a bɛ 1 KiB jukɔrɔ round kelen na.
gossip.h1_c: Bloom-filter kumakanw bɛ daminɛ Cornell ka san 1998 bimodal multicast papier la. Apache Cassandra bɛ baara kɛ n’a ye tɔndenw ye; Bitcoin ka ɲɛsin jagokɛlaw ka relay ma; IPFS ka ɲɛsin DHT ladonni ma. O(log N) ɲɔgɔndan de b’a to a bɛ se ka kɛ rezo belebelebaw ye.
gossip.h1_f:
fɛnw falen-falen(A, B): .
  A → B: filɛri_A = bɛɛ donna(ɲɔgɔn_A, k=5, m=256)
  B → A: ɲɔgɔndan_kura_A = {p ∈ ɲɔgɔndan_B : p ∉ filɛri_A}, filɛri_B
  A bɛ bɔ o cogo kelen na
hakɛ dan : 1 ɲɔgɔn falen-falen bɛ kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ s 30 kɔnɔ

gravitix.title: Gravitix Bamako
gravitix.subtitle: Vortex ka DSL ka botw sɛbɛnni kama.
gravitix.intro: Gravitix ye kan ye min bɛ Kɛ domani kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen na min Dabɔra Vortex botw sɛbɛnni kama. Ko kɛlenw ɲɛnabɔbagaw (`on /start { emit "hi" }`), cogoya jɔlen, boilerplate fitinin. A bɛ lajɛ ka kɛ baytkode ye ani ka boli sandboxed interpreter kɔnɔ.
gravitix.h1_a: Gravitix ye kan ye min bɛ Kɛ domani kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen na min Dabɔra Vortex botw sɛbɛnni kama. Ko kɛlenw ɲɛnabɔbagaw (`on /start { emit "hi" }`), cogoya jɔlen, boilerplate fitinin. A bɛ lajɛ ka kɛ baytkode ye ani ka boli sandboxed interpreter kɔnɔ.
gravitix.h1_b: A bɛ se ka kɛ Python SDK ye. Gravitix botw tɛ se ka don filesystem walima réseau arbitral kɔnɔ — Vortex ka API surface dɔrɔn. Compiler bɛ bytecode (baytkode) Bɔ; Rust boli waati min bɛ `Gravitix/` kɔnɔ, o bɛ kɔrɔfɔ. A ɲɛfɔli dafalen bɛ Gravitix docs tilayɔrɔba kɔnɔ.
gravitix.h1_c: A dabɔra v0.0.6 waati la k’a kɔlɔsi ko bot code fanba tun ye 80 % SDK boilerplate ye ka lamini kernel fitinin dɔ la min bɛ logique lakika la. A DSL bɛ a to logique ka yeelen bɔ ani sandboxes faratiw. A ni Hubot (2011) bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na hakili la nka a bɛ ni sandboxing gɛlɛn ye ani native Vortex integration.
gravitix.h2: Yɔrɔ min na a bɛ Kɛ Vortex .

hkdf.title: HKDF Bamako
hkdf.subtitle: HMAC-based Key Derivation Baarakɛcogo (RFC 5869).
hkdf.intro: HKDF ye dakun fila ye kilisi bɔli baara ye: Extract bɛ donna kilisi fɛn digi ka kɛ kilisi pseudo-random (PRK) ye; Expand bɛ PRK kɔrɔta ka kɛ bɔli key material ye janya o janya, min bɛ danfara ni info labels ye.
hkdf.h1_a: HKDF ye dakun fila ye kilisi bɔli baara ye: Extract bɛ donna kilisi fɛn digi ka kɛ kilisi pseudo-random (PRK) ye; Expand bɛ PRK kɔrɔta ka kɛ bɔli key material ye janya o janya, min bɛ danfara ni info labels ye.
hkdf.h1_b: Vortex bɛ baara Kɛ ni HKDF-SHA256 ye yɔrɔ bɛɛ: ka X25519 gundo jɛlenw tila ka Kɛ kodɔn + MAC + kuncɛ-kɔlɔsili ye, ka per-chunk file keys Sɔrɔ, ka backup keys sɔrɔ Argon2id bɔli la. Info strings bɛ taa ni version prefix ye tuma bɛɛ (misali la "v1:encryption") o la key hierarchy bɛɛ ka se ka wuli ni v1 → v2 bumping ye.
hkdf.h1_c: Hugo Krawczyk ye a bɔ EUROCRYPT san 2010; sariyalen don i n’a fɔ RFC 5869 o san kelen in na. A bɛ baara Kɛ ni TLS 1.3 ye a ka waati bolodacogo la, Signal for Double Ratchet, WireGuard ye session keys ye.
hkdf.h1_f:
A bɔlen: PRK = HMAC-SHA256(kɔgɔ, IKM) .
A bonya: T(1) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, kunnafoni ∥ 0x01)
          T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ kunnafoni ∥ i)
          OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ ... tigɛlen ka kɛ len ye

hmac.title: HMAC Bamako
hmac.subtitle: Cikanw dantigɛli kode min sinsinnen bɛ hash kan (RFC 2104).
hmac.intro: HMAC ye jɔli ye min bɛ kriptografiki hash (SHA-256, SHA-512) fɛn o fɛn Kɛ MAC ye. A bɛ dafalenya ni tiɲɛni di ni gundo jɛlen ye.
hmac.h1_a: HMAC ye jɔli ye min bɛ kriptografiki hash (SHA-256, SHA-512) fɛn o fɛn Kɛ MAC ye. A bɛ dafalenya ni tiɲɛni di ni gundo jɛlen ye.
hmac.h1_b: Vortex bɛ baara kɛ ni HMAC-SHA256 ye HKDF kɔnɔ, JWT bolonɔbila kama (HS256), ciden_nɔgɔ bɔli kama so kɔnɔ, ani coturn TURN seereyaw bolonɔbila kama. Waati-dafalen-falen-falen bɛ wajibiya sɛgɛsɛgɛli fan fɛ — `hmac.compare_digest` Python kɔnɔ.
hmac.h1_c: HMAC daminɛna Bellare, Canetti, Krawczyk fɛ san 1996. A kɛra sariya ye i n’a fɔ RFC 2104 (1997) ani FIPS 198 (2002). A kɛra MAC default ye TLS, IPsec, SSH kɔnɔ. Siginiden, Matrix, Discord, Slack bɛɛ bɛ baara Kɛ ni HMAC-SHA256 ye u ka JWT ani session tokenw kama.
hmac.h1_f:
HMAC(kilisi, cikan) = H( (kilisi ⊕ opad) ∥ H( (kili ⊕ ipad) ∥ cikan ) )
  yɔrɔ min na opad = 0x5c segin-ka-bɔnye, ipad = 0x36 segin-segin, bloki hakɛ bɛ bɛn H ma
hmac.h2: Yɔrɔ min na a bɛ Kɛ Vortex .
hmac.h2_a: Yɔrɔ bɛɛ la kripto stack kɔnɔ. Grep ye `hmac_sha256` walima `HKDF` ye.

ice.title: ICE Bamako
ice.subtitle: Jɛɲɔgɔnya sabatili (RFC 8445).
ice.intro: ICE ye WebRTC fɛɛrɛ ye min bɛ kɛ ka rezo sira sɔrɔ ɲɔgɔndan fila ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ NAT kɔfɛ. Fɛnɲɛnɛmaw bɛ kandidaw jate (host, server-reflexive, relay), u bɛ ɲɔgɔn falen-falen, ka fila-fila lajɛ fo kelen ka se.
ice.h1_a: ICE ye WebRTC fɛɛrɛ ye min bɛ kɛ ka rezo sira sɔrɔ ɲɔgɔndan fila ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ NAT kɔfɛ. Fɛnɲɛnɛmaw bɛ kandidaw jate (host, server-reflexive, relay), u bɛ ɲɔgɔn falen-falen, ka fila-fila lajɛ fo kelen ka se.
ice.h1_b: Vortex ka node brokers ICE kandida ɲɔgɔn falen-falen WebSocket taamasiɲɛw fɛ. coturn bɛ STUN (srflx sɔrɔli kama) ani TURN (relay kama ni sira tilennenw dɛsɛra) di. HMAC seereyaw minnu bɛ mɛn waati kunkurunnin kɔnɔ, olu bɛ di weleli kelen-kelen bɛɛ la.
ice.h1_c: ICE tun bɛ sariya kɔnɔ i n’a fɔ RFC 5245 (2010) ka sɔrɔ ka lakurayali i n’a fɔ RFC 8445 (2018). Carrier-grade NAT kɔfɛ, sira tilennenw bɛ dɛsɛ ~15 % waati la — TURN relay tɛ se ka bali. WebRTC kɛra ICE kɛ fɛnba ye; videyo-wele-minɛn bɛɛ bɛ baara kɛ n’a ye.

jwt.title: JWT Bamako
jwt.subtitle: JSON Ɛntɛrinɛti taamasiyɛn (RFC 7519).
jwt.intro: JWT ye token cogoya fitinin ye min bɛ kɛ ni base64-url-encoded yɔrɔ saba ye: kunkolo, payload (claims), signature. A bɛ Kɛ ni jamana tɛ session authentication ye.
jwt.h1_a: JWT ye token cogoya fitinin ye min bɛ kɛ ni base64-url-encoded yɔrɔ saba ye: kunkolo, payload (claims), signature. A bɛ Kɛ ni jamana tɛ session authentication ye.
jwt.h1_b: Vortex bɛ baara kɛ ni HS256 (HMAC-SHA256) JWTw ye. Sɔrɔ taamasiyɛn bɛ taa ni `{sub: baarakɛla_id, jti: minɛn_id, suguya: sɔrɔli, exp}`, miniti 15 TTL. Lakurayali taamasiyɛn `suguya: lakurayali`, 30 d TTL. A bolonɔ bilalen bɛ gundo 64 kan ka bɔ `.env` la. Fɔli sensitif si tɛ user_id kɔfɛ.
jwt.h1_c: JWTw tun bɛ sariya kɔnɔ i n’a fɔ RFC 7519 (2015). OAuth 2.0 tun y’u diya kabini san 2012. Kɔrɔfɔli san tan : alg-confusion binkanniw, revocation dɛsɛ. Vortex bɛ nɔgɔya: HS256 dɔrɔn (RS/ES ɲagami tɛ), minɛn-keyed jti (min bɛ se ka wuli baarakɛla_minɛnw fɛ).
jwt.h1_f:
HEADER.PAYLOAD.SIGNATURE Bamako, Mali.
kuncɛ = basigi64url({alg: "HS256", suguya: "JWT"})
payload = base64url ({sub, jti, suguya, ɲɛfɔli})

kyber.title: Kyber-768 ye
kyber.subtitle: Kɔnɔnafili kɔfɛ (FIPS 203).
kyber.intro: Kyber-768 (officiellement ML-KEM-768) ye NIST ka standardized post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism ye. 1184-bayt foroba kilisi, 1088-bayt ciphertextes, 32-bayt gundo jɛlenw. Lakanali bɛ dɔgɔya ka se Module-LWE ma, a dalen bɛ a la ko quantum-hard.
kyber.h1_a: Kyber-768 (officiellement ML-KEM-768) ye NIST ka standardized post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism ye. 1184-bayt foroba kilisi, 1088-bayt ciphertextes, 32-bayt gundo jɛlenw. Lakanali bɛ dɔgɔya ka se Module-LWE ma, a dalen bɛ a la ko quantum-hard.
kyber.h1_b: Vortex bɛ Kyber baara ni a yɛrɛ sago ye hybride kɔnɔ: `session_key = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, info="session-v1")`. Ni tilayɔrɔba kelen kelen bɛɛ tora, o lajɛ in tɛ mɔgɔ tɔɔrɔ. Opt-in in v0.1, on-by-default labɛnna v0.2 kama. Musaka: ~2 KB faralen ɲɔgɔn kan kalansen kelen-kelen bɛɛ bolodiɲɔgɔnma; latency (latɛmɛni) min tɛ jate.
kyber.h1_c: Kyber tun ye ~70 dɔ ye min bilala NIST ka PQ ɲɛɲini na (2016). A sugandira ka kɛ sariyasun ye san 2022 zuluyekalo la; labanna ni FIPS 203 ye Awirilikalo san 2024. Chrome ye Kyber hybride baara kɛ TLS 1.3 san 2024. Signal y’a fara u ka protocole kan o san kelen in na.
kyber.h1_f:
KeyGen(): (pk ∈ Zq^k, sk ∈ Zq^k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B. Bamako, Mali
Encaps(pk): (ct ∈ Zq^k, ss ∈ {0,1}256) ct = 1088 B. Bamako, Mali
Decaps(sk,ct): ss ∈ {0,1}256. Bamako, Mali
hybride = HKDF(x25519_bɔ ∥ kyber_bɔ, "session-v1")

mailbox.title: Batakiw ciyɔrɔ
mailbox.subtitle: Jatigila-ladɛrɛsi marayɔrɔ min bɛ BMP kɔnɔ.
mailbox.intro: Laselikɛlan ye BMP ka abstraction ye "yɔrɔ min na cikanw bɛ makɔnɔni sɔrɔbaga dilen dɔ fɛ". A bɛ dɔn ni `mailbox_id` ye min bɛ bayt 32 bɔ min bɛ bɔ a sɔrɔbaga ka pubkey la HKDF fɛ.
mailbox.h1_a: Laselikɛlan ye BMP ka abstraction ye "yɔrɔ min na cikanw bɛ makɔnɔni sɔrɔbaga dilen dɔ fɛ". A bɛ dɔn ni `mailbox_id` ye min bɛ bayt 32 bɔ min bɛ bɔ a sɔrɔbaga ka pubkey la HKDF fɛ.
mailbox.h1_b: Cibaga (min bɛ recipient_pubkey dɔn) ani ciden (min b’u yɛrɛ ka pubkey dɔn) dɔrɔn de bɛ se ka mailbox_id dilen dɔ jatebɔ. Cɛmancɛ-yɔrɔw bɛ 32-byte identifier opaque dɔrɔn de Ye. Lase kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ ni TTL 7200 s ye ani a marayɔrɔ dakun ye 500 MB ye node kelen na.
mailbox.h1_c: O daɲɛ in bɔra klasiki imɛri la. BMP bɛ juru ta ntalen na nka a bɛ lɛtɛrɛbɔlan kɛ min bɔra sɔrɔbaga fɛ sanni ka kɛ baarakɛminɛn ye — "sɛbɛnnikɛlan dabɔli" sen tɛ, baarakɛla si t’a dɔn ladɛrɛsi minnu bɛ yen.
mailbox.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF(sɔrɔbaga_pubkey, kunnafoni="bmp-v1", len=32)
ciden (a bɛ recipient_pk dɔn) ni sɔrɔbaga (a yɛrɛ ka pk dɔn) dɔrɔn de bɛ se ka jatebɔ kɛ

nonce.title: Nonce (Nonce) ye
nonce.subtitle: Jate min bɛ kɛ siɲɛ kelen — o ye siɲɛ kelen nafa ye.
nonce.intro: Nonce ye nafa ye min man kan ka segin abada kilisi dilen dɔ jukɔrɔ. Vortex kɔnɔ AES-GCM baara bɛɛ bɛ baara Kɛ ni 96-bit random nonce kura ye. Ka segin ka baara kɛ ni nonce ye ni kilisi kelen ye, o bɛ gundo ni tiɲɛni tiɲɛ — binkannikɛla min ka ciphertext fila bɛ kelen jukɔrɔ (key, nonce) o bɛ se ka sɛbɛn gansanw XORw sɔrɔ.
nonce.h1_a: Nonce ye nafa ye min man kan ka segin abada kilisi dilen dɔ jukɔrɔ. Vortex kɔnɔ AES-GCM baara bɛɛ bɛ baara Kɛ ni 96-bit random nonce kura ye. Ka segin ka baara kɛ ni nonce ye ni kilisi kelen ye, o bɛ gundo ni tiɲɛni tiɲɛ — binkannikɛla min ka ciphertext fila bɛ kelen jukɔrɔ (key, nonce) o bɛ se ka sɛbɛn gansanw XORw sɔrɔ.
nonce.h1_b: Vortex bɛ nonces (nonces) lawuli ni OS CSPRNG (`gundo.token_bytes`, `SecRandom`, `java.security.SecureRandom`) ye. Birthday bound with 96 bits: ~2^32 cikanw sanni ɲɔgɔndan ka kɛ dannaya ye, o ka ca kosɛbɛ ka tɛmɛ so kilisi bɛɛ bɛ min ye a ka ɲɛnamaya kɔnɔ. Lafasali duplicate-nonce tracking kan node kan iko cɛsirilan-ni-suspenders.
nonce.h1_c: Nonce hakilina ye kɔrɔlen ye kriptografi la; daɲɛ yɛrɛ bɔra tubabukan kɔrɔ la "for the once". GCM ka 96-bit ladilikan bɔra NIST SP 800-38D la. Adobe 2013 sariya tiɲɛni tɔgɔ bɔra kosɛbɛ ka sɛbɛnni jɛlenw sɔrɔ ka bɔ nonces segin-seginlenw na kliyan fan fɛ RSA.

P(boli) ni 109 AES-GCM nonces = ~10−19
wolodon sirilen : ɲɔgɔndan fɔlɔ bɛ makɔnɔn 248 nonces lamini na key kelen na
GCM lakana: 232 nonces randomes per key sanni siri ka tiɲɛ

ohttp.title: OHTTP Bamako
ohttp.subtitle: Oblivious HTTP (RFC 9458) Bamako, Mali.
ohttp.intro: OHTTP ye protocole ye min bɛ kɛ ka HTTP ɲininiw lase mɔgɔw ma, yɔrɔ min na mɔgɔ kelen tɛ ɲinini ni jaabi fila bɛɛ ye. Client bɛ ci bila relay fɛ min bɛ strips identifying headers; relay bɛ taa ɲɛfɛ ka taa da la min bɛ decrypt ani ka jaabi di.
ohttp.h1_a: OHTTP ye protocole ye min bɛ kɛ ka HTTP ɲininiw lase mɔgɔw ma, yɔrɔ min na mɔgɔ kelen tɛ ɲinini ni jaabi fila bɛɛ ye. Client bɛ ci bila relay fɛ min bɛ strips identifying headers; relay bɛ taa ɲɛfɛ ka taa da la min bɛ decrypt ani ka jaabi di.
ohttp.h1_b: Vortex bɛ baara kɛ ni OHTTP ye i n’a fɔ Layer-5 sonyali-fallback. Ni a farala ɲɔgɔn kan ni soja baara ye ani BMP, OHTTP bɛ sira laban di ni TLS datugulen don pewu. Relay ye dannaya-yɔrɔ ye min faralen don ɲɔgɔn kan (a ka c’a la Cloudflare walima Apple ka danbe-relay infrastructure).
ohttp.h1_c: OHTTP tun bɛ sariyasunba la iko RFC 9458 san 2024, a sɛbɛnna Cloudflare, Apple, Mozilla fɛ. Apple ka iCloud Private Relay (2021) ye OHTTP-kɛrɛfɛ-baarakɛcogo fɔlɔ ye. Vortex ye OHTTP fallback dɛmɛ fara a kan v0.0.9 kɔnɔ.

relay → gateway: ɲɛfɛ, ka kiliyanw dɔnni kuncɛw bɔ
gateway → jaabi: decrypt, baarakɛcogo, Encrypt_client_pub(jaabi) .
relay → client: ka ɲɛsin jaabi ma

onion.title: Soja baara
onion.subtitle: Tor baara dogolen.
onion.intro: Soja baara ye TCP baara ye min bɛ se ka sɔrɔ Tor ka ɲɔgɔnye protocol fɛ. A bɛ dɔn ni soja ladɛrɛsi ye (daɲɛ 56 basigilen32 min bɛ Ed25519 pubkey kan v3 kan). Foroba IP tɛ, DNS tɛ, cɛmancɛ sɛbɛnnikɛlan tɛ yen.
onion.h1_a: Soja baara ye TCP baara ye min bɛ se ka sɔrɔ Tor ka ɲɔgɔnye protocol fɛ. A bɛ dɔn ni soja ladɛrɛsi ye (daɲɛ 56 basigilen32 min bɛ Ed25519 pubkey kan v3 kan). Foroba IP tɛ, DNS tɛ, cɛmancɛ sɛbɛnnikɛlan tɛ yen.
onion.h1_b: Vortex node bɛɛ b'a yɛrɛ Jira i n'a fɔ `.soja` ka Fàra a labanyɔrɔ HTTPS nɔrɔlen kan. Tor dɛmɛ bɛ kiliyan minnu na, olu bɛ bin ka se soja ma ni fɛn tɔw bɛɛ ma ɲɛ. Bandwidth bɛ ~10× dɔɔnin dɔɔnin nka a bɛ se ka sɔrɔ rezow kɔnɔ minnu dantigɛlen don kosɛbɛ.
onion.h1_c: Soja baara bɛ daminɛ Tor 2004 (v1) la. A jɔra kokura i n’a fɔ v3 soja baarakɛlaw san 2017 ni Ed25519 kilisi ye. SecureDrop, New York Times, Facebook, ProPublica, olu bɛɛ bɛ baara kɛ ni jɛkulubaw ye minnu bɛ kripto dɔn. Siginiden ye soja-baara-ci fara a kan san 2022.

prekey.title: Prekey (kɔlɔsili) ye
prekey.subtitle: Ephemeral pubkey bɔra ka kɔn waati ɲɛ ka ɲɛsin bootstrap ma DM kuraw kama.
prekey.intro: Prekey ye X25519 keypair ye min bɛ bɔ node la ka kɔn mago ɲɛ walasa mɔgɔ kuraw ka se ka baro sirilenw daminɛ k’a sɔrɔ u ma taa ni segin. Baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ batɛmu dɔ Blà (10 prekeys by default); sèrvèr bɛ baara Kɛ u ye ni ɲinini ye; kliyan bɛ upload caman kɛ ni a dɔgɔyara.
prekey.h1_a: Prekey ye X25519 keypair ye min bɛ bɔ node la ka kɔn mago ɲɛ walasa mɔgɔ kuraw ka se ka baro sirilenw daminɛ k’a sɔrɔ u ma taa ni segin. Baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ batɛmu dɔ Blà (10 prekeys by default); sèrvèr bɛ baara Kɛ u ye ni ɲinini ye; kliyan bɛ upload caman kɛ ni a dɔgɔyara.
prekey.h1_b: Vortex ka prekey bundle bɛ bolonɔ bila minɛn in ka identité key kuntaalajan fɛ walasa binkannikɛla kana se ka prekey forged ɲɔgɔn falen hali ni node-level access ye. DM kuraw bɛ Diffie-Hellman round kelen kɛ ka prekey kura kɛlɛ sanni Double Ratchet ka don.
prekey.h1_c: Prekeys bɔra Signal ka san 2013 protocol design (X3DH) la. Sani X3DH ka se, bootstrap sirilen tun bɛ taa ni segin-ka-bɔ-ɲɔgɔn na — a man ɲi cikanw cili ma ɲɔgɔn fɛ. Bi ciden lakananen bɛɛ bɛ baara kɛ ni prekey-style bootstrap ye.
prekey.h1_f:
bundle = { .
  identité_pk, Bamako, Mali.
  bolonɔbila_prekey_pk, .
  signed_prekey_sig = Ed25519-Sign(identité_priv, bolonɔbila_prekey_pk),
  siɲɛ kelen_kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la: [pk_0, pk_1, ..., pk_9] .
} .

reality.title: Tiɲɛni
reality.subtitle: TLS-kɔnɔ-TLS masquerade sonyali bolifɛn.
reality.intro: Tiɲɛ ye sonyali bolifɛn ye min bɛ a yɛrɛ kɛ TLS ye ka taa tekinolojiba bɔyɔrɔ lakika la (a ka c’a la www.microsoft.com). Kɛnɛma boloci laɲiniw Microsoft; kɔnɔna bolonɔbila ye Vortex ye. Sonde active minnu ɲɛsinnen bɛ kɛnɛma ma, olu bɛ taa ɲɛfɛ ka taa bɔyɔrɔ yɛrɛ la o la sonda tɛ foyi jira.
reality.h1_a: Tiɲɛ ye sonyali bolifɛn ye min bɛ a yɛrɛ kɛ TLS ye ka taa tekinolojiba bɔyɔrɔ lakika la (a ka c’a la www.microsoft.com). Kɛnɛma boloci laɲiniw Microsoft; kɔnɔna bolonɔbila ye Vortex ye. Sonde active minnu ɲɛsinnen bɛ kɛnɛma ma, olu bɛ taa ɲɛfɛ ka taa bɔyɔrɔ yɛrɛ la o la sonda tɛ foyi jira.
reality.h1_b: Vortex bɛ Reality dɛmɛ i n’a fɔ Level-4 pluggable transport. Config bɛ masquerade laɲini, ID surunw, ani Vortex X25519 foroba kilisi jira. Server bɛ kliyan minnu bɛ na, olu tiɲɛ ni surun-ID ɲɔgɔndan ye; sonda minnu tɛ bɛn ɲɔgɔn ma, olu bɛ jaabiw sɔrɔ bɔyɔrɔ lakikaw la.
reality.h1_c: Tiɲɛ bɔra san 2022 k’a kɛ jaabi ye Siniwajamana ka tasuma-fanga-minɛnba ka TLS-based transports kɔrɔw (V2Ray ka VMess, Trojan) kɔlɔsili la. XrayCore ye a ta san 2023. Vortex ye dɛmɛ fara v0.0.9 kan.

rbac.title: RBAC Bamako
rbac.subtitle: Jɛkulu ka donko kɔlɔsili min sinsinnen bɛ jɔyɔrɔ kan.
rbac.intro: RBAC ye don-kɔlɔsili misali ye min kɔnɔ yamaruyaw bɛ di jɔyɔrɔw ma ani baarakɛlaw bɛ jɔyɔrɔw di u ma. Vortex bɛ baara kɛ ni RBAC saba ye so kelen kɔnɔ: tigi > ɲɛmɔgɔ > mɔgɔ.
rbac.h1_a: RBAC ye don-kɔlɔsili misali ye min kɔnɔ yamaruyaw bɛ di jɔyɔrɔw ma ani baarakɛlaw bɛ jɔyɔrɔw di u ma. Vortex bɛ baara kɛ ni RBAC saba ye so kelen kɔnɔ: tigi > ɲɛmɔgɔ > mɔgɔ.
rbac.h1_b: Cascade: tigiw bɛ ni admin fanga bɛɛ ye ka fara se kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen kan ka so bɔ walima ka tigiya wuli. Admins bɛ wele, ka kick, mute, ka so sigicogo sɛgɛsɛgɛ. Mɔgɔw ​​bɛ cikanw ci, ka jaabi di, k’u yɛrɛ ka cikanw ladilan. Jɛkulu jɔyɔrɔ caman yeli bɛ sɛbɛn i n’a fɔ sistɛmu cikanw walasa tɔnden bɛɛ k’u ye.
rbac.h1_c: RBAC iko modɛli foroba la, o bɛ daminɛ NIST ka san 1992 sɛbɛn na min sɛbɛnna Ferraiolo & Kuhn fɛ. A kɛra fɛnba ye baarakɛda IAM (AWS, Azure) la san 2010 waatiw la. So-dakun RBAC ye sariya ye barokɛminɛnw na — IRC ka ops/voice/user (1988), Discord jɔyɔrɔw (2015), Slack ka admin/member/guest.

transfert: tigi bɛ new_owner_id sigi → tigi kɔrɔ jiginna ka kɛ admin ye
revoke: admin bɛ se ka tɔnden dɔ jigin; tigi bɛ se ka admin dɔ demote

sfu.title: SFU Bamako
sfu.subtitle: Selective Forwarding Unit (Sɛbɛnni min bɛ kɛ ka ɲɛsin mɔgɔw ma.
sfu.intro: SFU ye cɛmancɛ-kɛsu ye min bɛ kunnafonidilanw ɲagami kulu weleli la. Lajɛden kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ 'sèn kelen Blà; SFU b'a ci tɔw ma. A bɛ topidiya dafalen-mesh (peer kelen-kelen bɛɛ kode N-1 streams) nɔ na, ​​yɔrɔ min na scaling ye O(N2) ye.
sfu.h1_a: SFU ye cɛmancɛ-kɛsu ye min bɛ kunnafonidilanw ɲagami kulu weleli la. Lajɛden kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ 'sèn kelen Blà; SFU b'a ci tɔw ma. A bɛ topidiya dafalen-mesh (peer kelen-kelen bɛɛ kode N-1 streams) nɔ na, ​​yɔrɔ min na scaling ye O(N2) ye.
sfu.h1_b: Vortex ka SFU bɛ waleya Rust kɔnɔ baarakɛcogo kama. Simulcast-aware : welebaga kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ ɲɛnabɔli saba kodɔn ɲɔgɔn fɛ; SFU bɛ min bɛnnen ta filɛlikɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka jiginɛ min fɔra. Lamɛnni dɔrɔn kuluw bɛ se mɔgɔ 100 ma; wideyow kuluw fo ka se mɔgɔ 32 ma (v0.3 sirako).
sfu.h1_c: SFU jɔli daminɛna Jitsi ka Videobridge (2013) la. Sani SFU ka kɛ, WebRTC kulu weleli tun ye dafalen ye. Zoom, Google Meet, Jitsi, Signal kulu weleli bɛɛ bɛ baara kɛ ni SFU ye. Vortex lamɛntaw dɔrɔn kulu minnu bɛ ci v0.0.8 kɔnɔ.
sfu.h1_f:
mesh dafalen (N peers): kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ N-1 jikuruw ci → O(N2) uplink
SFU (N ɲɔgɔnna): kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ 1 stream → O(N) uplink ci ɲɔgɔndan kelen-kelen bɛɛ ma
simulcast: L1 (dɔgɔman) + L2 (cɛmancɛ) + L3 (sanfɛ) kodɔnni minnu bɛ kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ
SFU bɛ layɛrɛ ta filɛlikɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ la ka da BWE-raported downlink kan
