snowflake.title: Sɛgɛsɛgɛli
snowflake.subtitle: Tor volontaire-relay transport ka tɛmɛ WebRTC kan.
snowflake.intro: Snowflake ye Tor Project ka bolifɛn ye min bɛ se ka don a kɔnɔ, yɔrɔ min na, navigatɔrɔw bɛ baara kɛ i n’a fɔ WebRTC relays. Baarakɛlaw bɛ navigatɔrɔn dɔ sigi sen kan ani u ka navigatɔrɔ bɛ kɛ relay ye k’a sɔrɔ u ka tab da wulilen don.
snowflake.h1_a: Snowflake ye Tor Project ka bolifɛn ye min bɛ se ka don a kɔnɔ, yɔrɔ min na, navigatɔrɔw bɛ baara kɛ i n’a fɔ WebRTC relays. Baarakɛlaw bɛ navigatɔrɔn dɔ sigi sen kan ani u ka navigatɔrɔ bɛ kɛ relay ye k’a sɔrɔ u ka tab da wulilen don.
snowflake.h1_b: Vortex bɛ sɔn Snowflake ma i n’a fɔ Layer-4 fallback ni TLS ni transport fɔlɔw datugulen don. No infra required on our side — an mago bɛ Snowflake bridges dɔrɔn de la minnu bɔra yɔrɔ lakodɔnnenw na. Volontaires minnu bɛ extension boli, olu bɛ cover di.
snowflake.h1_c: Snowflake daminɛna san 2020 i n’a fɔ Tor Project ka obfs4 nɔnabila (min tun kɛra bolokɔfɛfɛnw ye). WebRTC bolifɛnw bali ka gɛlɛn bawo n’i y’o kɛ, o bɛna wideyo weleli sariyalen caman tiɲɛ. Vortex ye dɛmɛ fara a kan v0.0.9 kɔnɔ.
snowflake.h1_f:
client → Snowflake broker: "Ne mago bɛ proxy la".
broker bɛ bɛn ni volontaire browser bolicogo extension ye
ŋaniyajirabaga → Tor don: a bɛ kiliyanw ka taamaw ci ka tɛmɛ WebRTC kan .
nafa : WebRTC sirako bɛ yɔrɔ bɛɛ; balili bɛ videyo weleli tiɲɛ
snowflake.h2: Yɔrɔ min na a bɛ Kɛ Vortex .
snowflake.h3: Daɲɛ minnu bɛ tali Kɛ ɲɔgɔn na
snowflake.h3_a: Tor, bolifɛn min bɛ se ka don a la, WebRTC, obfs4

tls13.title: TLS 1.3
tls13.subtitle: Transport Layer Security, a bɔko 1.3 (RFC 8446).
tls13.intro: TLS 1.3 ye TLS protocole sisan ye. A bɛ primitives lakananenw bɔ yen (RSA key exchange, CBC MACs, static ECDH), a bɛ bolonɔbila nɔgɔya ka taa ni segin kelen ye, ka gundo bila ɲɛfɛ.
tls13.h1_a: TLS 1.3 ye TLS protocole sisan ye. A bɛ primitives lakananenw bɔ yen (RSA key exchange, CBC MACs, static ECDH), a bɛ bolonɔbila nɔgɔya ka taa ni segin kelen ye, ka gundo bila ɲɛfɛ.
tls13.h1_b: HTTPS + WSS + federasɔn jὲɲɔgɔnya bɛɛ min bɛ Vortex kɔnɔ, o bɛ baara Kɛ ni TLS 1.3 ye. An bɛ Chrome 120 ka ClientHello ni bayt-ni-bayt bɛn o la DPI kana se ka bolonɔbila kɛ an na iko navigatɔrɔn tɛ. ECH (encrypté SNI) ye opt-in ye kɛnɛma-SNI config fɛ.
tls13.h1_c: TLS 1.3 kɛra sariya ye iko RFC 8446 san 2018 Awirilikalo la san 4 ni sɛbɛn 28 kɔfɛ. Chrome, Firefox, Safari ye dɛmɛ ci san 2018. Microsoft y’a fara Windows kan san 2020. San 2022 a kɛra ɛntɛrinɛti taama fanba ye.
tls13.h1_f:
bololabaara (1-RTT): .
  Client → Server: ClientHello (kilisi_jatebɔ, SNI?, ALPN, ...)
  Server → Client: ServerHello + EncryptedExtensions + Sɛbɛn + SɛbɛnniSɛgɛsɛgɛli + A dafara
  Client → Server: A dafara + Aplikasiɔn ka kunnafoniw
tls13.h2: Yɔrɔ min na a bɛ Kɛ Vortex .
tls13.h2_a: Jɛɲɔgɔnya TLS bɛɛ. Bololabaarakɛlaw ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔli `app/transport/stealth_level1.py` kɔnɔ.
tls13.h3: Daɲɛ minnu bɛ tali Kɛ ɲɔgɔn na
tls13.h3_a: ECH, TLS bolokɔnincinin, JA4, ɲɛfɛ gundo

totp.title: TOTP Bamako
totp.subtitle: Waati kelen-kelen ka tɔgɔlasɛbɛn (RFC 6238).
totp.intro: TOTP ye siɲɛ kelen daɲɛ ye min bɛ bɔ gundo jɛlen dɔ la ani waati min bɛ sen na sisan. Paramɛtiriw dafalenw: waati taabolo segin 30, kode 6, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_a: TOTP ye siɲɛ kelen daɲɛ ye min bɛ bɔ gundo jɛlen dɔ la ani waati min bɛ sen na sisan. Paramɛtiriw dafalenw: waati taabolo segin 30, kode 6, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_b: Vortex ka 2FA bɛ baara kɛ ni TOTP ye ni RFC defaults ye. Baarakɛlaw bɛ QR dɔ skan u tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni waati; kode min bɔra u ka Authenticator app kɔnɔ, o bɛ bɛn sèrwɛri ka kode makɔnɔnen ma. A hakɛ dan ye 5 ye miniti 5 kɔnɔ baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ la.
totp.h1_c: TOTP (RFC 6238, 2011) min sɛbɛnna Mark Pei fɛ min jɔra HOTP kan (RFC 4226, 2005). Sani o ka Kɛ, RSA SecurID tùn bɛ baara Kɛ ni 'algoritmɛ ye min ye a yɛrɛ ta ye. Google Authenticator (2010) ye TOTP ye min bɛ fɔ kosɛbɛ; 2FA app bɛɛ bɛ baara kɛ n'a ye sisan.
totp.h1_f:
TOTP(k, t) = HOTP(k, ⌊t / 30⌋) Bamako, Mali.
HOTP(k, c) = tigɛ( HMAC-SHA1(k, c) ) mod 106
finɛtiri : ±1 sen bɛ muɲu waati sɛgɛsɛgɛli la
totp.h2: Yɔrɔ min na a bɛ Kɛ Vortex .
totp.h3: Daɲɛ minnu bɛ tali Kɛ ɲɔgɔn na

turn.title: TURN Bamako
turn.subtitle: Traversal Baara kɛli ni Relays ye NAT lamini na (RFC 8656).
turn.intro: TURN ye protocole ye min bɛ UDP / TCP taamasiyɛnw lase foroba baarakɛminɛn dɔ fɛ ni ɲɔgɔndan sira tilennenw ma ɲɛ. A bɛ Kɛ i n'a fɔ kɔsegin sira ni ICE ka jatigila ni sèrwɛri-reflexif kandidaw ma baara Kɛ.
turn.h1_a: TURN ye protocole ye min bɛ UDP / TCP taamasiyɛnw lase foroba baarakɛminɛn dɔ fɛ ni ɲɔgɔndan sira tilennenw ma ɲɛ. A bɛ Kɛ i n'a fɔ kɔsegin sira ni ICE ka jatigila ni sèrwɛri-reflexif kandidaw ma baara Kɛ.
turn.h1_b: Vortex bɛ coturn misali dɔ ci ni node bɛɛ ye. Sɛbɛnw tɛ mɛn (24 h), HMAC-bolonɔ bilalen bɛ, u bɛ di weleli kelen-kelen bɛɛ la. Ni NAT tɛmɛsira ma ɲɛ — a ka c’a la, simetriki NAT walima tasuma-fanga-minɛn gɛlɛn kɔfɛ — weleli kunnafonidilan bɛɛ bɛ tɛmɛ TURN fɛ.
turn.h1_c: TURN fɔlɔ kɛra sariyasun ye i n’a fɔ RFC 5766 (2010), a sɛmɛntiyalen don ka kɛ RFC 8656 (2020) ye. A bɛ baara kɛ ni WebRTC bilali bɛɛ ye ~15 % weleli la sira tilennenw bɛ dɛsɛ yɔrɔ minnu na. coturn ye reference da wulilen waleyali ye.
turn.h1_f:
baarakɛla tɔgɔ = "{expiry_unix}:{baarakɛla_id}".
password = base64(HMAC-SHA1(sɛrɛkili_gundo, baarakɛla tɔgɔ))
TTL = lɛrɛ 24 kɔnɔ
coturn bɛ HMAC tiɲɛ AUTH kelen-kelen bɛɛ kan; bɛ ban waati tɛmɛnen kɔfɛ
turn.h2: Yɔrɔ min na a bɛ Kɛ Vortex .
turn.h3: Daɲɛ minnu bɛ tali Kɛ ɲɔgɔn na

vapid.title: VAPID Bamako
vapid.subtitle: Aplikasi Server Identification (RFC 8292) min bɛ kɛ ni ŋaniya ye.
vapid.intro: VAPID ye Ed25519 kilisi fila ye, baarakɛminɛn dɔ bɛ baara kɛ ni min ye walasa k’a yɛrɛ jira Web Push dilanbagaw la. A bɛ "jɔnni bɛ se ka push ci" ɲininkali bɔ Web Push bilali la.
vapid.h1_a: VAPID ye Ed25519 kilisi fila ye, baarakɛminɛn dɔ bɛ baara kɛ ni min ye walasa k’a yɛrɛ jira Web Push dilanbagaw la. A bɛ "jɔnni bɛ se ka push ci" ɲininkali bɔ Web Push bilali la.
vapid.h1_b: Vortex ka web kliyan bɛ abonné kɛ Web Push la ni node ka VAPID foroba kilisi ye. Payloads bɛ siri ni sealed-push key danfaralen ye (p256dh) abonné kelen-kelen bɛɛ la. Yɛlɛma: VAPID kilisi bɛ mɛn nka bolonɔbila nafamafɛnw bɛ waati surun JWT cogo la.
vapid.h1_c: VAPID tun bɛ sariya kɔnɔ i n’a fɔ RFC 8292 san 2017. Sani VAPID ka se, Web Push tun bɛ FCM-brokered abonnés walima auth mechanism danfaralen de wajibiya. VAPID bɛ yɛrɛ-jatigila baarakɛcogo nɔgɔya — Firebase porozɛ si mago tɛ.
vapid.h2: Yɔrɔ min na a bɛ Kɛ Vortex .
vapid.h2_a: `app/services/sealed_push.py::web_push`, min bɔra kunnafonidila `/v1/health` fɛ walasa ka bana sɛgɛsɛgɛ.
vapid.h3: Daɲɛ minnu bɛ tali Kɛ ɲɔgɔn na
vapid.h3_a: Web Push, puse sirilen, Ed25519, JWT Bamako, Mali.

waf.title: WAF Bamako
waf.subtitle: Web Aplikasi Firewall (Fɛɛrɛbɔlan) min bɛ wele ko Firewall.
waf.intro: WAF ye cɛmancɛ-minɛn ye min bɛ HTTP ɲininiw sɛgɛsɛgɛ ani ka misali juguw dɔntaw bali (SQL pikiri, sira tɛmɛni, jatebɔlan pikiri) sanni u ka se baarakɛminɛn kode ma.
waf.h1_a: WAF ye cɛmancɛ-minɛn ye min bɛ HTTP ɲininiw sɛgɛsɛgɛ ani ka misali juguw dɔntaw bali (SQL pikiri, sira tɛmɛni, jatebɔlan pikiri) sanni u ka se baarakɛminɛn kode ma.
waf.h1_b: Vortex ka WAF bɛ baara kɛ i n'a fɔ `app/security/middleware.py::WAFMiddleware`. ~50 regex sɛgɛsɛgɛliw kɛli URL, ɲininkali, farikolo. Bloki `UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$yɔrɔ`, dɔntaw XSS misaliw. A fana bɛ diɲɛ hakɛ dantigɛliw (1000 req/s), sira kelen-kelen dantigɛliw (donni 10/min, sɛbɛnni 5/min), baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ dantigɛliw waleya.
waf.h1_c: WAFw bɛ daminɛ mod_security (2002) la. Cloudflare ka WAF (2014) ye misali in kɛ jagofɛn ye. Bi ɛntɛrinɛti-kalansen bɛɛ bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛliw kulu dɔ ci. Vortex ka regex lisi labɛnna ka bɔ OWASP Top 10 bolonɔbilalenw na.
waf.h1_f:
ɲinini bɛɛ kan:
  ka ɲɛsin misali ma SQLI_PATTERNS kɔnɔ: ni misali.ɲini(url + ɲininkali + farikolo): ban
  ka ɲɛsin misali ma TRAVERSAL kɔnɔ: ni misali.ɲini(url): ban
  for pattern in TEMPLATE: ni misali.ɲini(farikolo): ban
hakɛ-dan min bɛ kɛ ni (IP, sira, baarakɛla_id) ye .
waf.h2: Yɔrɔ min na a bɛ Kɛ Vortex .
waf.h3: Daɲɛ minnu bɛ tali Kɛ ɲɔgɔn na
waf.h3_a: hakɛ dantigɛli, jatebɔ sɛbɛn, OWASP, SQL pikiri

x25519.title: X25519 Bamako
x25519.subtitle: Diffie-Hellman ka kurukuru eliptiki ka tɛmɛ Kuru25519 kan (RFC 7748).
x25519.intro: X25519 ye Diffie-Hellman ye min bɛ Kɛ ni kurukurunin ye min bɛ Kuru25519 kan a ka Montgomery cogo la. 32-bayt kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen ni foroba kilisi, 32-bayt jɛlen gundo. A bɛ kɛ ka bɛnkan kunbabaw kɛ.
x25519.h1_a: X25519 ye Diffie-Hellman ye min bɛ Kɛ ni kurukurunin ye min bɛ Kuru25519 kan a ka Montgomery cogo la. 32-bayt kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen ni foroba kilisi, 32-bayt jɛlen gundo. A bɛ kɛ ka bɛnkan kunbabaw kɛ.
x25519.h1_b: Minɛn statiki identité bɛɛ, session key ephemeral bɛɛ, sealed-push abonné bɛɛ Vortex kɔnɔ bɛ baara kɛ ni X25519 ye. Montgomery-ladder waleyali ye waati basigilen ye ani a lakananen don kɛrɛfɛ-kanali binkanniw kalasi la minnu tun bɛ kuru fɔlɔw tɔɔrɔ.
x25519.h1_c: Curve25519 bɔra Bernstein fɛ (2005); sariyalen don i n’a fɔ RFC 7748 (2016) ni tɔgɔ X25519 ye DH suguya la. A bɛ tali kɛ Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard, Apple iMessage, Chrome (post-quantum hybride) fɛ. A bɛ yɔrɔ bɛɛ la bi kriptografi kɛcogo la.
x25519.h1_f:
kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la: a ∈ [0, 2255) (32 bayt fitinin-endian, clamped)
forobaciyɛn : A = a · G (32-byte compressed point) .
tilalen : s = a · B = b · A (bayiti 32, → HKDF donna) .
baarakɛcogo: ~100 μs DH kelen na iPhone 11 kan
x25519.h2: Yɔrɔ min na a bɛ Kɛ Vortex .
x25519.h3: Daɲɛ minnu bɛ tali Kɛ ɲɔgɔn na
x25519.h3_a: Ed25519, HKDF, Curve25519, Siginidenw ka protocole

websocketFanout.title: WebSocket fan-out kɔnɔnafɛnw
websocketFanout.subtitle: Node kelen bɛ ko dɔ Lase cogo min na abonnés ba caman ma.
websocketFanout.what: WebSocket fan-out ye Python-native set ye min bɛ abonnés bololanɛgɛw sɔrɔ so kelen kɔnɔ. Ni cikan dɔ bilala POST la, fan-out dispatcher bɛ iterate set ani ka serialized frame enqueued abonné kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka cikan layini kan.
websocketFanout.why: Fan-out bɛ a yɛrɛ tanga N-kopi musaka ma min bɛ bɔ kunnafonidi la: decryption kelen cibaga fan fɛ, frame serialized kelen, N send-queue pushes. Puse kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye O(1) ye; kopi musaka bɛ gɛrɛ kernel kan `send()` waati la zeru-kopi buffers fɛ ni OS b'u dɛmɛ.
websocketFanout.where: A bɛ waleya `app/chats/fanout.py` kɔnɔ. Sanfɛla `FanoutRegistry` bɛ `dict[room_id, set[WebSocket]]` minɛ. Sɛbɛnniw bɛ kɔlɔsi ni `asyncio.Lock` ye; kalanw ye ja minnu tɛ datugu.
websocketFanout.how: Cikan POST kan, routeur bɛ wele ko `await fanout.broadcast(room_id, payload_bytes)`. Fɛɛrɛ bɛ seti kopi kɛ dakun jukɔrɔ, ka bɔ, o kɔfɛ ka kopi min bɛ `ws.send_bytes(payload)` makɔnɔ, a bɛ segin o kan ni segin 1 waati dafalen ye sosɛti kelen-kelen bɛɛ la. Sosɛti minnu waati tɛmɛna, olu taamasiyɛn bɛ kɛ ko jugu ani u saniyalen don.
websocketFanout.when: Cikan, jaabi, kalan-sɔrɔ, sɛbɛnni jiralan, weleli taamasiyɛn, ani so kilisi jiginni bɛɛ bɛ woyo nin fan-out kelen in fɛ. Kalansen hakɛ dan ye 64 KiB ye; nafalan belebelebaw bɛ ban ka segin welebaga ma HTTP fɛ.
websocketFanout.cfg1: `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE=256` — abonné kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ layidu juguya. Overflow bɛ frame kɔrɔlenba jigin.
websocketFanout.cfg2: `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS=1000` — sanfɛla dancɛ bɛ `ci_bytes` kan. Ka tɛmɛ o kan, o bɛ sosɛti jugu taamasiyɛn.
websocketFanout.cfg3: `FANOUT_MAX_ROOM_SIZE=10000` — bɛ ban fan-bɔli la so minnu ka bon ni nin ye. Sobaw bɛ baara kɛ ni kanal mode ni pull pattern ye o nɔ na.
websocketFanout.fail1: Slow consumer — per-socket layidu bɛ fa. Kalansen kɔrɔbaw binna. Client bɛ minɛ ka tɛmɛ `since` fɛ reconnect kan.
websocketFanout.fail2: Sosɛti salen — `ci_bytes` bɛ `JɛɲɔgɔnyaDɔgɔlen` lawuli. Dispatcher bɛ bɔ set la ka taa ɲɛ.
websocketFanout.fail3: Bursty producer — ni producer ye > 5× teliya ka tɛmɛ aggregate consumer bandwidth kan, back-pressure bɛ don via `await` suspending the sender.
websocketFanout.fail4: Hakilila fiyɛli — abonɛn kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka layidu dafalen bɛ kɛ 256 frames ye; ni 64 KiB kelen-kelen ye o ye 16 MiB max ye slow consumer kelen na. Mɔgɔ min bolila, o bɛna tigɛ ni ɲɛnamaya sɛgɛsɛgɛli ye sanni a ka o plafond gosi.
websocketFanout.mon1: Prometheus gauge `vortex_fanout_queue_depth{so,baarakɛla}` — socket kelen-kelen bɛɛ layidu juguya.
websocketFanout.mon2: Jatebla `vortex_fanout_drops_total{reason}` — karamɔgɔya fililenw sababu fɛ (dafalen, waati tɛmɛnen, datugulen).
websocketFanout.tune1: `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE` kɔrɔta kliyanw ye rezow kan minnu bɛ kɛ dɔɔnin dɔɔnin nka u sabatilen don.
websocketFanout.tune2: `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS` jigin sɔsɔliba kuluw kɔnɔ yɔrɔ minnu na sosɛti sumalenw bɛ mɔgɔ wɛrɛw kɔngɔ.
websocketFanout.tune3: Aw bɛ sobaw tila ka kɛ so fitininw ye walima k’u wuli ka taa kanal cogo la ni fɛn kuraw ye minnu sinsinnen bɛ samali kan.
websocketFanout.edge1: So jiginni ko kɛlenw (`type:"k"`) bɛ ci ni s 2 waati dafalen ye sanni ka kɛ s 1 ye bawo kiliyanw ka kan ka kilisiw don kokura sanni u ka sɔn cikan caman ma.
websocketFanout.edge2: Sɛbɛnni ko kɛlenw tɛ segin k'a lajɛ — ka "baarakɛla ye sɛbɛnni dabila" bɔnɛ, o tɛ kojugu ye.
websocketFanout.edge3: Presence updates bɛ kɛ batch (batch) ye: user presence flips caman bɛ 250 ms window kelen kɔnɔ, olu bɛ fara ɲɔgɔn kan ka kɛ frame kelen ye.
websocketFanout.mig1: v0.0 bɛ baara kɛ ni so kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye `asyncio.Queue`s — a bɛ bila v0.0.5 kɔnɔ ni lock-copy-iterate pattern ye walasa ka cikan kelen-kelen bɛɛ dɔgɔya CPU.
websocketFanout.mig2: Siniɲɛsigi : ni Redis bɛ sɔrɔ, fan-out bɛna pub/sub fɛ o la multi-node clusters ka ko kɛlenw lasegin ni mesh fan-out tɛ.
websocketFanout.ts1: Jigin hakɛ caman : rezo lajɛ ka taa a feerebaga sumayalen ma; bump queue hakɛ; sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ kiliyanw ka kɛwalew kan.
websocketFanout.ts2: Cikan kuntaala ka bon : a ka c’a la, TLS seginkanni bɛ sen na walima NAT tɛmɛsira waati tɛmɛnen; aw bɛ kernel logs lajɛ walasa ka TCP segin-ka-bɔnyew sɔrɔ.
websocketFanout.ts3: Hakilila sɛgɛsɛgɛli : `vortex_fanout_queue_depth` sɛgɛsɛgɛ baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ la; taamasiyɛn kɛ baarakɛla o baarakɛla ye min kɔnɔna bɛ to senna > 200 ko a bɛ se ka kɛ kiliyan ye min bɛ baara kɛ dɔɔnin dɔɔnin walima min ka jugu.
websocketFanout.faq1: J: Mun bɛ kɛ ni kiliyan dɔ ye frames (kalansenw) tiɲɛ jɛɲɔgɔnya tigɛtuma na? A: A bɛ jɛ kokura ni `since=<last_seen_id>` ye ani sèrwɛri bɛ segin ka fɔ ka bɔ DB la. Fan-out ye cɛsiri ɲuman ye waati yɛrɛ la; muɲuli bɛ balo DB kɔnɔ.
websocketFanout.faq2: J: Yala abonné jugu dɔ bɛ se ka fan-out sumaya wa? A: U b’u yɛrɛ ka layidu sumaya, o min bɛ u fa, k’u fili, k’u tigɛ. Abonnés (abonnenw) cɛtigɛbaliya si tɛ yen.
websocketFanout.faq3: J: Ne bɛ se ka baarakɛla kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen dɔ ka lasecogo debug cogo di? A: `GET /api/admin/debug/fanout/{user_id}` bɛ u ka layini juguya, cikan laban waati taamasiyɛn, ani kɔsa in na jigincogo fili.

nonceManagement.title: Nonce ɲɛnabɔli
nonceManagement.subtitle: Cogo min na Vortex bɛ AES-GCM nonces to kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la minɛnw, sow ani reboots bɛɛ kɔnɔ.
nonceManagement.what: AES-GCM baara bɛɛ bɛ 12-byte nonce ta ko MUST ka kɛ unique ye key dilen dɔ la. Ni i seginna ka baara kɛ ni nonce ye ni key kelen ye, o bɛ gundo ni tiɲɛni fila bɛɛ tiɲɛ — binkannikɛla min ka ciphertext fila bɛ kelen jukɔrɔ (key, nonce) o bɛ se ka plaintext XOR sɔrɔ.
nonceManagement.why: Vortex bɛ so kelen kilisi lawuli ka baara kɛ n’a ye cikan ba caman kama. Nonce compromised across two messages bɛna sɛbɛnni gansanw bɔ kɛnɛ kan. O la, nonces bɛɛ bɛ Sɔrɔ ni OS CSPRNG ye bitiki 96 la — wolodon-bound-safe mara bɛ cikan 2^32 ɲɔgɔn Bɔ key kelen na, o ka ca kosɛbɛ ka Tɛmɛ key kelen si bɛna siri.
nonceManagement.where: Client-side nonce generation bɛ balo `VortexCrypto` (iOS), `crypto/aead` module (Android), `app.security.crypto.aes_gcm_encrypt` (node) kɔnɔ. Node fana bɛ baara kɛ ni defensive duplicate-nonce check ye.
nonceManagement.how: Taabolo-dafalen : kiliyan bɛ bayt 12 labɛn k’a sɔrɔ a ma kɛ cogo si la, ka tɛmɛ ka taa AES-GCM sirili la, ka ciphertext frame i n’a fɔ `{ciphertext, nonce}` ani POSTs. Node bɛ `(room_id, nonce)` sɛbɛn hakilijagabɔ kɔnɔ LRU cache kɔnɔ min bonya bɛ se 10^6 dontaw ma. POST kan, node bɛ cache lajɛ — duplicate ⇒ 400 `duplicate_nonce`. Baarakɛcogo nɔgɔman kɔrɔ nin tɛ tasuma Bɔ abada (P(collision) ni cikan 10^9 ye ~10^-19 ye).
nonceManagement.when: Cikan bɛɛ kan. Jaabi-kɛrɛfɛ: nonce check tɛ — AES-GCM ka tag bɛ dafalenya ɲɛnabɔ. Ni nonce dɔ seginna cogo dɔ la, decrypt filanan tun bɛna ɲɛ sɔrɔ hali bi nka gundo tun bɛna tiɲɛ.
nonceManagement.cfg1: `NONCE_CACHE_SIZE=1000000` — kɔsa in na nonces hakɛ min tugura node kelen kɔnɔ.
nonceManagement.cfg2: `NONCE_CACHE_TTL_S=86400` — sɛbɛn kɔrɔw gɛnna ka bɔ yen lɛrɛ 24 kɔfɛ (kilisi fanba bɛ wuli lɛrɛ kɔnɔ cogo o cogo).
nonceManagement.fail1: RNG dɛsɛ kliyan kan — a ka ca kosɛbɛ ni OS-di CSPRNG. An tɛ segin abada RNGw kan minnu tɛ kripto ye.
nonceManagement.fail2: Cache miss on node restart — a bɛ sɔn bawo cache ye lafasali-kɔnɔna ye; kliyanw tɛ baara kɛ kokura ni nonces ye sariya siratigɛ la abada walasa miss kana binkanni finɛtiri da wuli.
nonceManagement.mon1: Jateden `vortex_nonce_duplicates_total{room}` — ka kan ka to zeru la.
nonceManagement.mon2: Gauge `vortex_nonce_cache_size` — ka kan ka sabati cache cap lamini na.
nonceManagement.tune1: Sobaw: dɔ fara cache hakɛ kan walasa ka finɛtiri janw datugu minnu bɛ wuli ka wuli.
nonceManagement.tune2: Node caman kuluw : ka cache tila Redis fɛ ni a bɛ sɔrɔ.
nonceManagement.edge1: Client min tɛ ɛntɛrinɛti kan, o seginni ka jɛɲɔgɔnya kɛ ni cikanw ye minnu bɛ layini na: cikan kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ taa n’a yɛrɛ ka nonce random ye. Baarakɛɲɔgɔnya si tun man kan ka kɛ.
nonceManagement.edge2: Minɛn caman ci : minɛn fila bɛɛ bɛ nonces randomes yɛrɛmahɔrɔnyalenw lawuli. P(boli) min bɛ minɛn 2 la × cikan 10^4 = a tɛ jate.
nonceManagement.mig1: v0.0 ye baara kɛ waati kunkurunnin kɔnɔ ni counter-based nonces seeded with device id — deprecated kɔfɛ papier dɔ ye cross-device collisions jira clock-skew jukɔrɔ. Random-96 ye sira kelenpe ye sisan min ye dugawu sɔrɔ.
nonceManagement.ts1: Aw ye `duplicate_nonce` banw lajɛ: ka kiliyan sɛgɛsɛgɛ ni buguri RNG tɛ; minɛnw ka ɛntɔrɔpi sɔrɔyɔrɔ lajɛ.
nonceManagement.ts2: Cache OOM: ka cache hakɛ lajɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni so sɛbɛnni hakɛ ye; walima ka bonya kɔrɔta walima ka jigin TTL.
nonceManagement.faq1: J: Ni kliyan fila ye nonce kelen ta k’a sɔrɔ u ma kɛ cogo di? A: Ni 96 bitikiw kɛra k’a sɔrɔ a ma kɛ cogo si la, ɲɔgɔndan fɔlɔ makɔnɔnen baarakɛlaw bɛɛ cɛma bɛ ~2^48 cikanw na — ɲɛnamaya caman Vortex baarakɛcogo. Ni o kɛra don dɔ, node tun bɛ ban filanan na.
nonceManagement.faq2: J: Mun na 96 bits ani 128 tɛ? A: AES-GCM ka standard nonce janya. 96 bitiki fana bɛ bayt 4 mara cikan kelen na.

keyRotation.title: Kilisi jiginni
keyRotation.subtitle: So, minɛn ani bɔli konnɛgɛw bɛ wuli tuma min na ani cogo min na.
keyRotation.what: Vortex kɔnɔ, kilisi min bɛ mɛn, o bɛɛ bɛ Yɛlɛma-yɛlɛma waatibolodalen dɔ kan walima trigger kan. So konnɛgɛw bɛ wuli ka wuli ni tɔndenw yeli ɲɔgɔn fɛ walima tuma ni tuma (dɔgɔkun o dɔgɔkun). Minɛnw ka kilisi bɛ wuli ka wuli baarakɛla ka sugandili kelen-kelen bɛɛ la. Release keys bɛ wuli ni siga bɛ bɛnkan dɔ la.
keyRotation.why: Yɛlɛma bɛ dan sigi bɛnkan dɔ ka fiɲɛbɔyɔrɔ la. So konnɛgɛ sonyalen dɔ min bɔra kunun, o bɛ bi cikanw decryption dabila. Bɔko kilisi sonyalen dɔ min Bɔra 2024 sàn na, o bɛ 2026 sàn bɔliw seereya dabila.
keyRotation.where: `app/keys/` bɛ sèrwɛri fan fɛ jiginni logiki so. Client fan fɛ: `ios/.../Kili/impl/SoKeyProvider.swift`, `android/.../keys/impl/RoomKeyProvider.kt`.
keyRotation.how: So jiginni: admin o admin bɛ se ka trigger; jiginni gansan min bɛ kɛ lafiɲɛbɔ la, o ye otomatiki ye. Rotator bɛ 32-byte root kura sɔrɔ, ka segin ka anwɛlɛki kɛ tɔnden tɔw ye, ka `POST /api/rooms/{id}/rotate` bila ni anwɛlɛki kura ye. Node bɛ `room_keys` kuraya atomi la ani ka `{type:"k"}` lase.
keyRotation.when: So: koniya la, admin trigger kan, tile 7 o tile 7 otomatiki la. Minɛn: tile 90 o tile 90 ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye (a bɛ se ka labɛn). Laseli: ad-hoc ka ɲɛsin bɛnkan ma min bɛ siga la.
keyRotation.cfg3: `ROTATE_ON_LEAVE=tiɲɛ` — a dabila walasa ka jiginni tɛmɛ lafiɲɛbɔ la (a bɛ lakana dɔgɔya CPU duguma).
keyRotation.fail1: Client offline during rotation: a bɛ se ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ nata la. Node stores laban 5 rotations donc reconnects tuma bɛɛ ka u ka enveloppe sɔrɔ.
keyRotation.fail2: Enveloppe minting race: admin fila bɛ wuli waati kelen na. Node bɛ sɔn fɔlɔ ma ka segin 409 Conflict kan filanan na.
keyRotation.mon1: Jatebla `vortex_room_rotations_total{kun}` — ka kɛɲɛ ni dalilu ye.
keyRotation.tune1: Foroba so minnu bɛ > mɔgɔ 1000 la: i bɛ wuli ka taa Variant-B key publish la. Yɛlɛma-yɛlɛma min bɛ kɛ koniya la, o bɛ kɛ no-op ye; tɔndenw dalen bɛ pubkey bolonɔbila sɛbɛnnen na.
keyRotation.tune2: So minnu bɛ waati jateminɛ (misali la kunnafonidilaw ka sɔrɔyɔrɔw): jiginni ka surun (don o don walima lɛrɛ o lɛrɛ).
keyRotation.edge1: Mɔgɔ kelen-kelen ka so tɔw bɛɛ bɔlen kɔfɛ: jiginni tɛ mako ɲɛ nka a bɛ daminɛ hali bi walasa ka kɛ kelen ye; lone member bɛ anwɛlɛki kura sɔrɔ u yɛrɛ ye.
keyRotation.edge2: Dutigi bɛ bɔ: tigiya bɛ wuli ka taa admin min farala ɲɔgɔn kan ka tɛmɛ tɔw bɛɛ kan; tigi ka anwɛlɛki kɔrɔ bɛ bɔ a la.
keyRotation.mig1: v0.0 bɛ wuli dɔrɔn lafiɲɛbɔ la. v0.2 bɛ waati-ni-waati jiginni fara a kan min bɛ kɔrɔsi `ROOM_KEY_ROTATION_DAYS` fɛ.
keyRotation.ts1: Clients stuck decrypting: anwɛlɛki tabali lajɛ; k’a lajɛ ko rotation event kɛra ka bɔ kɛnɛ kan.
keyRotation.ts2: Yɛlɛma dɛsɛw : a ka c’a la, rezow bɛ kɛ ka ɲɛsin mɔgɔ dɔ ma min bɛ kɛ dɔɔnin dɔɔnin. Segin ka jate minɛ min donna jatebɔ sira kɔnɔ.
keyRotation.faq1: J: Yala jiginni bɛ cikan kɔrɔw siri kokura wa? A: Ayi, ciphertext kɔrɔ bɛ to key kɔrɔ jukɔrɔ; kiliyanw bɛ kilisi kɔrɔw mara u ka sigida cache kɔnɔ tariku decryption kama.
keyRotation.faq2: J: Ni baarakɛla dɔ farala a kan ani ka bɔ joona siɲɛ 100 do? A: Waleya kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ wuli ka wuli. Sobaw kan nin sɔngɔ ka gɛlɛn — an bɛ tɔndenw ka ko kɛtaw dantigɛ ka se 1/min ma baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ la.

rateLimiting.title: Dan sigili hakɛ la
rateLimiting.subtitle: Per- IP, baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ, sira kelen-kelen bɛɛ token-bucket dantigɛliw.
rateLimiting.what: Taari dantigɛli ye lafasali fɔlɔ ye ka ɲɛsin caman tiɲɛni ma: don ni fanga jugu ye, mɔgɔ tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni sanjiba, cikanw cili, dosiyew bilali sɛgɛn.
rateLimiting.why: Ni dan tɛ, tɔɲɔlikɛla min sɛgɛsɛgɛra, o bɛ se ka disiki sɛgɛn, ka fan-out fa, walima ka 2FA 4-force kɛ brute-force. Danyɔrɔw ka dɔgɔ (~10 ns sɛkɛsɛkɛli kelen na) wa u bɛ binkanniw tigɛli kɛ minnu tɛ foyi ye, ka kɛ sɔngɔ gɛlɛnw ye.
rateLimiting.where: `app/security/limits.py` bɛ dantigɛlikɛla minɛ. `app/authentication/_helpers.py::_check_auth_rate` ye dakun finman ye min bɛ kɛ ka ɲɛsin dantigɛli siraw ma.
rateLimiting.how: Token-bucket algorithm per (skɔpi, kilisi). Bucket refills at rate R, capacity C. Demande bɛ token 1 ta. Bucket lankolon ⇒ 429. Tracker marayɔrɔ: in-memory dict kan node kelen kan; Redis ni `REDIS_URL=...`.
rateLimiting.when: Delili bɛɛ kɛra WAF cɛmancɛ-minɛn fɛ. Skip list for static assets ani kɛnɛya sɛgɛsɛgɛliw.
rateLimiting.cfg1: `_AUTH_RATE_LOGIN=10` s 60 kelen na IP kelen na.
rateLimiting.cfg2: `_AUTH_RATE_REGISTER=5` s 60 kelen na IP kelen na.
rateLimiting.cfg3: `MSG_RATE_PER_USER=30` miniti kelen kɔnɔ baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ la.
rateLimiting.cfg4: `FILE_UPLOAD_RATE=10` miniti kelen kɔnɔ baarakɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ la.
rateLimiting.fail1: Baarakɛla sariyalen kɔfɛ NAT tilalen (biro, lakɔli) bɛ dan per-IP gosi — baarakɛla ɲɛda 429 ni cikan bonyalen ye.
rateLimiting.fail2: Hakilila fiyɛli ni pɛrɛnba ye — capped at 100k distinct keys; LRU ka mɔgɔw gɛn ka bɔ yen.
rateLimiting.mon1: Jateden `vortex_rate_limit_denied_total{skɔpi,key_hash}` — ka kɛɲɛ ni skɔpi ye.
rateLimiting.mon2: Histogramme `vortex_rate_limit_check_duration_seconds` — ka kan ka to 100 μs jukɔrɔ.
rateLimiting.tune1: CDN kɔfɛ min bɛ IP lakika bɔ: `TRUSTED_PROXIES` sigi walasa an ka `X-Forwarded-For` kalan. N'o tɛ siraba bɛɛ bɛ dan Kɛ CDN ka bɔli IP 'kɔnɔ.
rateLimiting.tune2: Boti minnu ka bon kosɛbɛ: API kilisi di ni `BOT_RATE_OVERRIDE=1000` ye.
rateLimiting.edge1: IPv6 : an bɛ dan sigi /64 kelen-kelen bɛɛ la sanni ka dan sigi ladɛrɛsi kelen-kelen bɛɛ la walasa ka jatebɔ kɛ ISP tilalibaw la.
rateLimiting.edge2: Tor bɔli : an bɛ dan dɔ sigi min ka nɔgɔn (`TOR_RATE_MULTIPLIER=5`) walasa ka Tor baarakɛlaw ɲangi bɔli jɛlenw na.
rateLimiting.mig1: v0.0 tun bɛ baara kɛ ni `slowapi` ye ni decorator-per-route ye — a ma baara kɛ v0.0.5 kɔnɔ cɛmancɛ-minɛnw kama minnu bɛ cɛmancɛ la.
rateLimiting.ts1: False-positive 429: ka proxy config dannamɔgɔ lajɛ, ka shared-NAT setups lajɛ, bump scope limit ni sariya sira bɛ ka a gosi.
rateLimiting.ts2: Bypassed: ka dondaw sɛbɛnw sɛgɛsɛgɛ walasa ka IP juguw sɔrɔ; fara `BLACKLIST_IP=` kan env var ka ɲɛsin bloki gɛlɛn ma.
rateLimiting.faq1: J: Yala danw bɛ tila-tila nodew cɛma wa? A: Node kelen cogoya la, dan bɛ kɛ node kelen-kelen bɛɛ la. Ni Redis ye, dan bɛ diɲɛ kɔnɔ kulu bɛɛ kɔnɔ.
rateLimiting.faq2: J: Ne bɛ se ka dɔ fara ne yɛrɛ ye cogo di? A: Baarakɛlaw minnu sɛgɛsɛgɛra, olu bɛ se ka quota caman ɲini `/api/admin/quota` fɛ. Admins bɛ sɔn ko kelen-kelen bɛɛ ma.

emojiCatalog.title: Emoji katalogu
emojiCatalog.subtitle: Emoji 1500 kunnafonidilan in tilalen don kiliyan bɛɛ cɛ.
emojiCatalog.what: Vortex b’a yɛrɛ ka emoji set ci sanni a k’a jigi da Unicode-version sɔrɔli kan. 1500 emojis labɛnna ka kɛ kulu 9 ye (smileys, mɔgɔw, baganw, dumuni, taama, baarakɛtaw, fɛnw, taamasiyɛnw, darapow). O JSON kelen min bɛ Kɛ iOS (`Emoji/Resources/emoji.json`), Android (`android/app/src/main/assets/emoji.json`), ani ɛntɛrinɛti kliyan (`static/assets/emoji.json`) kan.
emojiCatalog.why: Bɛɛ: baarakɛla min bɛ 🥹 ci iOS 17 kan, o ka kan ka jira i n’a fɔ 🥹 Android 9. Native system emoji diverge across OS versions by 1-3 years, o la an b’an yɛrɛ ta ci walasa ka kartiw sabati.
emojiCatalog.how: JSON sigicogo: `{kategori: [emoji_char, ...]}`. Clients bɛ doni ta daminɛ na, ka flakɛ ka kɛ ɲinini index ye, ka render kɛ LazyVGrid / LazyGrid / CSS grid fɛ.
emojiCatalog.when: App daminɛ na ani tuma o tuma ni baarakɛla ye picker da wuli. MRU lisi bɛ to sen na UserDefaults / SharedPreferences / localStorage kɔnɔ.
emojiCatalog.cfg1: Kɔsa in na cap: 30 iOS kan, 30 Android kan, 20 web kan.
emojiCatalog.cfg2: Jateblaw bɛ Labɛn ka Kɛɲɛ ni ɲɔgɔn ye — sigicogo kura bɛ picker layout tiɲɛ.
emojiCatalog.fail1: Baarakɛla ka OS tɛ se ka emoji jira: a bɛ segin ka bin `?` glyph kan. An bɛ kodepointw ta ka bɔ Unicode ≤ 15.0 la min bɛ bi OS bɛɛ dɛmɛ.
emojiCatalog.tune1: Emoji packs custom: baarakɛlaw bɛ se ka sticker packs sigi sen kan minnu bɛ u yɛrɛ minɛ o cogo kelen na nka u bɛ raster jaw jira.
emojiCatalog.edge1: Fari-ɲɛnajɛ suguya wɛrɛw: an ka katalogu bɛ basigi emojis dɔrɔn de mara; variants bɛ dabɔ kliyan fan fɛ ZWJ sinsinniw fɛ.
emojiCatalog.edge2: Darapo emojis: mara-taamaʃyɛn taamasiyɛn fila-fila; iOS bɛ darapo jira, Android version dɔw bɛ lɛtɛrɛ fila jira.
emojiCatalog.mig1: v0.0 ye emoji.json baara ka bɔ emoji-mart sanfɛ. v0.0.5 foroko ka katalogu pin ani ka tigɛ ka se 1500 ma bundle-size kunw kosɔn.
emojiCatalog.ts1: Emoji minnu tununna: nafolo jɔli kokura; aw k’a lajɛ ko JSON bɛ se ka kɛ; minɛn dɔw bɛ kɔrɔlenw mara ni fanga ye — app cache jɛya.
emojiCatalog.faq1: J: Yala ne bɛ se ka emoji ladamulenw fara a kan wa? A: A tɛ kɛ katalogu fɛ. Aw bɛ baara kɛ ni stika pakew ye.
emojiCatalog.faq2: J: Mun na i tɛ baara kɛ ni Twemoji ye? A: Lase + bundle hakɛ. Twemoji ye CC-BY-4.0 ye nka PNG set bɛ 20 MB fara a kan kiliyan kelen-kelen bɛɛ la.

audio.title: Audio codec sira
audio.subtitle: Opus 48 kHz VBR Bamako, Mali.
audio.what: Opus 48 kHz VBR ye. DTX kan ka kɛ makun ye. Adaptive bitrate 6-128 kbps ka da rezow jateminɛ kan.
audio.why: Opus ye setigi jɛlen ye VoIP fɔli la : a tɛ sara, a bɛ se ka kɛ NetEQ ye, a bɛ se ka latɛmɛ kosɛbɛ, a kɔrɔbɔra kosɛbɛ.
audio.where: Aw ye kode jiri lajɛ sira kan min bɛ jira ni subsystem tɔgɔ ye.
audio.how: Aw ye modulu ka README walima waleyali dosiye kunba lajɛ walasa ka senfɛ-senfɛ.
audio.when: Yɔrɔ o yɔrɔ la, sigida fitinin in bɛ tali kɛ yɔrɔ o yɔrɔ; aw ye weleli yɔrɔw lajɛ grep fɛ.
audio.cfg1: Defaults ye ergonomie ye; tune ni mɛtiriw b’a jira.
audio.cfg2: Env-var basigilen; kode caman caman cili ma kɛ.
audio.fail1: A bɛ dɔgɔya ka taa baarakɛyɔrɔ dɔ la min ka dɔgɔ sanni a ka dɛsɛ kosɛbɛ.
audio.fail2: Logiw bɛ WARN; mɛtɛrɛw cayalenba; baarakɛla bɛ se ka lasɔmi.
audio.mon1: Prometheus jatebɔlanw ni jatebɔlanw. Grafana dakun min bɛ `deploy/grafana/` kɔnɔ.
audio.mon2: JSON logs sigilenw ni correlation id.
audio.tune1: A daminɛ ni defaults ye. Yɛlɛma don dɔrɔn dɔgɔkun kelen kɔfɛ basigilen jateminɛw kɔlɔsili kɔfɛ.
audio.tune2: Yɛlɛma bɛɛ sɛbɛn ops runbook kɔnɔ walasa ops nataw k’a dɔn mun na.
audio.edge1: A bɛ doni girinw minɛ minnu bɛ bɛn ni tiɲɛni ye min bɛ kɛ ni nɛɛma ye.
audio.edge2: Dɛsɛcogo minnu sɛbɛnnen don sanfɛ, olu bɛ banako sabatilenw ɲɛfɔ.
audio.mig1: Version-tagged (fɔcogo-taamaʃyɛn); Alembic seginnkanniw bɛ DB schema touch bɛɛ datugu.
audio.mig2: Rollback ye `git jatebɔ <tag> && kɛ deployi ye`.
audio.ts1: Aw ye mɛtiriw lajɛ fɔlɔ. O kɔ fɛ, logs filɛra ni correlation id ye.
audio.ts2: Ni fɛn tɔw bɛɛ ma ɲɛ, aw bɛ py-spy nɔrɔ a la ka flamegraph sɔrɔ.
audio.faq1: J: Yala nin ye wajibi ye kosɛbɛ wa? A: Ɔwɔ ka ɲɛsin fɛnw bɛɛ lajɛlen ma; bɛ se ka stubbed out in minimal deployments.
audio.faq2: J: A musaka ye mun ye? A: A tɛ jate doni danmadɔw la; sɛbɛnnen bɛ `docs/costs.md` kɔnɔ.
audio.faq3: J: N bɛ se k’a bali wa? A: Aw ye `.env.example` lajɛ walasa ka fɛnw jira.

smartReply.why: Subsystem (dakun fitinin) bɛ yen bawo protocol (protokol) bɛ ni slot (yɔrɔ) ye min ɲɛfɔlen dòn kosɛbɛ a kama. A bɔli tun bɛna baarakɛcogo dɔ to yen, baarakɛlaw bɛ u jigi da min kan.
smartReply.where: Aw ye Vortex sɔrɔyɔrɔ jiri lajɛ. Tɔgɔdacogo bɛnkan ye `app/<feature>/` ye node kan, `static/js/<feature>/` ye web client kan, `ios/Modules/Sources/<Feature>/` ye iOS kan, `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/<feature>/` ye Android kan.
smartReply.how: Clients bɛ subsystem wele a API surface fɛ; node siraw, maganw, ani fanw bɔ i n’a fɔ a bɛnnen don cogo min na. Waleya kunnafoniw bɛ balo modulu ka README kɔnɔ yɔrɔ min na.
smartReply.when: Ni smartReply bɛ tali kɛ tuma o tuma — aw ye weleli yɔrɔw kode lajɛ.
smartReply.cfg1: Default config bɛ baara kɛ common case ye.
smartReply.cfg2: Fɛnɲɛnɛma darapo min bɛ sɔrɔ `.env.example` kɔnɔ — `SMARTREPLY_ENABLED` ɲini.
smartReply.cfg3: Tuning knobs sɛbɛnnen bɛ module ka README kɔnɔ.
smartReply.fail1: Baara min tiɲɛna sanni ka kɛ dɛsɛ gɛlɛn ye.
smartReply.fail2: Metiriw ka dɔ farali; a bɛ tasuma lasɔmi ni dakun tɛmɛna.
smartReply.fail3: Segin-ka-bɔnyew bɛ dantigɛ; dan tɛ fɛn minnu na, olu tɛ yen.
smartReply.mon3: Aw bɛ don INFO la walasa ka siraw ɲɛnabɔ, WARN walasa ka filiw sɔrɔ minnu bɛ se ka segin.
smartReply.tune2: Aw bɛ jateminɛw kɔlɔsi dɔgɔkun kelen kɔnɔ sani aw ka fɛn caman Changer.
smartReply.tune3: Sɛbɛn kɛ kun min na tuning fɛn o fɛn bɛ Changer.
smartReply.edge1: A bɛ edge cases makɔnɔnenw ɲɛnabɔ ka kɛɲɛ ni protocol spec ye.
smartReply.edge2: Edge cases dɔnbaliw bɛ sɛbɛn walasa baarakɛla ka segin a kan.

smartReply.ts2: Filɛtiri sɛbɛnw ka kɛɲɛ ni jɛɲɔgɔnya id ye.
smartReply.ts3: Aw ye modulu ka README gɛlɛyaw ɲɛnabɔcogo yɔrɔ lajɛ.

roomFreeze.why: Subsystem (dakun fitinin) bɛ yen bawo protocol (protokol) bɛ ni slot (yɔrɔ) ye min ɲɛfɔlen dòn kosɛbɛ a kama. A bɔli tun bɛna baarakɛcogo dɔ to yen, baarakɛlaw bɛ u jigi da min kan.
roomFreeze.where: Aw ye Vortex sɔrɔyɔrɔ jiri lajɛ. Tɔgɔdacogo bɛnkan ye `app/<feature>/` ye node kan, `static/js/<feature>/` ye web client kan, `ios/Modules/Sources/<Feature>/` ye iOS kan, `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/<feature>/` ye Android kan.
roomFreeze.how: Clients bɛ subsystem wele a API surface fɛ; node siraw, maganw, ani fanw bɔ i n’a fɔ a bɛnnen don cogo min na. Waleya kunnafoniw bɛ balo modulu ka README kɔnɔ yɔrɔ min na.
roomFreeze.when: Ni roomFreeze bɛ tali kɛ tuma o tuma — aw ye weleli yɔrɔw kode lajɛ.
roomFreeze.cfg1: Default config bɛ baara kɛ common case ye.
roomFreeze.cfg2: Fɛnɲɛnɛma darapo min bɛ sɔrɔ `.env.example` kɔnɔ — `ROOMFREEZE_ENABLED` ɲini.
roomFreeze.cfg3: Tuning knobs sɛbɛnnen bɛ module ka README kɔnɔ.
roomFreeze.fail1: Baara min tiɲɛna sanni ka kɛ dɛsɛ gɛlɛn ye.
roomFreeze.fail2: Metiriw ka dɔ farali; a bɛ tasuma lasɔmi ni dakun tɛmɛna.
roomFreeze.fail3: Segin-ka-bɔnyew bɛ dantigɛ; dan tɛ fɛn minnu na, olu tɛ yen.
roomFreeze.mon3: Aw bɛ don INFO la walasa ka siraw ɲɛnabɔ, WARN walasa ka filiw sɔrɔ minnu bɛ se ka segin.
roomFreeze.tune2: Aw bɛ jateminɛw kɔlɔsi dɔgɔkun kelen kɔnɔ sani aw ka fɛn caman Changer.
roomFreeze.tune3: Sɛbɛn kɛ kun min na tuning fɛn o fɛn bɛ Changer.
roomFreeze.edge1: A bɛ edge cases makɔnɔnenw ɲɛnabɔ ka kɛɲɛ ni protocol spec ye.
roomFreeze.edge2: Edge cases dɔnbaliw bɛ sɛbɛn walasa baarakɛla ka segin a kan.
roomFreeze.mig1: Alembic revision bɛ schema caman caman cili ɲɛfɔ.
roomFreeze.mig2: Rollback dɛmɛna ka ɲɛsin version fitinin kelen ma.
roomFreeze.ts2: Filɛtiri sɛbɛnw ka kɛɲɛ ni jɛɲɔgɔnya id ye.
roomFreeze.ts3: Aw ye modulu ka README gɛlɛyaw ɲɛnabɔcogo yɔrɔ lajɛ.
roomFreeze.faq1: J: Yala nin fɛn in bɛ sabati wa? A: Ɔwɔ, minor-version sabatilen. Version belebelebaw bɛ se ka bɛnkan tiɲɛ.

mlsWelcome.what: mlsWelcome ye Vortex sigida fitinin ye. A bɛ a sen don ciden ka laban-ni-dakun protocol (labɛn) la wa a sɛbɛnnen bɛ ni ‘sènfɛjuru tɔw ye nin kunnafoni in kɔnɔ.
mlsWelcome.why: Subsystem (dakun fitinin) bɛ yen bawo protocol (protokol) bɛ ni slot (yɔrɔ) ye min ɲɛfɔlen dòn kosɛbɛ a kama. A bɔli tun bɛna baarakɛcogo dɔ to yen, baarakɛlaw bɛ u jigi da min kan.
mlsWelcome.where: Aw ye Vortex sɔrɔyɔrɔ jiri lajɛ. Tɔgɔdacogo bɛnkan ye `app/<feature>/` ye node kan, `static/js/<feature>/` ye web client kan, `ios/Modules/Sources/<Feature>/` ye iOS kan, `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/<feature>/` ye Android kan.
mlsWelcome.how: Clients bɛ subsystem wele a API surface fɛ; node siraw, maganw, ani fanw bɔ i n’a fɔ a bɛnnen don cogo min na. Waleya kunnafoniw bɛ balo modulu ka README kɔnɔ yɔrɔ min na.
mlsWelcome.when: Ni mlsWelcome bɛ tali kɛ tuma o tuma — aw ye weleli yɔrɔw kode lajɛ.
mlsWelcome.cfg1: Default config bɛ baara kɛ common case ye.
mlsWelcome.cfg2: Fɛnɲɛnɛma darapo min bɛ sɔrɔ `.env.example` kɔnɔ — `MLSWELCOME_ENABLED` ɲini.
mlsWelcome.cfg3: Tuning knobs sɛbɛnnen bɛ module ka README kɔnɔ.
mlsWelcome.fail1: Baara min tiɲɛna sanni ka kɛ dɛsɛ gɛlɛn ye.
mlsWelcome.fail2: Metiriw ka dɔ farali; a bɛ tasuma lasɔmi ni dakun tɛmɛna.
mlsWelcome.fail3: Segin-ka-bɔnyew bɛ dantigɛ; dan tɛ fɛn minnu na, olu tɛ yen.
mlsWelcome.mon3: Aw bɛ don INFO la walasa ka siraw ɲɛnabɔ, WARN walasa ka filiw sɔrɔ minnu bɛ se ka segin.
mlsWelcome.tune2: Aw bɛ jateminɛw kɔlɔsi dɔgɔkun kelen kɔnɔ sani aw ka fɛn caman Changer.
mlsWelcome.tune3: Sɛbɛn kɛ kun min na tuning fɛn o fɛn bɛ Changer.
mlsWelcome.edge1: A bɛ edge cases makɔnɔnenw ɲɛnabɔ ka kɛɲɛ ni protocol spec ye.
mlsWelcome.edge2: Edge cases dɔnbaliw bɛ sɛbɛn walasa baarakɛla ka segin a kan.
mlsWelcome.mig1: Alembic revision bɛ schema caman caman cili ɲɛfɔ.
mlsWelcome.mig2: Rollback dɛmɛna ka ɲɛsin version fitinin kelen ma.
mlsWelcome.ts2: Filɛtiri sɛbɛnw ka kɛɲɛ ni jɛɲɔgɔnya id ye.
mlsWelcome.ts3: Aw ye modulu ka README gɛlɛyaw ɲɛnabɔcogo yɔrɔ lajɛ.
mlsWelcome.faq1: J: Yala nin fɛn in bɛ sabati wa? A: Ɔwɔ, minor-version sabatilen. Version belebelebaw bɛ se ka bɛnkan tiɲɛ.
mlsWelcome.faq2: J: N bɛ se k’a bali wa? A: Ɔwɔ via feature flag fɛ.
mlsWelcome.faq3: J: Yala a bɛ se ka baara kɛ ni a daminɛ ye wa? A: A bɛ bɔ a la; `.env.misali` lajɛ.

intro.h2: Nin ye jɔn de ta ye?
intro.p1: Architex ye deklaratif UI kan ye min jɔra Vortex Mini Appw kama. Sani i ka JavaScript sɛbɛn min bɛ DOM sɛmɛntiya, i b’a fɛ ka ekran min ɲɛfɔ ani boli waati bɛ pixelw to ɲɔgɔn fɛ ni cogoya ye a yɛrɛma.
intro.p2: Kan in ka dɔgɔ: fɔlisen naani (@screen, @theme, @import, @for), kɔrɔɲɔgɔnma kelen min bɛ Kɛ fɛn caman sɛgɛsɛgɛli la (~), ani baarakɛla cakɛda kelen min bɛ Kɛ cogoya la (::).
intro.p3: Ni aw delila ka HTML + CSS + JS sɛbɛn, Architex bɛna a ye ko aw bɛ a dɔn nka ni boilerplate 10× ka dɔgɔn. N'i m'o Kɛ, Architex fana ye dakun nɔgɔman ye min bɛ Kɛ ni porogaramuw ye minnu bɛ Kɛ ni 'sèn ye bari kan in ka dɔgɔ kosɛbɛ i bɛ Se k'a bɛɛ Minɛ i kun na.
intro.p4: Nin kunnafoni in tilayɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ sinsin tɛmɛnenw kan. I ka pan ka don i b’a fɛ yɔrɔ o yɔrɔ n’i bɛ deklaratif UI karamɔgɔya wɛrɛ dɔn kaban; kalan sanfɛ ka taa duguma ni aw bɛ ka daminɛ kura ye.
intro.li1: Deklaratif — ka UI cogoya ɲɛfɔ, i kana a jɔ sennakow ɲɛfɔ
intro.li2: Reactive — baara kelen bɛ labeli, kalasi walima node dafalen bɛɛ kuraya
intro.li3: Portable — o .arx kelen bɛ baara kɛ ɛntɛrinɛti, iOS ani Android jatigiw kan
intro.li4: Tiny — parser + renderer kurun min bɛ 30 jukɔrɔ KB gzipped
intro.ct1: Architex ye domani kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen ye. A tɛna kanba dɔ bila a nɔ na — nka ka ɲɛsin ɛkran cilen ma baro kɔnɔ a teliya ka tɛmɛ an ye karamɔgɔya bɛɛ suman.
intro.ct2: Kan in kɔnɔ, jɔli bɛɛ bɛ karti ka taa boli waati fɔlɔ kelen na. Maji si tɛ yen i tɛ se ka min ɲɛfɔ.
intro.h1_a: Architex ye deklaratif UI kan ye min jɔra Vortex Mini Appw kama. Sani i ka JavaScript sɛbɛn min bɛ DOM sɛmɛntiya, i b’a fɛ ka ekran min ɲɛfɔ ani boli waati bɛ pixelw to ɲɔgɔn fɛ ni cogoya ye a yɛrɛma.
intro.h1_b: Baarakɛcogo lajɛlen "Architex ye mun ye?". Fɛɛrɛ in bɛ waleya modulu bɛnnin kɔnɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, walima `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` jukɔrɔ. Module README bɛ file sira tigitigiw wele.
intro.h1_c: "Architex ye mun ye?" fɛɛrɛ min jiginna Vortex bɔliw bɛɛ la. O dilancogo bɛ tali kɛ ciden tɛmɛnenw ka ɲininiw ni u dilanni kɛcogo bɔlenw na. Version tariku min bɛ `CHANGELOG.md` kɔnɔ, o bɛ sɛbɛnni kɛ waati min na a yɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ jigira ani min y’a bila.

quickstart.p1: Aw bɛ nin bila dosiye dɔ kɔnɔ min tɔgɔ ye ko hello.arx:
quickstart.p2: Architex tab da wuli Vortex bot studio kɔnɔ, ka file in nɔrɔ, ka Run digi. Preview pane dɔ bɛ ekran jira ani ka hot-reloads kɛ save bɛɛ kan.
quickstart.p3: Ni i ye sɛbɛn bɔ, i ka baarakɛlaw bɛ Mini App da wuli ka bɔ baro suguya bɛɛ la — install tɛ, app store tɛ.
quickstart.p4: Misali kalan kokura zana ni tigɛli : @screen ye ju ye, ~name ye reactive ye, col ye minɛn jɔlen ye, :: bɛ modifier cakɛda daminɛ, {~name} ye interpolation ye.

quickstart.li3: Persistence : reactive state ye hakilijagabɔ dɔrɔn ye; wire up send() ka to ka to.
quickstart.li4: Publishing: file ye app ye — bundler step tɛ, host bɛ filen parse ani ka a boli live.

syntax.p1: Architex porogaramu bɛɛ jɔlen bɛ ka bɔ sanfɛ-dakun naani na: @screen, @theme, @import, @component, ka fara @for loop farikolo kan. U kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ daminɛ kulu 0 kɔnɔ; fɛn o fɛn bɛ Dòn duguma, o bɛɛ ye o bloki ta ye.
syntax.p2: Yɛlɛma-dafalenw bɛ sɛbɛn ~name — tilde daminɛ bɛ u taamasiyɛn i n’a fɔ selilu minnu bɛ tugu ɲɔgɔn kɔ. Kalan kɛ ni ~name ye, ka baara di ni = ye, ka jatebɔ kɛ ni := ye.
syntax.p3: Yɔrɔw ye danfaralan gansanw ye u yɛrɛ ka layini kan: text, button, image, col, row, ani o ɲɔgɔnnaw. U jɔyɔrɔko sɔsɔli bɛ Nà o yɔrɔnin bɛɛ: text ~message, button "Save".
syntax.p4: Modifiers bɛ nɔrɔ :: kɔfɛ. Aw bɛ se ka cakɛda caman siri aw sago la: :: pad(24) gap(16) center color(#4f8ef7) bold size(20).
syntax.p5: Waleyaw bɛ balo => kɔfɛ. Waleya kelen bɛ kɛ jiribolo kelen na; bɛlɛkisɛ caman cakɛda: button "Buy" => ~busy = true => send(action: "buy") => ~busy = false.

variables.p1: Variable reactive bɛ nafa dɔ minɛ ani a bɛ mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ ladɔnniya a yɛrɛma n’i ye nafa kura sɛbɛn. Laseli kɛ ni = ye, ka segin ka baara kɛ ni = ye, ka kunnafoni kura di ni += / -= / *= / /= ye.
variables.p2: Jateblaw b’u nafa Sɔrɔ kumasen dɔ la min bɛ segin ka jateminɛ Kɛ tuma o tuma ni donnafɛn dɔ b’a Yɛlɛma. A fɔ ni := ye sanni ka kɛ = ye. Bololabaarakɛlaw ka abonnés tɛ yen, bugs stale-value tɛ yen.
variables.p3: Aw bɛ suguya in sɛbɛn ni : Type ye tɔgɔ kɔfɛ. A suguya minnu bɛ dɛmɛ: number, string, boolean, array, object. Annotations (daɲɛw ɲɛfɔcogo) ye ŋaniyataama ye; suguya bɛ jate ka bɔ nafa fɔlɔ la.
variables.p4: Baara kɛ ni lowerCamelCase walima sa_case ye; Architex fana tɛ sariya labato. Tɔgɔw ka surunya: ɛkran min kɔnɔ tɔgɔ jan tan ni caman bɛ yen, o bɛ indentation tiɲɛ.
variables.p5: Scope (dakun) : fɛn min bɛ fɛn caman sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ min fɔra @screen kɔnɔ, o bɛ ye o ɛkran farikolo kɔnɔ dɔrɔn. @theme tokenw bɛ ye diɲɛ kɔnɔ.
variables.p6: Ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo : jamana bɛ ɲɛnamaya ni ekran bɛ wuli. Ka kurun boli ka taa yɔrɔ jan, o b’a tiɲɛ; segin-ka-bɔnye bɛ segin k’a dabɔ a nafa fɔlɔ la.
variables.p7: Persistence: walasa ka ɲɛnamaya kɛ ka tɛmɛ ekran kan, i bɛ send(action: "save", data: ~state) wele ka bot host to a ka to.

state.p1: Seli reactive bɛɛ bɛ balo fo n’a lamini @screen bɛ wuli. Ekran dabɔli b’a ka fɔtaw boli sanfɛ ka taa duguma; n'i y'a To back() walima goto() fɛ, o b'u Tiɲɛ.
state.p2: N’i ​​mago bɛ jamana na walasa ka kisi navigatiɔn ma, i k’a Bɔ jatigila la: walima POST ka taa bot la ni send() ye ka segin ka na da wulilen kan, walima ka to sigida la store(key, value) weleli fɛ.
state.p3: Segin-ka-bɔnye: segin-ka-bɔnye nafa fɔlɔ la. reset daɲɛ koloma tɛ yen bawo segin-ka-bɔnye bɛ baara kɛ kaban; boli waati bɛ danfara ani ka segin ka fɛn min Changé dɔrɔn.
state.p4: Jamana bɔlen bɛ jate := fɛ. Architex bɛ dependencies (daɲɛw) nɔfɛtaama a yɛrɛma, o la i kana u jate bolo la. Dependency tracking ye tigitigi ye nafolo kelen-kelen bɛɛ la, a tɛ kɛ fɛn kelen-kelen bɛɛ la.
state.p5: Arrays ni fɛnw bɛ sanga ɲɔgɔn ma ni reference ye. Walasa ka segin-ka-bɔnye wajibiya, i ka array / object kura di. Mutation of the old one is ignored — jago laɲinilen don ka ɲɛsin update semantics predictable ma.

state.cc2: ~obj = {...~obj, tɔgɔ: "x"}  // misali kelen ye fɛnw ye
state.li1: A bonya: sigida la ka taa @screen lamini na.
state.li2: Ɲɛnamaya waati: k’a ta @screen don ka taa bɔ.
state.li3: Kɔrɔɲɔgɔnma: a bɛ kɛ ni jiri kelen ye ekran kelen na. Kumakura bɛ kɛ batch (batch) la microtask kelen kɔnɔ.

types.h3: A suguya min bɛ kɛ ni jagoya ye
types.p1: Architex suguya fɔlɔ duuru bɛ ​​yen: number, string, boolean, null, ani object / array faralen ɲɔgɔn kan. Donw bɛ tɛmɛ i n’a fɔ sɛrɛkiliw (ISO 8601) walima jatedenw (unix ms).
types.p2: Jatew ye 64-bit fila-fila ye (IEEE 754). Jateden dafalen jatebɔ fo 2^53 ye tigitigi ye.
types.p3: Jiriw ye UTF-8 ye; janya bɛ kode yɔrɔw jate, a tɛ bayt jate. Interpolation bɛ baara Kɛ ni braces kurulenw ye.
types.p4: Boolew ye true / false ye. Yɛlɛma implicit tɛ ka bɔ sɛrɛw la.
types.p5: Arrays bɛ sigi sen kan, 0-indexed. Sɔrɔli ~arr[0] fɛ; janya bɛ tɛmɛ ~arr.length fɛ.
types.p6: Fɛnw ye kilisi→nafa kartiw ye minnu ma sigi sen kan. A bɛ se ka sɔrɔ ~obj.name walima ~obj["name"] fɛ.
types.p7: Wajibiya : jatebla baarakɛlaw bɛ juruw Wajibiya ka Kɛ jatebla ye ni sɛrɛkili bɛ i n’a fɔ jatebla; n’o tɛ, fɔcogo fili dɔ bɛ tasuma Bɔ boli waati la.
types.p8: Tiɲɛ: nkalon nafaw ye false, 0, "", null, ani sɛrɛkili / fɛn lankolonw ye. Fɛn tɔw bɛɛ ye tiɲɛ ye.

layout.p1: Architex bɛ ni minɛn fila ye tigitigi minnu bɛ se ka kɛ: col (jɔlen) ani row (yɔrɔ tilennen). Fɛn tɔw bɛɛ ye furabulu-yɔrɔ ye.
layout.p2: Aw bɛ denmisɛnw sɔgɔ nivo kelen ye ka tɛmɛ u ka minɛn kan. Dadon taamasiyɛn tɛ yen — parser bɛ baara Kɛ ni indentation dɔrɔn ye.
layout.p3: Minɛnw bɛ sɔn gap(px) ma yɔrɔ la denmisɛnw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ, pad(px) kɔnɔna na, center ka taa cɛmancɛ la kuruwa sira fɛ, grow ka yɔrɔ tɔ fa aksidanba kan.
layout.p4: Alignment modifiers ye minɛn-dafalen ye: center in a col cɛmancɛw bɛ jɛgɛn; row kɔnɔ a bɛ cɛmancɛ la jɔlen na. align(left) / align(right) / align(top) / align(bottom) ye 'sènbɔli jɛlenw ye.
layout.p5: Bonya: a daminɛ na, a yɔrɔ bɛɛ bɛ Dɔgɔya walasa a ka Bɛn a kɔnɔkow ma. Aw bɛ w(px), h(px), grow, walima maxW(px) / maxH(px) jɛlen kɛ ka siri.
layout.cc3: col :: bonya // ka yɔrɔ jɔlen tɔ bɛɛ ta
layout.cc4: row :: bonya // ka yɔrɔ tilennen tolenw bɛɛ ta
layout.li1: col — denmisɛnw dalajɛ sanfɛ ka taa duguma
layout.li2: row — layini denmisɛnw kinin fɛ ka taa kinin fɛ
layout.li4: Denmisɛn minnu bɛ ni grow ye, olu bɛ yɔrɔ tolenw tila ɲɔgɔn na fo ni girinya jɛlenw dira.

modifiers.p1: Modifiers bɛ na :: kɔfɛ wa u bɛ se ka cakɛda tuma bɛɛ. Deklarasiyɔn yamaruya si tɛ yen min ka kan ka to an hakili la; bɛnbaliya bɛ sɛbɛnnikɛla labanw ka se sɔrɔli ɲɛnabɔ denbaya kɔnɔ.
modifiers.p2: Denbaya min bɛ yɔrɔjan: pad(n) (kɛrɛ bɛɛ), pad(x, y) (kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, jɔlen), pad(t, r, b, l) (CSS sigicogo), gap(n) (denmisɛnw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ), margin(n) (kɛnɛma da).
modifiers.p4: Kulɛri denbaya: color(#rrggbb) (ɲɛfɛ), bg(#rrggbb) (kɔfɛ). U fila bɛɛ bɛ sɔn barokun taamasiyɛnw ma (color(~primary)) ani hex nimɔrɔ 8 alfa (#00000080) kama.
modifiers.p6: Yɛrɛla denbaya: hidden(~flag) bɛ node bɔ ni darapo ye tiɲɛ ye; visible(~flag) ye a kɔfɛta ye. Nodes unmounted shed u ka DOM — conditionnel UI ye sɔngɔ gɛlɛn ye.
modifiers.p7: Taamacogo denbaya: debounce(ms) kan input gazi kuraw; placeholder("…") bɛ hakilina dɔ jira; format(kind, arg) kan text bɛ jateden dɔ labɛn ("currency", "percent", "compact").
modifiers.p8: Dan / radiyali: radius(px) bɛ nkɔni lamini; border(#rrggbb) bɛ 1 px sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ; border(px, #rrggbb) bɛ janya fana sigi.
modifiers.li1: Labɛnni denbaya kɔnɔ, o tɛ foyi ye.
modifiers.li2: Kulɛri caman sɛmɛntiyabagaw bɛ sɛbɛnnikɛla laban-seginw ɲɛnabɔ.
modifiers.li3: Yɔrɔ janya bɛ kɛ ka kɔn bonya ɲɛ, bonya bɛ kɛ ka kɔn dan ɲɛ.
modifiers.li4: Yɛlɛma dɔnbaliw ye parse fili ye — min laɲini ye ka ɲɛfɛla bɛnkan lakana.

handlers.h3: Waleya minnu bɛ kɛ ni cakɛda ye
handlers.p1: Fɛn minnu bɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ, olu bɛ wale dɔ nɔrɔ => kɔfɛ. Butɔn dɔ ka wale bɛ tasuma don pompi la. Donan dɔ ka wale bɛ tasuma don fɛn caman Changement (debounce kɔfɛ ni a labɛnna).
handlers.p2: Aw bɛ se ka wale caman siri ni cakɛda ye layini kelen kan. U bɛ baara Kɛ sanfɛ ka Taa duguma mikrotask kelen in na, o la UI bɛ 'kùnnafoni Kɛ siɲɛ kelen laban na.
handlers.p3: Waleya bɛ se ka di seliw ma minnu bɛ se ka wale kɛ, ka jatigila kɔnɔna wele, ka taama, walima ka cikan send() ka segin bot kan.
handlers.p4: Jatigila kɔnɔfɛnw bɛ dilan plateforme fɛ: copy(~text), share(~text), haptic("light"|"medium"|"heavy"), vibrate(ms), alert("..."), confirm("...") => ~ok = it, goto("ScreenName", arg: val), back(), close().

control_flow.h1: Yecogo min bɛ kɛ ni sariya ye
control_flow.p1: Architex tɛ ni if fɔcogo ye kɔrɔɲɔgɔnmaya sanfɛla la. Sarati UI bɛ Fɔ hidden(~flag) / visible(~flag) fɛnɲɛnamafagalanw fɛ walima fɔcogo saba fɛ yɔrɔw nafaw la.
control_flow.p2: Ternary bɛ baara Kɛ yɔrɔ o yɔrɔ la nafa dɔ Sɔnna: component argument, modifier argument, computed value.
control_flow.p3: Ni bolow ka ca ni fila ye, aw bɛ sabananw kɛ denso la. Architex bɛ parse kɛ kinin fɛ ka taa numan fɛ walasa nesting ka kalan kɛ cogo la min bɛ kɛ a yɛrɛ la.
control_flow.p4: Walasa ka switch ɲɔgɔnna hakilina sɔrɔ fɛn dɔ kan, baara kɛ ni jatebɔ ɲinini ye: ~labels := {home: "Home", settings: "Settings"}; text ~labels[~active].
control_flow.li1: if bloki tɛ — baara kɛ ni modifier walima ternaire ye.
control_flow.li2: No else if cakɛda — baara kɛ ni nested ternary ye.
control_flow.li3: No pattern matching — baara kɛ ni ɲinini tabali ye o nɔ na.
control_flow.li4: Segin joona tɛ — bolofara minnu bɛ sariya kɔnɔ, olu ye nafaw ye, kumasenw tɛ.

loops.h4: Lupu minnu bɛ sigi sen kan
loops.p1: Aw bɛ segin bloki kan min ye UI ye fɛn kelen na ni @for item in ~list ye. Indent farikolo la; den kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ render siɲɛ kelen element kelen-kelen bɛɛ la.
loops.p2: Index basigilen zeru siri ni tɔgɔ fila sɛbɛn ye: @for item, idx in ~list.
loops.p3: Boli waati bɛ danyɔrɔ nɔfɛtaama ni fɛn yɛrɛ ye ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye. Ka kɔn 10 000-row lisi kan, o musaka ye O(1) DOM baara ye — renderer diffs by reference, not by position.
loops.p4: Denso @for hɔrɔnya la. Kɔnɔna-lupuluw bɛ kɛnɛma-lupulu sirili ye.
loops.p5: Iterasiyɔn sigicogo ye sɛrɛkili sigicogo ye. Walasa ka kɔsegin, i bɛ segin kɔfɛ jatebɔlen dɔ kan: ~reversed := [...].reverse().
loops.li1: Iterasiyɔn farikolo bɛ don a kɔnɔ nivo kelen ka dun ka tɛmɛ @for layini kan.
loops.li2: Farikolo bɛ se ka kɛ fɛn o fɛn ye, hali @for wɛrɛ.

theme.p1: @theme bloki min bɛ dosiye sanfɛ, o bɛ dilancogo tokenw jira iko fɛn caman sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛcogo. Yɛlɛmakɛla walima yɔrɔ o yɔrɔ bɛ Se k’u Lakodɔn ni ~tokenName ye.

imports.h4: Sɛrɛkiliw ka fɛnw donna jamana kɔnɔ
imports.p1: @import "./path/to/file.arx" bɛ @component ni @screen kelen-kelen bɛɛ sama ka bɔ o dosiye in na ka don sisan dakun na. Siraw bɛ tali kɛ fɛnw doncogo filen na.
imports.p2: Imports (donni) tɛ tɔgɔda-yɔrɔw Dabɔ. Tɔgɔw bɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ fɛnw na minnu bɛ na ni u ye — don labanw ye se sɔrɔ. Aw ye yɔrɔw tɔgɔw to u danma.
imports.p3: Segin ka taa jamana wɛrɛw la: re-export daɲɛ koloma tɛ yen. Walasa ka duguma-dosiyɛri kɛ yɔrɔw ciyɛn ye, sanfɛla ta don a kɔnɔ ani k’i ka ɛkranw jira k’u ɲɛsin u ma.
imports.p4: Sɛrɛkiliw bɛ Kɔlɔsi parse waati la. Filen A min bɛ don B min bɛ don A filiw ni cycle sira ye.

define_comp.p1: Aw bɛ yɔrɔ dɔ jira min bɛ se ka baara kɛ kokura ni @component Name param1 param2 ... ye. Farikolo kɔnɔ, tɔgɔla paramɛtɛrɛw bɛ dakun na i n’a fɔ dantigɛli jɛlenw (ni ~ tɛ).
define_comp.p2: Paramɛtiriw bɛ Se ka sɛbɛnni Kɛ ni : Type kɔrɔɲɔgɔnmaya kelen ye. Paramɛtiri minnu ma sɛbɛn, olu bɛ sɔn nafa o nafa ma.
define_comp.p3: slot kɔnɔna na, yɔrɔ dɔ farikolo bɛ taamasiyɛn kɛ welebaga farikolo bɛ don yɔrɔ min na — miiri React denmisɛnw walima Vue default slot.

reactivity.h1: Tracking bɛ baara kɛ cogo min na
reactivity.p1: Reactive kalan bɛɛ bɛ computed expression walima modifier argument kɔnɔ, o bɛ dependency (dafalen) dɔ sɛbɛn. Ni dantigɛli fɛn o fɛn Changé, o fɔcogo bɛ segin ka jateminɛ kɛ mikrotask nata la.
reactivity.p2: Sɛbɛnw bɛ Kɛ kulu ye: baara caman Kɛra ko kɛlenw ɲɛnabɔbaga kelen kɔnɔ, olu bɛ tasuma Kɛ tigitigi render pass kelen na laban na. O de y’a To => ~a = 1 => ~b = 2 ka dɔgɔ hali ni kalanden caman bɛ yen.
reactivity.p3: Bɛɛ ka gɛlɛn (===). Nafa kelen sɛbɛnni tɛ foyi boli kokura. Walasa ka fɛn kuraw wajibiya ni kunnafoni suguyaw ye, i ka sɛrɛkili walima fɛn kura dɔ di.

errors.p1: Parse filiw bɛ tasuma don file-load waati la. Boli waati bɛ layini, kulu ani hakilina dɔ lakali. Sababu minnu ka teli ka sɔrɔ: indent min tɛ bɛn, = tɛ, modifier dɔnbali, string min ma datugu.
errors.p2: Boli waati filiw bɛ tasuma don jateminɛ waati la. A fanba ye walekɛcogo ye — kumasen dɔ bɛ tali kɛ seli la min ma fɔ, walima suguya bɛnbaliya jatebɔ la. Boli waati bɛ sɛbɛnni Kɛ, ka pankarti bilenman dɔ Jira ɲɛjirali kan, ka o karamɔgɔ ka 'kùnnafoni-cimago Tɛmɛ.
errors.p3: Modifier filiw (modifier dɔnbali, argument suguya jugu) bɛ tasuma don parse waati la. Architex bɛ gɛlɛya don fɛn caman sɛmɛntiyacogo dɔnbaliw la walasa ka ɲɛfɛla bɛnkan lakana.
errors.p4: Debugging: ka kumasen siguilen dɔ siri debug(...) la. Boli waati bɛ jateminɛ bɛɛ sɛbɛn konsolɛ kɔnɔ k’a sɔrɔ a ma nafa caman Changé. Aw ni Architex inspecteur ka fara ɲɔgɔn kan walasa ka sen don jamana caman yeli la.
errors.p5: Editeur integration : Architex IDE min bɛ Vortex bot studio kɔnɔ, o bɛ filiw jira waati yɛrɛ la, sanni dosiye ka mara.

bestpractices.p1: Architex bɛ sara di nɔgɔya la. Écran o écran min kalanni ka gɛlɛn, n’a sɔrɔla o bɛ ni nesting levels kelen ye kojugu, inline ternaries kelen ka ca kojugu, walima component kelen bɛ baara fila kɛ.
bestpractices.p2: Ni siga bɛ aw la, aw bɛ a bɔ. @component 5-line, grok ka nɔgɔn ka tɛmɛ 30-line @screen bloc kan.
bestpractices.p3: A ka fisa ni modifierw ye ka tɛmɛ wrapping kan. text :: pad(16) ka fisa ni col :: pad(16) sirili ye.
bestpractices.p4: A to boli waati ka baara kɛ. Manuel hidden darapo minnu bɛ fɛn o fɛn na lisi kɔnɔ, olu ye tiɲɛni ye — boli waati bɛ danfara kaban.
bestpractices.p5: Fɛnw tɔgɔ fɔ kalanden ye, a kana kɛ daɲɛw lajɛbaga ye. ~isLoading > ~l ye.

bestpractices.li2: A man kan ka tɛmɛ 3 kan denso hakɛ — refactor ni a juguman don
bestpractices.li3: A kana tɛmɛ 2 saba kan fɔcogo kelen na — baara kɛ ni jatebɔlan ye
bestpractices.li4: A man kan ka tɛmɛ ɛkran 1 kan filen kelen kɔnɔ — fo ni a sirilen don kosɛbɛ

navigation.p1: Architex bɛ baara Kɛ ni stack-based navigation model ye. goto("Name", arg: val, ...) bɛ ɛkran dɔ gɛrɛntɛ; back() bɛ pop sanfɛ; close() bɛ Mini App bɛɛ gɛn.
navigation.p2: Dalilu minnu tɛmɛna goto fɛ, olu bɛ kɛ fɛn caman sɛgɛsɛgɛli ye laɲini-ɛkran kɔnɔ — k’u jira sanfɛ ni tɔgɔ kelenw ni nafa fɔlɔw ye.
navigation.p3: Jɛɲɔgɔnya juguw: openArx(url) bɛ taa kɛnɛma Architex Mini App dɔ la; openUrl(url) bɛ da wuli sistɛmu navigatɛri kɔnɔ; openChat(room_id) bɛ pan ka taa Vortex so dɔ la.
navigation.p4: Modali jiracogo: present("Name") sanni goto ka gɛrɛntɛ i n’a fɔ sɛbɛnfura min baarakɛla bɛ se ka a bolo digi walasa k’a bila. dismiss() b'a datugu.
navigation.p5: Jamana min bɛ ɛkranw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ : navigatiɔn bɛ ekran kɔrɔ cogoya tiɲɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye. I mago bɛ fɛn minnu na, olu tɛmɛn goto args fɛ; kunnafoniw minnu bɛ mɛn ka tɛmɛ store(key, value) fɛ, olu bɛ to senna.

forms.p1: Donanw bɛ siri sira fila fɛ selilabana dɔ la: input ~email. Sɛbɛnni bɛ selilɛri kuraya; seli kurayali bɛ foro kuraya.
forms.p2: Validation ye jatebɔ boolean ye: ~emailOk := ~email.matches("^[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+$"). Baara kɛ ni hidden / visible fɛn caman sɛmɛntiyalanw ye fili sɛbɛnw kan.
forms.p3: Submit ye ​​butɔni gansan ye min bɛ kɛ ni cakɛda ye. Block submission ka sɔrɔ validation ma ɲɛ disabled(!~formOk) fɛ.
forms.p4: Misali jirali: text walima label jira ni visible(!~fieldOk) ye walasa a ka jira dɔrɔn ni a tɛ baara kɛ. Aw bɛ color(~danger) kɛ walasa ka sinsin ɲɛnamaw kan.
forms.p5: Debouncing: :: debounce(300) fara a kan walasa ka network-backed validation bila kɔfɛ fo baarakɛla ka sɛbɛnni dabila fo 300 ms.
forms.p6: Yɔrɔdacogo: :: placeholder("...") bɛ hakilina dɔ jira ni seli lankolon don. Hint bɛ tunun ni tulonkɛ fɔlɔ ye.
forms.p7: Donan suguyaw: input jɛlen ye sɛbɛnni ye; input.email, input.number, input.password, input.tel, input.date ka klaviyeti ni masike ladilan.
forms.li1: Sigili ye sira fila ye — sɛbɛnni bɛ selilɛri fɛn caman sɛmɛntiya ani a kɔfɛ.

forms.li3: Misaliw jira / dogo ni yecogo sɛmɛntiyalanw ye.

animations.h1: Tɛmɛsira minnu bɛ kɛ ni kɔnɔnafili ye
animations.p1: Architex bɛ ɲɛnamaya kɛ cogo jɛlen na ni nafa dɔ bɛ jatebɔ walima kulɛri caman sɛmɛntiyalan dɔ bila. Tɛmɛsira dafalen ye 200 ms nɔgɔya-bɔ ye. A bɛ tɛmɛ ni :: animate(ms, curve) ye.
animations.p2: Don / bɔ jiginniw : node minnu kɛra cogoya la (hidden / visible) olu bɛ ɲɛnamaya don ani ka bɔ. A bɛ kɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni :: animate.enter(...) ani :: animate.exit(...) ye.
animations.p3: Kurukuruw : ease-out (dafalen), ease-in, ease-in-out, linear, spring. Spring bɛ stiffness ni damping sɔsɔliw ta minnu bɛ se ka kɛ.
animations.p4: Taamaʃyɛnw: :: draggable ani :: swipeable bɛ taamasiyɛnw dɔnbagaw nɔrɔ minnu bɛ bɛn plateforme ma. Aw bɛ fara ɲɔgɔn kan ni reactive state ye ka ɲɛnamaya kɛ drag kan.
animations.p5: Lamaga-lamagali dɔgɔyali : jatigila bɛ baarakɛla ka se sɔrɔli cogoya bonya. Ni reduced-motion bɛ kɛnɛ kan, animations bɛ dɔgɔya ka se 100 ms jukɔrɔ ani ressort curves bɛ kɛ linear ye.

network.p1: send(action: "name", ...args) ye bridge ye ka taa bot host la. Jatigikɛ bɛ JSON RPC cikan sɔrɔ, ka baara kɛ, ka jaabi dɔ segin.
network.p2: O jaabi bɛ Di seli dɔ ma => ~result = it fɛ. it ye segin-ka-bɔnye nafa surun ye.
network.p3: Dɛsɛw bɛ bɔ kɛnɛ kan i n’a fɔ ~result.error. Aw bɛ a lajɛ sani aw ka ~result.data kalan. Baara kɛ ni nested ternaries ye doni / ɲɛtaa / fili cogoyaw kama.
network.p4: Loading states ye i yɛrɛ ka boolean ye: i ka ~loading selilɛri dɔ wuli ka kɔn weleli ɲɛ, ka segin kɔfɛ. spinner yɔrɔ dɔ jira min da bɛ ~loading kan.
network.p5: Siya cogoyaw : ni baarakɛla ye send daminɛ siɲɛ fila sanni fɔlɔ ka ɲɛnabɔ, filanan bɛ seli sɛbɛn a kan. Walasa ka a bali, da ni disabled(~loading).

a11y.p2: Focus order bɛ tugu source order kɔ ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye. Aw bɛ a dabila ni :: a11yOrder(n) ye walasa ka layidu kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw sɔrɔ.
a11y.p3: Dynamic Type: sɛbɛnni caman sɛmɛntiyabagaw bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ ni OS ka sɔrɔcogo sɛbɛnnibolo hakɛ ye fo ka se 200 %% ma k’a sɔrɔ u ma tigɛ. Boli waati bɛ segin-ka-bɔ minɛnw kan.
a11y.p4: Danfaraba cogoya : fɛn caman sɛmɛntiyabagaw minnu kɔkanna jɛlen don, olu bɛ fasa opaque sɔrɔ; dancɛw bɛ bugɔ ka bɔ 1 px la ka se 2 px ma. Otomatiki — kode si mago tɛ ka tɛmɛ barokun tokenw bonya kan.
a11y.p5: Kulɛri danfara: Vortex ka barokun dafalen bɛ WCAG AA (4.5:1) kunbɛn yeelen ni dibi cogoya fila bɛɛ la. Barokun minnu bɛ kɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni mɔgɔw sago ye, olu ka kan ka danfara kɔrɔbɔ ni kulɛri danfara baarakɛminɛn o baarakɛminɛn ye sani u ka ci.

performance.h3: Aw ye aw yɛrɛ tanga baara ma tulonkɛ bɛɛ la
performance.p1: Reactivité ye fine-grained ye: components dɔrɔn minnu bɛ selil re-render caman caman kalan. I bɛ fɛn o fɛn sɛbɛn "fu" o tɛ jiri dafalen segin-ka-bɔnye daminɛ.
performance.p2: Fɛn ba caman lisɛli bɛ ɲɛ. Boli waati bɛ danfara Bɔ element identité fɛ, o la prepending ye O(1) ye. Aw ye aw yɛrɛ tanga jatebɔ kumasenw ma minnu bɛ segin ka lisi bɛɛ jateminɛ fɛn caman Changement bɛɛ kan — ka baara tiɲɛ ka kɛ jatebɔ seliw ye minnu bɛ kɛ fɛn kelen-kelen bɛɛ la.
performance.p3: Fɛn minnu bɛ don ni frequence (fɔkan) caman ye : baara kɛ ni :: debounce(ms) ye input o input kan min bɛ rezo weleli daminɛ. A ka c’a la, 300 ms ye tiɲɛ ye.
performance.p4: Bundle hakɛ: Architex parser + renderer bɛ 30 KB gzipped jukɔrɔ. I ka .arx filen b’a yɛrɛ bonya fara a kan — jaw bila ka bɔ bundle kɔnɔ ani k’u doni ni URL ye.

runtime.p1: Architex baarakɛcogo ye TypeScript pake ye min bɔra ni tɔgɔ ye ko architex. Module naani b'a la: lexer, parser, renderer, reactive.
runtime.p2: Lexer bɛ source text kalan ani ka tokenw bɔ. O ye yɔrɔ kelen ye min b’a janto yɔrɔ finman na — duguma-module bɛɛ bɛ baara kɛ tokenw ni AST nodes kan.
runtime.p3: Parser bɛ AST dɔ jɔ. AST nodes bɛ sɛbɛn ani ka seriyali kɛ walasa u ka se ka ci ka tɛmɛ processus dancɛw kan (nafa bɛ hot-reload ani remote preview la).
runtime.p4: Renderer bɛ taama AST la ni render context ye min dira jatigila fɛ (web DOM / SwiftUI bridge / Compose bridge) ani ka native views bɔ.
runtime.p5: Jatigiw bɛ 'interface (dakun) fitinin dɔ Kɛ: createNode, updateNode, removeNode, ka Fàra modifier application (daɲɛgafe-minɛn) kan. Jatigila kura farali bɛ kola kode 500 ɲɔgɔn ta.

testing.h1: Sisi min sinsinnen bɛ ɲɛjirali kan
testing.p1: Kɔrɔbɔli nɔgɔman ye ɲɛjirali ɲɛnama ye. Aw ye aw ka ekran da wuli, ka butɔni ni donnakow bɛɛ kɛ, ka jamana taabolo lajɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛlikɛla kɔnɔ.
testing.p2: Snapshot tests: boli waati bɛ se ka jiri min jiralen don, o ka seriyali kɛ ka se JSON ma. Aw bɛ jaaw suma ɲɔgɔn na ka kɔn kode caman cili ɲɛ / kɔfɛ ni diff baarakɛminɛn suguya bɛɛ ye.
testing.p3: Jamana sɛgɛsɛgɛliw : ka selilu reactivew boli porogaramu kɔnɔ ni runtime.setCell("name", value) ye; assert on rendered bɔli. Good ka ɲɛsin kɔsegin sɛgɛsɛgɛli jatebɔ ma.
testing.p4: Jɛɲɔgɔnya sɛgɛsɛgɛliw ni bot ye : bot studio bɛ "disiki" mode min bɛ send() cikan bɛɛ minɛ; segin-ka-bɔnyew bɛ segin-ka-bɔnyew lasegin sɛbɛnni kan.
testing.p5: CI: ka ja dɔw bila ka taa i n’a fɔ bot bɔli yɔrɔ dɔ. Regression (kɔsegin) min bɛ rendering (fɔcogo) la, o bɛ farali bali.
testing.li1: Preview ye lafasali sira fɔlɔ ye.
testing.li2: Snapshot sɛgɛsɛgɛliw bɛ UI kɔseginw minɛ minnu kɛra kasaara la.
testing.li3: Jamana sɛgɛsɛgɛliw bɛ jatebɔ hakilinaw dege k’a sɔrɔ u ma maga DOM la.
testing.li4: Integration tests bɛ segin ka send() sɛbɛnniw kɛ bot kan.

faq.p1: J: Yala ne bɛ se ka appli dafalen sɛbɛn Architex kɔnɔ wa? A: Architex dabɔra Mini Apps — ekran minnu bɛ balo baro kɔnɔ. Walasa ka app native dafalen sɔrɔ i b’a fɛ SwiftUI / Compose / React.
faq.p2: J: A ni Flutter bɛ se ka suma cogo di? A: Flutter ka bon kosɛbɛ nka a boli waati bɛ a yɛrɛ la (Dart VM + Skia). Architex ka dɔgɔn wa a bɛ baara Kɛ jatigila primitives (jatigila fɔlɔw) kan. Ni aw mago bɛ plateforme lock-in la, Flutter; ni aw mago bɛ se sɔrɔli la, Architex.
faq.p3: J: Mun na if bloki tɛ yen? A: Sabula hidden / visible sɛmɛntiyalanw bɛ UI saratiw 95%% datugu ka saniya kosɛbɛ. 5%% tɔw ta la, fɔcogo saba bɛ baara kɛ.
faq.p4: J: Yala Architex da yelennen don wa? A: Ɔwɔ — aw ye GitHub repo lajɛ. MIT-lase bɛ boli waati min na, patɔrɔn ka sɛrɛw tɛ yen.
faq.p5: J: N bɛ se ka native code wele wa? A: Dɔrɔn jatigila-exposed built-ins walima bot send() walew fɛ. Direct native-bridge ye laɲini kɛ ka dɛmɛn — a tun bɛna portability tiɲɛ.
faq.p6: J: Max ekran complexité? A: Boli waati bɛ 10 k reactive cells ani 100 k list items ɲɛnabɔ ka ɲɛ. O kɔfɛ, i ka i kari ka don ekran caman na.
faq.p7: J: Yala ne bɛ se ka persist state wa? A: Ɔwɔ, store(key, value) fɛ (per-Mini-App local) walima send(action: "save") fɛ ka taa bot fɛ (server-side).
faq.p8: J: Yala a bɛ baara kɛ ni ɛntɛrinɛti tɛ wa? A: Ɔwɔ ka ɲɛsin pure-UI ekranw ma. Fɛn o fɛn bɛ wele send(), o mago bɛ rezo la.
faq.p9: J: Ne bɛ se ka ladamu yɔrɔ dɔ fara a kan cogo di? A: Wala @component Architex kɔnɔ, walima (n’i mago bɛ native primitives) la) ka dɛmɛ don Architex jatigila pake la.
faq.p10: J: Performance overhead vs bololasɛbɛnni native? A: A ka c’a la, 3-8 %% ka surun ka tɛmɛ bololasɛbɛnni SwiftUI / Compose kan. Hadamaden-min tɛ ye ka ɲɛsin ekran nɔrɔlenw ma.

faq.li2: Max file: 1 MB .arx sɔrɔyɔrɔ ka kɔn lasɔminiw ɲɛ.

gotchas.p1: Architex bɛ baara Kɛ ni yɔrɔ 2 ye indent level kelen-kelen bɛɛ la. Tabw bɛ ban parse waati la. IDE fanba bɛ fɛn caman sɛmɛntiya u yɛrɛma; ni aw ye filiw ye indent kɔnɔ minnu ma labɛn, aw bɛ yɔrɔ finman ɲagaminenw lajɛ.
gotchas.p2: Dadon minnu bɛ jatebɔ jiracogo la, olu bɛ selilu reactives kalan jateminɛ waati la, a tɛ kalan declaration waati la. ~a := ~b + 1 bɛ baara kɛ ni sisan ~b ye tuma bɛɛ, a tɛ baara kɛ ni nafa ye fɔli waati.
gotchas.p3: Async send() bɛ baara Di seli ma ni Layidu in ɲɛnabɔra, o bɛ Se ka Kɛ 'kɔnɔna na ni cikan caman bɛ Fɔ. Kɔlɔsili ni ~loading darapo walima ɲɔgɔndan nimɔrɔ ye.
gotchas.p4: Jatigɛwale suguya: "5" + 1 bɛ jateminɛ kɛ ka se "51" ma, a tɛ jateminɛ kɛ ka se 6 ma. Aw bɛ baara kɛ ni Number("5") ye walima ka kunnafoni di selilɛri kan ko : number.

gotchas.p6: Ladilikan sigicogo denbaya kɔnɔ: kulɛri caman sɛmɛntiyabagaw bɛ sɛbɛnnikɛla laban-seginw ɲɛnabɔ. Aw kana cakɛda color(...) fila siri ka ɲagami makɔnɔ.

gotchas.h3_c: "Async surprises" fɛɛrɛ in jiginna Vortex bɔliw bɛɛ la. O dilancogo bɛ tali kɛ ciden tɛmɛnenw ka ɲininiw ni u dilanni kɛcogo bɔlenw na. Version tariku min bɛ `CHANGELOG.md` kɔnɔ, o bɛ sɛbɛnni kɛ waati min na a yɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ jigira ani min y’a bila.
gotchas.h4_a: Jatigɛwale suguya: "5" + 1 bɛ jateminɛ kɛ ka se "51" ma, a tɛ jateminɛ kɛ ka se 6 ma. Aw bɛ baara kɛ ni Number("5") ye walima ka kunnafoni di selilɛri kan ko : number.
